##### *[PTS Page 078]*

[25. Annasaṃsāvaka.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ gacchantaṃ antarāpaṇe /  
kañcanagghiyasaṅkāsaṃ dvattiṃsavaralakkhaṇaṃ[^078-1]  // ApTha_3,25.1 //  
Siddhatthaṃ lokapajjotaṃ appameyyaṃ anopamaṃ[^078-2] /  
alatthaṃ[^078-3] paramaṃ pītiṃ[^078-4] disvā dantaṃ jutindharaṃ.  // ApTha_3,25.2 //  
Sambuddhaṃ atināmetvā bhojayiṃ taṃ[^078-5] mahāmuṇiṃ /  
muni kāruṇiko[^078-6] nātho anumodi[^078-7] ca maṃ[^078-8] tadā.  // ApTha_3,25.3 //  
Tasmiṃ mahākāruṇike paramassāsakārake /  
Buddhe cittaṃ pasādetvā kappam saggamhi mod'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_3,25.4 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bhikkhadānass idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_3,25.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_3,25.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Annasaṃsāvako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Annasaṃsāvakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[26. Dhūpadāyaka.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
kuṭidhūpaṃ[^078-9] mayā dinnaṃ vippasannena cetasā.  // ApTha_3,26.1 //  
Yaṃ yaṃ yonupapajjāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ /  
sabbesam pi piyo homi dhūpadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_3,26.2 //  
Catunavut'; ito kappe yaṃ dhūpam adadiṃ tadā[^078-10] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi dhūpadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_3,26.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_3,26.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Dhūpadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Dhūpadāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 079 -->
<a id="page-079"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 079]*

[27. Puḷinapājaka.] Vipassissa bhagavato bodhiyā pādamuttame /  
purāṇaṃ puḷinaṃ[^079-1] chaḍḍetvā suddhaṃ puḷinam ākiriṃ.  // ApTha_3,27.1 //  
Ekanavut'; ito kappe yaṃ puḷinam adās'; ahaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi puḷinadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_3,27.2 //  
Tipaññāse ito kappe rājā āsiṃ janādhibhū /  
Mahāpuḷino nāmena cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_3,27.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_3,27.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Puḷinapūjako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Puḷinapūjakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[28. Uttiya.] Candabhāgānadītīre suṃsumāro ahaṃ tadā /  
sabhojanapasutāhaṃ nadītitthaṃ agañchi 'haṃ.[^079-2]  // ApTha_3,28.1 //  
Siddhattho tamhi samaye sayambhū aggapuggalo /  
nadiṃ[^079-3] taritukāmo so nadītitthaṃ upāgamī.  // ApTha_3,28.2 //  
Upāgate ca sambuddhe aham pi tatth'; upāgamiṃ /  
upagantvāna sambuddhaṃ imaṃ vācam udīrayiṃ:  // ApTha_3,28.3 //  
Abhirūha mahāvīra tāressāmi[^079-4] ahaṃ tavaṃ[^079-5] /  
pettikaṃ[^079-6] visayaṃ mayhaṃ anukampa mahāmuṇi.  // ApTha_3,28.4 //  
Mama uggajjanaṃ sutvā abhirūhi mahāmuni /  
haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena tāresiṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_3,28.5 //  
Nadiyā pārime[^079-7] tīre Siddhattho lokanāyako /  
assāsesi maman tattha: amataṃ pāpuṇissasi.  // ApTha_3,28.6 //  
Tamhā kāyā cavitvāna devalokaṃ agañch'; ahaṃ /  
dibbaṃ sukhaṃ anubhaviṃ accharāhi purakkhato.  // ApTha_3,28.7 //  
Sattakkhattuñ ca devindo devarajjam akās'; ahaṃ[^079-8] /  
tīṇikkhattuñ cakkavattī mahiyā issaro ahuṃ.  // ApTha_3,28.8 //


<!-- PTS Page 080 -->
<a id="page-080"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 080]*

Vivekam anuyutto 'haṃ nipako ca susaṃvuto /  
dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane.  // ApTha_3,28.9 //  
Catunavut'; ito kappe tāresiṃ[^080-1] yaṃ narāsabhaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi taraṇāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_3,28.10 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_3,28.11 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Uttiyo thero[^080-2] imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Uttiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[29. Ekañjalika.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ gacchantaṃ antarāpaṇe /  
Vipassi-satthavāhaggaṃ naravīraṃ vināyakaṃ  // ApTha_3,29.1 //  
Adantadamanaṃ[^080-3] tādiṃ mahāvādiṃ[^080-4] mahāmuniṃ[^080-5] /  
disvā pasanno sumano ekañjalim akās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_3,29.2 //  
Ekanavut'; ito kappe yam añjalim kariṃ tadā[^080-6] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi añjalissa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_3,29.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_3,29.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ekañjaliko thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Ekañjalikatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[30. Khomadāyaka.] *Nagare Bandhumati*yā ahosiṃ[^080-7] vāṇijo tadā /  
ten'; eva dāraṃ[^080-8] posemi ropemi bījasampadaṃ.  // ApTha_3,30.1 //  
Rathiyaṃ paṭipannassa Vipassissa mahesino /  
ekaṃ khomaṃ mayā dinnaṃ kusalatthāya satthuno.  // ApTha_3,30.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 081 -->
<a id="page-081"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 081]*

Ekanavute ito kappe *yaṃ khomam adadiṃ tadā* /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi khomadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_3,30.3 //  
Sattavīse ito kappe eko Sindhavasandano[^081-1] /  
sattaratanasampanno cātuddīpamhi issaro.  // ApTha_3,30.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_3,30.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Khomadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Khomadāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Subhūti Upavāno[^081-2] ca Saraṇo[^081-3] Sīlagā*hako Annasaṃsāvako Dhūpo* Puḷino Uttiyena ca. Añjalī Khomadāyī ca das'; eva tatiye gaṇe[^081-4] pañcāsītisataṃ vuttā gāthāyo sabbapiṇḍitā. Subhūti vaggo tatiyo. Catutthaṃ[^081-5] bhāṇavāraṃ.

[IV. KUṆḌADHĀNAVAGGO.]

[31. Kuṇḍadhāna.] Sattāhaṃ patisallīnaṃ sayambhuṃ[^081-6] aggapuggalaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃ.  // ApTha_4,31.1 //  
Vuṭṭhitaṃ kālam aññāya Padumuttaramahāmuṇiṃ /  
mahantaṃ kadalīkaṇṇiṃ[^081-7] gahetvā upagañch'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_4,31.2 //  
Paṭiggahetvā[^081-8] bhagavā taṃ phalaṃ[^081-9] lokanāyako /  
mama cittaṃ pasādento paribhuñji mahāmuṇi.  // ApTha_4,31.3 //  
Paribhuñjitvā sambuddho satthavāho anuttaro /  
sakāsane[^081-10] nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_4,31.4 //


<!-- PTS Page 082 -->
<a id="page-082"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 082]*

Ye vasanti sametāro[^082-1] yakkhā imamhi pabbate /  
araññe bhūtabhavyāni[^082-2] sunantu vacanaṃ mama.  // ApTha_4,31.5 //  
Yo so buddhaṃ upaṭṭhāsi migarājā va kesarī[^082-3] /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_4,31.6 //  
‘So'; yam ekādasakkhattuṃ[^082-4] devarājā bhavissati /  
catuttiṃsatikkhattuṃ ca cakkavattī bhavissati.  // ApTha_4,31.7 //  
Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma gottena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_4,31.8 //  
Akkositvāna samaṇe sīlavante anāsave /  
pāpakammavipākena nāmadheyyaṃ labhissati.  // ApTha_4,31.9 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Koṇḍadhāno[^082-5] ti nāmena sāvako so bhavissati.';  // ApTha_4,31.10 //  
Pavivekam[^082-6] anuyutto jhāyī jhānarato ahaṃ /  
tosayitvāna satthāraṃ viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_4,31.11 //  
Sāvakaggehi[^082-7] parivuto bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhato /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā salākaṃ gāhayī jino.  // ApTha_4,31.12 //  
Ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā vanditvā lokanāyakaṃ /  
vadataṃ varassa[^082-8] purato paṭhamaṃ aggahes'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_4,31.13 //  
Tena kammena bhagavā dasasahassīpakampako[^082-9] /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā agge ṭhāne[^082-10] ṭhapesi maṃ.  // ApTha_4,31.14 //  
Viriyaṃ me dhuradhorayhaṃ yogakkhemādhivāhanaṃ /  
dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane.  // ApTha_4,31.15 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_4,31.16 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kuṇḍadhāno[^082-11] thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Kuṇḍadhānattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 083 -->
<a id="page-083"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 083]*

[32. Sāgata.] Sobhito nāma nāmena ahosiṃ[^083-1] brāhmaṇo tadā /  
purakkhato sasissehi ārāmaṃ agamās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_4,32.1 //  
Bhagavā tamhi[^083-2] samaye bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhato /  
ā*rāmadvārā nikkhamma a*ṭṭhāsi purisuttamo.  // ApTha_4,32.2 //  
Tam addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ dantaṃ dantapurakkhataṃ /  
sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā santhaviṃ[^083-3] lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_4,32.3 //  
Ye keci pādapā sabbe mahiyā te virūhare /  
buddhimanto[^083-4] tathā sattā rūhanti jinasāsane.  // ApTha_4,32.4 //  
Satthavāho *'si sappañ*ño panesi[^083-5] bahuke jane /  
vipathā[^083-6] uddharitvāna[^083-7] pathaṃ ācikkhase tuvaṃ.  // ApTha_4,32.5 //  
Danto dantaparikiṇṇo[^083-8] jhāyī jhānaratehi ca /  
ātāpi-pahitattehi upasantehi tādihi.  // ApTha_4,32.6 //  
Alaṅkato parisato sahagaṇehi[^083-9] sobhasi /  
pabhā niddhāvate tuyhaṃ suriyo 'bbhaghane yathā.[^083-10]  // ApTha_4,32.7 //  
Pasannacittaṃ disvāna mahesi Padumuttaro /  
bhikkhusaṅghe ṭhito satthā[^083-11] imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_4,32.8 //  
"Yo so hāsaṃ[^083-12] janetvāna[^083-13] mamam kittesi brāhmaṇo /  
kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ devaloke ramissati.  // ApTha_4,32.9 //  
Tusitāhi cavitvāna sukkamūlena codito /  
Gotamassa bhagavato sāsane pabbajissati.  // ApTha_4,32.10 //  
Vimbakapasuto hutvā arahattaṃ labhissati[^083-14] /  
Sāgato nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako".  // ApTha_4,32.11 //  
Pabbajitvāna kāyena pāpaṃ kammaṃ[^083-15] vivajjayiṃ[^083-16] /  
vacīduccaritaṃ hitvā ājīvaṃ parisodhayiṃ.  // ApTha_4,32.12 //


<!-- PTS Page 084 -->
<a id="page-084"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 084]*

Evaṃ viharamāno 'haṃ tejodhātūsu[^084-1] kovido /  
sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_4,32.13 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_4,32.14 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sāgato thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sāgatattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[33. Mahā-Kaccāna.] Padumuttarassa nāthassa padumaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ /  
sīhāsanaṃ[^084-2] kārayitvā[^084-3] suvaṇṇenābhilepayiṃ.  // ApTha_4,33.1 //  
Ratanāmayachattañ ca paggayha vālavījaniṃ[^084-4] /  
buddhassa abhiropesiṃ lokabandhussa[^084-5] tādino.  // ApTha_4,33.2 //  
Yāvatā devatā bhummā sabbe sannipatuṃ tadā /  
ratanāsanachattānaṃ vipākaṃ kathayissati.  // ApTha_4,33.3 //  
Tañ ca sabbaṃ suṇissāma kathayantassa satthuno /  
bhiyyohāsaṃ[^084-6] janeyyāma sammāsambuddhasāsane.  // ApTha_4,33.4 //  
He*māsane* nisīditvā sayambhū aggapuggalo /  
bhikkhusaṅghaparibbūḷho[^084-7] imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_4,33.5 //  
Yen'; idaṃ āsanaṃ dinnaṃ sovaṇṇaratanāmayaṃ /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_4,33.6 //  
Tiṃsakappāni devindo devarajjaṃ karissati /  
samantā yojanasataṃ ābhāyābhibhavissati.[^084-8]  // ApTha_4,33.7 //  
Manussalokaṃ āgantvā cakka vatti bhavissati. /  
Pabhassaro ti nāmena uggatejo bhavissati.  // ApTha_4,33.8 //  
Divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ sataraṃsīva uggato /  
samantā aṭṭharatanaṃ ujjotessati khattiyo.  // ApTha_4,33.9 //  
Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_4,33.10 //


<!-- PTS Page 085 -->
<a id="page-085"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 085]*

Tusītāhi cavitvāna sukkamūlena codito /  
Kaccāno nāma nāmena brahmabandhu bhavissati.  // ApTha_4,33.11 //  
So pacchā pabbajitvāna arahā hessati 'nāsavo[^085-1] /  
Gotamo lokapajjoto aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapessati.  // ApTha_4,33.12 //  
Saṅkhittaṃ pucchitaṃ pañhaṃ vitthārena kathessati /  
kathayanto ca taṃ pañhaṃ ajjhāsaṃ[^085-2] pūrayissati.  // ApTha_4,33.13 //  
Aḍḍhe kule abhijāto brāhmaṇo mantapāragū /  
ohāya dhanadhaññāni[^085-3] pabbajiṃ[^085-4] anagāriyaṃ.  // ApTha_4,33.14 //  
Saṅkhittenāpi pucchante vitthārena kathem'; ahaṃ /  
ajjhāsan tesaṃ pūremi tosemi dipaduttamaṃ.  // ApTha_4,33.15 //  
Tosito me mahāvīro sayambhū aggapuggalo /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ.  // ApTha_4,33.16 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_4,33.17 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Mahākaccāno thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Mahākaccānattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[34. Kāludāyi.] Padumuttarassa buddhassa[^085-5] lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
aḍḍhānaṃ paṭipannassa carato[^085-6] cārikaṃ tadā,  // ApTha_4,34.1 //  
Suphullaṃ padumaṃ gayha uppalaṃ mallikañ c'; ahaṃ /  
paramannaṃ gahetvāna adāsiṃ satthuno ahaṃ.  // ApTha_4,34.2 //  
Paribhuñji mahāvīro paramannaṃ subhojanaṃ /  
tañ ca pupphaṃ gahetvāna janassa[^085-7] sampadassayi.[^085-8]  // ApTha_4,34.3 //  
Iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ ciraṃ[^085-9] loke jalajaṃ puppham uttamaṃ /  
Sudukkaraṃ tena kataṃ yo me puppham adāsi so.  // ApTha_4,34.4 //


<!-- PTS Page 086 -->
<a id="page-086"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 086]*

Yo puppham abhiropesi paramannañ ca 'dāsi me /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_4,34.5 //  
*Dasa c'; aṭṭha ca* kkhattuñ so[^086-1] devarajjaṃ karissati /  
uppalaṃ padumaṃ cāpi mallikañ ca taduttariṃ.[^086-2]  // ApTha_4,34.6 //  
Assa puññāvipākena dibbagandhasamāyutaṃ /  
ākāse chadanaṃ katvā dhārayissati tāvade.  // ApTha_4,34.7 //  
Pañcavīsatikkhattuñ ca cakkavatti bhavissati /  
*paṭhavyā rajjaṃ* pañcasataṃ vasudhaṃ āvasissati.  // ApTha_4,34.8 //  
Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma gottena[^086-3] satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_4,34.9 //  
Sakakammābhiraddho so sukkamūlena codito /  
Sakyānaṃ[^086-4] nandijanano ñātibandhu bhavissati.  // ApTha_4,34.10 //  
So ca pacchā pabbajitvā[^086-5] sukkamūlena codito /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'[^086-6] anāsavo.  // ApTha_4,34.11 //  
Paṭisambhidā c'; anuppattam katakiccam anāsavaṃ /  
Gotamo lokabandhu so etadagge ṭhapessati.  // ApTha_4,34.12 //  
Padhānaṃ pahitatto so upasanto nirūpadhi /  
Udāyi nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_4,34.13 //  
Cittañ ca suvimuttam me māno makkho ca dhaṃsito[^086-7] /  
sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_4,34.14 //  
Tosayiñ cāpi[^086-8] sambuddham ātāpī nipako ahaṃ /  
pamodito ca sambuddho etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ.  // ApTha_4,34.15 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_4,34.16 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kāludāyi thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Kāludāyittherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 087 -->
<a id="page-087"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 087]*

[35. Mogharāja.] Atthadassī tu bhagavā sayambhū aparājito /  
bhikkhusaṅghaparibbūḷho rathiyaṃ paṭipajjatha.  // ApTha_4,35.1 //  
Sissehi samparivuto[^087-1] gharamhā[^087-2] abhinikkhamiṃ[^087-3] /  
nikkhamitvān'; ahaṃ tattha addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_4,35.2 //  
Abhivādetvāna sambuddhaṃ sire katvāna añjaliṃ[^087-4] /  
sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā santhaviṃ[^087-5] lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_4,35.3 //  
Yāvatā rūpino sattā arūpī vā asaññino /  
sabbe te tava ñaṇamhi anto honti samāhaṭā.[^087-6]  // ApTha_4,35.4 //  
Sumacchikena jālena udakaṃ yo parikkhipe /  
ye keci udake pāṇā antojāle bhavanti te.  // ApTha_4,35.5 //  
Yesañ ca cetanā atthi *rūpi*no ca arūpino /  
sabbe te tava ñāṇamhi anto honti samāhaṭā.[^087-7]  // ApTha_4,35.6 //  
Samuddharas'; imaṃ lokaṃ andhakārasamākulaṃ /  
tava dhammaṃ suṇitvāna kaṅkhāsotaṃ taranti te.  // ApTha_4,35.7 //  
Avijjānivuto loko andhakārena otthaṭo /  
*tava ñāṇamhi* jotante[^087-8] andhakārā padhaṃsitā.  // ApTha_4,35.8 //  
Tuvaṃ cakkhu 'si sabbesaṃ mahātamapanūdano[^087-9] /  
tava dhammaṃ suṇitvāna nibbāyati[^087-10] bahujjano.  // ApTha_4,35.9 //  
Piṭharaṃ[^087-11] pūrayitvāna madhukhuddaṃ aneḷakaṃ /  
ubhohatthehi paggayha upanesiṃ[^087-12] mahesi*no.*  // ApTha_4,35.10 //  
*Paṭigaṇhi* mahāvīro subhakena mahāisi /  
bhuñjitvā tañ ca[^087-13] sabbaññū vehāsan[^087-14] nabham uggami.  // ApTha_4,35.11 //  
Antalikkhe ṭhito satthā Atthadassī narāsabho /  
mama cittaṃ pasādento imā gāthā abhāsathā:  // ApTha_4,35.12 //  
Yen'; idaṃ thavitaṃ[^087-15] ñā*naṃ buddhaseṭṭho ca* thomito /  
tena cittappasādena duggatiṃ so na gacchati.  // ApTha_4,35.13 //  
Catuddasañ ca khattuṃ so devarajjaṃ karissati /  
padesarajjaṭṭhasataṃ[^087-16] vasudhaṃ āvasissati.  // ApTha_4,35.14 //


<!-- PTS Page 088 -->
<a id="page-088"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 088]*

Pañc'; eva[^088-1] satakkhattuñ ca cakkavattī bhavissati /  
padesa*rajjaṃ asaṅkheyaṃ[^088-2] mahiyā* kārayissati.  // ApTha_4,35.15 //  
Ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedāna pāragū /  
Gotamassa bhagavato sāsane pabbajissati.  // ApTha_4,35.16 //  
Gambhīraṃ nipuṇaṃ atthaṃ ñāṇena vicinissati /  
Mogharājā ti nāmena hessati *satthu sāvako*  // ApTha_4,35.17 //  
Tīhi vijjāhi sampanno katakicco anāsavo /  
Gotamo satthavāhaggo etadagge ṭhapessati.  // ApTha_4,35.18 //  
Hitvā mānusakaṃ yogaṃ chetvāna bhavabandhanaṃ /  
sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_4,35.19 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_4,35.20 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Mogharājā thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Mogharājattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[36. Adhimutta.] Nibbute lokanāthamhi Atthadassi-naruttame[^088-3] /  
nimantetvā bhikkhusaṅgham vippasannena cetasā  // ApTha_4,36.1 //  
Nimantetvā saṅgharatanaṃ ujubhūtaṃ samāhitaṃ /  
ucchunā maṇḍapaṃ[^088-4] katvā bhojesiṃ[^088-5] saṅgham uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_4,36.2 //  
Yaṃ yaṃ yonūpapajjāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ /  
sabbe satte atihomi puññakammass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_4,36.3 //  
Aṭṭhārase kappasate yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ucchudānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_4,36.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_4,36.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Adhimutto thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Adhimuttattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 089 -->
<a id="page-089"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 089]*

[37. Lasuṇadāyaka.] Himavantass'; avidūre tāpaso ās'; ahaṃ tadā /  
lasuṇaṃ upajivāmi lasuṇaṃ mayhaṃ bhojanaṃ.[^089-1]  // ApTha_4,37.1 //  
Khāriyo[^089-2] pūrayitvāna saṅghārāmaṃ agañch'; ahaṃ /  
haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena saṅghassa lasuṇaṃ adaṃ.  // ApTha_4,37.2 //  
Vipassissa naraggassa sāsane niratass'; ahaṃ /  
saṅghassa lasuṇaṃ datvā kappaṃ saggamhi mod'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_4,37.3 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe lasuṇaṃ yam adan tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi lasuṇānaṃ[^089-3] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_4,37.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_4,37.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Lasuṇadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Lasuṇadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[38. Āyāgadāyaka.] Nibbute lokanāthamhi Sikhimhi vadataṃ[^089-4] vare /  
haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena avandiṃ[^089-5] thūpam uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_4,38.1 //  
Vaḍḍhakehi kathāpetvā mūlan datvān'; ahaṃ tadā /  
haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena āyāgaṃ kārapes'[^089-6] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_4,38.2 //  
Aṭṭhakappāni devesu abbhocchinnaṃ vasim ahaṃ /  
avasesesu kappesu vokiṇṇaṃ saṃsarim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_4,38.3 //  
Kāye visaṃ na kamati[^089-7] satthāni *na ca ha*nti me /  
udake 'haṃ na miyyāmi āyāgassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_4,38.4 //  
Yad'; icchāmi ahaṃ[^089-8] vassaṃ mahāmegho pavassati /  
devā pi me vasaṃ enti puññakammass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_4,38.5 //  
Sataratanasampanno tiṃsakkhattuṃ ahos'; ahaṃ /  
na maṃ kecāvajānanti[^089-9] puññakammass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_4,38.6 //


<!-- PTS Page 090 -->
<a id="page-090"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 090]*

Ekatiṃse ito kappe āyāgaṃ yam akārayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi āyāgassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_4,38.7 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_4,38.8 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Āyāgodāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Āyāgadāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[39. Dhammacakkika.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato sīhāsanassa sammukhā /  
dhammacakkaṃ mayā ṭhapitaṃ sukataṃ viññuvaṇṇitaṃ.[^090-1]  // ApTha_4,39.1 //  
Cāruvaṇṇo va sobhāmi sayoggabalavāhano /  
parivārenti maṃ niccaṃ anuyuttā bahujjanā.  // ApTha_4,39.2 //  
Saṭṭhiṃ[^090-2] turiyasahassehi parivārem'[^090-3] ahaṃ sadā /  
parivārena sobhāmi puññakammass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_4,39.3 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ cakkaṃ ṭhapayim ahaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi dhammacakkass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_4,39.4 //  
Ito ekādase kappe aṭṭh'; āsiṃsu janādhipā /  
Sahassarājā nāmena cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_4,39.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_4,39.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Dhammacakkikothero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Dhammacakkikatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[40. Kapparukkhiya.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato thūpaseṭṭhassa sammukhā /  
vicittadusse laṅghetvā[^090-4] kapparukkhaṃ ṭhapes'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_4,40.1 //  
Yaṃ yaṃ *yonūpapajjāmi devattaṃ* atha mānusaṃ /  
sobhayanto mama dvāraṃ kapparukkho patiṭṭhati.  // ApTha_4,40.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 091 -->
<a id="page-091"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 091]*

Ahañ ca parisā c'; eva ye keci mama nissitā[^091-1] /  
tamhā dussaṃ gahetvāna nivāsema mayaṃ sadā.  // ApTha_4,40.3 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ rukkhaṃ[^091-2] ṭhapayiṃ[^091-3] tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi kapparukkhass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_4,40.4 //  
Ito ca sattame[^091-4] kappe Sucelā aṭṭha khattiyā /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_4,40.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_4,40.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kapparukkhiyo thero imā gāthāyo{abhāsitthā} ti. Kapparukkhiyatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Tass'; Uddānaṃ: Kuṇḍa[^091-5]-Sāgata-Kaccānā Udāyī Rājasavhayo Adhimutto Lasuṇado Āyāgī[^091-6] Dhammacakkiko. Kapparukkhī ca dasamo gāthā dvādasa sataṃ[^091-7] ti. Kuṇḍadhānavaggo[^091-8] catuttho.

[V. UPĀLIVAGGO.]

[41. Upāli.] Khiṇāsavasahassehi parivuto lokanāyako /  
vivekam anuyutto so gacchate paṭisallituṃ.  // ApTha_5,41.1 //  
Ajinena nivattho 'haṃ tidaṇḍaparicāraṇo[^091-9] /  
bhikkhusaṅghaparibbūḷhaṃ[^091-10] addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_5,41.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 092 -->
<a id="page-092"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 092]*

Ekaṃsaṃ ajinaṃ katvā sire katvāna añjaliṃ /  
sambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā santhaviṃ[^092-1] lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_5,41.3 //  
Yathāṇḍajā ca saṃsedā opapātī jalābujā /  
kākādipakkhino sabbe antalikkhe padesagā.[^092-2]  // ApTha_5,41.4 //  
Ye keci pāṇabhūt'; atthi saññino va asaññino /  
sabbe te tava ñāṇamhi anto honti samogadhā.[^092-3]  // ApTha_5,41.5 //  
Gandhā ca[^092-4] pabbateyyā ye[^092-5] Himavante naguttame /  
sabbe te tava sīlamhi kalāyo pi[^092-6] na yujjare.  // ApTha_5,41.6 //  
Mohandhakāraṃ[^092-7] pakkhanto[^092-8] ayaṃ loko sadevako /  
tava ñāṇamhi jotante andhakārā vidhaṃsitā.  // ApTha_5,41.7 //  
Yathā atthaṅgate suriye honti sattā tamogatā /  
evaṃ buddhe anuppanne hoti loko tamogato.[^092-9]  // ApTha_5,41.8 //  
Yathodayanto ādicco vinodeti tamaṃ sadā /  
tath'; eva tvaṃ buddhaseṭṭha viddhaṃsesi tamaṃ sadā.  // ApTha_5,41.9 //  
Padhānaṃ pahitatto 'si[^092-10] Buddho loke sadevake /  
tava kammābhiraddhena tosesi janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_5,41.10 //  
Taṃ sabbaṃ anumoditvā Padumuttaro mahāmuṇi /  
nabhe abbhuggamī[^092-11] vīro[^092-12] haṃsarājā va ambare.  // ApTha_5,41.11 //  
Abbhuggantvāna sambuddho mahesi Padumuttaro /  
antalikkhe ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsathā:  // ApTha_5,41.12 //  
Yen'; idaṃ thavitaṃ ñāṇaṃ opammehi samāyanaṃ[^092-13] /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_5,41.13 //  
‘Aṭṭhārasan ca khattuñ so devarājā bhavissati /  
pathavyā rajjaṃ tisataṃ vasudhaṃ āvasissati.  // ApTha_5,41.14 //  
Pañcavīsatikkhattuñ ca cakkavattī bhavissati /  
padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ.  // ApTha_5,41.15 //  
Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_5,41.16 //  
Tusitāhi cavitvāna sukkamūlena codito /  
hīno va jātiyā santo[^092-14] Upāli nāma hessati.  // ApTha_5,41.17 //


<!-- PTS Page 093 -->
<a id="page-093"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 093]*

So ca pacchā pabbajitvā virājetvāna[^093-1] pāpakaṃ /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.[^093-2]  // ApTha_5,41.18 //  
Tuṭṭho ca Gotamo Buddho Sakyaputto mahāyaso /  
vinayādhigatan tassa etadagge ṭhapessati.';  // ApTha_5,41.19 //  
Saddhāy'; ahaṃ pabbajito katakicco anāsavo /  
sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_5,41.20 //  
Bhagavā cānukampī[^093-3] maṃ vinaye 'haṃ visārado /  
sakakammābhiraddho ca viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_5,41.21 //  
Saṃvuto pāṭimokkhamhi indriyesu ca pañcasu /  
dhāremi vinayaṃ sabbaṃ kevalaṃ ratanākaraṃ.  // ApTha_5,41.22 //  
Mamañ ca guṇam aññāya satthā loke anuttaro /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ.  // ApTha_5,41.23 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_5,41.24 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Upālithero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Upālittherassa[^093-4] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[42. Koliyavessa*.] Anomadassissa munino lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
sudhāya lepanaṃ katvā caṅkamaṃ kārayim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_5,42.1 //  
Nānāvaṇṇehi pupphehi caṅkamaṃ santhariṃ ahaṃ /  
ākāse vitānaṃ katvā[^093-5] bhojayiṃ buddham uttamaṃ  // ApTha_5,42.2 //  
Añjalim paggahetvāna abhivādetvā subbataṃ /  
dīghasālaṃ[^093-6] bhagavato niyyātesim ahan tadā.  // ApTha_5,42.3 //  
Mama saṅkappam aññāya satthā loke anuttaro /  
paṭiggahesi bhagavā anukampāya cakkhumā.  // ApTha_5,42.4 //  
Paṭiggahetvā sambuddho dakkhiṇeyyo sadevake /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsathā:  // ApTha_5,42.5 //  
Yo so haṭṭhena cittena dīghasālam[^093-7] adāsi me /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi, suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_5,42.6 //


<!-- PTS Page 094 -->
<a id="page-094"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 094]*

Imassa maccukālamhi puññakammasamaṅgino /  
sahassayutt'; assa ratho upaṭṭhissati tāvade.  // ApTha_5,42.7 //  
Tena yānen'; ayam poso devalokaṃ gamissati /  
anumodissare devā sampatte kusale bhave.  // ApTha_5,42.8 //  
Mahārahaṃ vyamhaṃ seṭṭhaṃ[^094-1] ratanamattikalepanaṃ /  
kūṭāgāravarūpetaṃ vyamham[^094-2] ajjhāvasissati.  // ApTha_5,42.9 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassāni devaloke ramissati /  
pañcavīsatikappāni devarājā bhavissati.  // ApTha_5,42.10 //  
Sattasattatikkhattuñ ca cakkavattī bhavissati /  
Yasodharā samānā te sabbe pi ekanāmakā.  // ApTha_5,42.11 //  
Dve sampattī[^094-3] anubhotvā vinditvā[^094-4] puññasañcayaṃ /  
aṭṭhavīsatikappamhi cakkavattī bhavissati.  // ApTha_5,42.12 //  
Tatrāpi vyamhaṃ[^094-2] pavaraṃ Vissakammena[^094-5] māpitaṃ /  
dasa saddāvivittan taṃ[^094-6] puram ajjhāvasissati.  // ApTha_5,42.13 //  
Aparimeyye ito kappe bhūmipālo mahiddhiko /  
Okkāko nāma nāmena rā*jā raṭṭhe bhavissati  // ApTha_5,42.14 //  
Sola*sitthisahassānam sabbāsaṃ pavarā mayā /  
abhijātā khattiyānī nava putte janessati.[^094-7]  // ApTha_5,42.15 //  
Nava putte janetvāna[^094-8] khattiyānī marissati[^094-9] /  
taruṇī ca piyā[^094-10] kaññā mahesittaṃ karissati.  // ApTha_5,42.16 //  
Okkākaṃ tosayitvāna varaṃ kaññā labhissati /  
varaṃ laddhā ca sā[^094-11] kaññā putte pabbājayissati.  // ApTha_5,42.17 //  
Pabbajitvā[^094-12] ca te sabbe gamissanti naguttamaṃ /  
jātibhedabhayā sabbe bhaginīhi saṃvasissare.  // ApTha_5,42.18 //  
Ekā ca kaññā vyādhīhi bhavissati purakkhatā /  
mā no jāti[^094-13] pabhijjī ti[^094-14] nikhaṇissanti[^094-15] khattiyā.  // ApTha_5,42.19 //  
Khattiyo[^094-16] nīharitvāna tāya saddhiṃ vasissati[^094-17] /  
bhavissati tadā bhedo Okkākakulasambhavo.  // ApTha_5,42.20 //


<!-- PTS Page 095 -->
<a id="page-095"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 095]*

Tesaṃ pajā bhavissanti Koḷiyā[^095-1] nāma jātiyā /  
tattha mānusakaṃ bhogaṃ anubhossanti 'nappakaṃ.  // ApTha_5,42.21 //  
Tamhā kāyā cavitvāna devalokaṃ gamissati /  
tatrāpi pavaraṃ vyamhaṃ[^095-2] vindissati[^095-3] manoramaṃ.[^095-4]  // ApTha_5,42.22 //  
Devalokā cavitvāna sukkamūlena codito /  
agantvāna[^095-5] manussattaṃ Soṇo nāma bhavissati.  // ApTha_5,42.23 //  
Āraddhaviriyo pahitatto padahaṃ satthu sāsane /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.[^095-6]  // ApTha_5,42.24 //  
Anantadassī bhagavā Gotamo Sakyapuṅgavo /  
visesaññū[^095-7] mahāvīro aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapesi maṃ.[^095-8]*  // ApTha_5,42.25 //  
Uttame damathe danto[^095-9] cittam me suppaṇīhitaṃ /  
bhāro me ohito sabbo nibbuto 'mhi anāsavo.  // ApTha_5,42.26 //  
Aṅgīraso mahānāgo[^095-10] abhijāto va kesarī /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ.  // ApTha_5,42.27 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_5,42.28 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Soṇo Koḷiyavesso thero[^095-11] imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Koḷiyavessatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[43. Bhaddiya-Kaḷigodhāya-putta.] Padumuttarasambuddhaṃ mettacittaṃ mahāmuniṃ /  
upeti janatā sabbā sabbalokagganāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_5,43.1 //  
Satthukañ ca 'baddhakañ[^095-12] ca āmisaṃ pānabhojanaṃ /  
dadanti satthuno sabbe puññakkhette anuttare.  // ApTha_5,43.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 096 -->
<a id="page-096"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 096]*

Ahaṃ pi dānaṃ dassāmi devadevassa[^096-1] tādino /  
buddhaseṭṭhaṃ[^096-2] nimantetvā saṅgham pi ca anuttaraṃ.  // ApTha_5,43.3 //  
Uyyojitā mayā c'; ete nimantesuṃ[^096-3] Tathāgataṃ /  
kevalaṃ bhikkhusaṅghañ ca puññakkhettaṃ anuttaraṃ.  // ApTha_5,43.4 //  
Sataṃ[^096-4] sahassaṃ pallaṅkaṃ sovaṇṇaṃ gonakatthataṃ[^096-5] /  
tulikā[^096-6] paṭalikāya khomakappāsikehi ca /  
mahārahaṃ paññāpayim āsanaṃ Buddhayuttakaṃ.  // ApTha_5,43.5 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū devadevo narāsabho /  
bhikkhusaṅghaparibbūḷho mama dvāraṃ upāgami.  // ApTha_5,43.6 //  
Paccuggantvāna sambuddhaṃ lokanāthaṃ yasassinaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano atināmayiṃ[^096-7] sagharaṃ.[^096-8]  // ApTha_5,43.7 //  
Bhikkhūnaṃ satasahassaṃ Buddhañ ca lokanāyakaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano paramannena tappayiṃ.  // ApTha_5,43.8 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_5,43.9 //  
‘Yen idaṃ āsanaṃ dinnaṃ sovaṇṇaṃ gonakatthataṃ /  
Tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_5,43.10 //  
Catusattatikkhattuṃ so devarajjaṃ karissati /  
anubhossati sampattiṃ accharāhi purakkhato.  // ApTha_5,43.11 //  
Padesarajjaṃ sahassaṃ vasudhaṃ āvasissati /  
ekapaññāsakkhattuñ cakkavattī bhavissati.  // ApTha_5,43.12 //  
Sabbāsu bhavayonīsu[^096-9] uccākulī bhavissati /  
so ca[^096-10] pacchā pabbajitvā sukkamūlena codito /  
Bhaddiyo nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.';  // ApTha_5,43.13 //  
Vivekam anuyutto 'mhi pantasenanivās'[^096-11] ahaṃ /  
phalañ c'; avigataṃ[^096-12] sabbaṃ vattakeso 'mhi ajja 'haṃ.  // ApTha_5,43.14 //  
Mama sabbaṃ abhiññāya sabbaññū lokanāyako /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ.  // ApTha_5,43.15 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_5,43.16 //


<!-- PTS Page 097 -->
<a id="page-097"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 097]*

Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Bhaddiyo Kaḷigodhāyaputto thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Bhaddiyassa Kaḷigodhāyaputtatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[44. Sannidhāpaka.] Araññe kuṭikaṃ katvā vasāmi pabbatantare /  
lābhālābhena santuṭṭho yasena ayasena ca.  // ApTha_5,44.1 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
vasīsatasahassehi āgañchi mama santike.  // ApTha_5,44.2 //  
Upāgataṃ mahāvīraṃ[^097-1] jalajuttamanāyakaṃ[^097-2] /  
tiṇasantharaṃ paññāpetvā adāsiṃ satthuno ahaṃ.  // ApTha_5,44.3 //  
Pasannacitto sumano āmaṇḍaṃ pāniyañ ca 'haṃ /  
adāsiṃ ujubhūtassa vippasannena cetasā.  // ApTha_5,44.4 //  
Satasahass'[^097-3] ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi āmaṇḍass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_5,44.5 //  
Ekatālīsakappamhi eko āsi Arindamo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_5,44.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_5,44.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sannidhāpako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sannidhāpakatherassa[^097-4] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[45. Pañcahatthiya.] Sumedho nāma sambuddho gacchate[^097-5] antarāpaṇe /  
khittacakkhu mitabhāṇī satimā saṃvutindriyo.  // ApTha_5,45.1 //  
Pañcauppalahatthāni āveḷattham akāsi[^097-6] me /  
tena Buddhaṃ apūjesiṃ pasanno sehi pāṇihi.  // ApTha_5,45.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 098 -->
<a id="page-098"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 098]*

Āropitā ca te pupphā chādanaṃ assu[^098-1] satthuno /  
saṃsāviṃsu mahānāgaṃ sissā ācariyaṃ yathā.  // ApTha_5,45.3 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassamhi yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_5,45.4 //  
Ito vīsaṃkappasate[^098-2] ahesuṃ pañca khattiyā /  
Hatthiyā nāma nāmena cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_5,45.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_5,45.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pañcahatthiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Pañcahatthiyatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[46. Padumacchadaniya.] Nibbute lokanāthamhi Vipassimh'; aggapuggale[^098-3] /  
suphullaṃ[^098-4] padumaṃ gayha citam[^098-5] āropayiṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_5,46.1 //  
Āropite ca citake vehasan nabham uggamiṃ[^098-6] /  
ākāsacchadanaṃ katvā citakamhi adhārayiṃ.  // ApTha_5,46.2 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāni Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_5,46.3 //  
Sattatālīs'; ito kappe[^098-7] Padumissaranāmako /  
cāturanto vijitāvī cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_5,46.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_5,46.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Padumacchadaniyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Padumacchadaniyatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[47. Sayanadāyaka.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato mettacittassa tādino /  
sayanaggaṃ mayā dinnaṃ dussabhaṇḍehi atthataṃ.  // ApTha_5,47.1 //  
Paṭiggahesi bhagavā kappiyaṃ sayanāsanaṃ /  
uṭṭhāya āsanā tamhā vehāsaṃ uggamī jino.  // ApTha_5,47.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 099 -->
<a id="page-099"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 099]*

Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ sayanam adāsi 'haṃ[^099-1] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi sayanassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_5,47.3 //  
Ekapaññās'; ito kappe Varuṇo Devasavhayo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_5,47.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_5,47.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sayanadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sayanadāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[48. Caṅkamadāyaka.] *Atthadassissa munino* lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
iṭṭhakāhi cinitvāna caṅkamaṃ kārayim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_5,48.1 //  
Uccato[^099-2] pañcaratanaṃ caṅkamaṃ sādhu māpitaṃ /  
āyāmato hatthasataṃ bhāvanīyaṃ[^099-3] manoramaṃ.  // ApTha_5,48.2 //  
Paṭiggahesi bhagavā Atthadassī naruttamo /  
hatthena puḷinaṃ gayha imā gāthā abhāsathā:  // ApTha_5,48.3 //  
‘Imina puḷinadānena caṅkamaṃ sukatena ca /  
sattaratanasampannaṃ puḷinaṃ anubhossati.[^099-4]  // ApTha_5,48.4 //  
Tīṇi kappāni devesu devarajjaṃ karissati /  
anubhossati sampattiṃ accharāhi purakkhato.  // ApTha_5,48.5 //  
Manussalokaṃ āgantvā rājā raṭṭhe bhavissati /  
tikkhattuñ cakkavattī ca mahiyā so bhavissati.';  // ApTha_5,48.6 //  
Aṭṭhārase kappasate yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi caṅkamassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_5,48.7 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sasanan ti.  // ApTha_5,48.8 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Caṅkamadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Caṅkamatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 100 -->
<a id="page-100"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 100]*

[49. Subhadda.] Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
janataṃ uddharitvāna nibbāyati mahāyaso.  // ApTha_5,49.1 //  
Nibbāyante ca sambuddhe dasasahassī pakampatha /  
janakāyo mahā āsi devā sannipatuṃ tadā.  // ApTha_5,49.2 //  
Candanaṃ pūrayitvāna tagaramallikāhi[^100-1] ca /  
haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena ālepesiṃ[^100-2] naruttamaṃ.  // ApTha_5,49.3 //  
Mama saṅkappam aññāya satthā loke anuttaro /  
nipannako ca sambuddho imā gāthā abhāsathā:  // ApTha_5,49.4 //  
Yo me pacchimake kāle gandhamālena[^100-3] chādayi /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_5,49.5 //  
‘Ito cuto ayaṃ poso Tusitakāyaṃ gamissati /  
tattha rajjaṃ karitvāna Nimmānaṃ so gamissati.[^100-4]  // ApTha_5,49.6 //  
Eten'; eva upāyena datvā malyaṃ[^100-5] varuttamaṃ /  
sakakammābhiraddho so sampattiṃ anubhossati.  // ApTha_5,49.7 //  
Cuto pi[^100-6] Tusite kāye nibbattissati 'yaṃ naro /  
tamhā kāyā cavitvāna manussattaṃ gamissati.  // ApTha_5,49.8 //  
Sakyaputto mahānāgo aggo loke sadevake /  
bodhayitvā bahū satte nibbāyissati cakkhumā.  // ApTha_5,49.9 //  
Pabbajjūpagato[^100-7] santo sukkamūlena codito /  
upasaṅkammā sambuddhaṃ pañhaṃ pucchissate[^100-8] tadā.  // ApTha_5,49.10 //  
Bhāsayitvāna[^100-9] sambuddho sabbaññū lokanāyako /  
pubbaṃ[^100-10] kammaṃ abhiññāya saccāni vivarissati.  // ApTha_5,49.11 //  
Āraddho ca ayaṃ pañho tuṭṭho ekaggamānaso /  
satthāraṃ abhivādetvā[^100-11] pabbajjaṃ yācayissati.  // ApTha_5,49.12 //  
Pasannamānasaṃ disvā sakakammena tositaṃ /  
pabbajessati[^100-12] so Buddho aggadhammassa kovido.  // ApTha_5,49.13 //  
Vāyamitvāna yaṃ poso[^100-13] sammāsambuddhasāsane, /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.[^100-14]  // ApTha_5,49.14 //  
Pañcamaṃ bhāṇavāraṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 101 -->
<a id="page-101"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 101]*

Pubbakammena saṃyutto ekaggo susamāhito /  
Buddhassa oraso putto dhammajo 'mhi sunimmito.  // ApTha_5,49.15 //  
Dhammarājaṃ upāgantvā[^101-1] āpucchiṃ[^101-2] pañham uttamaṃ /  
kathayanto ca me pañhaṃ dhammasotaṃ[^101-3] upānayi.  // ApTha_5,49.16 //  
Tassāhaṃ dhammam aññāya vihāsiṃ sāsane rato /  
sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_5,49.17 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Jalajuttamanāyako[^101-4] /  
nibbāyi anupādāno dīpo va telasaṅkhayā.[^101-5]  // ApTha_5,49.18 //  
Sattayojanikaṃ āsi thūpañ ca ratanāmayaṃ /  
dhajaṃ tattha apūjesiṃ sabbabhaddaṃ manoramaṃ.  // ApTha_5,49.19 //  
Kassapassa ca sambuddhassa Tisso nām'; aggasāvako /  
putto me oraso āsi dāyādo jinasāsane.  // ApTha_5,49.20 //  
Tassa hīnena manasā vācaṃ bhāsiṃ abhaddakaṃ /  
tena kammavipākena pacchime addasaṃ jinaṃ.[^101-6]  // ApTha_5,49.21 //  
Upavattane Sālavane pacchime sayane muni /  
pabbājesi mahāvīro hito kāruṇiko jino.  // ApTha_5,49.22 //  
Ajj'; eva dāni pabbajjā ajj'; eva upasampadā /  
ajj'; eva parinibbānaṃ sammukhā dipaduttame.  // ApTha_5,49.23 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ sambuddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_5,49.24 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Subhaddo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Subhaddatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[50. Cunda.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
agghiyaṃ kārayitvāna[^101-7] jātipupphehi chādayiṃ.  // ApTha_5,50.1 //  
Niṭṭhapetvāna taṃ puppham buddhassa upanāmayiṃ /  
pupphāvasesaṃ paggayha Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_5,50.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 102 -->
<a id="page-102"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 102]*

Kañcanagghiyasaṅkāsaṃ Buddhaṃ lokagganāyakaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano pupphagghiyam upānayiṃ.  // ApTha_5,50.3 //  
Vitiṇṇakaṅkho sambuddho tiṇṇoghehi[^102-1] purakkhato /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_5,50.4 //  
Dibbaṃ gandhaṃ pavāyantaṃ yo me pupphagghiyaṃ adā /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_5,50.5 //  
Ito cuto ayaṃ poso devasaṅghapurakkhato /  
jātipupphehi parikiṇṇo devalokaṃ gamissati.  // ApTha_5,50.6 //  
Ubbiddhaṃ bhavanaṃ tassa sovaṇṇañ ca maṇimayaṃ /  
vyamhā[^102-2] pātubhavissanti puññakammapabhāvitā.[^102-3]  // ApTha_5,50.7 //  
Catusattatikkhattuṃ so devarajjaṃ karissati /  
anubhossati sampattiṃ accharāhi purakkhato.  // ApTha_5,50.8 //  
*Pathavyā rajjaṃ tisataṃ vasudhaṃ* āvasissati /  
pañcasattatikkhattuñ ca cakkavattī bhavissati.  // ApTha_5,50.9 //  
Dujjayo[^102-4] nāma nāmena hessati manujādhipo /  
anubhotvāna taṃ puññaṃ sakakammaṃ apassito.[^102-5]  // ApTha_5,50.10 //  
Vinipātaṃ āgantvāna manussattaṃ gamissati /  
*hiraññassa ca nicitaṃ koṭṭisatān* anappakaṃ.  // ApTha_5,50.11 //  
Nibbattissati lokamhi[^102-6] brāhmaṇo so bhavissati /  
Vaṅgantassa[^102-7] suto dhīmā Sāriyā[^102-8] oraso piyo.[^102-9]  // ApTha_5,50.12 //  
So ca pacchā pabbājitvā Aṅgīrasassa sāsane /  
Cūlacundo[^102-10] ti nāmena hessati *satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_5,50.13 //  
Sāmaṇero ca* so santo khīṇāsavo bhavissati /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbayissat'; anāsavo.[^102-11]  // ApTha_5,50.14 //  
Upaṭṭhahiṃ mahāvīraṃ aññe ca pesale bahū /  
bhātaram me c'; upaṭṭhāsiṃ[^102-12] uttamatthassa pattiyā.  // ApTha_5,50.15 //  
Bhā*taraṃ me upaṭṭhitvā[^102-13] dhātū pattamhi* opiya[^102-14] /  
sambuddhaṃ upanāmesi lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ.  // ApTha_5,50.16 //


<!-- PTS Page 103 -->
<a id="page-103"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 103]*

Ubho hatthehi paggayha Buddho loke sadevake /  
sandassayanto taṃ dhātuṃ kittayi aggasāvakaṃ.  // ApTha_5,50.17 //  
Cittañ ca suvimu*ttaṃ me saddhā mayhaṃ patiṭṭhitā /  
sabbāsa*ve pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_5,50.18 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_5,50.19 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Cundathero imā gāthāyo abhā- sitthā ti. Cundattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Upāli Soṇo Bhaddiyo[^103-1] Sannidhāpaka[^103-2] Hatthiyo Chadanaṃ[^103-3] Seyya-Caṅkamaṃ Subhaddo Cundasavhayo gāthā satañ ca tālīsaṃ catasso ca tath'; uttari Upālivaggo pañcamo.

[VI. VĪJANĪVAGGO.]

[51. Vidhūpanadāyaka.] Padumuttarabuddhassa lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
vījanikā[^103-4] mayā dinnā dīpadindassa tādino.  // ApTha_6,51.1 //  
Sakaṃ cittaṃ[^103-5] pasādetvā pagga*hetvāna añjaliṃ /  
sambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā* pakkāmiṃ uttarāmukho.  // ApTha_6,51.2 //  
Vījaniṃ[^103-6] paggahetvāna satthā lokagganāyako /  
bhikkhusaṅghe ṭhito santo imā gāthā abhāsathā:  // ApTha_6,51.3 //  
Iminā vījanīdānena[^103-7] cittassa paṇidhīhi ca /  
kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ vini*pātaṃ na gacchati  // ApTha_6,51.4 //  
Āraddhavi*riyo pahitatto cetoguṇasamāhito /  
jātiyā sattavasso 'haṃ[^103-8] arahattam apāpuṇiṃ.[^103-9]  // ApTha_6,51.5 //  
Saṭṭhikappasahassamhi Vījamānasanāmakā[^103-10] /  
solas'; āsiṃsu rājāno cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_6,51.6 //


<!-- PTS Page 104 -->
<a id="page-104"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 104]*

Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsasanan ti.  // ApTha_6,51.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Vidhūpanadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti. Vidhūpanadāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[52. Sataraṃsika.] Ubbiddhaṃ[^104-1] selam āruyha nisīdi purisuttamo /  
pabbatassāvidūramhi brāhmaṇo mantapāragū.  // ApTha_6,52.1 //  
Upaviṭṭhaṃ mahāvīraṃ devadevaṃ[^104-2] narāsabhaṃ /  
añjalim paggahetvāna santhaviṃ[^104-3] lokanāyakaṃ:  // ApTha_6,52.2 //  
‘Esa Buddho mahā*vīro varadhammappakāsako /  
jala*ti aggikkhandho 'va bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhato.  // ApTha_6,52.3 //  
Mahāsamuddo[^104-4] 'va 'kkhobbho aṇṇavo vā duruttaro[^104-5] /  
migarājā v'; asambhīto dhammaṃ deseti cakkhumā.';  // ApTha_6,52.4 //  
Mama saṅkappam aññāya Padumuttaranāyako /  
bhikkhusaṅghe ṭhito *satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha:*  // ApTha_6,52.5 //  
‘Yenāyaṃ[^104-6] añjali dinno Buddhaseṭṭho ca thomito /  
tiṃsakappasahassāni devarajjaṃ karissati.  // ApTha_6,52.6 //  
Kappasatasahassamhi Aṅgīrasassanāmako /  
vivattachaddo sambu*ddho uppajjissati tāvade.*  // ApTha_6,52.7 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Sataraṃsī ti nāmena arahā so bhavissati.';  // ApTha_6,52.8 //  
Jātiyā sattavasso 'haṃ pabbajjiṃ anagāriyaṃ /  
Sataraṃsī pi[^104-7] nāmena *pabhā niddhāvate mama.*  // ApTha_6,52.9 //  
Maṇḍape rukkhamūle vā jhāyī jhānarato ahaṃ /  
dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane.  // ApTha_6,52.10 //  
Saṭṭhikappasahassamhi caturo Romanāmakā /  
sattaratanasampannā *cakkavattī mahābalā.*  // ApTha_6,52.11 //


<!-- PTS Page 105 -->
<a id="page-105"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 105]*

Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_6,52.12 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sataraṃsiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sataraṃsikatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[53. Sayanadāyaka.] Padumuttarassa Buddhassa sabbalokānukampino /  
sayanaṃ tassa pādāsiṃ vippasannena cetasā.  // ApTha_6,53.1 //  
Tena sayanadānena sukhe*tte bījasampadā /  
bhogo nibbatt*ate tassa sayanassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_6,53.2 //  
Ākāse seyyaṃ kappemi dhāremi paṭhaviṃ[^105-1] imaṃ /  
pāṇesu me[^105-2] issariyaṃ sayanassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_6,53.3 //  
Pañcakappasahassamhi aṭṭha āsuṃ mahāvīrā /  
catuttiṃse *kappasate caturo ca mahābalā.*  // ApTha_6,53.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_6,53.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sayanadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sayanadāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[54. Gandhodaka.] Padumuttarabuddhassa mahābodhimaho ahu /  
vicittaghaṭam ādāya gandhodakam adās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_6,54.1 //  
Nahānakāle[^105-3] ca bodhiyā mahāmegho pavassatha /  
ninnādo ca mahā ahu[^105-4] *asaniyā phalantiyā.*  // ApTha_6,54.2 //  
Tena 'vāsanivegena[^105-5] tattha kālakato[^105-6] ahaṃ /  
devaloke ṭhito santo[^105-7] imā gāthā abhās'; ahaṃ[^105-8]:  // ApTha_6,54.3 //


<!-- PTS Page 106 -->
<a id="page-106"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 106]*

Aho Buddhā[^106-1] aho dhammā[^106-2] aho no satthu sampadā /  
kalebaram me[^106-3] patitaṃ devaloke ramām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_6,54.4 //  
Ubbiddhaṃ bhavanaṃ ma*yhaṃ satabhūmiṃ[^106-4] samuggataṃ /  
kaññā satasahassāni parivārenti maṃ* sadā.  // ApTha_6,54.5 //  
Rogā pi[^106-5] me na vijjanti soko mayhaṃ na vijjati /  
pariḷāhaṃ na passāmi puññakammass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_6,54.6 //  
Aṭṭhavīse kappasate rājā Samvasito[^106-6] ahu /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_6,54.7 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_6,54.8 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Gandhodakiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Gandhodakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[55. Opavuyha.] Padumuttarabuddhassa ājānīyam adās'; ahaṃ /  
niyyādetvāna[^106-7] sambuddhe[^106-8] agamāsiṃ sakaṃ gharaṃ.  // ApTha_6,55.1 //  
Devalo nāma nāmena satthuno aggasāvako /  
varadhammassa dāyādo āgañchi mama santikaṃ:  // ApTha_6,55.2 //  
‘Sapattabhāro bhagavā ājāneyyo[^106-9] na kappati[^106-10] /  
tava saṅkappam aññāya adhivāsesi cakkhumā.';  // ApTha_6,55.3 //  
Agghāpetvā vātajavaṃ[^106-11] sindhavaṃ sī*ghavāhanaṃ* /  
Padumuttarabuddhassa ajānīyam[^106-12] adās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_6,55.4 //  
Yaṃ yaṃ yonupapajjāmi bhavane sabbadā mama[^106-13] /  
khamanīyā vātajavā citte nibbattare mamaṃ.[^106-14]  // ApTha_6,55.5 //


<!-- PTS Page 107 -->
<a id="page-107"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 107]*

Lābhā tesaṃ suladdhaṃ vā ye labhant'; upasampadaṃ /  
punappayirūpāseyyaṃ Buddho loke sace bhave.  // ApTha_6,55.6 //  
Aṭṭhavīsatikkhattāhaṃ rājā āsiṃ mahābalo /  
caturanto vijitāvī jambusaṇḍassa issaro.  // ApTha_6,55.7 //  
Imaṃ pacchimakaṃ mayhaṃ carimo vattate bhavo /  
patto 'mhi acalaṃ ṭhānaṃ hitvā jayaparājayaṃ.  // ApTha_6,55.8 //  
Catu*ttiṃse sahassamhi* mahātej'; āsi khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahabbalo.  // ApTha_6,55.9 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_6,55.10 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Opavuyho[^107-1] thero imā gathāyo abhāsitthā ti. Opavuyhattherassa[^107-2] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[56. Saparivārāsana.] Padumuttarabuddhassa piṇḍapātaṃ adās'; ahaṃ /  
gantvā taṃ bhojanaṭṭhānaṃ[^107-3] mallikāhi parikkh*ittaṃ.  // ApTha_6,56.1 //  
Tamh'; āsanamhi* āsīno Buddho lokagganāyako /  
akittayi piṇḍapātaṃ ujubhūto samāhito:  // ApTha_6,56.2 //  
‘Yathāpi bhaddake khette bījaṃ appam pi ropitaṃ[^107-4] /  
sammādhāraṃ pavecchante[^107-5] phalaṃ toseti kassakaṃ.  // ApTha_6,56.3 //  
*Tath'; evāyaṃ piṇḍapāto sukhe*tte ropito[^107-6] tayā /  
bhave nibbattamānamhi phalato[^107-7] tosayissati.';  // ApTha_6,56.4 //  
Idaṃ vatvāna sambuddho Jalajuttamanāmako /  
piṇḍapātaṃ thavitvāna[^107-8] pakkāmi uttarāmukho.  // ApTha_6,56.5 //  
Saṃvuto pātimokkhasmi[^107-9] indriyesu ca pañcasu /  
pav*ivekaṃ anuyutto* viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_6,56.6 //


<!-- PTS Page 108 -->
<a id="page-108"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 108]*

Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_6,56.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Saparivārāsano[^108-1] thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Saparivārāsanattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[57. Pañcadīpika.] Padumuttarabuddhassa sabbabhūtānukampino /  
susaṇṭhahitvā[^108-2] saddhamme ujudiṭṭhi ahos'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_6,57.1 //  
Padīpadānam pādā*siṃ parivāre*tvāna bodhiyaṃ /  
saddahanto padīpāni akariṃ[^108-3] tāvade ahaṃ.  // ApTha_6,57.2 //  
Yaṃ yaṃ yonupapajjāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ /  
ākāse ukkaṃ dhārento dīpadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_6,57.3 //  
Tirokuḍḍaṃ tiroselaṃ *samati*ggayha pabbataṃ /  
samantā yojanasataṃ dassanaṃ anubhom'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_6,57.4 //  
Tena kammāvasesena patto'; mhi āsavakkhayaṃ /  
dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ dipadindassa sāsane.  // ApTha_6,57.5 //  
Catuttiṃse kappasate Satacakkhu-sanāmakā /  
rājā 'hesuṃ mahātejā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_6,57.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_6,57.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pañcadīpiko[^108-4] thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Pañcadīpikatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[58. Dhajadāyaka.] Padumuttarabuddhassa[^108-5] bodhiyā pādamuttame /  
h*aṭṭho haṭṭhena ci*ttena dhajjam āropayiṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_6,58.1 //  
Patapattāni[^108-6] gaṇhitvā bahiddhā chaḍḍayiṃ ahaṃ /  
anto suddhaṃ bahi suddhaṃ adhimuttam anāsavaṃ /  
sammukhā viya sambuddhaṃ avandiṃ bodhim uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_6,58.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 109 -->
<a id="page-109"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 109]*

Padumuttaro lokavidū *āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho* /  
bhikkhusaṅghe ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_6,58.3 //  
‘Iminā dhajadānena upaṭṭhānena cūbhayaṃ /  
kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ so na gacchati /  
devesu devasobhāgyaṃ anubhossat'; a*nappakaṃ.[^109-1]*  // ApTha_6,58.4 //  
Anekasatakkhattuñ ca rājā raṭṭhe bhavissati /  
Uggato[^109-2] nāma nāmena cakkavattī bhavissati.  // ApTha_6,58.5 //  
Sampattiṃ anubhotvāna sukkamūlena codito /  
Gotamassa bhagavato sāsane 'bhiramissati.'[^109-3]  // ApTha_6,58.6 //  
Pa*dhānaṃ pahita*tto 'mhi upasanto nirūpadhi /  
dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane.  // ApTha_6,58.7 //  
Ekapaññāsasahasse kappe Uggatasavhayo /  
paññāsasatasahasse khattiyo Meghasavhayo.  // ApTha_6,58.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ ti.  // ApTha_6,58.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Dhajadāyako thero ima gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Dhajadāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[59. Paduma.] Catusaccaṃ pakāse*nto varadhammacakka*pavattako /  
vassate amataṃ vuṭṭhiṃ nibbāpento mahājanaṃ.  // ApTha_6,59.1 //  
Sadhajaṃ[^109-4] padumaṃ gayha aḍḍhakose ṭṭhito[^109-5] ahaṃ /  
Padumuttaramunissa[^109-6] haṭṭho ukkhi*pim ambare.*  // ApTha_6,59.2 //  
Āgacchante ca padume abbhūto āsi *tāvade* /  
mama saṅkappam aññāya paggaṇhi vadataṃ varo.  // ApTha_6,59.3 //  
Karaseṭṭhena paggayha jalajaṃ puppham uttamaṃ /  
{bhikkhusaṅghe} ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_6,59.4 //  
Yen'; idaṃ padumaṃ khittaṃ sabbaññuta-m-anāsave[^109-7] /  
*tam ahaṃ kit*tayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_6,59.5 //


<!-- PTS Page 110 -->
<a id="page-110"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 110]*

Tiṃsakappāni devindo devarajjaṃ karissati /  
paṭhavyā rajjaṃ sattasataṃ vasudhaṃ āvasissati.  // ApTha_6,59.6 //  
Tattha pattaṃ gahetvāna cakkavatti bhavissati /  
ākāsato pupphavuṭṭhi abhivassissati tadā.  // ApTha_6,59.7 //  
Kappasatasahassamhi[^110-1] Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_6,59.8 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso *dhammani*mmito /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.[^110-2]  // ApTha_6,59.9 //  
Nikkhamitvāna kucchimhā sampajāno patissato /  
jātiyā pañcavasso 'haṃ arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_6,59.10 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_6,59.11 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Padumo thero imā gāthāyo abhā- sitthā ti. Padumattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[60. Asanabodhiya.] Jātiyā sattavasso 'haṃ addasaṃ *lokanā*yakaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano upagañchiṃ[^110-3] naruttamaṃ.  // ApTha_6,60.1 //  
Tissassāhaṃ bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
haṭṭho hatthena cittena ropayiṃ bodhim uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_6,60.2 //  
Asa*no nāmadheyyena dharaṇīrūhapādapo. /  
pañ*cavasse[^110-4] paricariṃ asanaṃ bodhim uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_6,60.3 //  
Pupphitaṃ pādapaṃ disvā abbhūtaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ /  
sakaṃ kammaṃ[^110-5] pakittento Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ[^110-6] upāgamiṃ.[^110-7]  // ApTha_6,60.4 //  
Tisso tadā yo[^110-8] sambuddho sayambhū *aggapuggalo /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā* abhāsatha:  // ApTha_6,60.5 //  
‘Yenāyaṃ ropitā bodhi Buddhapūjā ca sakkatā /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_6,60.6 //  
Tiṃsakappāni devesu devarajjaṃ karissati /  
catusaṭṭhiñ[^110-9] ca khattuṃ so cakkavatti bhavissati.  // ApTha_6,60.7 //


<!-- PTS Page 111 -->
<a id="page-111"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 111]*

Tu*sitāhi cavit*vāna sukkamūlena codito /  
dve sampattī anubhotvā[^111-1] manussatte ramissati.  // ApTha_6,60.8 //  
Padhānaṃ pahitatto so upasanto nirūpadhi /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.'[^111-2]  // ApTha_6,60.9 //  
Vivekam anuyutto 'haṃ upasanto nirūpadhi /  
*nāgo* va bandhanaṃ chetvā viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_6,60.10 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe bodhiṃ ropes[^111-3] ahaṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bodhiropay'[^111-4] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_6,60.11 //  
Catusattati ito kappe Daṇḍaseno ti vissuto /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti tadā ahu.  // ApTha_6,60.12 //  
Tesattati ito kappe sattāhesuṃ mahīpatī /  
Samantanemi nāmena rājāno cakkavattino.  // ApTha_6,60.13 //  
Paṇṇavīsat'; ito kappe *Puṇṇa*ko nāma khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahabbalo.  // ApTha_6,60.14 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_6,60.15 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Asanabodhiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Asanabodhiyatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ:-- Vījanī Sataraṃsī ca Sayan Odaki Vāhiyo Parivāro Padīpañ ca Dhajo Paduma-Pūjako Bodhī ca dasamo vutto gāthā dvenavutī tathā. Vījanīvaggo chaṭṭamo.

[VII. SAKACITTANIYAVAGGO.]

[61. Sakacittaniya.] Pavanaṃ kānanaṃ disvā a*ppasaddaṃ a*nāvilaṃ /  
isīnaṃ anuciṇṇaṃ[^111-5] va āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ[^111-6]  // ApTha_7,61.1 //  
Thūpaṃ katvāna veḷūnaṃ[^111-7] nānāpupphaṃ samokiriṃ /  
sammukhā viya sambuddhaṃ nimmitaṃ abhivandi 'haṃ.  // ApTha_7,61.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 112 -->
<a id="page-112"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 112]*

Sattaratanasampanno rājā raṭṭhasmiṃ[^112-1] issaro /  
sakakammābhiraddho 'haṃ thūpapūjāy'[^112-2] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_7,61.3 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi thūpapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_7,61.4 //  
Asītikappen'; antayaso cakkavatti ahos'; ahaṃ /  
sattaratanasampanno *catudīpamhi issaro*  // ApTha_7,61.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_7,61.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sakacittaniyo thero imā gāthāyo{abhāsitthā} ti. Sakacittaniyatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[62. Āvopupphiya.] Vihārā abhinikkhamma abbhuṭṭhāsi[^112-3] 'va caṅkame[^112-4] /  
catusaccaṃ pakāsento desento amataṃ padaṃ.  // ApTha_7,62.1 //  
Sikhissa giram aññāya Buddhaseṭṭhassa tādino /  
nānāpupphaṃ gahetvāna ākāsamhi samokiriṃ.  // ApTha_7,62.2 //  
Tena kammena dipadinda lokajeṭṭha narāsabha /  
patto 'mhi acalaṃ ṭhānaṃ hitvā[^112-5] jayaparājayaṃ.  // ApTha_7,62.3 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_7,62.4 //  
Ito vīsatikappamhi Sumedho nāma khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahabbalo.  // ApTha_7,62.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_7,62.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Āvopupphiyo[^112-6] thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Āvopupphiyatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 113 -->
<a id="page-113"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 113]*

[63. Paccāgamanīya.] Sindhuyā nadiyā tīre cakkavāko ahaṃ tadā /  
*suddhasevāla*bhakkho 'haṃ pāpesu[^113-1] ca susaññato.  // ApTha_7,63.1 //  
Addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ gacchantaṃ anilañjase /  
tuṇḍena sālaṃ[^113-2] paggayha Vipassissābhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_7,63.2 //  
Yassa saddhā Tathāgate acalā supatiṭṭhitā /  
tena cittappasādena duggatiṃ so na gacchati.  // ApTha_7,63.3 //  
Sāgataṃ[^113-3] vata me āsi Buddhaseṭṭhassa santike /  
vihaṅgamena santena[^113-4] su*bījaṃ* ropitaṃ mayā.  // ApTha_7,63.4 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_7,63.5 //  
Sucārudassanā nāma aṭṭha te ekanāmakā /  
kappe sattarase āsuṃ cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_7,63.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_7,63.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Paccāgamanīyo[^113-5] thero imā gāthāyo abhasitthā ti. Paccāgamanīyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[64. Parappasādaka.] Usabhaṃ pavaraṃ vīraṃ mahesiṃ vijitāvinaṃ /  
suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ ko disvā nappasidati?  // ApTha_7,64.1 //  
Himavā vāparimeyyo[^113-6] sāgaro va duruttaro /  
tad eva jhānaṃ[^113-7] Buddhassa ko disvā nappasīdati?  // ApTha_7,64.2 //  
Vasudhā yathāppameyyā cittā vanavaṭaṃsikā /  
tath'; eva sīlaṃ Buddhassa ko disvā nappasīdati?  // ApTha_7,64.3 //  
Anilañjasāsaṅkhubbho[^113-8] yath'; ākāso asaṅkhiyo[^113-9] /  
tath'; eva ñāṇaṃ[^113-10] Buddhassa ko disvā nappasīdati?  // ApTha_7,64.4 //


<!-- PTS Page 114 -->
<a id="page-114"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 114]*

Imāhi catūhi gāthāhi brāhmaṇo Yenasavhayo[^114-1] /  
buddhaseṭṭhaṃ thavitvāna Siddhattham aparājitaṃ.  // ApTha_7,64.5 //  
Catunavutikappānaṃ[^114-2] duggatiṃ nūpapajj'; aham[^114-3] /  
sugatīsu susampattiṃ anubhosiṃ[^114-4] anappakaṃ.  // ApTha_7,64.6 //  
Catunavute ito kappe thavitvā lokanāyakaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi thomanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_7,64.7 //  
Catuddasamhi kappamhi caturo āsuṃ Uggatā /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_7,64.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_7,64.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Parappasādako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Parappasādakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[65. Bhisadāyaka.] Vessabhū nāma nāmena isīnaṃ tatiyo ahu /  
kānanaṃ vanam oggayha vihāsi purisuttamo.  // ApTha_7,65.1 //  
Bhisaṃ muḷālaṃ gaṇhitvā agamaṃ[^114-5] Buddhasantike[^114-6] /  
tañ ca Buddhassa pādāsiṃ pasanno sehi pāṇihi.  // ApTha_7,65.2 //  
Karena ca parāmaṭṭho Vessabhū varabuddhinā /  
sukhāhaṃ nābhijānāmi saman tena kut'; uttariṃ.[^114-7]  // ApTha_7,65.3 //  
Carimo vattate mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā /  
hatthināgena[^114-8] santena kusalaṃ ropitaṃ mayā.  // ApTha_7,65.4 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bhisadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_7,65.5 //  
Samodhānā ca rājāno soḷasa maṇujādhipā /  
kappamhi terase āsuṃ cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_7,65.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_7,65.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Bhisadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Bhisadāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 115 -->
<a id="page-115"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 115]*

[66. Sucintita.] Giriduggacaro āsiṃ abhijāto va kesarī /  
migasaṅghaṃ vadhitvāna jīvāmi pabbatantare.  // ApTha_7,66.1 //  
Atthadassī tu bhagavā sabbaññū vadataṃ[^115-1] varo /  
mam uddharitukāmo so āgañchi pabbatuttamaṃ.  // ApTha_7,66.2 //  
Pasadañ ca migaṃ hantvā[^115-2] bhakkhetuṃ[^115-3] samupāgamiṃ /  
bhagavā tamhi samaye bhikkhayāno upāgami.  // ApTha_7,66.3 //  
Varamaṃsāni paggayha adāsiṃ tassa satthuno /  
anumodī mahāvīro nibbāpento mamaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_7,66.4 //  
Tena cittappasādena giriduggappavekkh'; ahaṃ[^115-4] /  
pītiṃ uppādayitvāna tattha kālakato[^115-5] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_7,66.5 //  
Etena maṃsadānena cittassa paṇidhīhi ca /  
paṇṇarase kappasate devaloke ramiṃ[^115-6] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_7,66.6 //  
Avasesesu kappesu kusalaṃ kāritaṃ[^115-7] mayā /  
ten'; eva maṃsadānena Buddhānussaraṇena ca.  // ApTha_7,66.7 //  
Aṭṭhatiṃsamhi kappamhi aṭṭha Dīghāyunāmakā[^115-8] /  
satthimh'; ito kappasate duve Varuṇanāmakā.[^115-9]  // ApTha_7,66.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ ti.  // ApTha_7,66.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sucintito[^115-10] thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sucintitatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 116 -->
<a id="page-116"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 116]*

[67. Vatthadāyaka.] Pakkhī jāto tadā āsiṃ supaṇṇo[^116-1] garuḷādhipo /  
addasaṃ virajaṃ buddhaṃ gacchantaṃ Gandhamādanaṃ  // ApTha_7,67.1 //  
Jahitvā garuḷavaṇṇaṃ māṇavatthaṃ[^116-2] adhārayiṃ[^116-3] /  
ekaṃ vatthaṃ mayā dinnaṃ dipadindassa tādino.  // ApTha_7,67.2 //  
Naṃ ca dussaṃ paṭiggayha Buddho lokagganāyako /  
antalikkhe ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_7,67.3 //  
Iminā vatthadānena cittassa paṇidhīhi ca /  
pahāya garuḷāyoniṃ[^116-4] devaloke ramissati.  // ApTha_7,67.4 //  
Atthadassī tu bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
vatthadānaṃ pasaṃsitvā pakkāmi uttarāmukho.  // ApTha_7,67.5 //  
Bhave nibbattamānamhi honti me vatthasampadā /  
ākāse chadanaṃ hoti vatthadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_7,67.6 //  
Aruṇakā[^116-5] satta janā cakkavattī mahabbalā /  
chattiṃsatimhi āsiṃsu kappamhi manujādhipā.  // ApTha_7,67.7 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_7,67.8 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Vatthadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Vatthadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[68. Ambadāyaka.] Anomadassī bhagavā nisinno pabbatantare /  
mettāya apharī lokaṃ[^116-6] appamāṇaṃ[^116-7] nirūpadhī.[^116-8]  // ApTha_7,68.1 //  
Kapi ahaṃ tadā āsiṃ Himavante naguttame /  
disvā Anomam amitaṃ Buddhe cittaṃ pasādayiṃ.  // ApTha_7,68.2 //  
Avidūre Himavantassa ambā suphalino tadā /  
tato pakkaṃ gahetvāna ambam samadhukam adaṃ.  // ApTha_7,68.3 //


<!-- PTS Page 117 -->
<a id="page-117"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 117]*

Tam me buddho viyākāsi Anomadassī mahāmuni: /  
‘Iminā madhudānena ambadānena cūbhayaṃ.  // ApTha_7,68.4 //  
Sattapaññāsakappāni devaloke ramissasi[^117-1] /  
avasesesu kappesu vokiṇṇaṃ saṃsarissasi.[^117-2]  // ApTha_7,68.5 //  
Khepetvā pāpakaṃ kammaṃ paripakkāya buddhiyā /  
vinipātādiyā gantvā kilese jhāpayissasi.';  // ApTha_7,68.6 //  
Dhammena yuttamenāhaṃ[^117-3] damito 'mhi mahesinā /  
patto 'mhi acalaṃ ṭhānaṃ hitvā jayaparājayaṃ.  // ApTha_7,68.7 //  
Sattasattati kappasate Ambaṭṭhaja-sanāmakā[^117-4] /  
*catuddasā te rājāno* cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_7,68.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ ti.  // ApTha_7,68.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ambadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Ambadāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[69. Sumana.] Sumano nāma nāmena mālākāro ahaṃ tadā /  
addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ.  // ApTha_7,69.1 //  
Ubbo hatthehi paggayha sumanaṃ pupphamuttamaṃ /  
Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Sikhino lokabandhuno.  // ApTha_7,69.2 //  
Imāya pupphapūjāya cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_7,69.3 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_7,69.4 //  
Chabbīsatimhi kappamhi cattār'; assu[^117-5] mahāyasā /  
sattaratanasampannā rājāno cakkavattino.[^117-6]  // ApTha_7,69.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_7,69.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sumano thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sumanattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 118 -->
<a id="page-118"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 118]*

[70. Pupphacaṅgoṭiya.] Abhītarūpaṃ sīhaṃ va garuḷaggaṃ va pakkhinaṃ /  
vyagghusabhaṃ va pavaraṃ abhijātaṃ va kesariṃ  // ApTha_7,70.1 //  
Sikhiṃ[^118-1] tilokasaraṇaṃ anejaṃ aparājitaṃ /  
nisinnaṃ *samaṇaggaṃ* bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṃ  // ApTha_7,70.2 //  
Caṅgoṭake ṭhapetvāna anojaṃ pupphamuttamaṃ /  
sahacaṅgoṭaken'[^118-2] eva Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ samokiriṃ.  // ApTha_7,70.3 //  
Tena cittappasādena dipadinda narāsabha[^118-3] /  
patto 'mhi acalaṭṭhānaṃ[^118-4] hitvā jayaparājayaṃ.  // ApTha_7,70.4 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_7,70.5 //  
Sampuṇṇe tiṃsakappamhi[^118-5] Devabhūti-sanāmakā /  
sattaratanasampannā pañc'; āsuṃ cakkavattino.  // ApTha_7,70.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_7,70.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pupphacaṅgoṭiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Pupphacaṅgoṭiyatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Sakacittaṃ[^118-6] Addhāpupphi[^118-7] Paccābhigamanena[^118-8] ca Parappasādi Bhisado Sucinti[^118-9] Vatthadāyako. Ambadāyi[^118-10] ca Sumano Pupphacaṅgoṭiko[^118-11] pi ca gāth'; ekasattati vuttā gaṇitā atthadassihi.[^118-12] Sakacittiyavaggo sattamo.


<!-- PTS Page 119 -->
<a id="page-119"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 119]*

[VIII. NĀGASAMALAVAGGO.]

[71. Nāgasamāla.] Apāṭaliṃ[^119-1] ahaṃ pupphaṃ ujjhitaṃ sumahāpathe /  
thūpamhi[^119-2] abhiropesiṃ[^119-3] Sikhino lokabandhuno.  // ApTha_8,71.1 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ[^119-4] tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi thūpapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_8,71.2 //  
Ito pannarase kappe Bhūmiyo nāma khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahabbalo.  // ApTha_8,71.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_8,71.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Nāgasamālo thero[^119-5] imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Nāgasamālatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[72. Padasaññaka.] Akkantañ ca padaṃ disvā Tissassādiccabandhuno /  
haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena pade[^119-6] cittaṃ pasādayiṃ.  // ApTha_8,72.1 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ[^119-7] tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi padasaññāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_8,72.2 //  
Ito sattamake kappe Sumedho nāma khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahābalo.  // ApTha_8,72.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ ti.  // ApTha_8,72.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Padasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Padasaññakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 120 -->
<a id="page-120"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 120]*

[73. Saññaka.] Dumagge paṃsukūlikaṃ laggaṃ disvāna satthuno /  
tato 'haṃ[^120-1] añjaliṃ katvā paṃsukūliṃ avandi 'haṃ.[^120-2]  // ApTha_8,73.1 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ[^120-3] tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhasaññāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_8,73.2 //  
Ito catutthake kappe Dumasāro su khattiyo /  
caturanto vijitāvī cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_8,73.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_8,73.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Saññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Saññakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[74. Bhisāluvadāyaka.] Kānanaṃ vanam oggayha[^120-4] vasāmi vivane ahaṃ /  
Vipassim addasaṃ Buddhaṃ āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ.  // ApTha_8,74.1 //  
Bhisāluvañ ca pādāsim[^120-5] udakaṃ hatthadhovanaṃ[^120-6] /  
vanditvā sirasā pāde pakkāmi uttarāmukho.  // ApTha_8,74.2 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe bhisāluvam adaṃ[^120-7] tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi puññakammass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_8,74.3 //  
Ito tatiyake kappe Bhisasammata[^120-8]-khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahabbalo.  // ApTha_8,74.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_8,74.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Bhisāluvadāyako[^120-9] thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Bhisāluvadāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Chaṭṭhamabhānavāraṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 121 -->
<a id="page-121"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 121]*

[75. Ekasaññaka.] Khaṇḍo nām'; āsi[^121-1] nāmena Vipassiss'; aggasāvako /  
ekā bhikkhā mayā dinnā lokāhutipaṭiggaho.  // ApTha_8,75.1 //  
Tena cittappasādena dipadinda[^121-2] narāsabha[^121-3] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ekabhikkhāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_8,75.2 //  
Cattālīse ito kappe Varuṇo nāma khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahabbalo.  // ApTha_8,75.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_8,75.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ekasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Ekasaññakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[76. Tiṇasanthāradāyaka.] Himavantass'; avidūre mahājātassaro ahū /  
satapattehi sañchanno nānāsakuṇamālayo.  // ApTha_8,76.1 //  
Tamhi nahātvā[^121-4] pivitvā ca avidūre vasām'; ahaṃ /  
addasaṃ samaṇānaggaṃ gacchantaṃ anilañjase.[^121-5]  // ApTha_8,76.2 //  
Mama saṅkappām aññāya satthā loke anuttaro /  
abbhato oruhitvāna[^121-6] bhūmiy'; aṭṭhāsi[^121-7] tāvade.  // ApTha_8,76.3 //  
Visāṇena tiṇaṃ gayha nisīdanam adās'; ahaṃ /  
nisīdi bhagavā tattha Tisso lokavināyako.[^121-8]  // ApTha_8,76.4 //  
Sakaṃ cittaṃ[^121-9] pasādetvā avandiṃ[^121-10] lokanāyakaṃ /  
paṭikuṭiko[^121-11] avasakkiṃ[^121-12] nijjhāyanto mahāmuniṃ.  // ApTha_8,76.5 //  
Tena cittappasādena Nimmānaṃ upapajj'; ahaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi santhārassa[^121-13] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_8,76.6 //


<!-- PTS Page 122 -->
<a id="page-122"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 122]*

Ito dutiyake kappe Migasammata-khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_8,76.7 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_8,76.8 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Tiṇasanthārako[^122-1] thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Tiṇasanthāradāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[77. Sūcidāyaka.] Tiṃsakappasahassamhi sambuddho lokanāyako /  
Sumedho nāma nāmena battiṃsavaralakkhaṇo.[^122-2]  // ApTha_8,77.1 //  
Tassa kañcanavaṇṇassa dipadindassa tādino /  
pañca sūcī mayā dinnā sibbanatthāya[^122-3] cīvaraṃ.  // ApTha_8,77.2 //  
Ten'; eva sūcidānena nipuṇatthaṃ vipassakaṃ /  
tikkhalahuñ[^122-4] ca phāsuñ ca ñāṇam me udapajjatha.[^122-5]  // ApTha_8,77.3 //  
Kilesā jhāpitā mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā /  
dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane.  // ApTha_8,77.4 //  
Dipadādhipati nāma rājāno caturo ahuṃ /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_8,77.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_8,77.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sūcidāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sūcidāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[78. Pāṭalipupphiya.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ[^122-6] sambuddhaṃ gacchantaṃ antarāpaṇe /  
kañcanagghiyasaṅkāsaṃ dvattiṃsavaralakkhaṇaṃ.[^122-7]  // ApTha_8,78.1 //  
Seṭṭhiputto tadā āsiṃ sukhumālo sukheṭhito[^122-8] /  
ucchaṅge[^122-9] pāṭalīpupphaṃ katvā taṃ abhisaṃhariṃ.[^122-10]  // ApTha_8,78.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 123 -->
<a id="page-123"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 123]*

Haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena pupphena[^123-1] abhipūjayiṃ /  
Tissaṃ lokaviduṃ nāthaṃ[^123-2] naradevaṃ namass'; ahaṃ.[^123-3]  // ApTha_8,78.3 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphapūjāy'[^123-4] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_8,78.4 //  
Ito tesaṭṭhi kappamhi Abhisammata-nāmako[^123-5] /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahābalo.  // ApTha_8,78.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_8,78.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pāṭalipupphiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Pāṭalipupphiyatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[79. Ṭhitañjaliya.] Migaluddo[^123-6] pure āsiṃ araññe kānane ahaṃ /  
tatth'; addasāsiṃ[^123-7] sambuddhaṃ Tissaṃ pavaralakkhaṇaṃ.  // ApTha_8,79.1 //  
Tatthāhaṃ añjaliṃ katvā pakkāmiṃ pācināmukho /  
avidūre nisinnassa niyate paṇṇasanthare.[^123-8]  // ApTha_8,79.2 //  
Tato me asanīpāto[^123-9] matthake nipatī[^123-10] tadā /  
so 'haṃ maraṇakālamhi akāsiṃ punar añjaliṃ.  // ApTha_8,79.3 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe añjalim akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi añjalissa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_8,79.4 //  
Catupaṇṇāsakappamhi Migaketu-sanāmako /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahabbalo.  // ApTha_8,79.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_8,79.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ṭhitañjaliyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Ṭhitañjaliyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 124 -->
<a id="page-124"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 124]*

[80. Tīṇipadumiya.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū /  
danto dantaparivuto nagarā nikkhamī jino.  // ApTha_8,80.1 //  
Nagare[^124-1] Haṃsavatiyā ahosiṃ[^124-2] māliko[^124-3] tadā /  
yaṃ tattha uttamaṃ pupphaṃ tīṇi pupphāni aggahiṃ.  // ApTha_8,80.2 //  
Addasaṃ virajaṃ *Buddhaṃ paṭimaggantarāpaṇe* /  
so 'haṃ[^124-4] disvāna sambuddhaṃ evaṃ cintes'; ahaṃ tadā:  // ApTha_8,80.3 //  
‘Kim me imehi[^124-5] pupphehi rañño upanītehi[^124-6] me? /  
Gāmaṃ vā gāmakkhettaṃ vā sahassaṃ vā labheyya 'haṃ.  // ApTha_8,80.4 //  
Adantadamakaṃ *dhīraṃ[^124-7] sabbasattasukhāvahaṃ* /  
lokanāthaṃ pūjayitvā lacchāmi amitaṃ[^124-8] dhanaṃ.';  // ApTha_8,80.5 //  
Evāhaṃ cintayitvāna sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādayiṃ[^124-9] /  
{tīṇi} lohitake gayha[^124-10] ākāse ukkhipiṃ[^124-11] tadā.  // ApTha_8,80.6 //  
Mayā ukkhittamattam hi ākāse patthariṃsu te[^124-12] /  
dhāriṃsu matthake tattha uddhavaṇṭā adhomukhā.  // ApTha_8,80.7 //  
Ye keci manujā disvā ukkuṭṭhiṃ sampavattayuṃ /  
devatā antalikkhamhi sādhukāraṃ pavattayuṃ:  // ApTha_8,80.8 //  
‘Accheraṃ loke uppannaṃ buddhaseṭṭhassa vāhasā /  
sabbe dhammaṃ suṇissāma pupphānaṃ vāhasā mayaṃ.';  // ApTha_8,80.9 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
vīthiyam hi ṭhito satthā[^124-13] imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_8,80.10 //  
‘Yo so buddhaṃ apūjesi[^124-14] rattapadumehi[^124-15] tadā[^124-16] /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato:';  // ApTha_8,80.11 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassāni devaloke ramissati /  
tiṃsakappāni devindo devarajjam karissati.  // ApTha_8,80.12 //  
Mahāvitthārikaṃ nāma vyamhaṃ[^124-17] hessati tāvade /  
tiyojanasatubbeddhaṃ[^124-18] diyaḍḍhasatavitthataṃ.  // ApTha_8,80.13 //


<!-- PTS Page 125 -->
<a id="page-125"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 125]*

Cattārisatasahassāni niyyūhā[^125-1] ca sumāpitā /  
kūṭāgāravarūpetā mahāsayanavositā.  // ApTha_8,80.14 //  
Koṭisatasahassiyo[^125-2] parivāressanti[^125-3] accharā /  
kusalā naccagītassa vāditehi padakkhinaṃ.  // ApTha_8,80.15 //  
Etādise vyamhavare[^125-4] nārīgaṇasamākule /  
vassissati pupphavasso dibbo lohitako[^125-5] sadā.  // ApTha_8,80.16 //  
Bhittikhīle nāgadante[^125-6] dvāragāhe[^125-7] ca toraṇe[^125-8] /  
cakkamattā[^125-9] lohitakā olambissanti tāvade.  // ApTha_8,80.17 //  
Pattena pattasañchanne[^125-10] anto vyamhavare[^125-11] imaṃ /  
attharitvā pārupitvā[^125-12] tuvaṭṭhissanti[^125-13] tāvade.  // ApTha_8,80.18 //  
Bhavanaṃ parivāretvā samantā satayojanaṃ[^125-14] /  
te visuddhā lohitakā dibbā gandhā pavāyare.  // ApTha_8,80.19 //  
Pañcasatatikkhattuñ ca cakkavatti bhavissati /  
padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ.[^125-15]  // ApTha_8,80.20 //  
Sampattiyo duve bhutvā[^125-16] anīti[^125-17] anupaddavo /  
sampatte pariyosāne nibbānaṃ passayissati.  // ApTha_8,80.21 //  
Sudiṭṭho vata me Buddho, vānijjaṃ suppayojitaṃ[^125-18] /  
padumāni {tīṇi} pūjetvā[^125-19] anubhosin ti[^125-20] sampadā.[^125-21]  // ApTha_8,80.22 //  
Ajja me dhammapattassa vippamuttassa sabbaso /  
supupphitaṃ lohitakaṃ dhārayissanti[^125-22] matthake.  // ApTha_8,80.23 //  
Mama kammaṃ kathentassa Padumuttarasatthuno /  
sattapāṇasahassānaṃ[^125-23] dhammābhisamayo ahu.  // ApTha_8,80.24 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ Buddham abhipūjayiṃ[^125-24] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi {tīṇi} padumān'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_8,80.25 //  
Kilesā jhāpitā mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā /  
sabbāsavaparikkhīṇo[^125-25] n'; atthi dāni[^125-26] punabbhavo.  // ApTha_8,80.26 //

Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_8,80.27 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Tīṇipadumiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Tīṇipadumiyatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Samālo Padasaññī ca[^126-1] Sasaññ'; Āluvadāyako[^126-2] Ekasaññī Tiṇadado[^126-3] Sūcī Pāṭalipupphiyo Ṭhitañjalī Tipadumī gāthāyo pañcasattati. Nāgasamālavaggo aṭṭhamo.

[IX. TIMIRAPUPPHIYA.]

[81. Timirapupphiya.] Candabhāgānadītīre anusotaṃ vajām'; ahaṃ /  
nisinnaṃ samaṇaṃ disvā vippasannam anāvilaṃ.  // ApTha_9,81.1 //  
Tassa cittaṃ pasādetvā evaṃ cintes'; ahaṃ tadā /  
tārayissati tiṇṇo 'yaṃ danto 'yaṃ damayissati.  // ApTha_9,81.2 //  
Assāsessati[^126-4] assattho[^126-5] santo ca samayissati /  
mocayissati mutto ca nibbāpessati nibbuto.  // ApTha_9,81.3 //  
Evāhaṃ cintayitvāna Siddhatthassa mahesino /  
gahetvā timiraṃ pupphaṃ matthake okirim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_9,81.4 //  
Añjalippaggahetvāna[^126-6] katvāna ca[^126-7] padakkhinaṃ /  
vanditvā satthuno pāde pakkāmiṃ aparaṃ disaṃ.[^126-8]  // ApTha_9,81.5 //  
Aciraṃ gatamattaṃ maṃ[^126-9] migarājā apīḷayi[^126-10] /  
papātam anugacchanto tatth'; eva papatiṃ[^126-11] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_9,81.6 //  
Catunavut'; ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ[^126-12] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapujāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_9,81.7 //


<!-- PTS Page 127 -->
<a id="page-127"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 127]*

Chappaññāsamhi kappamhi satt'; ev'; āsuṃ[^127-1] mahāyasā[^127-2] /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_9,81.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_9,81.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Timirapupphiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Timirapupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[82. Gatasaññaka.] Jātiyā[^127-3] sattavasso 'haṃ pabbajiṃ[^127-4] anagāriyaṃ /  
avandiṃ[^127-5] satthuno pāde vippasannena cetasā.  // ApTha_9,82.1 //  
Satta naṅgaliki pupphe[^127-6] ākāse ukkhipiṃ[^127-7] ahaṃ /  
Tissaṃ Buddhaṃ samuddissa[^127-8] anantaguṇasāgaraṃ.  // ApTha_9,82.2 //  
Sugatānugataṃ maggaṃ pūjetvā[^127-9] haṭṭhamānaso /  
añjaliṃ va[^127-10] tad'; ākāsiṃ[^127-11] pasanno sehi pāṇihi.  // ApTha_9,82.3 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_9,82.4 //  
Ito aṭṭhamake[^127-12] kappe tayo Aggisikhā ahuṃ /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_9,82.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_9,82.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Gatasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti. Gatasaññakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[83. Pannañjalika.] Rukkhamūle nisinno 'haṃ vyādhito paramen'; ahaṃ /  
paramakāruññapatto 'mhi araññe kānane ahaṃ.  // ApTha_9,83.1 //  
Anukampaṃ upādāya Tisso satthā upesi[^128-1] maṃ /  
so 'haṃ nipannako santo sīre katvāna añjaliṃ.  // ApTha_9,83.2 //  
Pasannacitto sumano sabbasattānam uttamaṃ /  
sambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā[^128-2] tattha kālakato[^128-3] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_9,83.3 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ vandiṃ purisuttamaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi vandanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_9,83.4 //  
Ito pañcamake kappe pañc'; ev'; āsuṃ Mahāsikhā /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_9,83.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_9,83.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pannañjaliyo[^128-4] thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Pannañjalikattherassa[^128-4] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[84. Adhopupphiya.] Abhibhū nāma so bhikkhu Sikhino aggasāvako /  
mahānubhāvo tevijjo Himavantaṃ upāgami.[^128-5]  // ApTha_9,84.1 //  
Aham pi Himavantamhi ramanīy'; assame[^128-6] isi /  
vasāmi appamaññāsu iddhīsu ca tadā vasī.[^128-7]  // ApTha_9,84.2 //  
Pakkhī jāto viy'; ākāse pabbataṃ abhipatthayiṃ[^128-8] /  
adho pupphaṃ gahetvāna āgañchiṃ[^128-9] pabbataṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_9,84.3 //  
Sattapupphāni[^128-10] gaṇhitvā matthake okiriṃ ahaṃ /  
ālokito ca vīrena[^128-11] pakkāmiṃ pācināmukho.  // ApTha_9,84.4 //
