##### *[PTS Page 129]*

Āvāsam abhisambhosiṃ patvāna assamaṃ ahaṃ /  
khāribhāraṃ[^129-1] gahetvāna pāvisiṃ[^129-2] pabbatantaraṃ.[^129-3]  // ApTha_9,84.5 //  
Ajagaro maṃ pīḷesi ghorarūpo mahabbalo /  
pubbakammaṃ[^129-4] saritvāna tattha kālakato[^129-5] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_9,84.6 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ[^129-6] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_9,84.7 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_9,84.8 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Adhopupphiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Adhopupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[85. Raṃsisaññika.] Pabbate Himavantamhi vāsaṃ kappes'; ahaṃ pure /  
ajinuttamavattho[^129-7] 'haṃ vasāmi pabbatantare.  // ApTha_9,85.1 //  
Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ sataraṃsī va bhānumaṃ /  
vanantara gataṃ[^129-8] disvā sālarājaṃ va pupphitaṃ.  // ApTha_9,85.2 //  
Raṃse[^129-9] cittaṃ pasādetvā Vipassissa mahesino /  
paggayha añjaliṃ vandiṃ sirasā ukkuṭiṃ[^129-10] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_9,85.3 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ[^129-11] tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi raṃsisaññāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_9,85.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_9,85.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Raṃsisaññako[^129-12] thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Raṃsisaññikattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[86. Raṃsisaññaka.] Pabbate Himavantamhi vākacīradharo ahaṃ /  
caṅkamañ ca samārūḷho nisīdiṃ[^130-1] pācināmukho.  // ApTha_9,86.1 //  
Pabbate sugataṃ disvā Phussaṃ jhānarataṃ tadā[^130-2] /  
añjaliṃ paggahetvāna raṃse cittappasādayiṃ.[^130-3]  // ApTha_9,86.2 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ[^130-4] tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi raṃsisaññāy'[^130-5] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_9,86.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /

Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Raṃsisaññako[^130-6] thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Raṃsisaññakatherassa[^130-7] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[87. Phaladāyaka.] Pabbate Himavantamhi kharājinadharo ahaṃ /  
Phussaṃ jinavaraṃ disvā phalahattho phalaṃ adaṃ  // ApTha_9,87.1 //  
Yam ahaṃ phalam adāsiṃ vippasannena cetasā /  
bhave nibbattamānamhi[^130-8] phalaṃ nibbattate[^130-9] mamaṃ.  // ApTha_9,87.2 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ phalam adadim ahaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_9,87.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sasanan ti.  // ApTha_9,87.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Phaladāyakothero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Phaladāyakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[88. Saddasaññaka.] Pabbate Himavantamhi vasāmi paṇṇasanthare[^131-1] /

Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ[^131-3] tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi puññakammass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_9,88.2 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_9,88.3 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Saddasaññakothero[^131-4] imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Saddasaññakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[89. Bodhisaññaka.] Vipassissa bhagavato mahābodhimaho ahū /  
pabbajj'; upagato[^131-5] santo upagacchiṃ[^131-6] mahaṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_9,89.1 //  
Kusumodakaṃ[^131-7] ādāya bodhiyā okirim ahaṃ /  
*mocayissati no mu*tto nibbāpessati nibbuto.  // ApTha_9,89.2 //

duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bodhisaññāy'[^131-9] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_9,89.3 //  
Tettiṃse vattamānamhi kappe āsuṃ janādhipa /  
Udakāsecanā nāma aṭṭh'; ete cakkavattino.  // ApTha_9,89.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍābhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_9,89.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Bodhisaññakothero[^131-10] imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Bodhisaññakatherassa[^131-10] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[90. Padumapupphiya.] Pokkharavanaṃ paviṭṭho bhuñjanto[^132-1] padumān'; ahaṃ /  
addasaṃ Phussasambuddhaṃ[^132-2] battiṃsavaralakkhaṇaṃ.[^132-3]  // ApTha_9,90.1 //  
Padumapupphaṃ gahetvā[^132-4] ākāse ukkhipiṃ[^132-5] ahaṃ /  
pasannakammaṃ katvāna[^132-6] pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ.  // ApTha_9,90.2 //  
Pabbajitvāna kāyena manasā saṃvutena[^132-7] ca /  
vacīduccaritaṃ hitvā ājīvaṃ parisodhayiṃ.  // ApTha_9,90.3 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_9,90.4 //  
Padumabhāsanāmā ca aṭṭhārasa-mahīpatī /  
aṭṭhārasasu[^132-8] kappesu aṭṭhatālīsa-m-āsisuṃ.[^132-9]  // ApTha_9,90.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_9,90.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Padumapupphiyothero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Padumapupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Timiraṃ Naṅgalipupphī Nipannañjaliko Adho dve Raṃsisaññī Phalado Saddasaññī ca Sevako Padumapupphī ca gāthāyo chapaññāsa pakittitā. Timirapupphiyavaggo[^132-10] navamo.

[91. Sudhāpiṇḍiya.] Pūjārahe pūjayato[^133-1] Buddhe yadi va[^133-2] sāvake /  
papañcasamatikkante tiṇṇasokapariddave.  // ApTha_10,91.1 //  
Te tādise pūjayato[^133-3] nibbute[^133-4] akutobhaye[^133-5] /  
na sakkā puññaṃ saṅkhātuṃ ime ttaṃ[^133-6] api kenaci.  // ApTha_10,91.2 //  
Catunnam api dīpānaṃ[^133-7] issaraṃ yodhakāraye /  
ekissā pūjanāy'; etaṃ kalaṃ nāgghati[^133-8] soḷasiṃ.[^133-9]  // ApTha_10,91.3 //  
Siddhatthassa naraggassa cetiye phalitantare[^133-10] /  
sudhāpiṇḍo mayā dinno vippasannena cetasā.  // ApTha_10,91.4 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi paṭisaṅkhārass'[^133-11] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_10,91.5 //  
Ito tiṃsati[^133-12]-kappamhi Paṭisaṅkhārasavhayā /  
sattaratanasampannā terasācakkavattino.  // ApTha_10,91.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_10,91.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sudhāpiṇḍiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sudhāpiṇḍiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[92. Sucintita.] Tissassa lokanāthassa pubbe-pīṭham-adās'; ahaṃ[^133-13] /  
haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena Buddhassādiccabandhuno.  // ApTha_10,92.1 //  
Aṭṭhatiṃse ito kappe rājā āsiṃ[^133-14] Mahāruci /  
bhogo ca vipulo āsi[^133-15] sayanañ ca anappakaṃ.  // ApTha_10,92.2 //  
Pīṭhaṃ[^133-16] Buddhassa datvāna vippasannena cetasā /  
anubhomi sakaṃ kammaṃ pubbe sukatam attano.  // ApTha_10,92.3 //

[95. Gandhamāliya.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato gandhathūpaṃ akās'; ahaṃ /

[109. Biḷālidāyaka.] Himavantass'; avidūre vasāmi paṇṇasanthare[^145-1] /  
ghāsesu gedham āpanno seyyasīlo va 'han tadā.  // ApTha_11,109.1 //  
Khaṇant'; ālu-kaḷambāni[^145-2] biḷāli-takkaḷāni ca /  
kolaṃ[^145-3] bhallātakaṃ bellaṃ[^145-4] āhaṭvā[^145-5] paṭiyāditaṃ.  // ApTha_11,109.2 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
mama saṅkappam aññāya agacchi[^145-6] mama santikaṃ.  // ApTha_11,109.3 //  
Upāgataṃ mahānāgaṃ devadevaṃ narāsabhaṃ /  
biḷāliṃ paggahetvāna pattamhi okiriṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_11,109.4 //  
Paribhuñji mahāvīro tosayanto mamaṃ tadā /  
paribhuñjitvāna sabbaññū imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_11,109.5 //  
‘Sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā biḷāliṃ me adā tuvaṃ /  
kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ nūpagacchasi.'[^145-7]  // ApTha_11,109.6 //  
Carimaṃ vattate mayhaṃ; bhavā sabbe samūhatā /  
dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane.  // ApTha_11,109.7 //  
Catupaññās'; ito kappe Sumekhalisamavhayo[^145-8] /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_11,109.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_11,109.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Biḷālidāyako thero[^145-9] imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti. Biḷālidāyakattherassa[^145-9] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 146 -->
<a id="page-146"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 146]*

[110. Reṇupūjaka.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ sataraṃsīva bhānumaṃ /  
obhāsentaṃ[^146-1] disā sabbā uḷurājaṃ[^146-2] va pūrītaṃ[^146-3]  // ApTha_11,110.1 //  
Purakkh*ataṃ sāvakehi sāgareneva medinī[^146-4] /  
nāgaṃ[^146-5] pa*ggayha reṇūhi Vipassissābhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_11,110.2 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ reṇum abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_11,110.3 //  
Paṇṇatālīs'; ito *kappe Reṇu-nām'; āsi khattiyo /  
sattaratana*sampanno cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_11,110.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_11,110.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Reṇupūjakothero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti. Reṇupūjakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Bhikkhadāyī Ñāṇaṃsaññī[^146-6] Hatthiyo Padapūjako Muṭṭhipupphī Udakado Naḷamālī Nivāsako[^146-7] Biḷālidāyī[^146-8] Reṇu ca gāthāyo cha ca saṭṭhi ca Bhikkhadāyī-vaggo ekadasamo.

[111. Mahāparivāra.] Vipassī nāma bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
aṭṭhasaṭṭhisahassehi pāvisi Bandhumaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_12,111.1 //  
Nagarā[^146-9] abhinikkhamma agamaṃ dīpacetiyaṃ /  
addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ.  // ApTha_12,111.2 //  
Cullāsītisahassāni[^146-10] yakkhā mayhaṃ upantike /  
upaṭṭhahanti sakkaccaṃ Indaṃ va Tidasāgaṇā.  // ApTha_12,111.3 //


<!-- PTS Page 147 -->
<a id="page-147"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 147]*

Bhavanā abhinikkhamma dussaṃ paggayh'; ahaṃ tadā /  
sīrasā abhivādesiṃ[^147-1] tañ cādāsi mahesino:  // ApTha_12,111.4 //  
‘Aho Buddhā aho dhammā aho no satthu sampadā /  
Buddhassa ānubhāvena vasudhā 'yam pakampatha.';  // ApTha_12,111.5 //  
Tañ ca acchariyaṃ disvā abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ /  
Buddhe cittaṃ pasādesiṃ[^147-2] dipadindamhi tādine.[^147-3]  // ApTha_12,111.6 //  
So 'haṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā dussaṃ datvāna satthuno /  
saraṇañ ca upāgañchiṃ sāmacco[^147-4] saparijjano.  // ApTha_12,111.7 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_12,111.8 //  
Ito paṇṇarase kappe soḷas'; āsiṃsu Vāhanā /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā  // ApTha_12,111.9 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_12,111.10 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Mahāparivāro thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Mahāparivāratherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[112. {Sumaṅgala}.] Atthadassī jinavaro lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
vihārā abhinikkhamma taḷākaṃ upasaṅkami.  // ApTha_12,112.1 //  
Nahātva[^147-5] pītvā ca[^147-6] sambuddho uttaritv'; ekacīvaro /  
aṭṭhāsi bhagavā tattha vilokento disodisaṃ.  // ApTha_12,112.2 //  
Bhavane[^147-7] upaviṭṭho 'haṃ addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ /  
haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena appoṭhesiṃ[^147-8] ahaṃ tadā  // ApTha_12,112.3 //  
Satarasmiṃ[^147-9] va jotantaṃ pabhāsantaṃ va kañcanaṃ /  
nacce gīte ca yutto[^147-10] 'haṃ pañcaturiyatamhi[^147-11] ca.  // ApTha_12,112.4 //  
Yaṃ yaṃ yonūpapajjāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ[^147-12] /  
sabbe satte atihomi[^147-13] vipulo hoti me yaso.  // ApTha_12,112.5 //


<!-- PTS Page 148 -->
<a id="page-148"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 148]*

‘Namo te purisājañña namo te purisuttama /  
attānaṃ tosayitvāna pare tosesi tvaṃ mune.'[^148-1]  // ApTha_12,112.6 //  
Paṭiggahetvā[^148-2] nisīditvā hāsaṃ katvāna subbate[^148-3] /  
upaṭṭhahitvā sambuddhaṃ Tusitaṃ upapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_12,112.7 //  
Soḷase 'to kappasate dvinavā[^148-4] Ekacintitā /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_12,112.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_12,112.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sumaṅgalo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sumaṅgalatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[113. Saraṇāgamaniya.] Ubhinnaṃ devarājūnaṃ saṅgāmo paccupaṭṭhito[^148-5] /  
ahosi samupabbūḷho[^148-6] mahāghoso pavattatha.  // ApTha_12,113.1 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
antalikkhe ṭhito satthā saṃvejesi mahājanaṃ.  // ApTha_12,113.2 //  
Sabbe devā attamanā nikkhittakavacāvudhā /  
sambuddham-abhivādetvā ekagg'-āsiṃsu[^148-7] tāvade.  // ApTha_12,113.3 //  
Amhaṃ[^148-8] saṅkappam aññāya vācāsabhim udīrayi[^148-9] /  
anukampako lokavidū nibbāpesi mahājanaṃ.  // ApTha_12,113.4 //  
‘Paduṭṭhacitto manujo ekapāṇaṃ[^148-10] viheṭhayaṃ /  
tena cittappadosena[^148-11] apāyaṃ upapajjati.  // ApTha_12,113.5 //  
Saṅgāmasīse[^148-12] nāgo va bahū[^148-13] pāṇe viheṭhayaṃ /  
nibbāpetha sakaṃ cittaṃ mā haññittho punappunaṃ.';  // ApTha_12,113.6 //  
Dvinnam pi yakkharājānaṃ senā sā vimhitā[^148-14] ahu /  
saraṇañ ca upagañchuṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ su-tādinaṃ.  // ApTha_12,113.7 //


<!-- PTS Page 149 -->
<a id="page-149"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 149]*

Saññāpetvāna janataṃ uddharī[^149-1] pana cakkhumā /  
pekkhamāno ca devehi pakkāmi uttarāmukho.  // ApTha_12,113.8 //  
Paṭhamaṃ saraṇaṃ gañchiṃ dipadindassa[^149-2] tādino /  
kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ nūpapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_12,113.9 //  
Mahācundā hi nāmā[^149-3] ca soḷas'; āsuṃ[^149-4] rathesabhā /  
tiṃsakappasahassamhi rājāno cakkavattino.  // ApTha_12,113.10 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_12,113.11 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Saraṇāgamaniyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Saraṇāgamaniyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[114. Ekāsanīya.] Varuṇo māma nāmena devarājā ahaṃ tadā /  
upaṭṭhahesiṃ[^149-5] sambuddhaṃ sayoggabalavāhano.  // ApTha_12,114.1 //  
Nibbutte lokanāthamhi Atthadassi-naruttame /  
turiyaṃ sabbam ādāya agamaṃ[^149-6] bodhim uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_12,114.2 //  
Vādi*tena ca naccena samatāḷasamāhi*to[^149-7] /  
Sammukhā[^149-8] viya[^149-9] sambuddhaṃ upaṭṭhiṃ[^149-10] bodhim uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_12,114.3 //  
Upaṭṭhahitvā taṃ bodhiṃ dharaṇīrūhapādapaṃ /  
pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvāna tattha kālakato[^149-11] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_12,114.4 //  
Sakakammābhiraddho 'haṃ pasanno bodhi-m-uttame /  
tena *cittappasādena nibbānam upapa*jj'; ahaṃ  // ApTha_12,114.5 //  
Saṭṭhiṃturiyasahassāni[^149-12] parivārenti maṃ sadā /  
mānussesu[^149-13] ca devesu vattamānaṃ bhavābhave.  // ApTha_12,114.6 //  
Tivaggī[^149-14] nibbutā[^149-15] mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā /  
dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane.  // ApTha_12,114.7 //


<!-- PTS Page 150 -->
<a id="page-150"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 150]*

Subahū[^150-1] nāma nāmena *cattutiṃsāsuṃ khattiyā /  
sa*ttaratanasampannā pañcakappasate ito.  // ApTha_12,114.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_12,114.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ekāsaniyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti. Ekāsanīyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[115. Suvaṇṇapupphiya.] Vipassī nāma bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
nisinno janakāyassa deseti amataṃ padaṃ.  // ApTha_12,115.1 //  
Tassāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna dipadindassa tādino /  
soṇṇapupphāni cattāri Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ.[^150-2]  // ApTha_12,115.2 //  
Suvaṇṇacchadanaṃ āsi yāvatā parisā tadā /  
Buddhābhā va[^150-3] suvaṇṇābhā āloko vipulo ahu.  // ApTha_12,115.3 //  
Udaggacitto sumano vedajāto[^150-4] katañjali[^150-5] /  
vittisañjanano[^150-6] tesaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhāvaho.  // ApTha_12,115.4 //  
Ārādhitvāna[^150-7] sambuddhaṃ vanditvāna ca subbataṃ[^150-8] /  
pāmujjaṃ janayitvāna sakaṃ bhavanupāgamiṃ.[^150-9]  // ApTha_12,115.5 //  
Bhavane upaviṭṭho 'haṃ Buddhaṃseṭṭhaṃ[^150-10] anussariṃ[^150-11] /  
tena cittappasādena Tusitaṃ upapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_12,115.6 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ[^150-12] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_12,115.7 //  
Soḷas'; āsiṃsu rājāno Nemisammata-nāmakā[^150-13] /  
tetālise[^150-14] ito kappe cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_12,115.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_12,115.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Suvaṇṇapupphiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Suvaṇṇapupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

##### *[PTS Page 151]*

[116. Citakapūjaka.] Vasāmi rājāyatane sāmacco saparijjano /  
parinibbute bhagavati Sikhine lokabandhune.  // ApTha_12,116.1 //  
Pasannacitto sumano citakaṃ agamās'[^151-1] ahaṃ /  
turiyaṃ tattha vādetvā gandhamālaṃ samokiriṃ.  // ApTha_12,116.2 //  
Citakamhi[^151-2] pūjaṃ katvā vanditvā[^151-3] citakaṃ ahaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano sakaṃ bhava'; upāgamiṃ.[^151-4]  // ApTha_12,116.3 //  
Bhavane upaviṭṭho 'haṃ citakapūjaṃ[^151-5] anussariṃ[^151-6] /  
tena[^151-7] kammena dipadinda[^151-8] lokajeṭṭha narāsabha[^151-9]  // ApTha_12,116.4 //  
Anubhotvāna[^151-10] sampattiṃ devesu manujesu ca /  
patto 'mhi acalaṭṭhānaṃ hitvā jayaparājayaṃ.  // ApTha_12,116.5 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi citakapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_12,116.6 //  
Ekūnatiṃse kappamhi ito soḷasa rājino /  
Uggatā[^151-11] nāma nāmena cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_12,116.7 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_12,116.8 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Citakapūjako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Citakapūjakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[117. Buddhasaññaka.] Yadā Vipassilokaggo āyusaṅkhāram ossaji[^151-12] /  
paṭhavī sampakampittha[^151-13] medinī-jalamekhalā.  // ApTha_12,117.1 //  
Otataṃ vitataṃ mayhaṃ suvicittaṃ vaṭaṃsakaṃ[^151-14] /  
bhavanam pi pakampittha Buddhassa āyusaṅkhaye.  // ApTha_12,117.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 152 -->
<a id="page-152"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 152]*

Tāso[^152-1] mayhaṃ samuppanno bhavane sampakampite /  
uppādo nu kim atthāya āloko vipulo ahu.  // ApTha_12,117.3 //  
Vessavaṇṇo idhāgamma nibbāpesi mahājanaṃ /  
‘pāṇabhūtaṃ bhayaṃ[^152-2] n'; atthi; ekaggā hotha[^152-3] saṃvutā.';  // ApTha_12,117.4 //  
Aho Buddhā aho dhammā aho no satthu sampadā /  
yasmiṃ[^152-4] uppajjamānasmiṃ paṭhavī[^152-5] sampakampati.  // ApTha_12,117.5 //  
Buddhānubhāvaṃ kittetvā[^152-6] kappaṃ saggamhi mod'; ahaṃ. /  
avasesesu kappesu kusalaṃ kāritaṃ mayā.  // ApTha_12,117.6 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhasaññāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_12,117.7 //  
Ito cuddasakappamhi rājā āsiṃ[^152-7] patāpavā /  
Samito nāma nāmena cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_12,117.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_12,117.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Buddhasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Buddhasaññakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[118. Maggasaññaka.] Padumuttarabuddhassa sāvakā vanacāriṇo /  
vippanaṭṭhā brahāraññe[^152-8] andhā va anusuyyare.  // ApTha_12,118.1 //  
Anussaritvā sambuddhaṃ Padumuttaranāyakaṃ /  
tassa te munino puttā vippanaṭṭhā mahāvane.  // ApTha_12,118.2 //  
Bhavanā[^152-9] oruhitvāna agamaṃ[^152-10] bhikkhusantike /  
tesaṃ maggaṃ va ācikkhiṃ[^152-11] bhojanañ ca adās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_12,118.3 //  
Tena kammena dipadinda[^152-12] lokajeṭṭha narāsabha /  
jātiyā sattavasso 'haṃ arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.[^152-13]  // ApTha_12,118.4 //  
Sacakkhu nāma nāmena dvādasa cakkavattino /  
sattaratanasampannā pañcakappasate ito.  // ApTha_12,118.5 //


<!-- PTS Page 153 -->
<a id="page-153"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 153]*

Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_12,118.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Maggasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti. Maggasaññakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[119. Paccupaṭṭhānasaññaka.] Atthadassimhi sugate nibbute samanantarā /  
yakkhayoniṃ upapajjiṃ[^153-1] yasapatto[^153-2] c'; ahaṃ[^153-3] tadā.  // ApTha_12,119.1 //  
Dulladdhaṃ vata me āsi, duppabhātaṃ[^153-4] duruṭṭhitaṃ /  
yaṃ me bhoge vijjamāne parinibbāyi cakkhumā.  // ApTha_12,119.2 //  
Mama saṅkappam aññāya Sāgaro nāma sāvako /  
mamuddharitukāmo so āgañchi[^153-5] mama santike.  // ApTha_12,119.3 //  
‘Kin nu socasi mā bhāyi[^153-6] varadhammasumedhasa /  
anuppadinnā Buddhena sabbesaṃ bījasampadā.[^153-7]  // ApTha_12,119.4 //  
Yo ca pūjeyya sambuddhaṃ Siddhatthaṃ[^153-8] lokanāyakaṃ /  
dhātuṃ sāsapamattam hi[^153-9] nibbutassāpi pūjaye.  // ApTha_12,119.5 //  
Same cittappasādamhi samaṃ puññaṃ mahaggataṃ /  
tasmā thūpaṃ karitvāna pūjesi jinadhātuyo.';  // ApTha_12,119.6 //  
Sāgarassa vaco sutvā Buddhathūpaṃ akās'; ahaṃ /  
pañcavasse paricariṃ munino thūpam uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_12,119.7 //  
Tena kammena dipadinda lokajeṭṭha narāsabha /  
sampattiṃ anubhotvāna arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.[^153-10]  // ApTha_12,119.8 //  
Bhūripaññā ca[^153-11] cattāro sattakappasate ito /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_12,119.9 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_12,119.10 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Paccupaṭṭhānasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti. Paccupaṭṭhānasaññakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 154 -->
<a id="page-154"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 154]*

[120. Jātipūjaka.] Jāyantassa Vipassissa āloko vipulo ahu /  
paṭhavī va pakampittha sasāgarasapabbatā.  // ApTha_12,120.1 //  
Nemittā ca viyākaṃsu: ‘Buddho loke bhavissati /  
aggo ca[^154-1] sabbasattānaṃ janataṃ uddharissati.';  // ApTha_12,120.2 //  
Nemittānaṃ suṇitvāna jātipūjaṃ akās'; ahaṃ /  
edisā pūjanā n'; atthi yādisā jātipūjanā.  // ApTha_12,120.3 //  
Saṃkharitvāna[^154-2] kusalaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ[^154-3] pasādayiṃ[^154-4] /  
jātipūjaṃ karitvāna tattha kālakato[^154-5] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_12,120.4 //  
Yaṃ yaṃ yonūpapajjāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ /  
sabbe satte atibhomi jātipūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_12,120.5 //  
Dhātuyo maṃ upaṭṭhanti[^154-6] mama cittavasānugā /  
na te[^154-7] sakkonti kopetuṃ jātipūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_12,120.6 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ pūjam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi jātipūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_12,120.7 //  
Supāricariyā nāma catutiṃsajanādhipā[^154-8] /  
ito tatiye[^154-9] kappamhi cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_12,120.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_12,120.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Jātipūjako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti. Jātipūjakatherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Parivāra-Sumaṅgalya[^154-10] Saraṇ-Āsana-Pupphikā Citapūjī Buddhasaññī Magg-Upaṭṭhāna-Jātinā gāthāyo navuti[^154-11] vuttā gaṇitāyo[^154-12] vibhāvihīti. Mahāparivāravaggo dvādasamo.

[121. Sereyyaka.] Ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedāna-pāragū[^155-1] /  
abbhokāse ṭṭhito[^155-2] santo addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ  // ApTha_13,121.1 //  
Sīhaṃ yathā vanacaraṃ vyaggharājaṃ[^155-3] va nittasaṃ[^155-4] /  
tidhāppabhinnaṃ[^155-5] mātaṅgaṃ kuñjaraṃ va mahesinaṃ.  // ApTha_13,121.2 //  
Sereyyakaṃ gahetvāna ākāse ukkhipiṃ ahaṃ /  
Buddhassa ānubhāvena parivārentu[^155-6] sabbato.  // ApTha_13,121.3 //  
Adhiṭṭhāsi[^155-7] mahāvīro sabbaññū lokanāyako /  
samantā pupphachadanaṃ okiriṃsu narāsabhaṃ.[^155-8]  // ApTha_13,121.4 //  
Tato sapupphakañcukā antovaṇṭā[^155-9] bahimukhā /  
sattāhaṃ chadanaṃ katvā tato antaradhāyatha.[^155-10]  // ApTha_13,121.5 //  
Tañ ca acchariyaṃ disvā abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ /  
Buddhe cittaṃ pasādesiṃ[^155-11] sugate lokanāyake.[^155-12]  // ApTha_13,121.6 //  
Tena cittappasādena sukkamūlena codito /  
kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ nūpapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_13,121.7 //  
Pannarasasahassamhi kappānaṃ pañc'; ahiṃsu te[^155-13] /  
Cīnamālā[^155-14]-sanāmā ca cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_13,121.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_13,121.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sereyyako thero īmā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sereyyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[122. Pupphathūpiya.] Himavantass'; avidūre Kukkuro nāma pabbato /  
vemajjhe tassa vasati brāhmaṇo mantapāragū.  // ApTha_13,122.1 //  
Pañcasissasahassāni parivārent'; imaṃ[^155-15] sadā /  
pubbuṭṭhāyī ca te āsuṃ mantesu ca visāradā.  // ApTha_13,122.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 156 -->

##### *[PTS Page 156]*

Buddho loke samuppanno, taṃ vijānātha no bhavaṃ /  
asītiṃvyañjanā nassa[^156-1] battiṃsavaralakkhaṇā /  
vyāmappabhājinavaro ādicco va virocati.  // ApTha_13,122.3 //  
Sissānaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā brāhmaṇo mantapāragū /  
assamā abhinikkhamma disaṃ pucchati brāhmaṇo /  
yamhi dese[^156-2] mahāvīro vasati lokanāyako?  // ApTha_13,122.4 //  
Na hi[^156-3] disvāna passissaṃ[^156-4] jinaṃ appaṭipuggalaṃ. /  
udaggacitto sumano pūjessañ[^156-5] ca[^156-6] Tathāgataṃ.  // ApTha_13,122.5 //  
Etha[^156-7] sissā gamissāma dakkhissāma Tathāgataṃ /  
vanditvā satthuno pāde sossāma jinasāsanaṃ.  // ApTha_13,122.6 //  
Ekāhaṃ[^156-8] abhinikkhamma[^156-9] vyādhiṃ paṭilabhim ahaṃ /  
vyādhinā pīḷito santo sālaṃ ve sayituṃ[^156-10] gamiṃ.[^156-11]  // ApTha_13,122.7 //  
Sabbe sisse samānetvā apucchiṃ[^156-12] te tathā ahaṃ /  
kīdisaṃ[^156-13] lokanāthassa guṇaṃ paramabuddhino.  // ApTha_13,122.8 //  
Te me puṭṭhā viyākaṃsu yathā dassāvino[^156-14] tathā /  
*kukkuṭṭhaṃ[^156-15] Buddha*seṭṭhaṃ taṃ dassesuṃ mama sammukhā.  // ApTha_13,122.9 //  
Tesāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādayiṃ[^156-16] /  
pupphehi[^156-17] thūpaṃ katvāna tattha kālakato[^156-18] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_13,122.10 //  
Te me sarīraṃ jhāpetvā āgamaṃsu Buddhasantike /  
añjaliṃ paggahetvāna satthāraṃ abhivādayuṃ.  // ApTha_13,122.11 //  
*Pupphehi thū*paṃ katvāna sugatassa mahesino /  
kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ nūpapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_13,122.12 //  
Cattārisatasahassamhi kappe solasa khattiyā /  
nāmen'; Aggisamā nāmā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_13,122.13 //  
Vīse kappasahassamhi[^156-19] rājāno cakkavattino /  
Ghatāsana-sanāmā ca[^156-20] aṭṭhatiṃsa mahīpatī.  // ApTha_13,122.14 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_13,122.15 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pupphathupiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti. Pupphathupiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[123. Pāyāsadāyaka.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ dvattiṃsavaralakkhaṇaṃ[^157-1] /  
pavanā[^157-2] abhinikkhantaṃ bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṃ.  // ApTha_13,123.1 //  
Sahatthā kaṃsapātiyā vaḍḍhetvā pāyāsaṃ ahaṃ /  
āhutiyiṭṭhukāmo so agamāsiṃ balim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_13,123.2 //  
Bhagavā[^157-3] tamhi samaye lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
caṅkamaṃ susamārūḷho ambare anilāyane.  // ApTha_13,123.3 //  
Tañ ca acchariyaṃ disvā abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ /  
ṭhapayitvā[^157-4] kaṃsapātiṃ Vipassiṃ abhivādayiṃ.  // ApTha_13,123.4 //  
Tuvaṃ devo 'si[^157-5] sabbaññū sadevasahamānuse /

Paṭiggahesi bhagavā sabbaññū lokanāyako /  
mama saṅkappam aññāya satthā loke mahāmuni.  // ApTha_13,123.6 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ[^157-7] tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pāyāsassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_13,123.7 //  
Ekatālis'; ito[^157-8] kappe Buddho nāmā 'si khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_13,123.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ ti.  // ApTha_13,123.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pāyāsadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Pāyāsadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[124. Gandhodakiya.] Nisajja[^157-9] pāsādavare Vipassiṃ addasaṃ jinaṃ /

Pāsādassāvidūre ca gacchati lokanāyako /  
pabhā niddhāvate[^157-11] tassa sataraṃsimhi nibbute.  // ApTha_13,124.2 //

[126. Kusumāsaniya.] Nagare Dhaññavatiyā ahosiṃ[^160-1] brāhmaṇo tadā /

āhutiyiṭṭhukāmo[^160-4] 'haṃ pitumātusamāgame.  // ApTha_13,126.3 //

obhāsento disā sabbā agacchati narāsabho.  // ApTha_13,126.4 //  
Āsanaṃ paññapetvāna nimantetvā mahamuniṃ /  
santharitvāna[^160-5] taṃ pupphaṃ atinesiṃ[^160-6] sakaṃ gharaṃ.  // ApTha_13,126.5 //  
Yaṃ me atthi sake gehe āmisaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ /  
tāhaṃ Buddhassa pādāsiṃ[^160-7] pasanno sehi pāṇihi.  // ApTha_13,126.6 //  
Bhuttāvikālam[^160-8] aññāya ekaṃ hatthaṃ adās'; ahaṃ /  
anumoditvā[^160-9] sabbaññū pakkāmi uttarāmukho.  // ApTha_13,126.7 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_13,126.8 //  
Anantarā ito kappe rājāhu Varadassano[^160-10] /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_13,126.9 //  
Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh'; ime /  
chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_13,126.10 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kusumāsaniyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Kusumāsaniyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[130. Padumapūjaka.] Himavantass'; avidūre Gotamo nāma pabbato /  
nānārukkhehi sañchanno[^162-9] mahābhūtāgaṇālayo.  // ApTha_13,130.1 //  
Vemajjhamhi[^162-10] ca tass'; āsi assamo abhinimmito /  
purakkhato sasissehi vasāmi assame ahaṃ.  // ApTha_13,130.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 163 -->
<a id="page-163"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 163]*

‘Āyantu me sissagaṇā padumaṃ āharantu me /  
Buddhapūjaṃ karissāma[^163-1] dipadindassa tādino.';  // ApTha_13,130.3 //  
Evan ti te paṭissutvā padumaṃ āhariṃsu me /  
tathā[^163-2] nimittaṃ katvā 'haṃ Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_13,130.4 //  
Sisse tadā samānetvā sādhukaṃ anusās'; ahaṃ: /  
mā kho tumhe pamajjittha, appamādo sukhāvaho.  // ApTha_13,130.5 //  
Evaṃ samanusāsitvā[^163-3] te sisse[^163-4] vacanakkhame[^163-5] /  
appamādaguṇe yutto tadā kalakato[^163-6] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_13,130.6 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_13,130.7 //  
Ekapaññāsakappamhi rājā āsi[^163-7] Jaluttamo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_13,130.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_13,130.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Padumapūjako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Padumapūjakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Sereyyako Pupphathūpi Pāyās'-Odaki-Thomako Āsanī-Phala-Saññī[^163-8] ca Gaṇṭhi-Padumapupphiyo[^163-9] Pañcuttarasatā[^163-10]-gāthā bhaṇitā[^163-11] atthadassīhi. Sereyyakavaggo terasamo.

[131. Sobhita.] Padummuttaro nāma jino lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
mahato[^163-12] janakāyassa deseti amataṃ padaṃ.  // ApTha_14,131.1 //  
Tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā vācāsabhim[^163-13] udīritaṃ /  
añjalim[^163-14] paggahetvāna ekaggo ās'; ahan[^163-15] tadā.  // ApTha_14,131.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 164 -->
<a id="page-164"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 164]*

Yathā samuddo udadhīnam[^164-1] aggo /  
Meru nagānaṃ[^164-2] pavaro siluccayo  // ApTha_14,131.3 //  
tath'; eva ye cittavasena vattare /  
na Buddhañāṇassa kalan-upenti te.  // ApTha_14,131.4 //  
Dhamme vidhiṃ[^164-3] ṭhapetvāna Buddho kāruṇiko isi /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_14,131.5 //  
‘Yo so ñāṇaṃ pakittesi Buddhamhi lokanāyake /  
kappānaṃ satasahasse duggatiṃ so na gacchati.[^164-4]  // ApTha_14,131.6 //  
Kilese jhāpayitvāna ekaggo susamāhito /  
Sobhito nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.';  // ApTha_14,131.7 //  
Kilesā jhāpitā mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā /  
tisso vijjā anuppattā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti.  // ApTha_14,131.8 //  
Paññāse kappasahasse satt'; ev'; āsuṃ Samuggatā /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_14,131.9 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_14,131.10 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sobhito thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Sobhitattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[132. Sudassana.] Vitthatāya[^164-5] nadītīre pilakkhaphalino[^164-6] ahu /  
tāhaṃ rukkhaṃ gavesanto addasaṃ[^164-7] lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_14,132.1 //  
Ketakaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā vaṇṭe[^164-8] chetvān'; ahan tadā /  
Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Sikhino lokabandhuno.  // ApTha_14,132.2 //  
Yena ñāṇena patto 'si accutaṃ amataṃ padaṃ /  
taṃ ñāṇaṃ abhipūjemi[^164-9] Buddhaseṭṭha mahāmuni.[^164-10]  // ApTha_14,132.3 //  
Ñāṇamhi pūjaṃ katvāna pilakkhaṃ[^164-11] addasaṃ ahaṃ /  
paṭiladdho 'mhi taṃ saññaṃ[^164-12] ñāṇapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_14,132.4 //


<!-- PTS Page 165 -->
<a id="page-165"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 165]*

Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ñāṇapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_14,132.5 //  
Ito terasakappamhi dvādas'; āsuṃ Khaluggatā[^165-1] /  
Sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_14,132.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_14,132.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sudassano thero i. g. a-ti. Sudassanattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[133. Candanapūjaka.] Candabhāgānadītīre ahosiṃ kiṇṇaro tadā /  
pupphabhakkho c'; ahaṃ[^165-2] āsiṃ pupphānaṃ vasano[^165-3] c'; ahaṃ.[^165-4]  // ApTha_14,133.1 //  
Atthadassī tu bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
pavanaggena niyyāti[^165-5] haṃsarājā va ambare.  // ApTha_14,133.2 //  
‘Namo te purisājañña! cittan te suvisodhitaṃ. /  
pasannamukhavaṇṇo 'si vippasannamukhindriyo.'[^165-6]  // ApTha_14,133.3 //  
Orohitvāna ākāsā bhūripañño sumedhaso /  
saṅghāṭiṃ pattharitvāna[^165-7] pallaṅkena upāvisi.  // ApTha_14,133.4 //  
Vilīnaṃ candan'; ādāya agamāsiṃ[^165-8] jinantike /  
pasannacitto sumano Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ.[^165-9]  // ApTha_14,133.5 //  
Abhivādetvāna sambuddhaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ /  
pāmujjaṃ[^165-10] janayitvāna pakkāmiṃ uttarāmukho.  // ApTha_14,133.6 //  
Aṭṭhārase kappasate candanaṃ yaṃ apūjayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_14,133.7 //  
Catuddase kappasate *ito āsiṃsu* te tayo /  
Rohiṇī[^165-11] nāma nāmena cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_14,133.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_14,133.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Candanapūjako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. Candanapūjakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Aṭṭhamaṃ bhāṇavāraṃ.

##### *[PTS Page 166]*

[134. Pupphachadanīya.] Sunando nāma nāmena brāhmaṇo mantapāragū /  
ajjhāyako yācayogo vājapeyyaṃ[^166-1] ayājayi.[^166-2]  // ApTha_14,134.1 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū aggo kāruṇiko isi /  
janataṃ anukampanto ambare caṅkamī tadā.  // ApTha_14,134.2 //  
Caṅkamitvāna sambuddho sabbaññū lokanāyako /  
mettāya upari satte appamāṇaṃ nirūpadhi.[^166-3]  // ApTha_14,134.3 //  
Vaṇṭe chetvāna[^166-4] pupphāni brāhmaṇo mantapāragū /  
sabbe sisse samānetvā ākāse ukkhipāpayi.  // ApTha_14,134.4 //  
Yāvatā nagaraṃ[^166-5] āsi pupphānaṃ chadanaṃ tadā /  
Buddhassa ānubhāvena sattāhaṃ na vigacchatha.  // ApTha_14,134.5 //  
Ten'; eva sukkamūlena anubhotvāna[^166-6] sampadā /  
sabbāsave[^166-7] pariññāya tiṇṇo loke visattikaṃ.  // ApTha_14,134.6 //  
Ekārase[^166-8] kappasate pañcatiṃs'; āsuṃ[^166-9] khattiyā /  
Ambaraṃsasamā nāmā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_14,134.7 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_14,134.8 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pupphachadanīyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti. Pupphachadanīyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[135. Rahosaññaka.] Himavantass'; avidūre Vasabho[^166-10] nāma pabbato /  
tasmiṃ pabbatapādamhi assamo āsi māpito.  // ApTha_14,135.1 //  
Tīṇi vassasahassāni vācesi[^166-11] brāhmaṇo tadā /  
saṃsāvetvāna[^166-12] te sisse ekamantaṃ upāvisi.[^166-13]  // ApTha_14,135.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 167 -->
<a id="page-167"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 167]*

Ekamantaṃ nisīditvā brāhmaṇo mantapāragū /  
Buddhavesaṃ gavesanto ñāṇe cittaṃ pasādayi.[^167-1]  // ApTha_14,135.3 //  
Tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā nisīdi paṇṇasanthare[^167-2] /  
pallaṅkam ābhujitvāna tattha kālakato[^167-3] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_14,135.4 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ñāṇasaññāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_14,135.5 //  
Sattavīsamhi kappamhi rājā Siridharo[^167-4] ahu[^167-5] /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_14,135.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_14,135.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Rahosaññako thero[^167-6] i. g. a-ti. Rahosaññakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[136. Campakapupphiya.] Kaṇikāraṃ va jotantaṃ nisinnaṃ pabbatantare /  
obhāsentaṃ disā sabbā osadhī viya tārakā.[^167-7]  // ApTha_14,136.1 //  
Tayo māṇavakā āsuṃ[^167-8] sake sippe susikkhitā /  
khāribhāraṃ gahetvāna anventi mama pacchato.  // ApTha_14,136.2 //  
Puṭake satta pupphāni nikkhittāni tapassinā[^167-9] /  
gahetvā tāni ñāṇamhi[^167-10] Vessabhussābhiropayiṃ.[^167-11]  // ApTha_14,136.3 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ñāṇapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_14,136.4 //  
Ekūnatiṃse kappamhi Vihatābhā-sanāmako[^167-12] /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī[^167-13] mahābalo.  // ApTha_14,136.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_14,136.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Campakapupphiyo thero i. g. a-t. Campakapupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[137. Atthasandassaka.] Visāḷamāḷe[^168-1] āsīno[^168-2] addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ /  
khiṇāsavaṃ balappattaṃ[^168-3] bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṃ.  // ApTha_14,137.1 //  
Satasahassatevijjā chaḷabhiññā mahiddhikā /  
parivārenti sambuddhaṃ; ko disvā nappasīdati?  // ApTha_14,137.2 //  
Ñāṇe upanidhā yassa na vijjati sadevake /  
anantañāṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ ko disvā nappasīdatī?  // ApTha_14,137.3 //  
Dhammakāyañ ca dīpenti kevalaṃ ratanākaraṃ /  
vikopetuṃ[^168-4] na sakkonti ko disvā nappasīdati?  // ApTha_14,137.4 //  
Imāhī tīhi gāthāhi Nārado[^168-5] pāragacchi so[^168-6] /  
Padumuttaraṃ thavitvāna sambuddhaṃ aparājitaṃ.  // ApTha_14,137.5 //  
Tena cittappasādena Buddhasaṃthavanena[^168-7] ca /  
kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ n'; upapajjatha.[^168-8]  // ApTha_14,137.6 //  
Ito tiṃse kappasate Sukhitto[^168-9] nāma khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_14,137.7 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_14,137.8 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Atthasandassako thero i. g. a ti. Atthasandassakattherassa[^168-10] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[138. Ekadaṃsaniya.] Nārado iti me nāmaṃ Kesavo iti maṃ vidū /  
kusalākusalaṃ[^168-11] esaṃ[^168-12] āgamaṃ Buddhasantikaṃ.  // ApTha_14,138.1 //  
Mettacitto kāruṇiko Atthadassī mahāmuni /  
assāsayanto satte so dhammaṃ deseti cakkhumā.  // ApTha_14,138.2 //  
Sakaṃ cittappasādetvā[^168-13] sire katvāna añjaliṃ /  
satthāraṃ abhivādetvā pakkāmiṃ pācināmukho.  // ApTha_14,138.3 //

Sattarase kappasate rājā āsi[^169-1] mahīpati /  
Amitta*vāsano[^169-2] nāma cakkavattī mahābalo.*  // ApTha_14,138.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_14,138.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ekadaṃsaniyo thero[^169-3] i. g. a-ti. Ekadaṃsaniyattherassa[^169-4] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[139. Sālapupphadāyaka.] Migarājā tadā āsiṃ abhijāto va kesarī /  
giriduggaṃ gavesanto addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_14,139.1 //  
‘Ayaṃ nu kho mahāvīro nibbāpeti[^169-5] mahājanaṃ /  
yannūnāhaṃ upāseyyaṃ devadevaṃ narāsabhaṃ!';  // ApTha_14,139.2 //  
Sākhaṃ sālassa bhañjitvā[^169-6] sakoṭaṃ[^169-7] puppham āhariṃ /  
upagantvāna sambuddhaṃ adāsiṃ puppham uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_14,139.3 //  
Ekanavute[^169-8] ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_14,139.4 //  
Ito ca navame kappe Virocana-sanāmakā /  
tayo āsiṃsu rājāno cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_14,139.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_14,139.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sālapupphadāyako thero[^169-9] i. g. a-ti. Sālapupphadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[140. Phaladāyaka.] Parodhako tadā āsiṃ paramānuparodhako[^169-10] /  
pabbhāre seyyaṃ kappemi avidūre Sikhisatthuno.  // ApTha_14,140.1 //

deyyadhammo ca me n'; atthi dipadindassa[^169-11] tādino.  // ApTha_14,140.2 //

Piyālaphalam[^170-1] ādāya agamaṃ Buddhasantikaṃ /

duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_14,140.5 //  
Ito pannarase kappe tayo āsiṃsu Mālabhi /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā  // ApTha_14,140.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_14,140.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Phaladāyako thero i. g. a-ti. Phaladāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Sobhi-Sudassano c'; eva Candano Pupphachadano Raho-Campakapupphī[^170-3] ca Atthasandassakena ca Ekadussi[^170-4] Sāladado dasamo Phaladāyako gāṇitāyo sattatiṃ[^170-5] dve ca ganitāyo vibhāvihi.[^170-6] Sobhitavaggo cuddasamo.

[141. Adhicchattiya.] Parinibbute bhagavati Atthadassi-naruttame /  
chattādhichattaṃ[^170-7] karetvā thūpamhi abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_15,141.1 //  
Kālena kālaṃ āgantvā namassiṃ lokanāyakaṃ /  
pupphacchadanaṃ katvāna chattamhi abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_15,141.2 //  
Sattarase kappasate devarajjam akārayiṃ. /  
manussattaṃ na gacchāmi thūpapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_15,141.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_15,141.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Adhicchattiyo thero[^170-8] i. g. a-ti. Adhicchatiyattherassa[^170-9] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[142. Thambhāropaka.] Nibbute[^171-1] lokanāthamhi Dhammadassi-narāsabhe /  
āropesiṃ[^171-2] dhajatthambhaṃ[^171-3] Buddhaseṭṭhassa cetiye.  // ApTha_15,142.1 //  
Nisseṇiṃ[^171-4] māpayitvāna thūpaseṭṭhaṃ samāruhiṃ[^171-5] /  
jātipupphaṃ gahetvāna thambhambhi[^171-6] abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_15,142.2 //  
Aho Buddhā! aho dhammā! aho no satthu sampadā! /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi thūpapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_15,142.3 //  
Catunavute ito kappe Thūpasikhasanāmakā /  
soḷas'; āsiṃsu rājāno cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_15,142.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_15,142.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. thambhāropako thero i. g. a-ti. Thambhāropakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[143. Vedikāraka.] Nibbute lokanāthamhi Piyadassi-naruttame /

vedikāya-mahaṃ katvā tattha kālakato ahaṃ.  // ApTha_15,143.2 //  
Yaṃ yaṃ yonūpapajjāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ /  
maṇī[^171-9] dhārenti[^171-10] ākāse puññakammass'; idaṃ phalaṃ  // ApTha_15,143.3 //  
Soḷase 'to kappasate Maṇippabhāsanāmakā /

Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_15,143.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Vedikārako[^171-11] thero i. g. ā-ti. Vedikārakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

##### *[PTS Page 172]*

[144. Saparivāriya.] Padumuttaro nāma jino lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
jalitvā aggikkhandho va sambuddho parinibbuto.  // ApTha_15,144.1 //  
Nibbute ca mahāvīre thūpo vitthāriko[^172-1] ahu /  
thūpam rattaṃ[^172-2] upaṭṭhenti dhātugehe varuttame.[^172-3]  // ApTha_15,144.2 //  
Pasannacitto sumano akaṃ kañcanavedikaṃ[^172-4] /  
dīyati[^172-5] dhūmakkhandho[^172-6] ca[^172-7] thupānucchavikaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_15,144.3 //  
Bhave nibbattamānamhi devatte atha mānuse /  
omattam me na[^172-8] passāmi pubbakammass'; idam phalaṃ.  // ApTha_15,144.4 //  
Pañcadase kappasate ito aṭṭha janā ahuṃ[^172-9] /  
sabbe Pamattanāmā[^172-10] te cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_15,144.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_15,144.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Saparivāriyo thero i. g. a-ti. Saparivāriyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[145. Ummāpupphiya.] Nibbute Lokamahite[^172-11] āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahe /  
Siddhatthamhi bhagavati mahāthūpamaho ahu.  // ApTha_15,145.1 //  
Mahe pavattamānamhi Siddhatthassa mahesino /  
ummāpupphaṃ gahetvāna thūpamhi abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_15,145.2 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi thūpapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_15,145.3 //  
Ito ca navame kappe Somadeva[^172-12]-sanāmakā /  
pañcāsītiṃ 'su[^172-13] rājāno cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_15,145.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_15,145.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Ummāpupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Ummāpupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.


<!-- PTS Page 173 -->

##### *[PTS Page 173]*

[146. Anulomadāyaka.] Anomadassissa munino bodhivedim akās'; ahaṃ /  
sudhāya piṇḍaṃ datvāna pāṇikammaṃ akās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_15,146.1 //  
Disvā taṃ sukataṃ kammaṃ Anomadassī naruttamo /  
bhikkhusaṅghe ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_15,146.2 //  
‘Iminā sudhakammena[^173-1] cetasā[^173-2]-paṇidhīhi ca /  
sampattiṃ anubhotvāna dukkhass'; antaṃ karissati.';  // ApTha_15,146.3 //  
Pasannamukhavaṇṇo 'mhi ekaggo susamāhito /  
dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane.  // ApTha_15,146.4 //  
Ito kappasate āsi[^173-3] paripuṇṇe[^173-4] anūnake[^173-5] /  
rājā Sabbagghano[^173-6] nāma cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_15,146.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_15,146.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Anulomadāyako[^173-7] thero i. g. a-ti. Anulomadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[147. Maggadāyaka.] Uttaritvāna nadikaṃ vanaṃ gacchati cakkhumā /  
tam addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ Siddhaṭṭhaṃ varalakkhaṇaṃ  // ApTha_15,147.1 //  
Kuddālapiṭakam ādāya samaṃ katvāna taṃ pathaṃ /  
satthāraṃ abhivādetvā sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādayiṃ.  // ApTha_15,147.2 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi maggadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_15,147.3 //  
Sattapaññāsakappamhi eko āsi janādhipo /  
nāmena Suppabuddho ti nāyako so narissaro.  // ApTha_15,147.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_15,147.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Maggadāyako thero i. g. a-ti. Maggadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

##### *[PTS Page 174]*

[148. Phalakadāyaka.] Yānakāro[^174-1] pure āsiṃ dārukamme susikkhito /  
candanaphalakaṃ katvā adāsiṃ[^174-2] lokabandhuno.  // ApTha_15,148.1 //  
Pabhāsati[^174-3] idaṃ vyamhaṃ[^174-4] suvaṇṇassa sunimmitaṃ /  
hatthiyānaṃ assayānaṃ dibbayānaṃ[^174-5] upaṭṭhitaṃ.[^174-6]  // ApTha_15,148.2 //  
Pāsādā sivikā c'; eva nibbattanti yadicchakaṃ /  
akkhobhaṃ[^174-7] ratanaṃ mayhaṃ phalakassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_15,148.3 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe phalakaṃ yaṃ ahaṃ dadiṃ[^174-8] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phalakassa idaṃ phalaṃ  // ApTha_15,148.4 //  
Sattapaññāsakappamhi caturo Bhavanimmitā /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_15,148.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_15,148.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Phalakadāyako thero i. g. a-ti. Phalakadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[149. Vaṭaṃsakiya.] Sumedho nāma nāmena sayambhū aparājito /  
vivekam anubrūhanto ajjhogahi[^174-9] mahāvanaṃ.  // ApTha_15,149.1 //  
Salalaṃ[^174-10] pupphitaṃ disvā bandhitvāna[^174-11] vaṭaṃsakaṃ /  
Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ sammukhā lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_15,149.2 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassamhi yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_15,149.3 //  
Ūnavīse[^174-12] kappasate solas'; āsiṃsu Nimmitā /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_15,149.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_15,149.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Vaṭaṃsakiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Vaṭaṃsakiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[150. Pallaṅkadāyaka.] Sumedhassa bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
pallaṅko hi mayā dinno sa-uttarasamacchado.[^175-1]  // ApTha_15,150.1 //  
Sattaratanasampanno pallaṅko āsi so tadā /  
mama saṅkappam aññāya nibbattati sadā[^175-2] mama.  // ApTha_15,150.2 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassāni pallaṅkam adadiṃ tadā[^175-3] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pallaṅkassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_15,150.3 //  
Vīsakappasahassamhi[^175-4] Suvaṇṇābhā tayo janā /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahābalā.  // ApTha_15,150.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_15,150.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Pallaṅkadāyako thero i. g. a-ti. Pallaṅkadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Chatta-Thambho ca Vedī[^175-5] ca Parivār'-Ummapupphiyo Anuloma[^175-6] Maggadāyī[^175-7] Phaladāyī-Vataṃsako[^175-8] Pallaṅkadāyi[^175-9] gāthāyo chappaññāsā pakittitā. Chattavaggo pannarasamo.

[151. Bandhujīvaka.] Candaṃ[^175-10] va vimalaṃ suddhaṃ vippasannam anāvilaṃ /  
nandibhavaparikkhīṇaṃ[^175-11] tiṇṇaṃ lokavisattikaṃ --  // ApTha_16,151.1 //  
Nibbāpayantaṃ janataṃ tiṇṇaṃ tārayataṃ muṇiṃ /  
vanasmiṃ jhāyamānan tam ekaggaṃ susamāhitaṃ.  // ApTha_16,151.2 //  
Bandhujīvakapupphāni[^175-12] laggetvā[^175-13] suttake[^175-14] ahaṃ /  
Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Sikhino lokabandhuno.  // ApTha_16,151.3 //

Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tada /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_16,151.4 //  
Ito sattamake kappe manujindo mahāyaso /  
Samantacakkhu nām'; āsiṃ cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_16,151.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_16,151.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Bandhujīvako thero i. g. a-ti. Bandhujīvakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[152. Tambapupphiya.] Parakammāyane yutto[^176-1] aparādhaṃ akās'; ahaṃ /  
vanantaṃ atidhāvissaṃ[^176-2] bhayabheravasamappito.[^176-3]  // ApTha_16,152.1 //  
Pupphitaṃ pādapaṃ disvā piṇḍibaddhaṃ sunimmitaṃ /  
tambapupphaṃ[^176-4] gahetvāna bodhiyaṃ okiriṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_16,152.2 //  
Sammajjitvāna[^176-5] taṃ bodhiṃ pāṭalipādamuttamaṃ /  
pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvāna bodhimūle upāvisiṃ.[^176-6]  // ApTha_16,152.3 //  
Gatamaggaṃ gavesanto āgañchuṃ[^176-7] mama santike /  
te ca dīsvān'; ahaṃ tattha āvajjiṃ[^176-8] bodhim uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_16,152.4 //  
Vanditvā ca[^176-9] ahaṃ bodhiṃ vippasannena cetasā /  
anekatālīsa patiṃ[^176-10] giridugge bhayānake.  // ApTha_16,152.5 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yam puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bodhipūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_16,152.6 //  
Ito ca tatiye kappe rājā Samphusito[^176-11] ahu[^176-12] /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo.  // ApTha_16,152.7 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_16,152.8 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Tambapupphiya[^176-13] thero i. g. a-ti. Tambapupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[153. Vīthisammajjaka.] Udentaṃ sataraṃsīva pītaraṃsīva[^177-1] bhāṇumaṃ /  
pannarase va tad-ahu-niyantaṃ[^177-2] lokanāyakaṃ  // ApTha_16,153.1 //  
Aṭṭhasaṭṭhisahassāni[^177-3] sabbe khiṇāsavā ahuṃ /  
parivāriṃsu sambuddhaṃ dipadindaṃ narāsabhaṃ.  // ApTha_16,153.2 //  
Sammajjitvāna taṃ vīthiṃ niyante lokanāyake /  
ussāpesiṃ[^177-4] dhajaṃ tattha vippasannena cetasā.  // ApTha_16,153.3 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ dhajaṃ abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi dhajadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_16,153.4 //  
Ito catutthake kappe rājā 'hosiṃ mahābalo /  
sabbākārenasampanno nāmena iti Vissuto.  // ApTha_16,153.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_16,153.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Vīthisammajjako thero i. g. a-ti. Vīthisammajjakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[154. Kakkārupūjaka.] Devaputto ahaṃ santo pūjayiṃ[^177-5] Sikhināyakaṃ /  
kakkārupupphaṃ paggayha Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_16,154.1 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yam puppham abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_16,154.2 //  
Ito ca navame kappe rājā Sattuttamo[^177-6] ahuṃ[^177-7] /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.[^177-8]  // ApTha_16,154.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_16,154.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Kakkārupūjako thero i. g. a-ti. Kakkārupūjakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[155. Mandāravapūjaka.] Devaputto ahaṃ santo pujesiṃ[^178-1] Sikhināyakaṃ /  
mandāravena pupphena Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_16,155.1 //  
Sattāhaṃ chadanaṃ āsi dibbaṃ mālyaṃ[^178-2] Tathāgate /  
sabbe janā samāgantvā namassiṃsu Tathāgataṃ.  // ApTha_16,155.2 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ[^178-3] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_16,155.3 //  
Ito ca dasame kappe rājā 'hosiṃ[^178-4] Jutindharo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.[^178-5]  // ApTha_16,155.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_16,155.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Mandāravapūjako thero i. g. ā-ti. Mandāravapūjakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[156. Kadambapupphiya.] Himavantass'; avidūre Kukkuṭo[^178-6] nāma pabbato /  
tamhi pabbatapādamhi satta Buddhā vasantike.  // ApTha_16,156.1 //  
Kadambaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā dīparājaṃ va uggataṃ /  
ubho hatthehi paggayha satta Buddhe samokiriṃ.  // ApTha_16,156.2 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nabhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_16,156.3 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe sattāhuṃ[^178-7] Phullanāyakā[^178-8] /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā[^178-9]  // ApTha_16,156.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_16,156.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Kadambapupphiyo thero i. g. ā-ti. Kadambapupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[157. Tiṇasūlaka.] Himavantass'; avidūre Bhūtagaṇo nāma pabbato /  
vasat'; eko jino tattha sayambhū lokanissaṭo.[^179-1]  // ApTha_16,157.1 //  
Tiṇasūle[^179-2] gahetvāna Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ /  
ekūnasatasahassaṃ[^179-3] kappānaṃ 'vinipātako.[^179-4]  // ApTha_16,157.2 //  
Ito ekādase kappe eko 'si Dharaṇīruho /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.[^179-5]  // ApTha_16,157.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_16,157.4 //

[158. Nāgapupphiya.] Suvaccho nāma nāmena brāhmaṇo mantapāragū /  
purakkhato sasissehi vasati pabbatantare.  // ApTha_16,158.1 //  
Padumuttaro nāma jino āhutīṇaṃ paṭiggaho /  
mam uddharitukāmo so āgacchi[^179-6] mama santike.  // ApTha_16,158.2 //  
Vehāyase[^179-7] caṅkamati dhūpo[^179-8] 'tijalate tathā[^179-9] /  
ve hāsaṃ mama disvāna[^179-10] pakkāmi pācināmukho  // ApTha_16,158.3 //  
Tañ ca acchariyaṃ disvā abbhūtaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ /  
nāgapupphaṃ gahetvāna gatamaggamhi okiriṃ[^179-11]  // ApTha_16,158.4 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ[^179-12] /  
tena cittappasādena duggatiṃ nūpapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_16,158.5 //  
Ekatiṃse kappasate rājā āsiṃ Mahāratho. /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.[^179-13]  // ApTha_16,158.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_16,158.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Nāgapupphiyo thero i. g. ā-ti. Nāgapupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[159. Punnāgapupphiya.] Kānanaṃ vanam ogayha vasāmi luddako ahaṃ /  
punnāgaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ anussariṃ.  // ApTha_16,159.1 //  
Taṃ pupphaṃ ocinitvāna sugandhaṃ gandhagandhitaṃ[^180-1] /  
thūpaṃ karitvā[^180-2] puḷine Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_16,159.2 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_16,159.3 //  
Ekamhi navute kappe eko āsi Tamonudo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_16,159.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_16,159.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Punnāgapupphiyo thero i. g. ā-ti. Punnāgapupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[160. Kumudadāyaka.] Himavantass'; avidūre mahājātassaro ahu /  
padumuppalasañchanno puṇḍarīkasamotato.[^180-3]  // ApTha_16,160.1 //  
Kakudho[^180-4] nāma nāmena tatthāsiṃ[^180-5] sakuṇo tadā /  
sīlavā Buddhisampanno puññāpuññe sukovido.  // ApTha_16,160.2 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
jātassarass'; avidūre sañcarittha[^180-6] mahāmuni.  // ApTha_16,160.3 //  
Jalajaṃ kumudaṃ gahetvā[^180-7] upanesiṃ[^180-8] mahesino /  
mama saṅkappam aññāya paṭiggahi mahāmuni.  // ApTha_16,160.4 //  
Taṃ dānam adaditvā-'haṃ sukkamūlena codito /  
kappānaṃ satasahassan duggatiṃ nupapajj'; ahaṃ[^180-9]  // ApTha_16,160.5 //  
Soḷase 'to kappasate āsuṃ Varuṇanāmakā[^180-10] /  
aṭṭha ete janā tattha cakkavattī mahabbalā.[^180-11]  // ApTha_16,160.6 //


<!-- PTS Page 181 -->
<a id="page-181"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 181]*

Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_16,160.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Kumudadāyako thero i. g. ā-ti. Kumudadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Bandhujīvo[^181-1] Tambapupphī[^181-2] Vīthī[^181-3] Kakkārupupphiyo Mandāravo Kadambī ca Suliko[^181-4] Nāgapupphiyo[^181-5] Punnāgo Komudī gāthā chappaññāsapakittitā.[^181-6] Bandhujīvakavaggo soḷasamo.

[161. Supāricariya.] Padumo nāma nāmena dipadindo[^181-7] narāsabho /  
pavanā abhinikkamma dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā  // ApTha_17,161.1 //  
Yakkhānaṃ samayo āsi avidūre mahesino /  
yena kiccena sampattā ajjhāpekkhiṃsu tāvade  // ApTha_17,161.2 //  
Buddhassa giram aññāya amatassa ca desanaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano appoṭhetvā[^181-8] upaṭṭh'; ahaṃ.[^181-9]  // ApTha_17,161.3 //  
Suciṇṇassa phalam passa[^181-10] upaṭṭhānassa satthuno /  
tiṃsakappasahassesu duggatiṃ n'; upapajj'; ahaṃ.[^181-11]  // ApTha_17,161.4 //  
Ūnatiṃse kappasate Samalaṅkata-nāmako /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.[^181-12]  // ApTha_17,161.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_17,161.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Supāricariyo[^181-13] thero i. g. ā-ti. Supāricariyattherassa[^181-14] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

##### *[PTS Page 182]*

[162. Kaṇaverapupphiya.] Siddhattho nāma bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
purakkhato sāvakehi nagaraṃ paṭipajjatha.[^182-1]  // ApTha_17,162.1 //  
Rañño antepure āsiṃ-gopako abhisammato /  
pāsāde upaviṭṭho 'haṃ addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_17,162.2 //  
Kaṇaveraṃ[^182-2] gahetvāna bhikkhusaṅghe samokiriṃ /  
Buddhassa visuṃ katvāna tato bhiyyo samokiriṃ.  // ApTha_17,162.3 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_17,162.4 //  
Sattāsītimhi 'to kappe caturo āsuṃ mahiddhikā /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_17,162.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_17,162.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Kaṇaverapupphiyo thero i. g. ā-ti. Kaṇaverapupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. [163. Khajjakadāyaka.] Tissassāhaṃ[^182-3] bhagavato pubbe phalam adās'; ahaṃ /  
nāḷikerañ[^182-4] ca pādāsiṃ khajjakam abhisammataṃ.[^182-5]  // ApTha_17,163.1 //

modām'; ahaṃ kāmakārī upapajjaṃ yamicchakaṃ.[^182-7]  // ApTha_17,163.2 //

sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_17,163.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_17,163.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Khajjakadāyako thero i. g. ā-ti. Khajjakadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

Itthaṃ sudaṃ ayasmā Bandhujīvako[^192-7] thero i. g. ā-ti. Bandhujīvakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[183. Koṭumbariya.] Kaṇikāraṃ[^192-8] va jotantaṃ nisinnaṃ pabbatantare /  
appameyyaṃ va udadhim uddhataṃ[^192-9] dharaṇiṃ[^192-10] yathā.  // ApTha_19,183.1 //  
Paretaṃ[^192-11] devasaṅghena nisabhājāniyaṃ yathā /  
haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena upagacchiṃ[^192-12] naruttamaṃ.  // ApTha_19,183.2 //  
Satta pupphāni paggayha koṭumbarasamākulaṃ /  
Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Sikhino lokabandhuno.  // ApTha_19,183.3 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ[^192-13] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_19,183.4 //  
Ito vīsatikappamhi Mahānela-sanāmako /  
eko āsiṃ[^192-14] mahātejo cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_19,183.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_19,183.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Koṭumbariyo thero i. g. a-ti. Koṭumbariyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

##### *[PTS Page 193]*

[184. Pañcahatthiya.] Tisso nāmāsi bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
purakkhato sāvakehi rathiyaṃ paṭipajjatha.  // ApTha_19,184.1 //  
Pañcauppalahatthā ca[^193-1] catur'; oṭṭhapitā[^193-2] mayā /  
āhutiṃ[^193-3] dātukāmo 'haṃ mūgo 'mhi[^193-4] vata siddhiyā.  // ApTha_19,184.2 //  
Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ[^193-5] sambuddhaṃ gacchantam antarāpaṇe /  
Buddharaṃsābhighuṭṭho 'mhi pūjesiṃ[^193-6] dipaduttamaṃ[^193-7]  // ApTha_19,184.3 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ[^193-8] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_19,184.4 //  
Ito terasakappamhi pañc'; āsu Sabhāsammatā[^193-9] /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_19,184.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_19,184.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pañcahatthiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Pañcahatthiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[185. Isimuggadāyaka.] Udentaṃ[^193-10] sataraṃsiṃ va[^193-11] uggataṃ iva[^193-12] bhānumaṃ[^193-13] /  
kakudhaṃ vilasantaṃ[^193-14] va Padumuttaranāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_19,185.1 //  
Isimuggā nisandhetvā[^193-15] madhukhudde anīlake /  
pāsāde va ṭhito[^193-16] santo adāsiṃ[^193-17] lokabandhuno.  // ApTha_19,185.2 //  
Aṭṭhasatasahassāni ahesuṃ Buddhasāvakā /  
sabbesaṃ pattapūrentaṃ[^193-18] tato cāpi bahuttaraṃ[^193-19]  // ApTha_19,185.3 //  
Tena cittappasādena sukkamūlena codito /  
kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ nūpapajj'; ahaṃ  // ApTha_19,185.4 //

Cattārīsamhi[^194-1] sahasse kappānam aṭṭh'; ahiṃsu te[^194-2] /  
Mahisamanta-nāmā te[^194-3] cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_19,185.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_19,185.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Isimuggadāyako[^194-4] thero i. g. a-ti. Isimuggadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[186. Bodhiupaṭṭhāyaka.] Nagare[^194-5] Rammavatiyā āsiṃ[^194-6] Muraja-nāmako[^194-7] /  
niccupaṭṭhānayutto 'mhi gato 'haṃ bodhiṃ uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_19,186.1 //  
Sāyapātaṃ uṭṭhahitvā[^194-8] sukkamūlena codito /  
aṭṭhārase kappasate duggatiṃ nūpapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_19,186.2 //  
Pañcadase[^194-9] kappasate rājāhosiṃ[^194-10] janādhipo /  
Damatho[^194-11] nāma nāmena cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_19,186.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_19,186.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Bodhiupaṭṭhāyako thero i. g. a-ti. Bodhiupaṭṭhāyakattherassa apadanaṃ samattaṃ.

[187. Ekacintita.][^194-12] Yadā devo devakāyā cavate āyusaṅkhayā /  
tayo saddā niccharanti devānam anumodataṃ.[^194-13]  // ApTha_19,187.1 //  
Ito bho sugatiṃ gaccha manussānaṃ sahavyataṃ[^194-14] /  
manussabhūto saddhamme[^194-15] labha saddham[^194-16] anuttaraṃ.  // ApTha_19,187.2 //  
Sā te saddhā[^194-17] niviṭṭhāya[^194-18] mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā /  
yāvajīvam asaṃhīrā[^194-19] saddhamme[^194-20] suppavedite.[^194-21]  // ApTha_19,187.3 //

##### *[PTS Page 195]*

Kāyena kusalaṃ katvā vācāya kusalaṃ bahuṃ /  
manasā kusalaṃ katvā avyāpajjhaṃ nirūpadhiṃ.[^195-1]  // ApTha_19,187.4 //  
Tato opadhikaṃ puññaṃ katvā dānena taṃ bahuṃ /  
aññe pi macce saddhamme brahmacariye nivesaya.[^195-2]  // ApTha_19,187.5 //  
Imāya anukampāya devadevaṃ yathāvidū /  
bhavantam[^195-3] anumodanti ‘ehi deva punappunaṃ.';  // ApTha_19,187.6 //  
Saṃviggo 'mhi tadā āsiṃ[^195-4] devasaṅghe samāgate /  
kaṃ su nāma ahaṃ yoniṃ gamissāmi ito cuto?  // ApTha_19,187.7 //  
Mama saṃvegam aññāya samaṇo bhāvitindriyo /  
mam uddharitukāmo so āgacchi mama santike.  // ApTha_19,187.8 //  
Sumano nāma nāmena Padumuttarasāvako /  
atthadhammānusāsitvā[^195-5] saṃvejesi mamaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_19,187.9 //  
Tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā Buddhe cittaṃ pasādayiṃ /  
taṃ dhīram abhivādetvā tattha kālakato ahaṃ.  // ApTha_19,187.10 //  
Upapajjissaṃ[^195-6] tatth'; eva sukkamūlena codito /  
kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ nūpapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_19,187.11 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_19,187.12 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Ekacintito[^195-7] thero i. g. a-ti. Ekacintitattherassa[^195-8] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[188. Tikaṇṇipupphiya.] Devabhūto ahaṃ santo accharāhi purakkhato /  
pubbaṃ kammaṃ[^195-9] saritvāna Buddhaseṭṭham anussariṃ[^195-10]  // ApTha_19,188.1 //  
Tikaṇṇipupphaṃ paggayha sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādayiṃ /  
Buddhassa[^195-11] abhiropesiṃ[^195-12] Vipassimhi narāsabhe  // ApTha_19,188.2 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ[^195-13] /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_19,188.3 //  
Tesattati ito kappe catur āsuṃ naruttamā /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_19,188.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_19,188.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tikaṇṇipupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Tikaṇṇipupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[189. Ekacāriya.] Tāvatiṃsesu devesu mahāghoso tadā ahu /  
Buddho ca loke nibbāti[^196-1] mayañ c'; amha[^196-2] sarāgino.[^196-3]  // ApTha_19,189.1 //  
Tesaṃ saṃvegajātānaṃ sokasallasamaṅginaṃ /  
sabalena[^196-4] upatthaddho agamaṃ Buddhasantike.  // ApTha_19,189.2 //  
Mandāravaṃ gahetvāna saṅhitaṃ[^196-5] abhinimmitaṃ /  
parinibbānākālamhi[^196-6] Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_19,189.3 //  
Sabbe devānumodiṃsu accharayo ca me tadā /  
kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ nūpapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_19,189.4 //  
Saṭṭhikappasahassamhi ito soḷasa te janā /  
Mahāmallājanā-nāma[^196-7] cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_19,189.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_19,189.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Ekacāriyo thero i. g. a-ti. Ekacāriyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṇ.

[190. Tivaṇṭipupphiya.] Abhibhuṃ vopanijjhanti[^196-8] sabbe saṅgamma te mamaṃ /  
tesaṃ nijjhāyamānānaṃ pariḷāho ajāyatha.  // ApTha_19,190.1 //  
Sunando nāma nāmena Buddhassa sāvako tadā /  
Dhammadassissa munino āgacchi mama santike.  // ApTha_19,190.2 //  
Ye me paddhacarā[^196-9] āsuṃ te me pupphaṃ aduṃ tadā /  
tāhaṃ pupphaṃ gahetvāna sāvake abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_19,190.3 //  
So haṃ kālakato tattha punāpi upapajj'; ahaṃ /  
aṭṭhārase kappasate vinipātaṃ n'; agacch'[^196-10] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_19,190.4 //  
Terase 'to kappasate aṭṭhāsuṃ Dhūmaketuno /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_19,190.5 //

Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_19,190.6 //

[192. Tiṇasantharadāyaka.] Yaṃ dāyavāsiko isi tiṇaṃ lāyati satthuno[^198-1] /

Taṃ tiṇaṃ chadanaṃ katvā[^198-4] Siddhatthassa adās'; ahaṃ /  
sattāhaṃ dhārayuṃ tattha devāmanussā satthuno.  // ApTha_20,192.3 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ tiṇaṃ adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi tiṇadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_20,192.4 //  
Pañcasaṭṭhi ito kappe cattāro 'suṃ Mahādhanā[^198-5] /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_20,192.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_20,192.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tiṇasantharadāyako[^198-6] thero i. g. a-ti. Tiṇasantharadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[193. Khaṇḍaphulliya.] Phussassa kho[^198-7] bhagavato thūpo āsi mahāvane /

Visamañ ca samaṃ katvā sudhāpiṇḍaṃ[^198-9] adās'; ahaṃ /

Sattasattatikappamhi Jitasen'; āsuṃ[^198-12] solasa[^198-13] /

Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_20,193.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Khaṇḍaphulliyo thero i. g. a-ti. Khaṇḍaphulliyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[200. Yūthikapupphiya.] Padumuttaro nāma jino āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
pavanā nikkhamitvāna vihāraṃ yāti cakkhumā.  // ApTha_20,200.1 //

kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ nūpapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_20,200.3 //  
Ito paññāsakappesu eko āsi janādhipo /  
Samitaṃnandano[^202-4] nāma cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_20,200.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_20,200.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Yūthikapupphiyo[^202-5] thero i. g. a-ti. Yūthikapupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. [219. Sappidāyaka.] Nisinno pāsādavare nārīgaṇapurakkhato /

duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi sappitelass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_22,219.5 //

sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_22,219.6 //

anumodi mahāvīro sayambhū aparājito:  // ApTha_27,265.2 //  
Biḷālī te[^232-2] mamaṃ[^232-3] dinnā vippasannena cetasā /  
bhave nibbattamānamhi phalaṃ nibbattate[^232-4] tavaṃ.[^232-5]  // ApTha_27,265.3 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ biḷālim adās'; ahaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi biḷāliyā idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_27,265.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_27,265.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Biḷālidāyako thero i. g. a-ti. Biḷālidāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[266. Macchadāyaka.] Candabhāgānadītīre[^232-6] ukkuso ās'; ahaṃ tadā /  
mahantaṃ macchaṃ paggayha Siddhatthamunino[^232-7] adaṃ.  // ApTha_27,266.1 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ maccham adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi macchadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_27,266.2 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_27,266.3 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Macchadāyako thero i. g. a-ti. Macchadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[267. Javahaṃsaka.] Candabhāgānadītīre[^232-8] āsiṃ[^232-9] vanacaro tadā /  
Siddhattham addasaṃ Buddhaṃ gacchantam anilañjase.[^232-10]  // ApTha_27,267.1 //  
Añjaliṃ paggahetvāna ullokento mahāmuniṃ[^232-11] /  
sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā avandiṃ[^232-12] nāyakam ahaṃ.  // ApTha_27,267.2 //

*Catunavute* ito kappe yam avandiṃ[^233-1] narāsabhaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi vandanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_27,267.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_27,267.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Javahaṃsako thero i. g. a-ti. Javahaṃsakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[268. Saḷalapupphiya.] Candabhāgānadītīre[^233-2] ahosiṃ[^233-3] kinnaro tadā /  
Vipassim addasaṃ *Buddhaṃ raṃsijālasamākulaṃ.*  // ApTha_27,268.1 //  
Pasannacitto sumano paramāya ca pītiyā /  
paggayha saḷalaṃ pupphaṃ Vipassim okirim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_27,268.2 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjay'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_27,268.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_27,268.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Saḷalapupphiyo[^233-4] thero i. g. a-ti. Saḷalapupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[269. Upāgatabhāsaniya.] Himavantassa vemajjhe saro āsi sunimmito /  
tatthāhaṃ rakkhaso āsiṃ poṭṭhasīso[^233-5] bhayānako.  // ApTha_27,269.1 //  
Anukampako kāruṇiko Vipassī lokanāyako /  
mam uddharitukāmo so āgacchi[^233-6] mama santike.  // ApTha_27,269.2 //  
Upāgataṃ mahāvīraṃ devadevaṃ narāsabhaṃ /  
āsayā abhinikkhamma avandiṃ satthuno ahaṃ.  // ApTha_27,269.3 //  
Ekanavute[^233-7] ito kappe yaṃ vandiṃ[^233-8] purisuttamaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi vandanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_27,269.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_27,269.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Upāgatabhāsaniyo[^233-9] thero i. g. a-ti. Upāgatabhāsaniyattherassa[^233-10] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[270. Taraṇiya.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇo sambuddho Vipassī dakkhiṇāraho /  
nadītīre ṭhito satthā bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhato.  // ApTha_27,270.1 //  
Nāvā na vijjate tattha santāraṇī[^234-1] mahaṇṇave /  
nadiyā abhinikkhamma tāresiṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_27,270.2 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ tāresiṃ naruttamaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi taraṇāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_27,270.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_27,270.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Taraṇiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Taraṇiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Ukkhepī Tela-Candī ca Dīpado ca Biḷālido Maccho Javo Salaḷado Rakkhaso Taraṇo[^234-2] dasa gāthāyo c'; ettha[^234-3] saṅkhātā tālisam[^234-4]-ekam[^234-5] eva ca. Padumukkhepavaggo[^234-6] sattavīsatimo.

[271. Suvaṇṇabibbohaniya.] Ekāsanam aham adaṃ pasanno sehi pāṇihi /  
bibbohanañ ca pādāsim uttamatthassa pattiyā.[^234-7]  // ApTha_28,271.1 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe bibbohanam adās'; ahaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bibbohanass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_28,271.2 //  
Ito tesaṭṭhime kappe Asamo nāma khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_28,271.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_28,271.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Suvaṇṇabibbohaniyo[^234-8] thero i. g. a-ti. Suvaṇṇabibbohaniyattherassa[^234-8] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[272. Tilamuṭṭhidāyaka.] Mama saṅkappam aññāya satthā lokagganāyako /  
manomayena kāyena iddhiyā upasaṅkami.  // ApTha_28,272.1 //  
Satthāram upasaṅkantaṃ[^235-1] vanditvā purisuttamaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano tilamuṭṭhim adās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_28,272.2 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi tilamuṭṭhe[^235-2] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_28,272.3 //  
Ito soḷasakappamhi Nandiyo[^235-3] nāma khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_28,272.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_28,272.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tilamuṭṭhidāyako thero[^235-4] i. g. a-ti. Tilamuṭṭhidāyakattherassa[^235-4] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[273. Caṅgoṭakiya.] Mahāsamuddaṃ nissāya vasate[^235-5] pabbatantare /  
paccuggantvān'; akāmāhaṃ[^235-6] caṅgoṭakam[^235-7] adās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_28,273.1 //  
Siddhatthassa mahesissa sabbabhūtānukampino /  
pupphacaṅgoṭakaṃ[^235-8] datvā kappaṃ saggamhi mod'; ahaṃ.[^235-9]  // ApTha_28,273.2 //  
Catunavute ito kappe caṅgoṭakam adaṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi caṅgoṭakass'[^235-10] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_28,273.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_28,273.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Caṅgoṭakiyo[^235-11] thero i. g. a-ti. Caṅgoṭakiyattherassa[^235-11] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[274. Abbhañjanadāyaka.] Koṇḍaññassa bhagavato vītarāgassa tādino /  
ākāsasamacittassa[^236-1] nippapañcassa jhāyino  // ApTha_28,274.1 //

Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Abbhañjanadāyako thero i. g. a-ti. Abbhañjanadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[275. Ekañjaliya.] Udumbare vasanta*ssa niyate paṇṇasa*nthare[^236-6] /  
vutthokāso[^236-7] mayā dinno samaṇassa[^236-8] mahesino.  // ApTha_28,275.1 //

Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_28,277.4 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Citakapūjako thero i. g. a-ti. Citakapūjakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[280. Taraṇiya.] Mahāpathamhi visame setu[^238-3] kārāpito mayā /

[282. Phaladāyaka.] Sinerusamasanto so dharaṇīdhārisādiso /

Siddhatthassa mahesissa sabbalokānukampino /  
tañ ca sabbaṃ mayā dinnaṃ vippasannena cetasā.  // ApTha_29,282.3 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ phalam adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_29,282.4 //  
Sattapaññās'; ito kappe Ekajjho[^239-7] nāma khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_29,282.5 //

Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Phaladāyako thero i. g. a-ti. Phaladāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[288. Sattāhapabbajita.] Vipassissa bhagavato saṅgho sakkatamānito /  
vyasanaṃ me anuppattaṃ[^242-1] ñātibhedo pure ahu.  // ApTha_29,288.1 //  
Pabbajjam upagantvāna vyasanūpasamāy'; ahaṃ /  
sattāhābhirato tattha satthusāsanakamyatā.[^242-2]  // ApTha_29,288.2 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yam ahaṃ pabbajiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pabbajjāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_29,288.3 //  
Sattasaṭṭhi ito kappe satta āsuṃ mahīpatī /  
Sunikkhammā[^242-3] ti ñāyanti cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_29,288.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_29,288.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sattāhapabbajito thero i. g. a-ti. Sattāhapabbajitattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[289. Buddhūpaṭṭhāyaka.] Veṭambarī[^242-4] ti me nāma[^242-5] pitu santaṃ mamaṃ tadā /  
mama hatthaṃ gahetvāna upānayi mahāmuniṃ.  // ApTha_29,289.1 //  
Ime mam uddisissanti[^242-6] Buddhā lokagganāyakā /  
te 'ham upaṭṭhahiṃ[^242-7] sakkaccaṃ pasanno sehi pāṇihi.  // ApTha_29,289.2 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe Buddhe paricariṃ[^242-8] tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi upaṭṭhānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_29,289.3 //  
Tevisamhi ito kappe caturo āsuṃ khattiyā /  
Samaṇūpaṭṭhākā nāma cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_29,289.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_29,289.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Buddhūpaṭṭhāko[^242-9] thero i. g. a-ti. Buddhūpaṭṭhāyakattherassa[^242-10] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[290. Pubbaṅgamaniya.] Cullāsītisahassāni pabbajimha akiñcanā /  
tesaṃ *pubbaṅga*mo āsim uttamatthassa pattiyā.[^243-1]  // ApTha_29,290.1 //  
Sarāgā sabhāvā loke[^243-2] vippasannam anāvilaṃ /  
upaṭṭhahiṃsu sakkaccaṃ pasannā sehi pāṇihi.  // ApTha_29,290.2 //  
Khīṇāsavā vantadosā katakiccā anāsavā /  
phariṃsu mettacittena sayambhū aparājitā.  // ApTha_29,290.3 //  
Tesam upaṭṭhahitvāna sambuddhānaṃ patissato[^243-3] /  
maraṇañ ca anuppatto devattañ ca agamhase.  // ApTha_29,290.4 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ sīlam anupālayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi saññamassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_29,290.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_29,290.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pubbaṅgamiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Pubbaṅgamaniyattherassa[^243-4] apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Paṇṇaṃ[^243-5] Phalaṃ Uggamiyo Ekapupphi[^243-6] ca Maghavā[^243-7] Upaṭṭhāk āpadānañ ca Pabbajjā ca[^243-8] Upaṭṭhahaṃ[^243-9] Pubbaṅgamo ca gāthāyo aṭṭhatālīsa kittitā ti.[^243-10] Paṇṇadāyakavaggo[^243-11] ekūnatiṃsamo.

[291. Citapūjaka.] Ajito[^243-12] nāma nāmena ahosiṃ brāhmaṇo tadā /  
āhutiṃ yiṭṭhukāmo[^243-13] 'haṃ nānāpupphaṃ samānayiṃ.[^243-14]  // ApTha_30,291.1 //  
Jalantaṃ citakaṃ katvā[^243-15] Sikhino lokabandhuno /  
tañ ca pupphaṃ samānetvā[^243-16] citake okirim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_30,291.2 //

Sattavīse ito kappe satt'; āsuṃ manujādhipā /  
Supajjalita-nāmā te cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_30,291.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_30,291.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Citapūjako thero i. g. a-ti. Citapūjakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[292. Pupphadhāraka.] Vākacīradharo āsim ajinuttaravasano[^244-1] /  
abhiññā pañca nibbattā[^244-2] candassa parimajjako.  // ApTha_30,292.1 //  
*Vipassiṃ lokapajjo*taṃ disvā abhigataṃ mamaṃ /

Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhidhārayiṃ[^244-3] /

Sattāsītimhi 'to kappe eko āsi mahīpati /

Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pupphadhārako[^244-6] thero i. g. a-ti. Pupphadhārakattherassa[^244-6] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[293. Chattadāyaka.] Putto mama pabbajito kāsāyavasano tadā /  
so ca Buddhattaṃ sampatto nibbuto[^244-7] lokapūjito.  // ApTha_30,293.1 //  
Vicinanto sakaṃ puttam agamaṃ pacchato ahaṃ /  
nibbutassa mahantassa citakam agamās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_30,293.2 //  
Paggayha añjaliṃ tattha vanditvā citakam ahaṃ /  
Setacchattañ ca paggayha āropesim ahaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_30,293.3 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ chattam abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi chattadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_30,293.4 //

Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā /

[295. Gosīsanikkhepa.] Ārāmadvārā nikkhamma gosīsaṃ santhataṃ[^245-7] mayā /  
anuhomi[^245-8] sakaṃ kammaṃ pubbakammass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_30,295.1 //

anubhomi sabbam etaṃ gosīsassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_30,295.2 //

Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ sīsaṃ santharim[^245-10] ahaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi santhārass'[^245-11] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_30,295.4 //  
Pañcasattati kappamhi Suppatiṭṭhita-nāmako /  
eko āsi mahātejo cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_30,295.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_30,295.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Gosīsanikkhepo[^245-12] thero i. g. a-ti. Gosīsanikkhepattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[296. Pādapūjaka.] Pabbate Himavantamhi ahosiṃ[^246-1] kinnaro tadā /  
addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ vītarasmīva[^246-2] bhānumaṃ.  // ApTha_30,296.1 //  
Upetaṃ maṃ tadā Buddhaṃ Vipassiṃ loka*nāyakaṃ* /  
candanaṃ tagaraṃ[^246-3] cāpi pade[^246-4] osiñc'; ahan tadā.[^246-5]  // ApTha_30,296.2 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ pādam abhipūjāyiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pādapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_30,296.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_30,296.4 //

[297. Desakittiyo.] Upasālaka[^246-6]-nāmo 'haṃ ahosiṃ brāhmaṇo tadā /  
kānanaṃ vanam ogāḷhaṃ[^246-7] lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ  // ApTha_30,297.1 //  
Disvāna vandiṃ pādesu lokāhutipaṭiggahaṃ[^246-8] /  
pasannacittaṃ maṃ ñatvā Buddho antaradhāyatha.  // ApTha_30,297.2 //  
Kānanā abhinikkhamma Buddhaseṭṭham anussariṃ /  
taṃ desaṃ kittayitvāna kappaṃ saggamhi mod'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_30,297.3 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ desam abhikittayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi kittanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_30,297.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_30,297.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Desakittiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Desakittiyattherassa[^246-9] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[298. Saraṇagamaniya.] Pabbate Himavantamhi ahosiṃ luddako tadā /  
Vipassim addasaṃ Buddhaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ.  // ApTha_30,298.1 //  
Upāsitvāna[^246-10] sambuddhaṃ veyyāvaccam akās'; ahaṃ /

duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ambadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_30,299.2 //

[300. Anusaṃsāvaka.] Piṇḍāya caramānāhaṃ Vipassim addasaṃ jinaṃ /

Pasannacitto sumano abhivādes'; ahaṃ tadā /  
anusaṃsāvayiṃ Buddham uttamatthassa pattiyā.[^247-2]  // ApTha_30,300.2 //  
Ito ekanavute[^247-3] kappe anusaṃsāvayim ahaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi anusaṃsāvanā phalaṃ.[^247-4]  // ApTha_30,300.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_30,300.4 //

Añjaliṃ paggahetvāna atinesiṃ sakaṃ gharaṃ /

duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi paramannass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_31,303.3 //

[304. Dhammasaññaka.] Vipassino bhagavato mahābodhimaho ahu /

vivattacchaddo[^249-6] sambuddho nibbāpesi mahājanaṃ.  // ApTha_31,304.3 //  
Tassāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
vanditvā satthuno pāde pakkāmiṃ uttarāmukho.  // ApTha_31,304.4 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ dhammam asuṇiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi dhammadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_31,304.5 //  
Tettiṃsamhi ito kappe eko āsi mahīpati /  
Sutavā nāma nāmena cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_31,304.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_31,304.7 //

[305. Phaladāyaka.] Bhāgīrasī[^250-1] nadītīre ahosi assamo[^250-2] tadā /

duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_31,305.3 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_31,305.4 //

[306. Sampasādaka.] Namo te buddhavīr'; atthu vippamutto si sabbadhi /

Siddhattho tassa vyākāsi loke appaṭipuggalo: /

Tattha tvaṃ[^250-7] viraje khette anantaphaladāyake /

Idaṃ vatvāna sabbaññū lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
mam evam anusāsitvā vehāsaṃ[^250-10] nabham uggami.  // ApTha_31,306.4 //  
Aciraṃ gatamaggamhi[^250-11] sabbaññumhi narāsabhe /  
maraṇaṃ samanuppatto[^250-12] Tusitam upapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_31,306.5 //  
Tadāhaṃ viraje khette anantaphaladāyake /  
saṅghe cittaṃ pasādetvā kappaṃ saggamhi mod'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_31,306.6 //  
Catunavute ito kappe pasādam alabhiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pasādassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_31,306.7 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_31,306.8 //

[307. Ārāmadāyaka.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato ārāmo *ro*pito mama /  
sandacchāyesu[^251-1] rukkhesu upavattesu[^251-2] pakkhisu.  // ApTha_31,307.1 //

Haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena phalam pupphañ ca 'dās'[^251-3] ahaṃ /  
tato jātappasādo ca taṃ dānaṃ pari*ṇāmay*iṃ.[^251-4]  // ApTha_31,307.3 //

bhave nibbattamānamhi[^251-5] nibbattati[^251-6] phalaṃ mama.  // ApTha_31,307.4 //

duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ārāmassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_31,307.5 //  
Ito sattatiṃse kappe *satt'; āsuṃ Mudusītalā* /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_31,307.6 //

[324. Saññasāmika.] Jātiyā sattavasso 'haṃ ahosiṃ mantapāragū /  
kulavaṃsam adhāresiṃ[^260-1] yañño ussāhito mayā.  // ApTha_33,324.1 //

udayanto va suriyo puṇṇamāse va candimā  // ApTha_33,324.3 //
