upagantvāna sambuddho idaṃ vacanam abravi:  // ApTha_33,324.4 //  
‘Ahiṃsā sabbapāṇānaṃ[^260-5] kumāra mama ruccati /

Rati ca samacariyāya[^260-7] bāhusaccakataññutā /  
diṭṭhe dhamme paratthā[^260-8] ca dhammā ete pasaṃsiyā.  // ApTha_33,324.6 //  
Ete dhamme bhāvayitvā[^260-9] sattāsattahite rato[^260-10] /  
Buddhe cittaṃ pasādetvā bhāvehi maggam uttamaṃ.';  // ApTha_33,324.7 //  
Idaṃ vatvāna sabbaññū lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
mam evam anusāsetvā vehāsam uggato gato.  // ApTha_33,324.8 //  
Pubbe[^260-11] cittaṃ visodhetvā pacchā cittaṃ[^260-12] pasādayiṃ. /  
Tena cittappasādena Tusitam upapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_33,324.9 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yadā cittaṃ pasādayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhasaññāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_33,324.10 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_33,324.11 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Saññasāmiko[^260-13] thero i. g. a-ti. Saññasāmikattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[325. Nimittasaññaka.] Candabhāgānadītīre[^261-1] vasāmi assame ahaṃ /  
suvaṇṇamigam addakkhiṃ carantaṃ[^261-2] vipine[^261-3] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_33,325.1 //

tena cittappasādena aññe Buddhe anussariṃ.  // ApTha_33,325.2 //  
Abbhatītā ca ye Buddhā vattamānā tathāgatā /  
evam eva virocanti migarājā va cetaso.  // ApTha_33,325.3 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi *Buddhasaññāy'* idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_33,325.4 //  
Sattavīse ito kappe eko āsi mahīpati /  
Araññasatto[^261-4] nāmena cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_33,325.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_33,325.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Nimittasaññako thero i. g. a-ti. Nimittasaññakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[326. Annasaṃsāvaka.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ gacchantam antarāpaṇe /  
kañcanagghiyasaṅkāsaṃ battiṃsavaralakkhaṇaṃ  // ApTha_33,326.1 //  
Siddhatthaṃ sabbasiddhattham anejam aparājitaṃ /  
sambuddham atināmetvā bhojayin taṃ[^261-5] mahamuniṃ.  // ApTha_33,326.2 //  
Muni kāruṇiko loke obhāsayi[^261-6] mamaṃ tadā /  
Buddhe cittaṃ pasādetvā kappaṃ saggamhi mod'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_33,326.3 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bhikkhadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_33,326.4 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_33,326.5 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Annasaṃsāvako thero i. g. a-ti. Annasaṃsāvakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

<a id="page-262"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 262]*

[327. Nigguṇṭhipupphiya.] Yadā devo devakāyā cavati āyusaṅkhayā /  
tayo saddā niccharanti[^262-1] devānam anumodataṃ.[^262-2]  // ApTha_33,327.1 //  
Ito bho sugatiṃ[^262-3] gaccha[^262-4] manussānaṃ sahavyataṃ /  
manussabhūto saddhamme labha saddham[^262-5] anuttaraṃ.  // ApTha_33,327.2 //  
Sā te[^262-6] saddhā niviṭṭhassa[^262-7] mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā /  
yāvajīvam asaṃhīrā[^262-8] saddhamme suppavedite.[^262-9]  // ApTha_33,327.3 //  
Kāyena kusalaṃ katvā vācāya kusalaṃ bahuṃ[^262-10] /  
manasā kusalaṃ katvā avyapajjhaṃ nirūpadhiṃ.  // ApTha_33,327.4 //  
Tato opadhikaṃ puññaṃ[^262-11] katvā dānena taṃ bahuṃ[^262-12] /  
aññe nicc'; eva saddhamme[^262-13] brahmacariye nivesaya.  // ApTha_33,327.5 //  
Imāya anukampāya devadevaṃ yadā viduṃ[^262-14] /  
cavantam anumodanti ehi deva punappunaṃ.  // ApTha_33,327.6 //  
Saṃviggo 'mhi[^262-15] tadā āsiṃ[^262-16] devasaṅghe[^262-17] samāgate /  
kaṃ su nāma ahaṃ yoniṃ gamissāmi ito cuto?  // ApTha_33,327.7 //  
Mama saṃvegam aññāya samaṇo bhāvitindriyo /  
mam uddharitukāmo so agacchi mama santike.  // ApTha_33,327.8 //  
Sumano nāma nāmena Padumuttarasāvako /  
atthadhammānusāsitvā saṃvejesi maman tadā.[^262-18]  // ApTha_33,327.9 //  
Tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā Buddhe cittappasādayiṃ /  
taṃ vīram abhivādetvā tattha kālakato ahaṃ.  // ApTha_33,327.10 //  
Upapajjissaṃ tatth'; eva sukkamūlena codito{cross} /  
vasanto mātukucchimhi puna dhāretu mātuyā  // ApTha_33,327.11 //  
Tamhā kāyā cavitvāna Tidase upapajj'; ahaṃ /  
etthantare na passāmi domanassaṃ mamaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_33,327.12 //


<!-- PTS Page 263 -->
<a id="page-263"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 263]*

Tāvatiṃsā cavitvāna mātukucchiṃ samokkamaṃ[^263-1] /  
nikkhamitvāna kucchimhā kaṇhasukkam ajāni 'haṃ.  // ApTha_33,327.13 //  
Jātiyā sattavassena[^263-2] ārāmaṃ pāvisim ahaṃ /  
Gotamassa bhagavato Sakyaputtassa tādino.  // ApTha_33,327.14 //  
Vitthārake[^263-3] pāvacane bahujaññamhi sāsane /  
addasaṃ sāsanakāre[^263-4] bhikkhavo tattha satthuno.  // ApTha_33,327.15 //  
Sāvatthi nāma nagaraṃ[^263-5] rājā tatthāsi Kosalo /  
rathena nāgayuttena[^263-6] upesi bodhim uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_33,327.16 //  
Tassāhaṃ nāgaṃ[^263-7] disvāna pubbakammam anussariṃ /  
añjaliṃ paggahetvāna samayam agamās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_33,327.17 //  
Jātiyā sattavass'[^263-8] eva pabbajim anagāriyaṃ[^263-9] /  
yo so Buddham upaṭṭhāsi Ānando nāma sāvako.  // ApTha_33,327.18 //  
Gatimā dhitimā[^263-10] c'; eva satimā ca bahussuto /  
rañño cittaṃ pasādento niyyādesi[^263-11] mahājutiṃ.  // ApTha_33,327.19 //  
Tassāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna pubbakammam anussariṃ /  
tatth'; eva ṭhitako santo arahattam apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_33,327.20 //  
Ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā sire katvāna añjaliṃ /  
sambuddham abhivādetvā imaṃ vācam udīrayiṃ[^263-12]:  // ApTha_33,327.21 //  
‘Padumuttarabuddhassa dipadindassa satthuno /  
nigguṇṭhipupphaṃ[^263-13] paggayha sīhāsane ṭhapes'; ahaṃ.[^263-14]  // ApTha_33,327.22 //  
Tena kammena dipadinda lokajeṭṭha narāsabha[^263-15] /  
patto 'mhi acalaṃ ṭhānaṃ hitvā jayaparājayaṃ.';  // ApTha_33,327.23 //  
Pañcavīsasahassamhi kappānaṃ manujādhipā /  
Abbudanirabbudāni[^263-16] aṭṭh'; aṭṭh'; āsisu[^263-17] khattiyā.  // ApTha_33,327.24 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_33,327.25 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Nigguṇṭhipupphiyo[^263-18] thero i. g. a-ti. Nigguṇṭhipupphiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

##### *[PTS Page 264]*

[328. Sumanāveḷiya.] Vessabhussa bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
sabbe janā[^264-1] samāgamma mahāpūjaṃ karonti te.  // ApTha_33,328.1 //  
Sudhāya piṇḍaṃ katvāna āveḷaṃ sumanāy'; ahaṃ /  
sīhāsanassa purato abhiropes'; ahan tadā.  // ApTha_33,328.2 //  
Sabbe janā[^264-2] samāgamma pekkhanti puppham uttamaṃ /  
ken'; idaṃ pūjitaṃ pupphaṃ[^264-3] Buddhaseṭṭhassa tādino?  // ApTha_33,328.3 //  
Tena cittappasādena Nimmānam[^264-4] upapajj'; ahaṃ /  
anubhosiṃ[^264-5] sakaṃ kammaṃ pubbe sukatam attano.  // ApTha_33,328.4 //  
Yaṃ yaṃ yonūpapajjāmi devattam atha mānusaṃ /  
sabbesānaṃ piyo homi pupphapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_33,328.5 //  
Nābhijānāmi kāyena vācāya uda cetasā /  
saṃyatāna tapassīnaṃ[^264-6] katam uṭṭhāhitaṃ[^264-7] mayā.  // ApTha_33,328.6 //  
Tena sucaritenāhaṃ cittassa paṇidhīhi ca /  
sabbesaṃ pūjito[^264-8] homi anakkosass'[^264-9] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_33,328.7 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_33,328.8 //  
Ito *ekādase kappe* Sahassāro'; si[^264-10] khattiyo /  
sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo.  // ApTha_33,328.9 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_33,328.10 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sumanāveḷiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Sumanāveḷiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[329. Pupphacchattiya.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
saccaṃ pakāsayantassa nibbāpentassa *pāṇino  // ApTha_33,329.1 //  
Jalajaṃ āhari*tvāna satapattaṃ manoramaṃ /  
pupphassa chattaṃ katvāna Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ.  // ApTha_33,329.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 265 -->
<a id="page-265"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 265]*

Siddhattho ca lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
bhikkhusaṅghe ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_33,329.3 //  
‘Yo me cittaṃ pasādetvā pupphacchattam *akārayi /  
tena* cittappasādena duggatiṃ so na gacchati.';  // ApTha_33,329.4 //  
Idaṃ vatvāna sambuddho Siddhattho lokanāyako /  
uyyojetvāna[^265-1] parisaṃ vehāsaṃ nabham uggami.  // ApTha_33,329.5 //  
Vuṭṭhite naradevamhi setacchattam hi vuṭṭhahi /  
purato Buddhase*ṭṭhassa gacchati cha*ttam uttamaṃ  // ApTha_33,329.6 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ chattam abhiropayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphacchattass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_33,329.7 //  
Catusattati kappamhi aṭṭha Jalasikhā ahuṃ[^265-2] /  
sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā.  // ApTha_33,329.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_33,329.9 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pupphacchattiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Pupphacchattiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[330. Saparivārachattadāyaka.] Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
ākāse jalavuṭṭhīva[^265-3] vassati dhammavuṭṭhiyā.  // ApTha_33,330.1 //  
Tam addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ desentam amataṃ padaṃ /  
sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā agamāsiṃ[^265-4] sakaṃ gharaṃ  // ApTha_33,330.2 //  
Chattam alaṅkataṃ[^265-5] gayha upagacchiṃ[^265-6] naruttamaṃ /  
haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena ākāse ukkhipim ahaṃ.[^265-7]  // ApTha_33,330.3 //  
Susaṅgahītayānaṃ va danto va sāvakuttamo /  
upagantvāna sambuddhaṃ matthake sampatiṭṭhahi.  // ApTha_33,330.4 //  
Anukampako kāruṇiko Buddho lokagganāyako /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_33,330.5 //  
‘Yena chattam idaṃ dinnam alaṅkataṃ manoramaṃ[^265-8] /  
tena cittappasādena duggatiṃ so na gacchati.  // ApTha_33,330.6 //


<!-- PTS Page 266 -->
<a id="page-266"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 266]*

Sattakkhattuñ ca devesu devarajjaṃ karissati /  
chattiṃsakkhattuṃ rājā ca cakkavattī bhavissati.  // ApTha_33,330.7 //  
Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_33,330.8 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.'[^266-1]  // ApTha_33,330.9 //  
Buddhassa giram aññāya vācāsabhim[^266-2] udīritaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano bhiyyobhāsaṃ janes'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_33,330.10 //  
Jahitvā mānusaṃ yoniṃ devayoniṃ[^266-3] samajjhagaṃ /  
vimānam uttamaṃ mayham abbhuggataṃ manoramaṃ.[^266-4]  // ApTha_33,330.11 //  
Vimānā nikkhamantassa setacchattaṃ dhāriyati[^266-5] tadā /  
saññaṃ paṭilabhāmi pubbakammass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_33,330.12 //  
Devalokā cavitvāna manussattañ ca āgacchiṃ[^266-6] /  
chattiṃsakkhattuñ cakkavattī sattakappasatamhi 'to.  // ApTha_33,330.13 //  
Tamhā kāyā cavitvāna āgacchaṃ[^266-7] tidasaṃ puraṃ /  
saṃsaritvānupubbena[^266-8] mānussaṃ punar āgamaṃ.[^266-9]  // ApTha_33,330.14 //  
Okkantam mātukucchiṃ maṃ setacchattam adhārayuṃ /  
Jātiyā sattavassā 'haṃ[^266-10] pabbajim[^266-11] anagāriyaṃ.  // ApTha_33,330.15 //  
Sunando nāma nāmena brāhmaṇo mantapāragū /  
phalitaṃ[^266-12] chattam ādāya sāvakaggassa so[^266-13] adā.  // ApTha_33,330.16 //  
Anumodi mahāvīro Sāriputto mahākathī /  
sutvānumodanaṃ tassa pubbakammam anussariṃ:  // ApTha_33,330.17 //  
Añjaliṃ paggahetvāna sakaṃ cittaṃ pasādayiṃ[^266-14] /  
saritvā pūrimaṃ kammam arahattam apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_33,330.18 //  
Uṭṭhāya āsanā tamhā sīre katvāna añjaliṃ /  
sambuddham abhivādetvā imaṃ vācam udīrayiṃ:  // ApTha_33,330.19 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Buddho loke anuttaro /  
Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho.  // ApTha_33,330.20 //  
Tassa chattaṃ mayā dinnaṃ vicittaṃ samalaṅkataṃ /  
ubho hatthehi paggaṇhi sayambhū aggapuggalo.  // ApTha_33,330.21 //


<!-- PTS Page 267 -->

##### *[PTS Page 267]*

Aho buddhā[^267-1] aho dhammā[^267-2] aho no satthu sampadā[^267-3] /  
ekachattassa dānena duggatiṃ nūpapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_33,330.22 //  
Kilesā jhāpitā mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā /  
sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_33,330.23 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_33,330.24 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Saparivārachattadāyako th. i. g. a-ti. Saparivārachattadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Ummāpupphañ ca Pulinaṃ[^267-4] Hāso Saññā-Nimittako[^267-5] Saṃsāvako[^267-6] Nigguṇṭhī[^267-7] ca Sumanaṃ Pupphachattako Saparivāracchatto ca gāthā sattasat'; uttarā.[^267-8] Ummāpupphiyavaggo tettiṃso.[^267-9]

[331. Gandhathūpiya.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato gandhathūpam adās'; ahaṃ /  
sumanehi paṭicchannaṃ Buddhānucchavikañ ca taṃ.  // ApTha_34,331.1 //  
Kañcanagghiyasaṅkāsaṃ sambuddhaṃ lokanāyakaṃ[^267-10] /  
indīvaraṃ va jalitam ādittaṃ va hutāsanaṃ  // ApTha_34,331.2 //  
Vyagghusabhaṃ va pa*varam abhijātaṃ va* kesariṃ /  
nisinnaṃ samaṇānaggaṃ bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṃ  // ApTha_34,331.3 //  
Disvā cittaṃ pasādetvā paggahetvāna añjaliṃ /  
vanditvā satthuno pāde pakkāmiṃ uttarāmukho.  // ApTha_34,331.4 //  
Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ gandham adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi *gandhapūjāy'; idaṃ* phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,331.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_34,331.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Gandhathūpiyo th. i. g. a-ti. Gandhathūpiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[332. Phussitakammiya.] Vipassī nāma sambuddho lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
khīṇāsavehi sahito saṅghārāme vasī[^268-1] tadā.  // ApTha_34,332.1 //  
Ārāmadvārā nikkhamma Vipassī lokanāyako /  
sahasatasahassehi aṭṭha khīṇāsavehi tu.[^268-2]  // ApTha_34,332.2 //  
Ajinena* nivattho[^268-3] 'haṃ vāka*ciradharo pi ca /  
kusumbhodakam[^268-4] ādāya sambuddham upasaṅkamiṃ.  // ApTha_34,332.3 //  
Sakaṃ[^268-5] cittaṃ pasādetvā vedajāto[^268-6] katañjali /  
kusumbhodakam ādāya Buddham abbhukkirim ahaṃ  // ApTha_34,332.4 //  
Tena kammena sambuddho jalajuttamanāmako /  
mama kammaṃ pakittetvā[^268-7] *agamā ye*na patthitaṃ.  // ApTha_34,332.5 //  
Phussitā pañcasahassā yehi pūjes'; ahaṃ jinaṃ /  
aḍḍhateyyasahassehi devarajjam akārayiṃ.  // ApTha_34,332.6 //  
Aḍḍhateyyasahassehi cakkavattī ahos'; ahaṃ /  
avasesena kammena arahattam apāpuṇiṃ.[^268-8]  // ApTha_34,332.7 //  
Devarājā yadā[^268-9] homi[^268-10] manujādhipati[^268-11] yathā[^268-12] /  
tam yeva nāmadheyyam me Phussito[^268-13] nāma hom'[^268-14] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,332.8 //  
Devabhūtassa santassa athāpi mānusassa vā /  
samantāvyāmato[^268-15] mayhaṃ phussitaṃ va pavassati[^268-16]  // ApTha_34,332.9 //  
Bhavā ugghāṭitā mayhaṃ kilesā jhāpitā mama /  
sabbāsave[^268-17] parikkhīṇo phussitassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,332.10 //  
Candanass'; eva me vasso[^268-18] tathā gandho pavāyati /  
sārīriko mamaṃ[^268-19] gandho aḍḍhakose[^268-20] pavāyati.  // ApTha_34,332.11 //  
Dibbagandhaṃ[^268-21] sampavantaṃ[^268-22] puññakammasamaṅginaṃ[^268-23] /  
gandhaṃ ghatvāna jānanti[^268-24] Phussito āgato idha.  // ApTha_34,332.12 //


<!-- PTS Page 269 -->
<a id="page-269"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 269]*

Sākhā phalā[^269-1] sakaṭṭhāni tiṇāni pi va sabbaso /  
mama saṅkappam aññāya gandho sampajjate khaṇe.  // ApTha_34,332.13 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe candanam abhipūjayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phussitassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,332.14 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_34,332.15 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Phussitakammiyo[^269-2] th. i. g. a-ti. Phussitakammiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[333. Pabhaṅkara.] Padumuttarassa bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino /  
pavane cetiyam āsi vāḷamigasamākule.  // ApTha_34,333.1 //  
Na koci visahī gantuṃ cetiyam abhivandituṃ /  
tiṇakaṭṭhalatonaddhaṃ paluggam āsi[^269-3] cetiyaṃ.  // ApTha_34,333.2 //  
Vanakammiko tadā āsiṃ pitupetāmahen'; ahaṃ /  
addasaṃ pavane thūpaṃ luggaṃ tiṇalatākulaṃ.  // ApTha_34,333.3 //  
Disvān'; ahaṃ Buddhathūpaṃ garucittam upaṭṭhahiṃ[^269-4] /  
Buddhaseṭṭhassa thūpo yaṃ paluggo acchatī[^269-5] vane.  // ApTha_34,333.4 //  
Nacchannaṃ nappatirūpaṃ jānantassa guṇāguṇaṃ /  
Buddhathūpam asodhetvā aññakammaṃ payojaye.  // ApTha_34,333.5 //  
Tiṇakaṭṭhañ ca vallin ca[^269-6] *sodhayitvāna cetiye /  
vanditvā* aṭṭha *vā*rāni paṭikuṭiko[^269-7] agacch'; ahaṃ.[^269-8]  // ApTha_34,333.6 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsam agacch'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,333.7 //  
Tattha me sukataṃ vyamhaṃ[^269-9] sovaṇṇaṃ sappabhassaraṃ /  
saṭṭhiyojanam ubbedhaṃ[^269-10] tiṃsayojanavitthataṃ.  // ApTha_34,333.8 //  
Tisatāni ca vārāni devarajjam akārayiṃ /  
pañcavīsatikkhattuñ ca cakkavattī ahos'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,333.9 //  
Bhavābhave saṃsaranto mahābhogaṃ labhām'; ahaṃ /  
bhoge me ūṇatā n'; atthi sodhanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,333.10 //


<!-- PTS Page 270 -->

##### *[PTS Page 270]*

Siviyā hatthikkhandhena pavane gacchato mamaṃ /  
yaṃ yaṃ disāhaṃ gacchāmi saraṇaṃ sampajjate dhanaṃ.[^270-1]  // ApTha_34,333.11 //  
Khāṇuṃ vā kaṇṭakaṃ vāpi nāhaṃ passāmi cakkhunā /  
puññakammena saṃyutto sayam evāpaṇiyyare.  // ApTha_34,333.12 //  
Kuṭṭhaṃ gaṇḍo kilāso ca apamāro vitacchikā /  
daddu kaṇḍu[^270-2] ca me n'; atthi sodhanāya idhaṃ phalaṃ  // ApTha_34,333.13 //  
Aññaṃ pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpassa sodhane[^270-3] /  
nābhijānāmi me kāye jātaṃ pilakabindukaṃ.[^270-4]  // ApTha_34,333.14 //  
Aññaṃ pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpamhi sodhite /  
duve bhave saṃsarāmi devatte atha mānuse.  // ApTha_34,333.15 //  
Aññaṃ pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpamhi sodhite /  
suvaṇṇavaṇṇo sabbattha sappabhāso bhavām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,333.16 //  
Aññam pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpamhi sodhite /  
amanāpaṃ vivajjeti manāpam upatiṭṭhati.  // ApTha_34,333.17 //  
Aññaṃ pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpamhi sodhite /  
visuddhaṃ[^270-5] hoti me cittam ekaggaṃ susamāhitaṃ.  // ApTha_34,333.18 //  
Aññaṃ pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpamhi sodhite /  
ekāsane nisīditvā arahattam apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_34,333.19 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi sodhanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,333.20 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_34,333.21 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pabhaṅkaro thero i. g. a-ti. Pabhaṅkarattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[334. Tiṇakuṭidāyaka.] Nagare[^270-6] Bandhumatiyā ahosiṃ parakammiko /  
parakammāyane yutto parabhattaṃ apassito.[^270-7]  // ApTha_34,334.1 //  
Rahogato nisīditvā evaṃ cintesi tāvade[^270-8]: /  
Buddho loke samuppanno adhikāro *ca n'; atthi* me.  // ApTha_34,334.2 //

##### *[PTS Page 271]*

Kālo gatiṃ me sodhetuṃ khaṇo me paṭipādito /  
dukkho nirayasamphasso[^271-1] apuññānaṃ hi pāṇinaṃ.  // ApTha_34,334.3 //  
Evāhaṃ cintayitvāna kammasāmim upāgamiṃ /  
ekāhaṃ kammaṃ *yācitvā pavanaṃ pāvisim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,334.4 //  
Tiṇakaṭṭhañ ca* valliñ[^271-2] ca āharitvān'; ahan tadā /  
tidaṇḍake ṭhapetvāna akaṃ tiṇakuṭim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,334.5 //  
Saṅghassatthāya kuṭikaṃ niyyātetvāna *tam ahaṃ* /  
tadahe yeva āgantvā kammasāmim upāgamiṃ.  // ApTha_34,334.6 //  
*Tena kammena sukatena Tāvatiṃsam agacch'; ahaṃ /  
tattha me* sukataṃ vyamhaṃ[^271-3] tiṇakuṭikāya nimmitaṃ.  // ApTha_34,334.7 //  
Sahassakaṇḍo[^271-4] satageṇḍu[^271-5] dhajālu haritāmayo /  
satasahassaniyyūhā vyamhe[^271-6] pātubhaviṃsu me.  // ApTha_34,334.8 //  
Yaṃ yaṃ yonūpapajjāmi devattam atha mānusaṃ /  
mama saṅkappam aññāya *pāsādo upatiṭṭhati.*  // ApTha_34,334.9 //  
Bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso na vijjati /  
tāsaṃ mamaṃ[^271-7] na jānāmi tiṇakuṭikāy[^271-8] idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,334.10 //  
Sīhavyagghā ca dīpī ca acchakokataracchayo[^271-9] /  
sabbe maṃ parivajjenti tiṇakuṭikāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,334.11 //  
Siriṃsapā ca bhūtā *ca ahi-kumbhaṇḍa-ra*kkhasā /  
te pi maṃ parivajjenti tiṇakuṭikāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,334.12 //  
Na pāpasupinassāhaṃ[^271-10] sarāmi dassanaṃ mama /  
upaṭṭhitā sati mayhaṃ tiṇakuṭikāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,334.13 //  
Tāy'; eva[^271-11] tiṇakuṭikāya anubhotvāna sampadā /  
Gotamassa bhagavato dhammaṃ sacchikarim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,334.14 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi tiṇakuṭikāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,334.15 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_34,334.16 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tiṇakuṭidāyako th. i. g. a-ti. Tiṇakuṭidāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[335. Uttareyyadāyaka.] Nagare[^272-1] Haṃsavatiyā āhosiṃ[^272-2] brāhmaṇo tadā /  
ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedāna pāragū.  // ApTha_34,335.1 //  
Purakkhato sasissehi jātimā ca susikkhito /  
toyābhisecanatthāya nagarā[^272-3] nikkhamiṃ[^272-4] tadā.  // ApTha_34,335.2 //  
Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū /  
khīṇāsa*vasa*hassehi nagaraṃ pāvisi jino.  // ApTha_34,335.3 //  
Sucārurūpaṃ[^272-5] disvāna anejaṃ kāritaṃ viya[^272-6] /  
parivutam[^272-7] arahantehi disvā cittaṃ pasādayiṃ.  // ApTha_34,335.4 //  
Sirasi añjaliṃ katvā namassitvāna subbataṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano uttarīyam adās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,335.5 //  
Ubho hatthehi paggayha sāṭakam ukkhipim ahaṃ /  
yāvatā Buddhaparisā tāva cchādesi[^272-8] sāṭakaṃ.  // ApTha_34,335.6 //  
Piṇḍacārañ *caran*tassa mahābhikkhugaṇādinaṃ[^272-9] /  
chadaṃ[^272-10] karonto aṭṭhāsi hāsayanto[^272-11] maman tadā.  // ApTha_34,335.7 //  
Gharato nikkhamantassa sayambhū aggapuggalo /  
vīṭhiyaṃ 'va[^272-12] ṭhito satthā akā me anumodanaṃ:  // ApTha_34,335.8 //  
Pasannacitto sumano yo me *pādāsi sāṭa*kaṃ /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_34,335.9 //  
‘Tiṃsakappasahassāni devaloke ramissati /  
paññāsakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjaṃ karissati.  // ApTha_34,335.10 //  
Devaloke vasantassa puññakammasamaṅgino /  
samantāyojanasataṃ *dussacchannaṃ* bhavissati.  // ApTha_34,335.11 //  
Chattiṃsakkhattuṃ rājā *ca* cakkavatti bhavissati /  
padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ.[^272-13]  // ApTha_34,335.12 //  
Bhave saṃsāramāṇassa puññakammasamaṅgino /  
manasā patthitaṃ sabbaṃ nibbattissati tāvade.  // ApTha_34,335.13 //  
Koseyyakambalāni ca khomakappāsikāni ca /  
mahagghāni ca dussāni paṭilacchati[^272-14] yaṃ naro.  // ApTha_34,335.14 //

##### *[PTS Page 273]*

Manasā patthitaṃ sabbaṃ paṭilacchati[^273-1] yaṃ naro /  
ekadussassa vipākam anubhossati[^273-2] sabbadā.  // ApTha_34,335.15 //  
So pacchā pabbajitvāna sukkamūlena codito /  
Gotamassa bhagavato dhammaṃ sacchikarissati.';  // ApTha_34,335.16 //  
Aho me sukataṃ kammaṃ sabbaññussa mahesino /  
ekāhaṃ sāṭakaṃ datvā[^273-3] patto 'mhi amataṃ[^273-4] padaṃ.  // ApTha_34,335.17 //  
Maṇḍape rukkhamūle vā vasato suññake ghare[^273-5] /  
dhāreti dussacchadanaṃ samantāvyāmato mamaṃ.  // ApTha_34,335.18 //  
Aviññatti[^273-6] nisevāmi cīvaraṃ paccayañ ca 'haṃ[^273-7] /  
lābhī hi annapānassa[^273-8] uttareyyass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,335.19 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi vatthadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,335.20 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_34,335.21 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Uttareyyadāyako thero i. g. a-ti. Uttareyyadāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[336. Dhammasavaniya.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna-pāragū[^273-9] /  
catusaccaṃ pakāsento santāreti bahuṃ janaṃ.[^273-10]  // ApTha_34,336.1 //  
Ahaṃ tena samayena jaṭilo uggatāpaṇo[^273-11] /  
dhunanto vākacīrāni gacchāmi ambare tadā.  // ApTha_34,336.2 //  
Buddhaseṭṭhassa upari gantuṃ na visahām'; ahaṃ /  
pakkhī va selam āsajja gamanaṃ na labhe[^273-12] tadā.  // ApTha_34,336.3 //  
Na me idaṃ bhūtapubbam iriyassa vikopanaṃ[^273-13] /  
dake yathā ummisitvā[^273-14] evaṃ gacchāmi ambare.  // ApTha_34,336.4 //

##### *[PTS Page 274]*

Ulārabhūto[^274-1] manujo heṭṭhāsīno[^274-2] bhavissati /  
handa me naṃ[^274-3] gavesissam[^274-4] api atthaṃ labheyy'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,336.5 //  
Orohanto antalikkhā saddam assosi satthuno /  
aniccataṃ kathentassa tam aham uggahiṃ tadā.  // ApTha_34,336.6 //  
Aniccasaññam uggayha agamāsiṃ mam'; assamaṃ /  
yāvatā*yu vasitvā*na tattha kālakato ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,336.7 //  
Carime vattamānamhi taṃ dhammasavanaṃ sariṃ[^274-5] /  
tena kammena sukatena Tāvatiṃsam agacch'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,336.8 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassāni devaloke ramiṃ ahaṃ /  
Ekapaññāsakkhattuñ ca devarajjam akārayiṃ.  // ApTha_34,336.9 //  
*Ekasattatikkhattuñ ca* cakkavattī ahos ahaṃ /

*Pi*tu ghare nisīditvā samaṇo bhāvitindriyo /  
kathāya[^274-7] paridīpento aniccavatthudāhari[^274-8]  // ApTha_34,336.11 //  
Anussarāmi *taṃ saññaṃ saṃsaranto bhavābhave /  
na koṭipaṭivijjhāmi[^274-9] ni*bbānam accutaṃ padaṃ.  // ApTha_34,336.12 //  
Aniccā vata saṅkhārā uppādāvayadhammino[^274-10] /  
uppajjitvā nirujjhanti tesaṃ vupasamo sukho.  // ApTha_34,336.13 //  
Saha gāthaṃ[^274-11] suṇitvāna pubbasaññam anussariṃ /  
ekāsane nisīditvā arahattam apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_34,336.14 //  
Jātiyā *sattavasso 'ham*arahattam apāpuṇiṃ /  
upasampādayi[^274-12] Buddho guṇam aññāya cakkhumā.  // ApTha_34,336.15 //  
Dārako va[^274-13] ahaṃ santo karaṇīyaṃ samāpayiṃ[^274-14] /  
kim me karaṇiyam ajja Sakyaputtassa sāsane.  // ApTha_34,336.16 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi saddhammasavane phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,336.17 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_34,336.18 //

[337. Ukkhittapadumiya.] Nagare Haṃsavatiyā āhosiṃ[^275-1] māliko tadā /  
ogahetvā padumasaraṃ[^275-2] satapatte[^275-3] ocinām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,337.1 //  
Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū /  
sahasatasahassehi santacittehi tādihi  // ApTha_34,337.2 //  
Khīṇāsavehi suddhehi chaḷābhiññāhi so saha[^275-4] /  
mama vuddhiṃ[^275-5] samannesaṃ[^275-6] āgacchi[^275-7] purisuttamo.  // ApTha_34,337.3 //  
Disvān'; ahaṃ[^275-8] devadevan sayambhuṃ lokanāyakaṃ /  
vaṇṭe[^275-9] chetvā[^275-10] satapattam ukkhipim[^275-11] ambare tadā:  // ApTha_34,337.4 //  
‘Yadi Buddho tuvaṃ vīra lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
sayaṃ[^275-12] gantvā[^275-13] satapattā matthake dhārayantu te.';  // ApTha_34,337.5 //  
Adhiṭṭhahi mahāvīro lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
Buddhassa ānubhāvena matthake dhārayiṃsu te.  // ApTha_34,337.6 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā[^275-14] mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsam agacch'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,337.7 //  
Tattha me sukataṃ vyamhaṃ[^275-15] Satapattan[^275-16] ti vuccati /  
saṭṭhiyojanamubbiddhaṃ tiṃsayojanavitthataṃ.  // ApTha_34,337.8 //  
Sahassakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjam akārayiṃ /  
pañcasattatikkhattuñ ca cakkavattī ahos'; ahaṃ  // ApTha_34,337.9 //  
Padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ[^275-17] /  
anubhomi sakaṃ kammaṃ pubbe sukatam attano  // ApTha_34,337.10 //  
Ten'; eva ekapadumena anubhotvāna[^275-18] sampadā /  
Gotamassa bhagavato dhammaṃ sacchikarim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_34,337.11 //  
Kilesā jhāpitā mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā /  
nāgo va bandhanaṃ chetvā viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_34,337.12 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ekapadumass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_34,337.13 //

[338. Ekapadumiya.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū /  
bhavābhave vibhāvento tāreti janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_35,338.1 //  
Haṃsarājā tadā homi dijānaṃ pavaro ahaṃ /

mama kammaṃ pakittetvā agamā yena patthitaṃ.  // ApTha_35,338.8 //

Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_35,338.10 //

duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_35,339.8 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_35,339.9 //

anubhomi sakaṃ kammaṃ pubbe sukatam attano.  // ApTha_35,340.4 //

[341. Tīṇikiṅkhaṇikapūjaka.] Himavantass'; avidūre Bhūtagaṇo nāma pabbato /  
tatth'; addasaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ dumaggamhi vilaggitaṃ.  // ApTha_35,341.1 //

[342. Nalāgārika.] Himavantass'; avidūre Hārito nāma pabbato /

[386. Soṇakoṭivīsa.] Vipassino pāvacane ekaṃ leṇaṃ mayā kataṃ /  
cātuddisassa saṅghassa Bandhumā-rājadhāniyā.[^298-1]  // ApTha_39,386.1 //  
Dussehi bhūmileṇassa[^298-2] santharitvā[^298-3] pariccajiṃ /  
udaggacitto sumano akāsiṃ paṇidhiṃ tadā:  // ApTha_39,386.2 //  
‘Ārādhayeyyaṃ sambuddhaṃ pabbajjañ ca labheyy'; ahaṃ /  
anuttarañ ca nibbānaṃ phuseyyaṃ santim uttamaṃ.';  // ApTha_39,386.3 //  
Ten'; eva sukkamūlena kappaṃ navuti saṃsariṃ /  
devabhūto manusso va[^298-4] katapuñño viroc'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_39,386.4 //  
Tato kammāvasesena idha pacchimake bhave /  
Campāyam aggaseṭṭhissa jāto 'mhi ekaputtako.  // ApTha_39,386.5 //  
Jāta*mat*tassa[^298-5] me sutvā pitucchando[^298-6] ayam ahu /  
dadām'; ahaṃ[^298-7] kumārassa vīsakoṭianūnakā.  // ApTha_39,386.6 //  
Caturaṅgulā ca me lomā jātā pādatale ubho /  
sukhumā mudusamphassā 'tulāpi ca mahāsubhā.  // ApTha_39,386.7 //  
Atītā navutī kappā[^298-8] *ay*am eko 'va uttariṃ[^298-9] /  
nābhijānāmi nikkhitte pāde bhume[^298-10] asanthate.  // ApTha_39,386.8 //  
Ārādhito me sambuddho pabbajim anagāriyaṃ /  
arahattañ ca me pattaṃ sītibhūto 'mhi nibbuto.[^298-11]  // ApTha_39,386.9 //  
Aggo āraddhaviriyānaṃ[^298-12] niddiṭṭho *sabbadassinā* /  
khīṇāsavo ca arahā chaḷabhiññāmahiddhiko.[^298-13]  // ApTha_39,386.10 //  
Ekanavut'; ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi leṇadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_39,386.11 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_39,386.12 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_39,386.13 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_39,386.14 //  
Koṭivīso ti so Soṇo bhikkhu *saṅghassa aggato* pañhaṃ[^298-14] puṭṭho viyākāsi Anotatte mahāsare ti. Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Soṇo Koṭivīso thero i. g. a-ti. Soṇakoṭivīsattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

##### *[PTS Page 299]*

[387. Pubbakammapiloti.] Anota*ttasarāsanne ramaṇīye silā*tale /  
nānāratanapajjote nānāgandhavanantare  // ApTha_39,387.1 //  
Mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena pareto lokanāyako /  
āsīno vyākari tattha pubbakammāni attano:  // ApTha_39,387.2 //  
‘Suṇotha[^299-1] bhikkhavo mayham yaṃ kammaṃ pakatam mayā /  
*pilotiyassa[^299-2] kammassa buddhatthe[^299-3]* pi vipaccati.  // ApTha_39,387.3 //  
Munāli[^299-4] nām'; ahaṃ dhutto[^299-5] pubbe aññāsu jātisu /  
paccekabuddhaṃ Surabhim abbhācikkhim[^299-6] adūsakaṃ.  // ApTha_39,387.4 //  
Tena kammavipākena niraye saṃsariṃ ciraṃ /  
bahū vassasahassāni dukkhaṃ vedesiṃ vedanaṃ.  // ApTha_39,387.5 //  
Tena kammāvasesena idha pa*cchimake bhave /  
abbhakkhā*naṃ mayā laddhaṃ Sundarīkāya kāraṇā.  // ApTha_39,387.6 //  
Sabbābhibhussa Buddhassa Nando nām'; āsi sāvako /  
tam[^299-7] abbhakkhāya[^299-8] niraye ciraṃ saṃsaritam mayā.  // ApTha_39,387.7 //  
Dasavassasahassāni niraye saṃsariṃ ciraṃ /  
manussabhāvaṃ laddhāham[^299-9] abbhakkhānaṃ bahuṃ labhiṃ.  // ApTha_39,387.8 //  
Tena kammā*vasesena Ciñca* mānavikā mamaṃ /  
abbhakkhāsi[^299-10] abhūtena janakāyassa aggato.  // ApTha_39,387.9 //  
Brāhmaṇo sutavā āsim ahaṃ sakkatapūjito /  
mahāvane pañcasate *mante* vācemi māṇave.  // ApTha_39,387.10 //  
Tatthāgato Isigaṇo[^299-11] pañcābhiññāmahi*ddhiko*[^299-12] /  
tañ cāham[^299-13] ā*gataṃ disvā abbhācikkhim adūsakaṃ.  // ApTha_39,387.11 //  
Tato 'ham avacaṃ sisse: kāmabhogī[^299-14] ayaṃ isi /  
mayhaṃ vibhāsamānassa anumodiṃsu māṇavā.  // ApTha_39,387.12 //  
Tato māṇavakā sabbe bhikkhamānā kulākule[^299-15] /  
mahājanassa ahaṃsu: *kāma*bhogī[^299-14] ayaṃ isi.  // ApTha_39,387.13 //


<!-- PTS Page 300 -->
<a id="page-300"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 300]*

Tena kammavipākena pañcabhikkhusatā ime /  
abbhakkhānaṃ labhuṃ sabbe Sundarīkāya kāraṇā.  // ApTha_39,387.14 //  
Dvemātā[^300-1]-bhātaro pubbe[^300-2] dhanahetu haniṃ ahaṃ[^300-3] /  
pakkhipiṃ giriduggesu silāya[^300-4] ca apiṃsayiṃ.  // ApTha_39,387.15 //  
Tena kammavipākena Devadatto silaṃ khipi /  
aṅguṭṭhaṃ piṃsayī[^300-5] pāde mama pāsānasakkharā.  // ApTha_39,387.16 //  
Pure 'haṃ dārako hutvā kīḷamāno mahāpathe /  
paccekabuddhaṃ disvāna magge sakalikaṃ dahiṃ.[^300-6]  // ApTha_39,387.17 //  
Tena kammavipākena idha pacchimake bhave /  
vadhatthaṃ maṃ Devadatto abhimāre[^300-7] payojayi.  // ApTha_39,387.18 //  
Hatthāroho pure āsiṃ paccekamunim uttamaṃ /  
piṇḍāya vicarantaṃ *tam* āsādesiṃ[^300-8] gajen'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_39,387.19 //  
Tena kammavipākena bhanto[^300-9] Nāḷāgirī[^300-10] gajo /  
Giribbaje puravare[^300-11] dāruṇo mam upāgamī.[^300-12]  // ApTha_39,387.20 //  
Rājāhaṃ patthivo[^300-13] āsiṃ sattiyā purisaṃ haniṃ /  
tena kammavipākena niraye paccasiṃ[^300-14] bhusaṃ.  // ApTha_39,387.21 //  
Kammuṇo[^300-15] tassa sesena c'ādiṇṇaṃ[^300-16] sakalaṃ mama /  
pāde chaviṃ pakopesi[^300-17] na hi kammaṃ panassati.[^300-18]  // ApTha_39,387.22 //  
Ahaṃ kevaṭṭagāmasmim[^300-19] ahuṃ kevaṭṭadārako /  
macchake ghātite disvā janayiṃ somanassakaṃ.  // ApTha_39,387.23 //  
Tena kammavipākena sīsadukkham ahu mama /  
Sakkesu haññamānesu yadā hani Viḍuḍabho.[^300-20]  // ApTha_39,387.24 //  
Phussassāhaṃ[^300-21] pāvacane sāvake paribhāsayiṃ[^300-22] /  
yavaṃ khādatha bhuñjatha mā ca bhuñjatha sāliyo.  // ApTha_39,387.25 //


<!-- PTS Page 301 -->
<a id="page-301"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 301]*

Tena kammavipākena temāsaṃ khāditaṃ yavaṃ /  
nimantito brāhmaṇena verajjāyaṃ[^301-1] vasiṃ[^301-2] tadā.  // ApTha_39,387.26 //  
Nibbuddhe vattamānamhi Mallaputtaṃ nisedhayiṃ /  
tena kammavipākena piṭṭhidukkham ahu mama.[^301-3]  // ApTha_39,387.27 //  
Tikicchako aham āsiṃ seṭṭhiputtaṃ virecayiṃ /  
tena kammavipākena hoti pakkhandikā mama.  // ApTha_39,387.28 //  
Avacāhaṃ Jotipālo sugataṃ Kassapaṃ tadā: /  
kuto nu bodhi muṇḍassa bodhi paramadullabhā?  // ApTha_39,387.29 //  
Tena kammavipākena ācariṃ[^301-4] dukkaraṃ bahuṃ /  
chabbassān'; Uruvelāyaṃ tato bodhim apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_39,387.30 //  
Nāhaṃ etena[^301-5] maggena pāpuṇiṃ bodhim uttamaṃ /  
kummaggena[^301-6] gavesissaṃ pubbakammena kārito.  // ApTha_39,387.31 //  
Puññapāpaparikhīṇo sabbasantāpavajjito /  
asoko anupāyāso nibbāyissam anāsavo.';  // ApTha_39,387.32 //  
Evaṃ jino viyākāsi bhikkhusaṅghassa aggato  // ApTha_39,387.33 //  
sabbābhiññābalappatto Anotatte mahāsare ti. Itthaṃ sudaṃ bhagavā attano pubbacaritaṃ Pubbakammapiloti nāma Buddhāpadānaṃ dhammapariyāyam abhāsi.[^301-7] Pubbakammapiloti nāma Buddhāpadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Avaṇṭaṃ Labujañ c'; eva Udumbara Pilakkhu[^301-8] ca Phāru-Vallī[^301-9] ca Kadalī[^301-10] Panasa[^301-11]-Koṭivīsako. Pubbakammapiloti ca apadānaṃ mahesino gāthāyo ekanavuti gaṇitāyo vibhāvihī.[^301-12] Avaṇṭaphalavaggo ekūnacattāriṃso.[^301-13]

##### *[PTS Page 302]*

[388. Pilindavaccha.] Nagare Haṃsavatiyā āsiṃ dovāriko ahaṃ /  
akkhobhaṃ[^302-1] amitabhogaṃ[^302-2] ghare sannicitaṃ mamaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.1 //  
Rahogato nisīditvā sampahaṃsitvā[^302-3] mānasaṃ /  
nisajja pāsādavare evaṃ cintes'; ahan tadā:  // ApTha_40,388.2 //  
Bahū me 'dhigatā[^302-4] bhogā: phītam[^302-5] antepuraṃ mama /  
rājāpi[^302-6] sannimantesi Ānando puthuvissaro.[^302-7]  // ApTha_40,388.3 //  
Ayañ ca Buddho uppanno adhiccuppattiko[^302-8] muni /  
saṃvijjanti ca me bhogā; dānaṃ dassāmi satthuno.  // ApTha_40,388.4 //  
Padume[^302-9] rājaputtena dinnaṃ dānaṃ varaṃ[^302-10] jine /  
hatthināge ca pallaṅke appassenañ c'; anappakaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.5 //  
Aham pi dānaṃ dassāmi saṅghe guṇavaruttame /  
adinnapubbaṃ dānavaraṃ bhavissam ādikammiko.  // ApTha_40,388.6 //  
Cintetvāhaṃ bahuvidhaṃ yāge yassa sukhaṃ phalaṃ /  
parikkhāradānam addakkhiṃ mama saṅkappapūraṇaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.7 //  
Parikkhārāna[^302-11] dassāmi saṅghe guṇavaruttame /  
adinnapubbam aññesaṃ bhavissam ādikammiko.  // ApTha_40,388.8 //  
Naḷakāre[^302-12] upāgamma chattaṃ kāresiṃ tāvade /  
chattasatasahassāni ekato sannipātayiṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.9 //  
Dussasatasahassāni ekato sannipātayiṃ /  
vāsiyo satthake[^302-13] cāpi sūciyo nakhacchedane.  // ApTha_40,388.10 //  
Heṭṭhā chatte laggāpesiṃ[^302-14] kāretvā tadanucchave /  
vidhūpane tālavaṇṭe morahatthe ca cāmare.  // ApTha_40,388.11 //  
Parissāvane teladhāre kārayiṃ tadanuccha*ve /  
sūcighare aṃsabaddhe[^302-15] atho* pi kāyabandhane.  // ApTha_40,388.12 //  
Ādhārake ca sukate kārayiṃ tadanucchave /  
paribhogabhājane ca atho pi lohathālake.  // ApTha_40,388.13 //


<!-- PTS Page 303 -->
<a id="page-303"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 303]*

Bhesajjaṃ[^303-1] pūrayitvāna heṭṭhā chatte ṭhapes'; ahaṃ /  
vacam usīram laṭṭhimadhuṃ pipphalī maricāni ca  // ApTha_40,388.14 //  
Harī*ṭakiṃ siṅgiveraṃ sabbaṃ pūresi bhājane* /  
upāhanā[^303-2] pādukāyo atho udakapuñchane.[^303-3]  // ApTha_40,388.15 //  
Kattaradaṇḍe sukate kārayiṃ tadanucchave /  
osadhaṃ jananāliṃ ca salākā dhammakuttarā.  // ApTha_40,388.16 //  
Kuñcikā pañcavaṇṇehi sibbite kuñcikāghare /  
āyoge[^303-4] dhūmanette ca atho pi dīpadhārake.[^303-5]  // ApTha_40,388.17 //  
Tumbake ca karaṇḍe ca kārayiṃ tadanucchave /  
saṇḍāse pipphale c'; eva atho pi malahārake.[^303-6]  // ApTha_40,388.18 //  
Bhesajjathavike c'; eva kārayiṃ tadanucchave /  
āsandiyo pīṭhake[^303-7] ca pallaṅke caturomaye  // ApTha_40,388.19 //  
tadanucchave kāretvā heṭṭhā chatte ṭhapes'; ahaṃ. /  
Unnābhisī tūlabhisī atho pi pīṭhikābhisī[^303-8]  // ApTha_40,388.20 //  
bimbohane ca sukate kārayiṃ tadanucchave /  
kuruvinde madhusitthe[^303-9] telahatthappatāpakaṃ[^303-10]  // ApTha_40,388.21 //  
Sipāṭiphalake sucī[^303-11] mañcam attharaṇena[^303-12] ca /  
senāsane pādapuñche[^303-13] sayanāsanadaṇḍake.  // ApTha_40,388.22 //  
Dantapoṇe ca pāṭalī[^303-14] sīsālepanagandhake /  
araṇī palālapīṭhe[^303-15] ca pattapidhānadhārake.[^303-16]  // ApTha_40,388.23 //  
Udakassa katacchuñ ca cuṇṇakam rajanammanaṃ[^303-17] /  
sammajjanaṃ uda vatthaṃ[^303-18] tathā vassikasāṭakaṃ  // ApTha_40,388.24 //  
nisīdanaṃ kaṇḍucchādi atha antaravāsakaṃ /  
uttarāsaṅghasaṅghāṭiṃ[^303-19] natthukaṃ mukhasodhanaṃ  // ApTha_40,388.25 //  
bilaṅgaloṇaṃ bhūtaṃ[^303-20] ca madhuñ ca dadhipānakaṃ /  
pupphaṃ sitthaṃ[^303-21] pilotiñ ca mukhapuñchanasuttakaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.26 //  
Dātabbaṃ nāma yam atthi yañ ca kappati satthuno /  
sabbam etam samānetvā Ānandam upasaṅkamiṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.27 //


<!-- PTS Page 304 -->
<a id="page-304"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 304]*

Upasaṅkamma rājānaṃ janetāraṃ mahāyasaṃ[^304-1] /  
sirasā abhivādetvā imaṃ[^304-2] vacanam abraviṃ:  // ApTha_40,388.28 //  
Ekato jātasaṃvaddhā ubhinnam ekato yasaṃ[^304-3] /  
sādhāraṇā sukkhadukkhe ubho ca anuvattakā.  // ApTha_40,388.29 //  
Atthi cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ tavāddheyyam arindama /  
yadi sakkosi naṃ dukkhaṃ vinodeyyāsi khattiya.  // ApTha_40,388.30 //  
Tava dukkhaṃ mama dukkham ubhinnam ekato manaṃ /  
niṭṭhitan ti vijānāhi[^304-4] mamādheyyaṃ sace tuvaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.31 //  
Jānāhi kho mahārāja dukkhaṃ me dubbinodayaṃ /  
bahussamāno[^304-5] gajjassu[^304-6] etaṃ te[^304-7] duccajjaṃ dhanaṃ.[^304-8]  // ApTha_40,388.32 //  
Yāvatā vijitaṃ[^304-9] atthi yāvatā mama jīvitaṃ /  
etehi yadi te attho dassāmi avikampito.  // ApTha_40,388.33 //  
Gajjitaṃ kho tayā deva micchā taṃ[^304-10] bahugajjitaṃ /  
jānissāmi tavaṃ[^304-11] ajja sabbadhamme patiṭṭhitaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.34 //  
Atibāḷhaṃ nipīḷesi dadamānassa me sato /  
kin te palapite n'; attho[^304-12]; patthitaṃ te[^304-13] kathehi me.  // ApTha_40,388.35 //  
Icchām'; ahaṃ mahārāja Buddhaseṭṭham anuttaraṃ /  
bhojayissāmi sambuddhaṃ vajjaṃ me p'; āhu jīvitaṃ.[^304-14]  // ApTha_40,388.36 //  
Aññam te 'haṃ varaṃ dammi; ayācittho[^304-15] Tathāgataṃ[^304-16] /  
adeyyo kassaci Buddho maṇijotiraso yathā.  // ApTha_40,388.37 //  
Nanu te gajjitaṃ deva yāvajīvitam atthikaṃ[^304-17] /  
jivitaṃ[^304-18] dadamānena yuttaṃ dātuṃ[^304-19] Tathāgataṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.38 //  
Ṭhapanīyo mahāvīro adeyyo kassaci jino /  
na me *paṭissuto* Buddho varassu amitaṃ dhanaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.39 //  
Vinicchayam pāpuṇāma pucchissāma vinicchaye /  
yathāsaṇhaṃ kathessanti[^304-20] paṭipucchāma taṃ tathā.  // ApTha_40,388.40 //  
Rañño hatthe gahetvāna agamāsiṃ vinicchayaṃ /  
purato akkhadassānam idaṃ vacanam abraviṃ:  // ApTha_40,388.41 //


<!-- PTS Page 305 -->
<a id="page-305"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 305]*

Sunaṇtu me akkhadassā rājā varam adāsi me /  
na kiñci ṭhapayitvāna jīvitam pi pavārayi.[^305-1]  // ApTha_40,388.42 //  
Tassa me varadinnassa Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ varim ahaṃ /  
sudinno hoti me Buddho athavā[^305-2] saṃsayaṃ mama.[^305-3]  // ApTha_40,388.43 //  
Sussāma tava vacanaṃ bhūmipālassa rājino /  
ubhinnaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā chindissām'[^305-4] ettha saṃsayaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.44 //  
Sabbaṃ deva tayā dinnaṃ imassa sabbagāhikaṃ[^305-5] /  
na kiñci ṭhapayitvāna jīvitam pi pavārayi?  // ApTha_40,388.45 //  
Kicchapatto va hutvāna yācī varam anuttaraṃ[^305-6] /  
imaṃ sudukkhitaṃ ñatvā adāsiṃ sabbagāhikaṃ.[^305-7]  // ApTha_40,388.46 //  
Parājayo tavaṃ[^305-8] deva assa deyyo Tathāgato /  
ubhinnaṃ saṃsayo chinno yathāsaṇṭhamhi tiṭṭhatha.  // ApTha_40,388.47 //  
Rājā tatth'; eva ṭhatvāna akkhadasse tad abravi: /  
sammā mayhaṃ pi deyyātha[^305-9] puna Buddhaṃ labhām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.48 //  
Pūretvā tava saṅkappaṃ bhojayitvā Tathāgataṃ /  
puna deyyāsi[^305-10] sambuddham Ānandassa yasassino.  // ApTha_40,388.49 //  
Akkhadasse 'bhivādetvā Ānandañ cāpi khattiyaṃ /  
tuṭṭho pamudito hutvā sambuddham upasaṅkamiṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.50 //  
Upasaṅkamma sambuddham oghatiṇṇam anāsavaṃ /  
sirasā abhivādetvā idaṃ vacanam abraviṃ:  // ApTha_40,388.51 //  
‘Vasīsatasahassehi adhivāsehi cakkhumā[^305-11] /  
hāsayanto[^305-12] mamaṃ cittaṃ nivesanam upehi me.';  // ApTha_40,388.52 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
mama saṅkappam aññāya adhivāsesi cakkhumā.  // ApTha_40,388.53 //  
Adhivāsanam aññāya abhivādiya satthuno /  
haṭṭho udaggacitto 'haṃ nivesanam upāgamiṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.54 //  
Mittāmacce samānetvā idaṃ vacanam abraviṃ: /  
sudullabho mayā laddho maṇijotiraso yathā.  // ApTha_40,388.55 //  
Kena taṃ pūjayisāma[^305-13]? appameyyo anupamo /  
atulo asamo vīro[^305-14] jino appaṭipuggalo.  // ApTha_40,388.56 //  
Tathā samasamo c'; eva adutiyo[^305-15] narāsabho /  
dukkaram adhikāram hi Buddhānucchavikaṃ tayā.[^305-16]  // ApTha_40,388.57 //


<!-- PTS Page 306 -->
<a id="page-306"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 306]*

Nānāpupphe samānetvā karoma pupphamaṇḍapaṃ /  
Buddhānucchavikaṃ etaṃ sabbapūjā bhavissati.  // ApTha_40,388.58 //  
Uppalaṃ padumañ cāpi vassikam atimuttakaṃ[^306-1] /  
campakaṃ nāgap*upphañ ca ma*ṇḍapaṃ kārayim ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.59 //  
Satāsanasahassāni[^306-2] chattacchāyāya paññapiṃ[^306-3] /  
pacchimam āsanaṃ mayham adhikaṃ satam agghati[^306-4]  // ApTha_40,388.60 //  
Satāsanasahassāni . . . pe . . . /  
paṭiyādetvā annapānaṃ kālam arocayiṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.61 //  
*Ārocitamhi kālamhi* Padumuttaro mahāmuni /  
vasīsatasahassehi nivesanam upesi me.  // ApTha_40,388.62 //  
Dhārentam uparicchattaṃ suphullapupphamaṇḍape /  
vasīsatasahassehi nisīdi purisuttamo.  // ApTha_40,388.63 //  
Chattasatasahassāni satasahassa-m-āsanaṃ[^306-5] /  
ka*ppiyam anavajjañ ca paṭiga*ṇhāhi cakkhumā.  // ApTha_40,388.64 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
maman tāretukāmo so sampaṭicchi mahāmuni.  // ApTha_40,388.65 //  
Bhikkhussa[^306-6] ekam ekassa paccekaṃ patt'; adās'; ahaṃ /  
jahiṃsu pupphakaṃ[^306-8] pattaṃ lohaṃ pattam adhārayuṃ.[^306-9]  // ApTha_40,388.66 //  
Sattarattindivaṃ *Buddho ni*sīdi pupphamaṇḍape /  
bodhayanto bahu satte dhammacakkaṃ pavattayi.[^306-10]  // ApTha_40,388.67 //  
Dhammacakkaṃ pavattento heṭṭhato pupphamaṇḍape /  
cullāsītisahassānaṃ[^306-11] dhammābhisamayo ahu.  // ApTha_40,388.68 //  
Sattame divase patte Padumuttaro mahāmunī /  
chattacchāyāya*m āsī*no imā gāthā abhāsathā:  // ApTha_40,388.69 //  
Anūnakaṃ dānavaraṃ yo me pādāsi māṇavo /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_40,388.70 //  
Hatthī assā rathā pattī senā ca caturaṅginī /  
parivāressanti taṃ niccaṃ sabbadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.71 //  
Hatthiyānam assayānaṃ sivikaṃ sandamānikaṃ[^306-12] /  
upaṭṭhissant'; imaṃ niccaṃ sabbadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.72 //  
Saṭṭhirathasahassāni sabbālaṅkārabhūsitā /  
parivāressant'; imaṃ niccaṃ sabbadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.73 //


<!-- PTS Page 307 -->
<a id="page-307"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 307]*

Saṭṭhituriyasahassāni bheriyo samalaṅkatā /  
vajjayissant'; imaṃ niccaṃ sabbadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.74 //  
Chalāsītisahassāni nāriyo samalaṅkatā /  
vicittavatthābharaṇā āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā.  // ApTha_40,388.75 //  
Aḷārapamhāhasulā[^307-1] susoññā tanumajjhimā /  
parivāressant'; imaṃ niccaṃ sabbadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.76 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassāni devaloke ramissati /  
sahassakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjaṃ karissati.  // ApTha_40,388.77 //  
Sahassakkhattuṃ rājā *ca* cakkavattī bhavissati /  
padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto[^307-2] asaṅkhiyaṃ.[^307-3]  // ApTha_40,388.78 //  
Devaloke vasantassa puññakammasamaṅgino /  
devalokānupariyante ratanachattaṃ dharissati.[^307-4]  // ApTha_40,388.79 //  
Icchissati yadā cāyaṃ chadanaṃ dussapupphajaṃ /  
imassa cittam aññāya nibaddhaṃ[^307-5] chādayissati.  // ApTha_40,388.80 //  
Devalokā cavitvāna sukkamūlena codito /  
puññakammena saṃyutto brahmabandhu bhavissati.  // ApTha_40,388.81 //  
Kappasatasahassamhi[^307-6] Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma gottena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_40,388.82 //  
Sabbam etam abhiññāya Gotamo Sakyapuṅgavo /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā etadagge ṭhapessati.  // ApTha_40,388.83 //  
Pilindavaccho[^307-7] nām*ena* hessati satthu sāvako /  
devānam asurānañ ca gandhabbānañ ca sakkato.  // ApTha_40,388.84 //  
Bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnañ ca gihīnañ ca tath'; eva so /  
piyo hutvāna sabbesaṃ viharissat'; anāsavo.[^307-8]  // ApTha_40,388.85 //  
Satasahasse kataṃ kammaṃ phalaṃ dassesi me idha /  
sumutto saravego ca[^307-9] kilese jhāpayissati.  // ApTha_40,388.86 //  
Aho me sukataṃ kammaṃ puññakkhette anuttare /  
yatthakāraṃ karitvāna patto 'mhi acalaṃ[^307-10] padaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.87 //  
Anūnakaṃ[^307-11] dānavaram adāsi yo hi māṇavo /  
ādipubbaṅgamo āsiṃ[^307-12] tassa dānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.88 //  
Chatte sugate datvāna saṅghe {guṇavaruttame}[^307-13] /  
aṭṭhānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike[^307-14] mama.  // ApTha_40,388.89 //


<!-- PTS Page 308 -->
<a id="page-308"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 308]*

Sītaṃ uṇhaṃ na jānāmi rajojallaṃ na lippati[^308-1] /  
anupaddavo anītī[^308-2] ca homi apacito sadā.[^308-3]  // ApTha_40,388.90 //  
Sukhumacchaviko homi visadaṃ hoti[^308-4] mānasaṃ /  
chattasatasahassāni bhave saṃsarato mama.  // ApTha_40,388.91 //  
Sabbālaṅkārayuttāni tassa kammassa vāhasā /  
idaṃ jātiṃ ṭhapetvāna matthake dhārayanti me.  // ApTha_40,388.92 //  
Tasmā[^308-5] imāya jātiyā n'; atthi me chattadhāraṇā /  
mama sabbaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ vimutticchattapattiyā.[^308-6]  // ApTha_40,388.93 //  
Dussāni sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame[^308-7] /  
aṭṭhānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama.  // ApTha_40,388.94 //  
Suvaṇṇavaṇṇo virajo sappabhāso[^308-8] patāpavā[^308-9] /  
siniddhaṃ hoti me gattaṃ bhave saṃsarato mamaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.95 //  
Dussasatasahassāni setā pītā ca lohitā /  
dhārenti matthake mayhaṃ dussadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.96 //  
Koseyyakambalīyāni khomakappāsikāni ca /  
sabbattha paṭilābhāmi tesaṃ nissandato ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.97 //  
Patte sugate datvāna saṅghe guṇavaruttame[^308-7] /  
dasānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike[^308-10] mama.  // ApTha_40,388.98 //  
Suvaṇṇathāle maṇithāle rajate[^308-11] pi ca thālake[^308-12] /  
lohitaṅkamaye thāle paribhuñjāmi sabbadā.  // ApTha_40,388.99 //  
Anupaddavo anītī ca homi apacito sadā /  
lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa sayanassa ca.  // ApTha_40,388.100 //  
Na vinassanti me bhogā; ṭhitacitto[^308-13] bhavām'; ahaṃ /  
dhammakāmo sadā bhomi 'ppakileso[^308-14] anāsavo.  // ApTha_40,388.101 //  
Devaloke manusse vā anubaddhā[^308-15] ime guṇā /  
chāyā yathāpi rukkhassa sabbattha na jahanti maṃ  // ApTha_40,388.102 //  
Cittabandhanasambaddhā[^308-16] sukatā vāsiyo bahū /  
datvāna Buddhaseṭṭhassa saṅghassa ca tath'; ev'; ahaṃ /  
aṭṭhānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama.  // ApTha_40,388.103 //


<!-- PTS Page 309 -->

##### *[PTS Page 309]*

Sūro homi visālī[^309-1] ca vesārajjesu pāramī /  
dhitiviriyavā homi paggahītamano sadā.  // ApTha_40,388.104 //  
Kilesacchedanaṃ ñāṇam sukhumam atulaṃ suciṃ /  
sabbattha paṭilābhāmi tassa[^309-2] nissandato mama.  // ApTha_40,388.105 //  
Aka*kkase apha*ruse adhote satthake[^309-3] bahū /  
pasannacitto datvāna Buddhasaṅghe tath'; eva ca /  
pañcānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama.  // ApTha_40,388.106 //  
Kalyāṇacittaṃ[^309-4] viriyaṃ khantiñ ca mettasatthakaṃ[^309-5] /  
taṇhāsallassa chinnattā[^309-6] pañ*ñāsattham anuttaraṃ /  
vaji*rena samaṃ ñāṇaṃ tesaṃ nissandato labhe.  // ApTha_40,388.107 //  
Sūciyo sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame[^309-7] /  
pañcānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama.  // ApTha_40,388.108 //  
Namassiyo[^309-8] kaṅkhachedo abhirūpo ca bhogavā[^309-9] /  
tikkhapañño *sadā homi saṃsaranto bhavābhave.*  // ApTha_40,388.109 //  
Gambhīraṃ nipuṇaṃ ṭhānam attha-ñāṇena[^309-10] passayiṃ[^309-11] /  
vajiraggasamaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti me tamaghāṭanaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.110 //  
Nakhacchedane sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame[^309-7] /  
pañcānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mamaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.111 //  
Dāsidāse gavasse[^309-12] ca bhata*ke ārakkhe[^309-13] bahū* /  
nahāpite[^309-14] bhatake[^309-15] sūde[^309-16] sabbatth'; eva labhām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.112 //  
Vidhūpane sugate datvā tālavaṇṭe ca sobhane /  
aṭṭhānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama.  // ApTha_40,388.113 //  
Sītam uṇhaṃ na jānāmi pariḷāho na vijjati /  
darathaṃ nābhijānāmi cittasantāpanaṃ mama.  // ApTha_40,388.114 //  
*Rāgaggi do*samohaggi mānaggi diṭṭhiaggi ca /  
sabbaggī[^309-17] nibbutā mayhaṃ tassa nissandato mamaṃ.[^309-18]  // ApTha_40,388.115 //  
Morahatthe cāmariyo datvā saṅghe gaṇuttame /  
upasantakileso 'haṃ viharāmi anaṅgaṇo.  // ApTha_40,388.116 //

##### *[PTS Page 310]*

Parissāvane sugate datvā saṅghe gaṇuttame[^310-1] /  
pañcānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mamaṃ.[^310-2]  // ApTha_40,388.117 //  
Sabbesaṃ samatikkamma[^310-3] dibbam āyuṃ[^310-4] labhām'; ahaṃ /  
appasayho sadā homi corapaccatthikehi[^310-5] vā.  // ApTha_40,388.118 //  
Satthena vā visena vā vihesam pi na kubbate /  
antarāmāraṇaṃ[^310-6] n'; atthi tesaṃ nissandato mamaṃ.[^310-2]  // ApTha_40,388.119 //  
Teladhāre sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame[^310-7] /  
pañcānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mamaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.120 //

tīṇānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mamaṃ.[^310-2]  // ApTha_40,388.122 //  
Cetosukhaṃ kāyasukham iriyāpathajaṃ sukhaṃ /

Aṃsabaddhe[^310-9] jine datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame[^310-7] /  
tīṇānisaṃse anubhomi kammānucchavike mama.  // ApTha_40,388.124 //  
Saddhamme gādhaṃ vindāmi[^310-10] sarāmi dutiyaṃ bhavaṃ[^310-11] /  
sabbattha succhavī[^310-12] homi tassa nissandato ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.125 //  
Kāyabandhe[^310-13] sugate[^310-14] datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame[^310-7] /  
chānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,388.126 //  
Samādhisu na kaṅkhāmi[^310-15] vasī homi samādhisu /

Upaṭṭhitasatī homi tāso mayhaṃ na vijjati /

Ādhārake jine datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame /

Ye keci me sutā dhammā satiñāṇappabodhanā /  
*va*tā[^311-1] me na vinassanti bhavanti suvinicchitā.  // ApTha_40,388.130 //  
Bhājane paribhoge ca datvā Buddhegaṇuttame /

Sovaṇṇamaye maṇimaye atho pi phalikāmaye /  
lohitaṅkamaye c'; eva labhāmi bhājane ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.132 //  
Bhariyā dāsadāsī ca hatthassarathapattike[^311-2] /  
itthī patibbatā c'; eva paribhogādisampadā.[^311-3]  // ApTha_40,388.133 //  
Vijjā mantapade c'; eva vividhe āgame bahū /

lohitaṅkamaye c'; eva labhāmi thālake ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,388.136 //

Vatte[^311-10] guṇe paṭilabhe[^311-11] ācārakiriyāsu ca /

Bhesajje[^311-12] sugate datvā saṅghe guṇavaruttame[^311-7] /

Na me piyaviyog'; atthi tassa nissandato mama.  // ApTha_40,388.140 //

tīṇānisaṃse anubhomi . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,388.141 //

saṭṭhiṃ satasahassāni[^311-16] parivārenti maṃ sadā.  // ApTha_40,388.142 //

Paṭisallāṇagarukā appasaddā durāsadā /  
durūpasaṅkamā Buddhā garū honti sadevake.  // ApTha_40,389.63 //  
Yāvāhaṃ[^320-17] pañhaṃ pucchāmi paṭisammodiyāmi vā[^320-18] /  
appasaddā tadā[^320-19] hotha munibhūtā va tiṭṭhatha[^320-20]  // ApTha_40,389.64 //


<!-- PTS Page 321 -->
<a id="page-321"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 321]*

Yaṃ so desesi saddhammaṃ khemaṃ nibbānapattiyā /  
tam ev'; atthaṃ nisāmetha saddhammasavanaṃ sukhaṃ.[^321-1]  // ApTha_40,389.65 //  
Upasaṅkamma sambuddhaṃ sammodiṃ[^321-2] muninā ahaṃ /  
taṃ kathaṃ vītisāretvā lakkhaṇe upadhārayiṃ.  // ApTha_40,389.66 //  
Lakkhaṇe dve va[^321-3] kaṅkhāmi passāmi tiṃsalakkhaṇe /  
kosohitaṃ vatthaguyham itthiyā[^321-4] dassayi muni.  // ApTha_40,389.67 //  
Jīvhaṃ ninnāmayitvā ca kaṇṇasote ca nāsike /  
paṭimasanalāṭan taṃ[^321-5] kevalaṃ chādayī jino.  // ApTha_40,389.68 //  
Tassāhaṃ lakkhaṇe disvā paripuṇṇe savyañjane /  
Buddho ti niṭṭhaṃ gantvāna saha sissehi pabbajiṃ.[^321-6]  // ApTha_40,389.69 //  
Satehi tīhi sahito pabbajim anagāriyaṃ /  
aṭṭhamāse asampatte sabbe patt'; amha nibbutiṃ.  // ApTha_40,389.70 //  
Ekato kammaṃ katvāna puññakkhette anuttare /  
ekato saṃsaritvāna ekato vinivaṭṭayuṃ.  // ApTha_40,389.71 //  
Gopānasīyo datvāna pūgadhamme vasiṃ[^321-7] ahaṃ /  
tena kammena sukatena aṭṭhahetū labhām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,389.72 //  
Disāsu pūjito homi bhogā ca amitā mama /  
patiṭṭhā bhosiṃ[^321-8] sabbesaṃ tāso mama na vijjati.  // ApTha_40,389.73 //  
Vyādhiyo me na vijjanti dīghāyuṃ pālayāmi ca /  
sukhumacchaviko homi āvāse patthite vase.[^321-9]  // ApTha_40,389.74 //  
Aṭṭha gopānasī datvā pūgadhamme vasiṃ[^321-10] ahaṃ /  
paṭisambhidā 'rahattañ[^321-11] ca etaṃ me aparaṭṭhamaṃ.[^321-12]  // ApTha_40,389.75 //  
Sabbavosita vosāno katakicco anāsavo /  
Aṭṭhagopānasī nāma tava putto mahāmuni.  // ApTha_40,389.76 //  
Pañca thambhāni datvāna pūgadhamme[^321-13] vasiṃ ahaṃ /  
tena kammena sukatena pañcahetū labhām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,389.77 //  
Acalo homi mettāya anūnabhogavā-m-ahaṃ[^321-14] /  
ādeyyavacano homi na dhaṃsemi yathā ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,389.78 //  
Abhantaṃ hoti me cittam acalo[^321-15] homi kassaci /  
tena kammena sukatena vimalo homi[^321-16] sāsane.  // ApTha_40,389.79 //

Sagāravo sappaṭisso katakicco anāsavo /  
sāvako te mahāvīra bhikkhu taṃ vandate mune.[^322-1]  // ApTha_40,389.80 //  
Katvā sukatapallaṅkaṃ sālāyaṃ paññapes'[^322-2] ahaṃ /  
tena kammena sukatena pañca hetū labhām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,389.81 //  
Ucce kule pajāyāmi mahābhogo bhavām'; ahaṃ /  
sabbasampattiko homi maccheraṃ me na vijjati.  // ApTha_40,389.82 //  
Gamane patthite mayhaṃ pallaṅko upatiṭṭhati /  
saha pallaṅkaseṭṭhena gacchāmi mama patthitaṃ.  // ApTha_40,389.83 //  
Tena pallaṅkadānena tamaṃ sabbaṃ vinodayiṃ /  
*sabbābhiññā-balappatto* thero vandati taṃ mune.  // ApTha_40,389.84 //  
Parakiccattakiccāni[^322-3] sabbakiccāni sādhayiṃ /  
tena kammena sukatena pāvisim abhayaṃ puraṃ.  // ApTha_40,389.85 //  
Pariniṭṭhitasālam pi paribhogam adās'; ahaṃ /  
tena kammena sukatena seṭṭhan tam[^322-4] ajjhupāgato.[^322-5]  // ApTha_40,389.86 //  
Ye keci damakā loke hatthī asse damenti 'me[^322-6] /  
karetvā[^322-7] kāraṇā[^322-8] nānā dārune na damenti te.  // ApTha_40,389.87 //  
Na heva[^322-9] tvaṃ mahāvīra damesi[^322-10] naranāriyo /  
adaṇḍena asatthena damesi *uttame dame.*  // ApTha_40,389.88 //  
*Dāna*ssa vaṇṇaṃ[^322-11] kittento desanākusalo muni /  
ekapañhe kathento va[^322-12] mocesi[^322-13] tisate muni.  // ApTha_40,389.89 //  
Dantā mayaṃ sārathinā suvimuttā anāsavā /  
sabbābhiññā-balappattā nibbutā upadhikkhaye.  // ApTha_40,389.90 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā /  
atikkantā bhayā sabbe sāladānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,389.91 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,389.92 //

[390. Sabbakittika.] Kanikāraṃ va jalitaṃ dīparukkhaṃ[^323-1] va jotitaṃ /  
osadhiṃ va virocantaṃ vijjuṃ[^323-2] abbhaghane[^323-3] yathā  // ApTha_40,390.1 //  
Asambhītam anuttāsiṃ[^323-4] migarājaṃ va kesariṃ /  
ñāṇālokaṃ pakāsentaṃ maddantaṃ titthiye gaṇe  // ApTha_40,390.2 //  
Uddharantam imaṃ lokaṃ chindantaṃ sabbasaṃsayaṃ /  
lasantaṃ[^323-5] migarājaṃ va addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_40,390.3 //  
Jaṭājinadharo[^323-6] āsiṃ brahā[^323-7] uju[^323-8] patāpavā /  
*vā*kacīraṃ gahetvāna pādamūle apatthariṃ.[^323-9]  // ApTha_40,390.4 //  
Kāḷānusārikaṃ gayha anulimpin[^323-10] Tathāgataṃ /  
sambuddham anulimpitvā santhaviṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_40,390.5 //  
Samuddharas'; imaṃ[^323-11] lokam oghatiṇṇa mahāmuni[^323-12] /  
ñāṇālokena jotesi vajirañāṇam[^323-13] uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_40,390.6 //  
Dhammacakkaṃ[^323-14] pavattesi maddase[^323-15] paratitthiye /  
usabho jitasaṅgāme[^323-16] sampakampesi mediniṃ.  // ApTha_40,390.7 //  
Mahāsamudde ūmī va[^323-17] velantamhi pabhijjare[^323-18] /  
tath'; eva tava ñāṇamhi sabbā diṭṭhī pabhijjare.[^323-19]  // ApTha_40,390.8 //  
Sukhumacchikajāle va saramhi sampatānite[^323-20] /  
antojāligatā pāṇā pīḷitā honti tāvade.  // ApTha_40,390.9 //  
Tath'; eva titthiyā loke phuṭā saccavinissitā[^323-21] /  
anto ñāṇavare tuyhaṃ parivattanti mārisa.  // ApTha_40,390.10 //  
Patiṭṭhā vuyhataṃ oghe tvam hi nātho abandhanaṃ /  
bhayāṭṭitānaṃ saraṇo muttatthīnaṃ parāyano.  // ApTha_40,390.11 //  
Ekavīro asadiso mettākāruṇādisañcayo /  
susīlo asamo santo vasitavijitañjayo.[^323-22]  // ApTha_40,390.12 //


<!-- PTS Page 324 -->
<a id="page-324"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 324]*

Dhīro vigatasammoho[^324-1] anejo akathaṃ kathī /  
vusito[^324-2] vantadoso 'si nimmalo payato suci.  // ApTha_40,390.13 //  
Saṅgh'; ātīto[^324-3] gatamado tevijjo tibhavantago /  
sīmātigo dhammagarū katattho[^324-4] hitadhammato.[^324-5]  // ApTha_40,390.14 //  
Tārako tvaṃ yāthā nāvā[^324-6] nidhi v'; assāsakārako[^324-7] /  
asambhīto yathā sīho gajarājā[^324-8] va dammito.  // ApTha_40,390.15 //  
Thometvā dasagāthāhi Padumuttaraṃ mahāyasaṃ /  
vanditvā satthuno pāde tuṇhī aṭṭhās'; ahaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_40,390.16 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
bhikkhusaṅghe ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_40,390.17 //  
Yo me sīlañ ca ñāṇañ ca dhamman cāpi pakittayi[^324-9] /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_40,390.18 //  
Saṭṭhiṃ kappasahassāni[^324-10] devaloke ramissati /  
aññe deve adhibhotvā[^324-11] isseraṃ[^324-12] kārayissati.  // ApTha_40,390.19 //  
So pacchā pabbajitvāna sukkamūlena codito /  
Gotamassa bhagavato sāsane pabbajissati.  // ApTha_40,390.20 //  
Pabbajitvāna kāyena pāpakammaṃ vivajjiya /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.  // ApTha_40,390.21 //  
Yathāpi megho thanayaṃ[^324-13] tappeti medinim imaṃ /  
tath'; eva tvaṃ mahāvīra thanena[^324-14] tappayī[^324-15] mamaṃ.  // ApTha_40,390.22 //  
Sīlaṃ paññaṃ ca dhamman ca thavitvā lokanāyakaṃ /  
patto 'mhi paramaṃ santiṃ nibbānaṃ padaṃ accutaṃ.  // ApTha_40,390.23 //  
Api nūn'; esa[^324-16] bhagavā ciraṃ tiṭṭheyya cakkhumā /  
aññātañ ca vijāneyyaṃ[^324-17] phasseyyam[^324-18] amataṃ padaṃ.  // ApTha_40,390.24 //  
Ayaṃ me pacchimā jāti bhavā sabbe samūhatā /  
sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_40,390.25 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ Buddham abhipūjayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi kittanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,390.26 //

[391. Madhudāyaka.] *Sindhuyā nadiyā tīre sukato assamo mama /  
tassa vācem'; ahaṃ[^325-2] sisse itihāsaṃ salakkhaṇaṃ.  // ApTha_40,391.1 //  
Dhammakāmā vinītā te sotukāmā pi sāsanaṃ* /  
Chalaṅge pāramiṃ pattā Sindhukūle vasanti te.  // ApTha_40,391.2 //  
Uppādāgamane c'; eva lakkhaṇesu ca kovidā /  
uttamatthaṃ gavesantā vasanti pavane tadā.[^325-3]  // ApTha_40,391.3 //  
Sumedho nāma sambuddho loke uppajji tāvade /  
amhākam anukampanto upagacchi vināyako.  // ApTha_40,391.4 //  
Upāgataṃ mahāvīraṃ Sumedhaṃ lokanāyakaṃ /  
tiṇasantharakaṃ[^325-4] katvā lokajeṭṭhass'; adās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,391.5 //  
Pavanāto madhuṃ gayha Buddhaseṭṭhass'; adās'; ahaṃ /  
sambuddho paribh*uñjitvā idaṃ vacanam abravi:*  // ApTha_40,391.6 //  
Yan taṃ adāsi madhuṃ me pasanno sehi pānihi /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_40,391.7 //  
Iminā madhudānena tiṇasanthārakena ca /  
tiṃsakappasahassāni devaloke ramissati.  // ApTha_40,391.8 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassāni *Okkākakula*sambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā[^325-5] loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_40,391.9 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissati 'nāsavo.  // ApTha_40,391.10 //  
Devalokā idhāgantvā mātukucchim upāgato /  
madhuvasso pavassittha chādayaṃ[^325-6] madhunā mahiṃ.  // ApTha_40,391.11 //  
Mama nikkhantamattamhi[^325-7] kumbhiyā vasuduttarā[^325-8] /  
tatrāpi madhuvasso me vassate niccakālikaṃ.  // ApTha_40,391.12 //

[392. Padumakūṭāgāriya.] Piyadassī nāma bhagavā sayambhū lokanāyako /  
vivekakāmo sambuddho samādhikusalo muni.  // ApTha_40,392.1 //  
Vanasaṇḍaṃ samoggayha Piyadassī mahāmuni /  
paṃsukūlaṃ pattharitvā nisīdi purisuttamo.  // ApTha_40,392.2 //  
Migaluddo pure āsiṃ iriṇe[^326-6] kānane ahaṃ /  
pasadaṃ migam esanto[^326-7] ahiṇḍāmi ahaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_40,392.3 //  
Tatth'; addasāsiṃ sambuddham oghatiṇṇam anāsavaṃ /  
pupphitaṃ sālarājaṃ va sataraṃsīva uggataṃ.  // ApTha_40,392.4 //  
Disvān'; ahaṃ devadevaṃ Piyadassi-mahāyasaṃ[^326-8] /  
jātassaraṃ samoggayha[^326-9] padumam āhariṃ tadā.[^326-10]  // ApTha_40,392.5 //  
Āharitvāna padumaṃ satapattaṃ manoramaṃ /  
kūṭāgāraṃ karitvāna chādayiṃ padumen'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,392.6 //


<!-- PTS Page 327 -->
<a id="page-327"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 327]*

Anukampako kāruṇiko Piyadassī mahāmunī /  
sattarattindivaṃ Buddho kūṭāgāre vasī jino.  // ApTha_40,392.7 //  
Purāṇaṃ chaḍḍayitvāna navena cchādayim ahaṃ /  
añjaliṃ paggahetvāna aṭṭhāsiṃ tāvade ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,392.8 //  
Vuṭṭhahitvā samādhimhā Piyadassī mahāmuni /  
disā anuvilokento nisīdi lokanāyako.  // ApTha_40,392.9 //  
Tadā Sudassano nāma upaṭṭhāko mahiddhiko /  
cittam aññāya Buddhassa Piyadassissa satthuno  // ApTha_40,392.10 //  
Asītiyā sahassehi bhikkhūhi parivārito /  
vanante sukham āsīnam upesi lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_40,392.11 //  
Yāvatā vanasaṇḍamhi[^327-1] adhivatthā ca devatā /  
Buddhassa cittam aññāya sabbe sannipatuṃ tadā.  // ApTha_40,392.12 //  
Samāgatesu yakkhesu kumbhaṇḍe saha rakkhase /  
bhikkhusaṅghe ca sampatte gāthā m'; avyāharī jino:  // ApTha_40,392.13 //  
Yo maṃ sattāhaṃ pūjesi āvāsañ ca akāsi me /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_40,392.14 //  
Sududdasaṃ sunipuṇaṃ gambhīraṃ suppakāsitaṃ /  
ñāṇena kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_40,392.15 //  
Catuddasāni kappāni devarajjaṃ karissati /  
kūṭāgāraṃ brahan tassa padumapupphehi chāditaṃ /  
ākāse dhārayissanti pubbakammass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,392.16 //  
Catubbise kappasate vokiṇṇaṃ[^327-2] saṃsarissati /  
tattha pupphamayaṃ vyamham[^327-3] ākāse dhārayissati.  // ApTha_40,392.17 //  
Yathā padumapattamhi toyaṃ na upalippati[^327-4] /  
tath'; ev'; imassa ñāṇamhi kilesā nopalippare[^327-5] /  
manasā vinivaṭṭetvā pañcanīvaraṇe ayaṃ  // ApTha_40,392.18 //  
Cittaṃ janetvā[^327-6] nikkhamma agārā pabbajissati /  
tato pupphamayaṃ vyamhaṃ[^327-7] dhārentaṃ nikkhamissati.  // ApTha_40,392.19 //  
Rukkhamūle vasantassa nipakassa satīmato[^327-8] /  
tattha pupphamayaṃ vyamhaṃ matthake dhārayissati.  // ApTha_40,392.20 //  
Cīvaraṃ piṇḍapātañ ca paccayaṃ sayanāsanaṃ /  
daditvā bhikkhusaṅghassa nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.  // ApTha_40,392.21 //  
Kūṭāgārena caraṇā[^327-9] pabbajjaṃ abhinikkhamiṃ[^327-10] /  
rukkhamūle vasantamhi[^327-11] kūṭāgāraṃ dhariyyati.[^327-12]  // ApTha_40,392.22 //

Cīvare piṇḍapāte[^328-1] ca cetanā me na vijjati /

Gaṇanāto asaṅkheyyā kappakoṭī[^328-2] bahū mama /

Aṭṭhārase kappasate yaṃ Buddham abhipūjayiṃ /

[393. Bakkula.] *Himavantass'* avidūre Sobhito nāma pabbato /  
assamo sukato mayhaṃ sakasissehi māpito.  // ApTha_40,393.1 //  
Maṇḍapā ca bahū tatthā pupphitā sindhuvāritā[^328-6] /  
kapiṭṭhaṃ ca bahuṃ[^328-7] tatthā[^328-8] pupphitā jīvajīvakā.[^328-9]  // ApTha_40,393.2 //  
Nigguṇḍiyo[^328-10] bahū tatthā badarā malakāni *ca[^328-11] /  
Phārusakā alābū* ca puṇḍarīkā ca pupphitā.  // ApTha_40,393.3 //  
Āḷakā beluvā[^328-12] tattha kadalī mātuluṅgakā[^328-13] /  
mahānāmā bahū tattha ajjunā ca piyaṅgukā.  // ApTha_40,393.4 //


<!-- PTS Page 329 -->
<a id="page-329"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 329]*

Kosumbhā salaḷā nīpā nigrodhā ca kapitthanā[^329-1] /  
ediso assamo mayhaṃ sasisso 'haṃ tadā vasiṃ.  // ApTha_40,393.5 //  
Anomadassī bhagavā sayambhū lokanāyako /  
gavesaṃ paṭisallāṇaṃ mam assamam[^329-2] upāgami.  // ApTha_40,393.6 //  
Upetañ ca mahāvīram Anomadassi-mahāyasaṃ /  
khaṇena[^329-3] lokanāthassa vātābādho samuṭṭhahi  // ApTha_40,393.7 //  
Vicaranto araññamhi addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ /  
upagantvāna sambuddhaṃ cakkhumantam mahāyasaṃ  // ApTha_40,393.8 //  
Iriyañ cāpi disvāna upalakkhes'[^329-4] ahan tadā /  
asaṃsayaṃ hi Buddhassa vyādhino udapajjatha.  // ApTha_40,393.9 //  
Khippam assamam āgacchiṃ[^329-5] mama sissāna santike /  
bhesajjaṃ kattukāmo 'haṃ sisse āmantayiṃ[^329-6] tadā.  // ApTha_40,393.10 //  
Paṭissutvāna me vākyaṃ sissā sabbe sagāravā /  
ekajjhaṃ sannipātiṃsu[^329-7] satthu gāravatā mama.  // ApTha_40,393.11 //  
Khippaṃ pabbatam āruyha sabbosadham akās ahaṃ /  
pānīyayogaṃ katvāna Buddhaseṭṭhass'; adās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,393.12 //  
Paribhutto mahāvīro sabbaññū lokanāyako[^329-8] /  
khippaṃ vāto vūpasami sugatassa mahesino.  // ApTha_40,393.13 //  
Passaddhadarathaṃ[^329-9] disvā Anomadassī mahāyaso /  
sakāsane nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_40,393.14 //  
Yo me pādāsi bhesajjaṃ vyādhiñ ca samayī mayī[^329-10] /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_40,393.15 //  
Kappasatasahassāni devaloke ramissati /  
vādite turiye tattha modissati sadā ayaṃ.  // ApTha_40,393.16 //  
Manussalokam āgantvā sukkamūlena codito /  
sahassakkhattuṃ rājā ca cakkavattī bhavissati.  // ApTha_40,393.17 //  
Pañcapaññāsakappamhi Anoma[^329-11]-nāma khattiyo /  
cāturanto vijitāvī jambusaṇḍassa issaro.  // ApTha_40,393.18 //  
Sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo /  
Tāvatiṃse 'to[^329-12] khobhetvā[^329-13] isseraṃ[^329-14] kārayissati.  // ApTha_40,393.19 //


<!-- PTS Page 330 -->

##### *[PTS Page 330]*

Devabhūto manusso vā appābādho bhavissati /  
pariggahaṃ vivajjetvā vyādhiṃ loke tarissati.  // ApTha_40,393.20 //  
Aparimeyye ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_40,393.21 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.  // ApTha_40,393.22 //  
Kilesā jhāpayitvāna taṇhāsotaṃ[^330-1] tarissati /  
Bakkulo nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_40,393.23 //  
Idaṃ sabbam abhiññāya Gotamo Sakyapuṅgavo /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā etadagge ṭhapessati.  // ApTha_40,393.24 //  
Anomadassī bhagavā sayambhū lokanāyako /  
vivekānuvilokento mam assamam upāgamī.  // ApTha_40,393.25 //  
Upāgataṃ mahāvīraṃ sabbaññuṃ lokanāyakaṃ /  
sabbosadhena tappesiṃ[^330-2] pasanno sehi pānihi.  // ApTha_40,393.26 //  
Tassa me sukataṃ kammaṃ sukhette bījasampadā /  
khepetuṃ n'; eva sakkomi[^330-3] tadā hi sukataṃ mama.  // ApTha_40,393.27 //  
Lābhā mama suladdhaṃ me yo 'haṃ addakkhi nāyakaṃ /  
tena kammāvasesena patto 'mhi acalaṃ padaṃ  // ApTha_40,393.28 //  
Sabbam etam abhiññāya Gotamo Sakyapuṅgavo /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ.  // ApTha_40,393.29 //  
Aparimeyye ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bhesajjass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,393.30 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,393.31 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,393.32 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,393.33 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Bakkulo thero i. g. a-ti. Bakkulattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[394. Girimānanda.] Bhariyā me kālakatā putto[^330-4] sīvathikaṃ[^330-5] gato /  
mātā pitā ca bhātā ca ekacitakamhi ḍayhare.  // ApTha_40,394.1 //  
Tena sokena santatto kiso paṇḍu ahos'; ahaṃ /  
cittakkhepañ ca me āsi tena sokena cakkhumā.  // ApTha_40,394.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 331 -->
<a id="page-331"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 331]*

Sokasallapareto 'haṃ vanantam upasaṅkamiṃ /  
pavattaphalabhuñjitvā rukkhamūle vasām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,394.3 //  
Sumedho nāma sambuddho dukkhass'; antakaro[^331-1] jino /  
mam uddharitukāmo so agacchi[^331-2] mama santike.  // ApTha_40,394.4 //  
Padasaddaṃ suṇitvāna Sumedhassa mahesino /  
paggahetvāna 'haṃ sīsam ullokesi[^331-3] mahāmuni.  // ApTha_40,394.5 //  
Upagacchi[^331-4] mahāvīro pīti me udapajjatha[^331-5] /  
tadāsi me p'; aggamano[^331-6] disvā taṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_40,394.6 //  
Satiṃ paṭilabhitvāna paṇṇamuṭṭhim adās'; ahaṃ /  
nisīdi bhagavā tattha anukampāya cakkhumā.  // ApTha_40,394.7 //  
Nisajja tattha bhagavā Sumedho lokanāyako /  
dhammam me kathayī Buddho sokasallavinodanaṃ:  // ApTha_40,394.8 //  
Anavhātā[^331-7] tato āguṃ[^331-8] nānuññātā[^331-9] ito gatā[^331-10] /  
yathāgatā tathāgatā: tattha kā paridevanā?  // ApTha_40,394.9 //  
Yathāpi pathikā sattā vassamānāya vuṭṭhiyā /  
sabhaṇḍā[^331-11] upagacchanti vassass'; āpatanāya te.[^331-12]  // ApTha_40,394.10 //  
Vasse ete oramite[^331-13] sampayanti yadicchakaṃ /  
evaṃ mātā pitā tuyhaṃ: tattha kā paridevanā? [^331-14]  // ApTha_40,394.11 //  
Āgantukā pāhuṇakā caliteritakampitā[^331-15] /  
evaṃ mātā pitā tuyhaṃ: tattha kā paridevanā?  // ApTha_40,394.12 //  
Yathāpi *urago jiṇṇaṃ hitvā ga*cchati saṃ tanuṃ[^331-16] /  
evaṃ mātā pitā tuyhaṃ saṃ tanuṃ[^331-17] idha hiyyare.  // ApTha_40,394.13 //  
Buddhassa giram aññāya sokasallaṃ vivajjayiṃ[^331-18] /  
pāmujjaṃ janayitvāna Buddhasettham avandi 'haṃ.  // ApTha_40,394.14 //  
Vanditvāna mahānāgaṃ[^331-19] girapañjaliṃ[^331-20] pūjayiṃ /  
dibbagandhena sampannaṃ[^331-21] Sumedhaṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_40,394.15 //  
Pūjayitvāna sambuddhaṃ sire katvāna añjaliṃ /  
anussaraṃ guṇaggāni santhaviṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_40,394.16 //

Nitthiṇṇo 'si[^332-1] mahāvīra sabbaññū lokanāyako /  
sabbe satte[^332-2] uddharesi ñāṇena tvaṃ mahāmune.[^332-3]  // ApTha_40,394.17 //  
Vimatiṃ dveḷhakañ cāpi[^332-4] sacchindasi[^332-5] mahāmune[^332-6] /  
paṭipādesi me maggaṃ tava ñāṇena cakkhumā.  // ApTha_40,394.18 //  
Arahā siddhipattā ca chaḷabhiññā mahiddhikā /  
antalikkhe carā[^332-7] dhīrā parivārenti tāvade.  // ApTha_40,394.19 //  
Paṭipannā ca sekhā ca phalaṭṭhā santi[^332-8] sāvakā. /  
sūrodaye va padumā pupphanti tava sāvakā.  // ApTha_40,394.20 //  
Mahāsamuddo vākkhobbho[^332-9] atulo pi duruttaro[^332-10] /  
evaṃ ñāṇena sampanno[^332-11] appameyyo 'si cakkhumā.  // ApTha_40,394.21 //  
Vanditvāhaṃ lokajinaṃ cakkhumantam mahāyasaṃ /  
puthudisā namassanto paṭikuṭiko agacch'[^332-12] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,394.22 //  
Devalokā cavitvāna sampajāno paṭissato /  
okkami[^332-13] mātuyā kucchiṃ sandhāvanto[^332-14] bhavābhave.  // ApTha_40,394.23 //  
Agārā abhinikkhamma pabbajim[^332-15] anagāriyaṃ /  
ātāpī[^332-16] nipako cāpi paṭisallāṇagocaro.  // ApTha_40,394.24 //  
Padhānaṃ padahitvāna tosayitvā mahāmuniṃ /  
cando v'; abbhaghanā mutto vicarāmi ahaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_40,394.25 //  
Vivekam anuyutto 'mhi upasanto nirūpadhi /  
sabbāsave pariññāya viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_40,394.26 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassamhi yaṃ Buddham abhipūjayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,394.27 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,394.28 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,394.29 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,394.30 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Girimānando[^332-17] thero i. g. a-ti. *Girimānandattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.*

[395. Salaḷamaṇḍapiya.] Nibbute Kakusandhamhi brāhmaṇamhi vusīmati[^333-1] /

duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,395.4 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,395.5 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,395.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,395.7 //

[396. Sabbadāyaka.] Mahāsamuddam ogayha bhavanam me sunimmitaṃ /  
sunimmitā pokkharaṇī cakkavākā pakūjitā.[^333-6]  // ApTha_40,396.1 //  
Mandālakehi[^333-7] sañchannā padumupphalakehi ca /  
nadī ca sandate tattha sūpatitthā manoramā.  // ApTha_40,396.2 //  
Macchakacchapa*sañ*channā nānāmigasamotthatā[^333-8] /  
mayurakoñcā bhīrujā[^333-9] kokilādihi vagguhi.[^333-10]  // ApTha_40,396.3 //  
Pārevaṭā ravihaṃsā[^333-11] cakkavākā nadīcarā /  
dindibhā sāḷikā c'; ettha pampakā[^333-12] jīvajīvakā.  // ApTha_40,396.4 //  
Haṃsā koñcābhināditā kosikā piṅgalā bahū /  
sattaratanasampannā maṇimuttikavālukā.  // ApTha_40,396.5 //  
Sabbe sovaṇṇayā rukkhā nānāgandhā sameritā[^333-13] /  
ujjotanti[^333-14] divā rattiṃ bhavanaṃ sabbakālikaṃ.  // ApTha_40,396.6 //

##### *[PTS Page 334]*

Saṭṭhiṃ turiyasahassāni[^334-1] sāyapāto[^334-2] pavajjare[^334-3] /  
soḷasitthisahassāni parivārenti maṃ sadā.  // ApTha_40,396.7 //  
Abhinikkhamma bhavanā Sumedhaṃ lokanāyakaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano vandissan[^334-4] taṃ mahāyasaṃ.  // ApTha_40,396.8 //  
Sambuddham abhivādetvā sasissaṃ taṃ nimantayiṃ[^334-5] /  
adhivasesi so vīro[^334-6] Sumedho lokanāyako.  // ApTha_40,396.9 //  
Mamaṃ dhammakathaṃ katvā uyyojesi mahāmuni[^334-7] /  
sambuddham abhivādetvā bhavanam me upāgamiṃ.  // ApTha_40,396.10 //  
Āmantayiṃ[^334-8] parijanaṃ sabbe sannipatātha vo[^334-9] /  
pubbaṇhasamayaṃ Buddho bhavanam āgamissati.  // ApTha_40,396.11 //  
Lābhā amhaṃ[^334-10] suladdhaṃ no[^334-11] y'; esāma[^334-12] tava sa*ntike* /  
mayam pi buddhaseṭṭhassa pūjaṃ karissāma satthuno.  // ApTha_40,396.12 //  
Annaṃ pānaṃ paṭṭhapetvā kālam arocayim ahaṃ /  
vasīsatasahassehi upesi lokanāyako.  // ApTha_40,396.13 //  
Sataṅgikehi[^334-13] turiyehi paccuggaman akās'; ahaṃ /  
sabbasovaṇṇaye pīṭhe nisīdi purisuttamo.  // ApTha_40,396.14 //  
Uparicchannam akāsiṃ[^334-14] sabbasovaṇṇayaṃ tadā /  
vījanīyā[^334-15] pavāyanti bhikkhusaṅghassa antare.  // ApTha_40,396.15 //  
Bahuken'; annapānena[^334-16] bhikkhusaṅgham atappayiṃ. /  
paccekadussayugale bhikkhusaṅghass adās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,396.16 //  
Yaṃ vadanti Samedho ti lokāhutipaṭiggahaṃ /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā *imā gāthā abhāsatha:*  // ApTha_40,396.17 //  
Yo me annañ ca pānañ ca saṅgham[^334-17] etena tappayi /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_40,396.18 //  
Aṭṭhārase kappasate devaloke ramissati /  
sahassakkhattuṃ rājā ca cakkavattī bhavissati.  // ApTha_40,396.19 //  
Upapajjati yaṃ yo*niṃ devattam atha mānusaṃ /  
sabbadā* sabbasovaṇṇaṃ chadanaṃ dhārayissati.  // ApTha_40,396.20 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena[^334-18] satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_40,396.21 //

[397. Ajita.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū /  
ajjhogāhetvā Himavantaṃ nisīdi lokanāyako.  // ApTha_40,397.1 //  
Nāham addakkhiṃ sambuddhaṃ na pi saddaṃ suṇom'; ahaṃ /  
mamaṃ bhikkhaṃ gavesanto āhiṇḍāmi[^335-3] vane ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.2 //  
Tatth'; addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ dvattiṃsavaralakkhaṇaṃ /  
disvāna cittam āpajjiṃ[^335-4]: satto[^335-5] ko nām'; ayaṃ bhave?  // ApTha_40,397.3 //  
Lakkhaṇāni viloketvā mama vijjam anussariṃ /  
sutaṃ hi me taṃ Buddhānaṃ paṇḍitānaṃ subhāsitaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.4 //  
Tesaṃ tathā taṃ[^335-6] vacanam: ayaṃ Buddho bhavissati /  
yannunāhaṃ sakkareyyaṃ gatiṃ[^335-7] me sodhayissati.  // ApTha_40,397.5 //  
Khippam assamam āgantvā dumatelaṃ gahim ahaṃ /  
kolambakaṃ gahetvāna upagacchiṃ[^335-8] vināyakaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.6 //  
Tidaṇḍake gahetvāna abbhokāse ṭhapes'[^335-9] ahaṃ /  
padīpaṃ pajjaletvāna[^335-10] aṭṭhakkhattum avand'; ahaṃ.[^335-11]  // ApTha_40,397.7 //


<!-- PTS Page 336 -->

##### *[PTS Page 336]*

Sattarattindivaṃ Buddho nisīdi purisuttamo /  
tato ratyā vivasane[^336-1] vuṭṭhāsi lokanāyako.  // ApTha_40,397.8 //  
Pasannacitto sumano sabbarattindivam ahaṃ /  
dīpaṃ Buddhassa pādāsiṃ pasanno sehi pānihi.  // ApTha_40,397.9 //  
Sabbe vanā gandhamayā[^336-2] pabbate Gandhamādane /  
Buddhass'; ānubhāvena upagacchuṃ tadā jinaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.10 //  
Ye keci pupphagandhā ye[^336-3] pupphitā dharaṇīruhā /  
Buddhass'; ānubhāvena sabbe sannipatuṃ tadā.  // ApTha_40,397.11 //  
Yāvatā Himavantamhi nāgā ca garuḷā ubho /  
dhammañ va sotukāmā te[^336-4] āgacchuṃ[^336-5] Buddhasantike.  // ApTha_40,397.12 //  
Devalo nāma samaṇo Buddhassa aggasāvako /  
vasīsatasahassehi Buddhasantik'; upāgami.[^336-6]  // ApTha_40,397.13 //  
Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_40,397.14 //  
Yo me dīpaṃ padīpesi pasanno sehi pānihi /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi: suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_40,397.15 //  
Saṭṭhiṃ kappasahassāni[^336-7] devaloke ramissati /  
sahassakkhattuṃ rājā ca cakkavattī bhavissati.  // ApTha_40,397.16 //  
Chattiṃsakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjaṃ karissati /  
pathaviyaṃ[^336-8] sattasataṃ[^336-9] vipulaṃ[^336-10] rajjaṃ karissati /  
padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto[^336-11] asaṅkhiyaṃ.[^336-12]  // ApTha_40,397.17 //  
Iminā dīpadānena dibbacakkhu bhavissati /  
samantato aḍḍhakosaṃ passissati[^336-13] ayaṃ sadā.  // ApTha_40,397.18 //  
Devalokā cavantassa nibbattantassa[^336-14] jantuno /  
divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ[^336-15] padīpaṃ dhārayissati /  
jāyamānassa santassa[^336-16] puññakammasamaṅgiṇo.  // ApTha_40,397.19 //  
Yāvatā nagaram āsi tāvatā jotayissati[^336-17] /  
upapajjati yaṃ yoniṃ devattam atha mānusaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.20 //  
Ass'; eva dīpadānassa aṭṭhadīpaphalena hi[^336-18] /  
*na* jahissant'; imaṃ jantuṃ[^336-19] dīpadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.21 //


<!-- PTS Page 337 -->
<a id="page-337"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 337]*

Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_40,397.22 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.[^337-1]  // ApTha_40,397.23 //  
Tosayitvāna sambuddhaṃ Gotamaṃ Sakyapuṅgavaṃ /  
Ajito nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_40,397.24 //  
Saṭṭhiṃ kappasahassāni[^337-2] devaloke ramim ahaṃ /  
tatrāpi me dīpasataṃ[^337-3] jotare[^337-4] niccakālikaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.25 //  
Devaloke manusse vā niddhāvanti pabhā mama /  
Buddhasetthaṃ saritvāna bhiyyo bhāsaṃ[^337-5] janes'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.26 //  
Tusitāhaṃ cavitvāna okkamiṃ mātukucchiyā /  
jāyamānassa santassa[^337-6] āloko vipulo ahu.  // ApTha_40,397.27 //  
Agārā abhinikkhamma pabbajim anagāriyaṃ /  
Bāvarim[^337-7] upasaṅkamma sissattham ajjhupāgamiṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.28 //  
Himavante vasanto 'haṃ assosiṃ lokanāyakaṃ /  
uttamatthaṃ gavesanto upagacchiṃ[^337-8] vināyakaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.29 //  
Danto Buddho ca medhāvī[^337-9] oghatiṇṇo nirūpadhī /  
nibbānaṃ kathayi[^337-10] Buddho sabbadukkhappamocanaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.30 //  
Tam me āgamanaṃ siddhaṃ tosito 'haṃ mahāmuniṃ[^337-11] /  
tisso vijjā anuppattā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.31 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ dīpam adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi dīpadānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_40,397.32 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,397.33 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,397.34 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_40,397.35 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Ajito thero i. g. a-ti. *Ajitattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.* *Uddānaṃ:* Pilindavaccho Selo ca Sabbakittī Madhundado[^337-12] Kūṭāgārī Ba*kulo ca Giri*-Salaḷasavhayo.
