ito phalaṃ labhissāmi[^417-3] yo me attho samijjhatu.  // ApTha_48,476.4 //  
Anomadassī bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
pānadhim[^417-4] abhirūhitvā imaṃ vacanam abravi:  // ApTha_48,476.5 //  
Yo pānadhim me adadā pasanno sehi pāṇihi[^417-5] /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_48,476.6 //  
Buddhassa giram aññāya sabbe devā samāgatā /  
udaggacittā sumanā vedajātā katañjalī.  // ApTha_48,476.7 //  
Pānadhīnaṃ padānena[^417-6] sukhito 'yaṃ bhavissati /  
pañcapaññāsakkhattuñ ca devarajjaṃ karissati.  // ApTha_48,476.8 //  
Sahassakkhattuṃ rājā ca cakkavattī bhavissati /  
padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ.  // ApTha_48,476.9 //  
Aparimeyye ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_48,476.10 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.  // ApTha_48,476.11 //  
Devaloke manusse vā nibbattissati puññavā /  
devayānapaṭibhāgaṃ yānaṃ paṭilabhissati.  // ApTha_48,476.12 //  
Pāsādā sivikā mayhaṃ hatthino samalaṅkatā /  
rathā c'; ājañña-saṃyuttā sadā pātubhavanti me.  // ApTha_48,476.13 //  
Agārā nikkhamanto pi rathena nikkhamām'; ahaṃ /  
kesesu chijjamānesu arahattam apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_48,476.14 //  
Lābhā mayhaṃ suladdham me vānijjaṃ suppayojitaṃ /  
datvāna pānadhiṃ[^417-4] ekaṃ patto 'mhi acalaṃ padaṃ.  // ApTha_48,476.15 //  
Aparimeyy'; ito kappe yaṃ pānadhim[^417-4] adās'; ahaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pānadhissa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_48,476.16 //

[477. Pulinacaṅkamiya.] Migaluddo pure āsiṃ araññe kānane ahaṃ /  
vātamigaṃ gavesanto caṅkamaṃ addasaṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_48,477.1 //  
Ucchaṅgapulinaṃ[^418-2] gayha caṅkame okiriṃ ahaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano sugatassa sirīmato.  // ApTha_48,477.2 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe pulinaṃ okiriṃ ahaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi puḷinassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_48,477.3 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_48,477.4 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_48,477.5 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_48,477.6 //  
Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pulinacaṅkamiyo th. i. g. a-ti. Pulinacaṅkamiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Naḷamālī Maṇidado Ukkāsatika Vījanī Kummāso ca Kusaṭṭho ca Giripunnāgiyo pi ca Valliṅkaro Pānadhido atha Pulinacaṅkamo[^418-3] gāthāyo pañcanavuti gaṇitāyo vibhāvihi. Naḷamālīvaggo aṭṭhacattālīso[^418-4] XLIX

[478. Paṃsukūlasaññika.] Tisso nāmāsi bhagavā syambhū aggapuggalo /  
paṃsukūlaṃ ṭhapetvāna vihāraṃ pāvisī jino.  // ApTha_49,478.1 //  
Tiyantaṃ[^418-5] dhanuṃ ādāya akkhitto yamaliṃ[^418-6] ahaṃ /  
maṇḍalaggaṃ gahetvāna kānanaṃ pāvisiṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_49,478.2 //

Tatth'; addasaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ dumagge laggitaṃ tadā /

Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ saritvāna paṃsukūlaṃ avandi 'haṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi vandanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_49,478.4 //

[479. Buddhasaññaka.] Ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānapāragū[^419-2] /  
lakkhaṇe *itihāse ca sanighaṇḍu-sa*keṭubhe.  // ApTha_49,479.1 //  
Nadīsotapaṭibhāgā sissā āyanti me tadā /  
tesāhaṃ mante[^419-3] vācemi rattindivam atandito.  // ApTha_49,479.2 //  
Siddhattho nāma sambuddho loke uppajji tāvade /  
tam andhakāraṃ nāsetvā ñāṇalokaṃ[^419-4] pavattayi.  // ApTha_49,479.3 //  
Mama aññataro sisso sissānaṃ so kathesi me /  
sutvāna te etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ maman tadā:  // ApTha_49,479.4 //  
"Buddho loke samuppanno sabbaññū lokanāyako /  
tassānuvattati jano lābho amhaṃ na hessati."[^419-5]  // ApTha_49,479.5 //  
Adhiccuppattikā Buddhā cakkhumanto mahāyasā /  
yannūnāhaṃ Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ passeyyaṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_49,479.6 //  
Ajinam me gahetvāna vākacīraṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ /  
assamā abhinikkhamma sisse āmantayiṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_49,479.7 //  
Odumbarakapupphaṃ va candamhi sasakaṃ yathā /  
vāyasānaṃ yathā khīraṃ dullabhaṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_49,479.8 //  
Buddho lokamhi uppanno manussattam pi dullabhaṃ /  
ubhosu vijjamānesu savanañ ca sudullabhaṃ.  // ApTha_49,479.9 //  
Buddho loke samuppanno cakkhuṃ lacchāma no bhavaṃ[^419-6] /  
etha[^419-7] sabbe gamissāma sammāsambuddhasantikaṃ.[^419-8]  // ApTha_49,479.10 //

[480. Bhisadāyaka.] Ogayhāhaṃ pokkharaṇiṃ nānākuñjarasevitaṃ /  
uddharāmi bhisaṃ tattha ghāsahetu[^420-7] ahaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_49,480.1 //  
Bhagavā ca tamhi samaye Padumuttara*savhayo /  
rattam*baradharo Buddho gacchati anilañjase.[^420-8]  // ApTha_49,480.2 //  
Dhunanto[^420-9] paṃsukūlāni saddam assos'; ahaṃ tadā /  
uddhaṃ nijjhāyamāno[^420-10] 'haṃ addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_49,480.3 //  
Tatth'; eva ṭhitako santo āyāciṃ[^420-11] lokanāyakaṃ /  
*madhu bhisehi savati khirasa* ppi muḷālibhi /  
paṭigaṇhātu me Buddho anukampāya cakkhumā.  // ApTha_49,480.4 //  
Tato kāruṇiko satthā orohitvā mahāyaso /  
patigaṇhi mamaṃ bhikkhaṃ anukampāya cakkhumā.  // ApTha_49,480.5 //  
Patiggahetvā[^420-12] sambuddho akā me anumodanaṃ: /  
‘Sukhī hohi mahāpuñña[^420-13] gati tuyhaṃ samijjhatu /  
iminā bhisadānena labhassu vipulaṃ sukhaṃ.';  // ApTha_49,480.6 //

Idaṃ vatvāna sambuddho jalajuttamanāmako /

Anukampitattā[^421-7] tena devadevena tādinā /

[481. Ñāṇatthavika.] Dakkhiṇe Himavantassa sukato assamo mama /  
uttamatthaṃ gavesanto vasāmi pavane tadā.  // ApTha_49,481.1 //  
Lābhālābhena santuṭṭho mūlena ca phalena ca /  
anomasanto cariyaṃ[^421-9] vasāmi ekato ahaṃ.  // ApTha_49,481.2 //  
Sumedho nāma sambuddho loke uppajji tāvade /  
catusaccaṃ pakāseti uddharanto mahājanaṃ.  // ApTha_49,481.3 //  
Nāhaṃ suṇomi[^421-10] sambuddhaṃ na pi me koci sāsati[^421-11] /  
aṭṭhavasse atikkante assosiṃ lokanāyakaṃ.  // ApTha_49,481.4 //


<!-- PTS Page 422 -->
<a id="page-422"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 422]*

Aggidāruṃ nīharitvā[^422-1] sammajjitvāna assamaṃ /  
khāribhāraṃ gahetvāna nikkhamiṃ[^422-2] pavanā ahaṃ.  // ApTha_49,481.5 //  
Ekarattiṃ vasanto 'haṃ gāmesu nigamesu ca /  
anupubbena Candavatiṃ[^422-3] tadā 'haṃ upasaṅkamiṃ.  // ApTha_49,481.6 //  
Bhagavā ca tamhi samaye Sumedho lokanāyako /  
uddharanto bahū satte deseti amataṃ padaṃ.  // ApTha_49,481.7 //  
Janakāyam atikkamma vanditvā jinasāsanaṃ[^422-4] /  
ekaṃsaṃ ajinaṃ katvā santhaviṃ[^422-5] lokanāyakaṃ:  // ApTha_49,481.8 //  
‘Tuvaṃ satthā ca ketu ca dhajo yūpo ca pāṇinaṃ /  
parāyaṇo patiṭṭhā ca dīpo ca dīpaduttamo.  // ApTha_49,481.9 //  
Nepuñño dassane vīro[^422-6] tāresi janataṃ tuvaṃ /  
n'; atth'; añño tārako loke tav'[^422-7] uttaritaro mune.  // ApTha_49,481.10 //  
Sakkā ha ve[^422-8] kusaggena pametuṃ[^422-9] sāgaruttamo /  
na tveva tava sabbaññū ñāṇaṃ sakkā pametave.  // ApTha_49,481.11 //  
Tulamaṇḍale ṭhapetvāna[^422-10] mahī[^422-11] sakkā dharetave /  
na tveva tava paññāya pamāṇaṃ atthi cakkhumā.  // ApTha_49,481.12 //  
Ākāso minituṃ[^422-12] sakkā rajjuya aṅgulena pi /  
na tveva tava sabbaññū sīlaṃ sakkā pametave.  // ApTha_49,481.13 //  
Mahāsamudde udakaṃ ākāso ca vasundharā /  
parimeyyāni etāni appameyyo[^422-13] 'si cakkhumā.'[^422-14]  // ApTha_49,481.14 //  
Chahi gāthāhi sabbaññuṃ kittayitvā mahāyasaṃ /  
añjaliṃ paggahetvāna tuṇhī[^422-15] aṭṭhās'; ahaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_49,481.15 //  
Yaṃ vadanti Sumedho ti bhūripaññaṃ sumedhasaṃ /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha:  // ApTha_49,481.16 //  
‘Yo me ñaṇaṃ pakittesi pasanno sehi pāṇihi[^422-16] /  
tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato:  // ApTha_49,481.17 //  
Sattasattatikappāni devaloke ramissati /  
sahassakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjaṃ karissati.  // ApTha_49,481.18 //  
Anekasatakkhattuñ ca cakkavatti bhavissati /  
padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ.  // ApTha_49,481.19 //


<!-- PTS Page 423 -->
<a id="page-423"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 423]*

Devabhūto manusso vā puññakammasamāhito /  
anūnamatasaṅkappo[^423-1] tikkhapañño bhavissati  // ApTha_49,481.20 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo. /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_49,481.21 //  
Agārā abhinikkhamma pabbajjissati 'kiñcano /  
jātiyā sattavassena arahattaṃ phusissati.[^423-2]  // ApTha_49,481.22 //  
Yato sarāmi attānaṃ yato patto 'mhi sāsanaṃ /  
etth'; antare na jānāmi cetanaṃ amanoramaṃ.[^423-3]  // ApTha_49,481.23 //  
Saṃsaritvā bhave sabbe sampatt'; anubhaviṃ[^423-4] ahaṃ /  
bhoge me ūnatā n'; atthi phalaṃ ñāṇassa thomane.  // ApTha_49,481.24 //  
Tivaggī[^423-5] nibbutā mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā /  
sabbāsavaparikkhīṇā n'; atthi dāni punabbhavo.  // ApTha_49,481.25 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassāni yaṃ ñāṇaṃ abhithom'; ahaṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phalaṃ ñāṇassa thomane.  // ApTha_49,481.26 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_49,481.27 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_49,481.28 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_49,481.29 //

[482. Candanamāliya.] Pañcakāmaguṇe hitvā piyarūpe manorame /  
asītikoṭiyo hitvā pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ.  // ApTha_49,482.1 //  
Pabbajitvāna kāyena pāpakammaṃ vivajjayiṃ[^423-6] /  
vacīduccaritaṃ hitvā nadīkūle vasām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_49,482.2 //  
Ekakammaṃ vihāraṃ taṃ Buddhaseṭṭho upāgamī /  
nāhaṃ jānāmi Buddho ti akāsiṃ paṭisantharaṃ.[^423-7]  // ApTha_49,482.3 //  
Karitvā paṭisanthāraṃ nāmagottaṃ apucch'; ahaṃ: /  
devatā nu 'si gandhabbo uda[^423-8] Sakko Purindado?  // ApTha_49,482.4 //  
Ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto mahābrahmā idhāgato /  
virocesi[^423-9] disā sabbā udayaṃ suriyo[^423-10] yathā.  // ApTha_49,482.5 //


<!-- PTS Page 424 -->
<a id="page-424"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 424]*

Sahassarāṇi cakkāni pāde dissanti mārisa /  
ko va tvaṃ kassa vā putto kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ? /  
nāmagottaṃ pavedehi saṃsayaṃ apanehi me!  // ApTha_49,482.6 //  
‘N'; amhi devo na gandhabbo n'; amhi Sakko Purindado /  
brahmā bhāvo ca me n'; atthi etesaṃ uttamo ahaṃ  // ApTha_49,482.7 //  
Atīto visayaṃ tesaṃ dālayiṃ kāmabandhanaṃ /  
sabbe kilese jhāpetvā patto sambodhim uttamaṃ.';  // ApTha_49,482.8 //  
Tassa vācaṃ suṇitvāhaṃ imaṃ[^424-1] vacanam abraviṃ[^424-2]: /  
yadi Buddho '; si sabbaññū nisīda tvaṃ mahāmune /  
tam ahaṃ pūjayissāmi dukkass'; antakaro[^424-3] tuvaṃ.  // ApTha_49,482.9 //  
Pattharitvā 'jinaṃ cammaṃ[^424-4] adāsiṃ[^424-5] satthuno ahaṃ /  
nisīdi tattha bhagavā sīho va girigabbhare.  // ApTha_49,482.10 //  
Khippaṃ pabbatam āruyha ambassa phalam aggahiṃ[^424-6] /  
sālakalyāṇikaṃ pupphaṃ candanañ ca mahārahaṃ.  // ApTha_49,482.11 //  
Khippaṃ paggayha taṃ sabbaṃ upesiṃ[^424-7] lokanāyakaṃ /  
phalaṃ Buddhassa datvāna sālapupphaṃ apūjayiṃ.  // ApTha_49,482.12 //  
Candanaṃ anulimpitvā avandi satthuno ahaṃ /  
pasannacitto sumano vipulāya ca pītiyā.  // ApTha_49,482.13 //  
Ajinamhi nisīditvā Sumedho lokanāyako /  
mama kammaṃ pakittesi hāsayanto[^424-8] mamaṃ tadā:  // ApTha_49,482.14 //  
‘Iminā phaladānena gandhamālehi cūbhayaṃ /  
pañcavīsakappasate[^424-9] devaloke ramissati /  
anūnamanasaṅkappo Vasavatti[^424-10] bhavissati.  // ApTha_49,482.15 //  
Chabbīsatikappasate manussattaṃ gamissati /  
bhavissati[^424-11] cakkavattī cāturanto mahiddhiko.  // ApTha_49,482.16 //  
Vebhāraṃ[^424-12] nāma nagaraṃ *Vissakammena[^424-13] māpitaṃ* /  
hessati sabbasovaṇṇaṃ nānāratanabhūsitaṃ.  // ApTha_49,482.17 //  
Eten'; eva upāyena saṃsarissati[^424-14] yoniso /  
sabbattha sukhito hutvā devatte atha mānuse /  
pacchime bhave sampatte brahmabandhu bhavissati.  // ApTha_49,482.18 //  
Agārā abhinikkhamma anāgārī bhavissati /  
aviññattipaccayo hutvā nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.';  // ApTha_49,482.19 //


<!-- PTS Page 425 -->

##### *[PTS Page 425]*

Idaṃ vatvāna sambuddho Sumedho lokanāyako /  
mama nijjhāyamānassa pakkāmi anilañjase.  // ApTha_49,482.20 //  
Tusitāto cavitvāna nibbattiṃ[^425-1] mātukucchiyaṃ /  
bhoge me ūnatā n'; atthi yamhi gabbhe vasām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_49,482.21 //  
Mātukucchigate mayhaṃ annapānañ[^425-2] ca bhojanaṃ /  
mātuyā mama chandena nibbattati[^425-3] yadicchakaṃ.  // ApTha_49,482.22 //  
Jātiyā pañcavassena pabbajiṃ[^425-4] anagāriyaṃ /  
oropitamhi kesamhi arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_49,482.23 //  
Pubbakammaṃ gavesanto orena nāddasaṃ ahaṃ /  
tiṃsakappasahassamhi mama kammaṃ anussariṃ.[^425-5]  // ApTha_49,482.24 //  
Namo te purisājañña! Namo te purisuttama! /  
tava sāsanam āgamma patto 'mhi acalam padaṃ.  // ApTha_49,482.25 //  
Tiṃsakappasahassamhi yam Buddham abhipūjayiṃ /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_49,482.26 //

[484. Puḷinuppādaka.] *Pabbate Himavantamhi Devalo[^426-1] nāma tāpaso /  
tattha me caṅkamo* āsi amānussikamāpito.[^426-2]  // ApTha_49,484.1 //  
Jaṭābhārena bharito kamaṇḍaludharo tadā /  
uttamatthaṃ gavesanto pavanā abhinikkhamiṃ.[^426-3]  // ApTha_49,484.2 //  
Cullāsītisahassāni *sissā mayhaṃ upaṭṭhahuṃ /  
sakakammāni pasutā vasanti pavane tadā.  // ApTha_49,484.3 //  
Assamā* abhinikkhamma akaṃ pulinacetiyaṃ[^426-4] /  
nānāpupphaṃ samānetvā taṃ cetiyam apūjayiṃ.  // ApTha_49,484.4 //  
Tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā assamaṃ pavisām'; ahaṃ /  
sabbe sissā samāgantvā[^426-6] etam atthaṃ pucchiṃsu maṃ.[^426-7]  // ApTha_49,484.5 //  
Puḷinena kato thūpo yaṃ tvaṃ *devam namassasi /  
mayaṃ pi ñā*tum icchāma puṭṭho ācikkha 'ma[^426-8] tuvaṃ.  // ApTha_49,484.6 //  
Niddhiṭṭhā no mantapade[^426-9] cakkhumanto mahāyasā /  
te kho ahaṃ namassāmi Buddhaseṭṭhamahāyase.  // ApTha_49,484.7 //  
Kīdisā te mahāvirā sabbaññū lokanāyakā /  
kathaṃ vaṇṇakathaṃ sīlā kīdisā te mahāyasā?  // ApTha_49,484.8 //  
Battiṃsalakkhaṇā Buddhā cattārīsaddijāpi[^426-10] ca /  
nettā go-pamukhā[^426-11] tesaṃ jiñjukaphalasannibhā.[^426-12]  // ApTha_49,484.9 //  
Gacchamānā ca te Buddhā yugamattañ ca pekkhare /  
na tesaṃ jānu nadati sandhisaddo na suyyati.[^426-13]  // ApTha_49,484.10 //  
Gacchamānā ca sugatā uddharantā va gacchare /  
paṭhamaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ pādaṃ; Buddhānaṃ esa dhammatā.  // ApTha_49,484.11 //  
Asambhītā ca te Buddhā migarājā va kesarī /  
nev'; ukkaṃsenti[^426-14] attānaṃ no ca vambhenti[^426-15] pāṇinaṃ.[^426-16]  // ApTha_49,484.12 //  
Mānāvamānato muttā samā sabbesu pāṇisu[^426-17] /  
anattukkaṃsakā Buddhā, Buddhānaṃ esa dhammatā.  // ApTha_49,484.13 //  
Uppajjantā ca sambuddhā ālokaṃ dassayanti te /  
chabbikāraṃ[^426-18] pakampenti kevalaṃ vasudhaṃ imaṃ.  // ApTha_49,484.14 //

Passanti nirayaṃ c'; ete nibbāti nirayo tadā /

uppajji mātukucchismiṃ dasasahassī pakampatha.  // ApTha_49,484.19 //

Sadatthe vāyameyyātha rattindivam atanditā /

Sake sisse 'nusāsitvā[^427-15] devalokaṃ punāgamiṃ[^427-16] /

assatthamūle sambuddho bujjhissati mahāyaso.  // ApTha_49,486.3 //

Ānando nāma nāmena upaṭṭhissat'; imaṃ jinaṃ.  // ApTha_49,486.4 //  
Khemā Uppalavaṇṇā ca aggā hessanti sāvikā /  
Citto Ālavako c'; eva aggā hessant'; upāsakā  // ApTha_49,486.5 //  
Khujjuttarā Nandamātā aggā hessant'; upāsikā /  
bodhi imassa vīrassa assattho ti pavuccati.';  // ApTha_49,486.6 //

Idaṃ sutvāna vacanaṃ asamassa[^430-1] mahesino /

Saṃvuto pātimokkhasmiṃ indriyesu ca pañcasu /  
suddhājivo sato vīro jinasāsanakārako.  // ApTha_49,486.10 //  
Evaṃ viharamāno 'haṃ pāpamittena kenaci /

Vitakkavasago[^430-4] hutvā sāsanato apakkamiṃ[^430-5] /

Asmiṃ kappe samuddamhi maccho āsiṃ timiṅgalo[^430-10] /

Disvā maṃ vānijā bhītā Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ anussaruṃ /

Sāvatthiyaṃ kule ucce[^430-12] jāto brāhmaṇajātiyā[^430-13]  // ApTha_49,486.17 //  
Āsiṃ Dhammarucī nāma sabbapāpajigucchako.[^430-14] /

Mahā-Jetavanaṃ gantvā pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ /  
upemi Buddhaṃ tikkhattuṃ rattiyā divasassa ca  // ApTha_49,486.19 //

tato 'haṃ avacaṃ Buddhaṃ pubbakammapabhāvitaṃ[^430-16]:  // ApTha_49,486.20 //

[487. Sālamaṇḍapiya.] Ajjhogahetvā sālavanaṃ sukato assamo mama /  
sālapupphehi sañchanno vasāmi pavane tadā.  // ApTha_49,487.1 //  
Piyadassī ca bhagavā sayambhū aggapuggalo /  
vivekakāmo sambuddho sālavanam upāgami.  // ApTha_49,487.2 //  
Assamā abhinikkhamma pavanaṃ agamās'; ahaṃ /  
mūlaphalaṃ gavesanto *āhiṇḍāmi vane tadā.  // ApTha_49,487.3 //  
Tatthā*ddasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ Piyadassiṃ mahāyasaṃ /  
sunisinnaṃ samāpannaṃ virocantaṃ mahāvane.  // ApTha_49,487.4 //  
Catudaṇḍe ṭhapetvāna Buddhassa uparī ahaṃ /  
maṇḍapaṃ sukataṃ katvā sālap*upphehi chādayiṃ*  // ApTha_49,487.5 //  
Sattā*haṃ dhārayitvāna maṇḍapaṃ sālachāditaṃ /  
tattha* cittaṃ pasādetvā Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ avandi 'haṃ.  // ApTha_49,487.6 //

##### *[PTS Page 432]*

Bhagavā tamhi samaye vuṭṭhahitvā samādhino[^432-1] /  
yugamattaṃ pekkhamāno nisīdi purisuttamo.  // ApTha_49,487.7 //  
Sāvako Varuṇo nāma Piyadassissa satthuno /  
vasīsatasahassehi upāgacchi[^432-2] vināyakaṃ.  // ApTha_49,487.8 //  
Piyadassī tu[^432-3] bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho /  
bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā sitaṃ pātukarī[^432-4] jino.  // ApTha_49,487.9 //  
Anuruddho upaṭṭhāko Piyadassissa satthuno /  
ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā apucchittha mahāmuniṃ:  // ApTha_49,487.10 //  
‘Ko nu kho bhagavā hetu sitakammassa[^432-5] satthuno /  
kāraṇe vijjamānamhi satthā pātukaresi[^432-6] taṃ?';  // ApTha_49,487.11 //  
Sattāhaṃ pupphachadanaṃ yo me dhāresi māṇavo /  
tassa kammaṃ saritvāna sitaṃ pātukariṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_49,487.12 //  
Okāsāhaṃ na passāmi yan taṃ puññaṃ vipaccati[^432-7] /  
devaloke manusse vā okāso ca na sammati.  // ApTha_49,487.13 //  
Devaloke vasantassa puññakammasamaṅgino /  
yāvatā parisā tassa sālacchannā bhavissati.  // ApTha_49,487.14 //  
Tattha dibbehi naccehi gītehi vāditehi ca /  
ramissati tadā santo puññakammasamāhito.  // ApTha_49,487.15 //  
Yāvatā parisā tassa gandhagandhī bhavissati /  
sālassa pupphavasso ca pavassissati tāvade.  // ApTha_49,487.16 //  
Tato cuto yaṃ[^432-8] manujo mānusaṃ agamissati /  
idhāpi sālacchadanaṃ sabbakālaṃ dhariyyati[^432-9]  // ApTha_49,487.17 //  
Idha naccañ ca gītañ ca samatālasamāhitaṃ /  
parivāressant'; imaṃ niccaṃ Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ  // ApTha_49,487.18 //  
Uggacchante ca suriye sālavassaṃ pavassati /  
puññakammena sanyuttaṃ vassate sabbakālikaṃ.  // ApTha_49,487.19 //  
Aṭṭhārase kappasate Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_49,487.20 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat'; anāsavo.  // ApTha_49,487.21 //  
Dhammaṃ abhisamentassa sālacchadanaṃ bhavissati /  
citake jhāyamānassa chadanaṃ tattha hessati  // ApTha_49,487.22 //  
Vipākaṃ kittayitvāna Piyadassī mahāmuni /  
parisāya dhammaṃ desesi[^432-10] tappento dhammavuṭṭhiyā.  // ApTha_49,487.23 //

susuddhapuḷinākiṇṇā avidūre mam'; assamaṃ.  // ApTha_50,495.7 //

tīṇipupphāni ādāya Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ apūjayiṃ.  // ApTha_51,498.6 //  
Buddhassa ānubhāvena tīṇi pupphāni me tadā /  
uddhavaṇṭā[^442-3] adhopattā chāyaṃ kubbanti satthuno.  // ApTha_51,498.7 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_51,498.8 //  
Tattha me sukataṃ vyamhaṃ[^442-4] Kaṇikārīti ñāyati /  
saṭṭhiyojanam ubbiddhaṃ tiṃsayojanavitthataṃ.[^442-5]  // ApTha_51,498.9 //  
Sahassakaṇḍo satageṇḍu[^442-6] dhajālu haritāmayo /  
satasahassa-niyyūhā vyamhe[^442-7] pātubhaviṃsu me.  // ApTha_51,498.10 //  
Sovaṇṇamayā maṇimayā[^442-8] lohitaṅkamayā pi ca /  
phalikāpi ca pallaṅkā yenicchakā yadicchakā.  // ApTha_51,498.11 //  
Ma*hārahañ ca sayanaṃ tū*likāvikatīyutaṃ[^442-9] /  
uddhalomika-ekantaṃ[^442-10] bimbohanasamāyutaṃ.  // ApTha_51,498.12 //  
Bhavanā nikkhamitvāna caranto devacārikaṃ /  
yadā icchāmi gamanaṃ devasaṅghapurakkhato.  // ApTha_51,498.13 //  
Pupphassa heṭṭhā tiṭṭhāmi uparicchadanaṃ mama[^442-11] /  
samantā yojanasataṃ kanikārehi[^442-12] chāditaṃ.  // ApTha_51,498.14 //  
Saṭṭhituriyasahassāni sāyaṃ pātaṃ[^442-13] upaṭṭhahuṃ /  
parivārenti[^442-14] maṃ niccaṃ rattindivaṃ atanditā.  // ApTha_51,498.15 //  
Tattha naccehi gītehi *tā*lehi vāditehi ca /  
ramāmi khiḍḍāratiyā modāmi kāmakāmi 'haṃ.  // ApTha_51,498.16 //  
Tattha bhutvā ca pitvā ca modāmi Tidase tadā /  
nārīgaṇehi sahito modāmi vyamha-m-uttame.[^442-15]  // ApTha_51,498.17 //  
Satānaṃ pañcakkhattuñ ca devarajjam akārayiṃ /  
satānaṃ tīṇikkhattuñ ca cakkavatti ahos'; ahaṃ. /  
padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ.  // ApTha_51,498.18 //  
Bhavābhave saṃsaranto mahābhoge[^442-16] labhām'; ahaṃ. /  
bhoge me ūnatā n'; atthi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_51,498.19 //

[516. Sabbaphaladāyaka.] Varuṇo[^452-1] nāma nāmena brāhmaṇo mantapāragū /  
chaḍḍetvā dasaputtāni vanam ajjhogahiṃ tadā.  // ApTha_52,516.1 //  
Assamaṃ sukataṃ katvā *suvibhattaṃ monoramaṃ /

mam uddharitukāmo so agacchi[^452-2] mam 'assamaṃ.  // ApTha_52,516.3 //  
Yāvatā vanasaṇḍasmiṃ obhāso vipulo ahu /  
Buddhas*sa ānubhāvena pajjali[^452-3] pavanaṃ tadā.  // ApTha_52,516.4 //  
Disvān'; ahaṃ[^452-4] pāṭihīraṃ Buddhaseṭṭhassa tadino /  
pattapuṭaṃ[^452-5] gahetvāna phalena pūrayiṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_52,516.5 //  
Upagantvāna taṃ Buddhaṃ sākhārikaṃ[^452-6] adās'; ahaṃ /  
anukampāya me Buddho imaṃ vacanam abravī[^452-7]:  // ApTha_52,516.6 //  
Khāribhāraṃ[^452-8] gahetvāna pacchato ehi[^452-9] me tuvaṃ /

Puṭakantaṃ[^452-13] gahetvāna bhikkhusaṅghass'; adās ahaṃ /  
tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā Tusitaṃ upapajj'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_52,516.8 //  
Tattha naccehi gītehi dibbehi vāditehi ca[^452-14] /  
puññakammena saṃyutto anubhomi sadā ahaṃ.  // ApTha_52,516.9 //  
Yaṃ yaṃ yon'; upapajjāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ /  
bhoge me ūnatā n'; atthi phaladānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_52,516.10 //  
Yāvatā caturo[^452-15] dīpā sasamuddā sapabbatā /  
phalaṃ Buddhassa datvāna issaraṃ kārayām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_52,516.11 //  
Yāvatā ye pakkhigaṇā ākāse uppatanti te /  
te pi maṃ vasam anventi phaladānass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_52,516.12 //  
Yāvatā vanasaṇḍamhi yakkhā bhutā ca rakkhasā /  
kumbhaṇḍā garulā cāpi pāricariyaṃ[^452-16] upenti me.  // ApTha_52,516.13 //

na honti kāye dadduñ[^458-6] ca vipāko pattachaḍḍite.  // ApTha_53,525.9 //  
Aparam pi gaṇaṃ tassa nibbattati[^458-7] bhavābhave /  
rogā na honti kāyasmiṃ vipāko pattachaḍḍite.  // ApTha_53,525.10 //  
Aparam pi guṇaṃ tassa nibbattati bhavābhave /  
na hoti cittajā pīḷā vipāko pattachaḍḍite.  // ApTha_53,525.11 //  
Aparam pi guṇaṃ tassa nibbattati bhavābhave /  
āmittā na bhavant'; assa vipāko pattachaḍḍite.  // ApTha_53,525.12 //  
Aparam pi gaṇaṃ tassa nibbattati bhavābhave /  
anūnabhogo bhavati vipāko pattachaḍḍite.  // ApTha_53,525.13 //  
Aparam pi gunaṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . . /  
aggi-rajjūhi[^458-8] corehi na hoti udake bhayaṃ.  // ApTha_53,525.14 //  
Aparam pi . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . . /  
dāsī dāsā anucarā honti cittānuvattakā.  // ApTha_53,525.15 //  
Yamhi āyuppamānamhi jāyate[^458-9] mānuse bhave /  
tato na hāyate āyu tiṭṭhate yāvatāyukaṃ.  // ApTha_53,525.16 //  
Abbhantarā bahicarā[^458-10] negamā ca saraṭṭhakā /  
anuyuttā honti sabbe pi vuṭṭhikāmā sukhicchakā.[^458-11]  // ApTha_53,525.17 //  
Bhogavā yasavā homi sirimā ñātipakkhavā /  
apetabhayasantāso bhavesaṃ sabbato[^458-12] bhave.  // ApTha_53,525.18 //  
Devā manussā asurā gandhabbā yakkha-rakkhasā /  
sabbe te parirakkhanti bhave saṃsarato sadā.[^458-13]  // ApTha_53,525.19 //  
Devaloke manusse vā anubhotvā ubho yase /  
avasāne[^458-14] ca nibbānaṃ sivaṃ patto anuttaraṃ.  // ApTha_53,525.20 //

aññesaṃ adhiko hutvā nibbāyāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_53,525.21 //

[526. Āmaṇḍaphaladāyaka.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū /  
vuṭṭhahitvā samādhimhā caṅkamī[^459-3] lokanāyako  // ApTha_53,526.1 //  
Khāribhāraṃ gahetvāna āharanto[^459-4] phalaṃ tadā /  
addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ caṅkamantaṃ mahāmuniṃ.  // ApTha_53,526.2 //  
Pasannacitto sumano sire katvāna añjaliṃ /  
sambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā āmaṇḍam adadaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_53,526.3 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ phalaṃ adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi āmaṇḍassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_53,526.4 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_53,526.5 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_53,526.6 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_53,526.7 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Āmaṇḍaphaladāyako th. i. g. a-ti. Āmaṇḍaphaladāyakattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[527. Sugandha.] Imamhi bhaddake kappe brahmabandhu mahāyaso /  
Kassapo nama nāmena uppajji vadataṃ varo.  // ApTha_53,527.1 //  
Anuvyañjanasampanno dvattiṃsavaralakkhaṇo[^459-5] /  
byāmappabhāparivuto[^459-6] raṃsijālasamosaṭo.  // ApTha_53,527.2 //  
Assāsetā[^459-7] yathā cando suriyo va pabhaṅkaro /  
nibbāpetā yathā megho sāgaro va gaṇākaro.[^459-8]  // ApTha_53,527.3 //


<!-- PTS Page 460 -->
<a id="page-460"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 460]*

Dharanī-r-iva sīlena Himavā va samādhinā /  
ākāso viya paññāya asaṅgo[^460-1] anilo yathā.  // ApTha_53,527.4 //  
Sa kadāci mahāviro parisāsu visārado /  
saccāni sampakāseti uddharanto mahājanaṃ.  // ApTha_53,527.5 //  
Tadā hi Bārāṇasiyam seṭṭhiputto mahāyaso /  
ās'; ahaṃ dhanadhaññassa pahūtassa pahū tadā[^460-2]  // ApTha_53,527.6 //  
Jaṅghāvihāraṃ vicaraṃ Migadāyam upecc'; ahaṃ[^460-3] /  
addasaṃ tādisaṃ Buddhaṃ desentaṃ amataṃ padaṃ.  // ApTha_53,527.7 //  
Vissaṭṭhakantavacanaṃ karavīkasamassaraṃ /  
haṃsadundubhi-nigghosaṃ[^460-4] viññāpentaṃ mahājanaṃ  // ApTha_53,527.8 //  
Disvā devātidevan taṃ sutvā ca madhuraṃ giraṃ /  
pahāy'; ānappake bhoge pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ.  // ApTha_53,527.9 //  
Evaṃ pabbajito cāhaṃ nacirena bahussuto /  
ahosiṃ[^460-5] dhammakathiko vicittapaṭibhānavā.  // ApTha_53,527.10 //  
Mahāparisamajjhe 'haṃ haṭṭhacitto punappunaṃ /  
vaṇṇayiṃ[^460-6] hemavaṇṇassa vaṇṇaṃ vaṇṇavisārado[^460-7]:  // ApTha_53,527.11 //  
Esa khīṇāsavo Buddho anīgho chinnasaṃsayo[^460-8] /  
sabbakammakkhayaṃ patto vimutto satisaṅkhaye.[^460-9]  // ApTha_53,527.12 //  
Esa so bhagavā Buddho esa sīho anuttaro /  
sadevakassa lokassa brahmacakkappavattako.  // ApTha_53,527.13 //  
Danto dametā santo ca sametā nibbuto isi /  
nibbāpetā ca assattho assāsetā mahājanaṃ.[^460-10]  // ApTha_53,527.14 //  
Vīro suro ca dhīro ca pañño kāruṇiko[^460-11] vasī[^460-12] /  
vijitāvī ca sa jino apagabbho[^460-13] anālayo.  // ApTha_53,527.15 //  
Anejo acalo dhīmā amoho asamo muni /  
dhorayho usabho nāgo sīho sakko gurūsu pi[^460-14]  // ApTha_53,527.16 //  
Virāgo vimalo brahmā vādisuro[^460-15] raṇañjaho[^460-16] /  
akhilo ca visallo[^460-17] ca asamo payato[^460-18] suci.[^460-19]  // ApTha_53,527.17 //


<!-- PTS Page 461 -->
<a id="page-461"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 461]*

Brāhmaṇo samaṇo[^461-1] nātho bhisakko sallakattako /  
yodho Buddho suto sūto[^461-2] acalo mudito 'sito.[^461-3]  // ApTha_53,527.18 //  
Tātā tantā ca hantā[^461-4] ca kattā netā pakāsitā /  
sampahaṃsitā bhottā[^461-5] ca chettā sotā[^461-6] pasaṃsitā  // ApTha_53,527.19 //  
Akhilo ca visālo ca anīgho[^461-7] akathaṅkathī[^461-8] /  
anejo virajo khattā[^461-9] gandhā mettā pakāsitā.[^461-10]  // ApTha_53,527.20 //  
Tāretā atha tāretā[^461-11] kāretā sampadāletā[^461-12] /  
pāpetā sahitā hantā hantā tātāpi tāpaso.[^461-13]  // ApTha_53,527.21 //  
Samacitto samasamo asahāyo dayāyaso /  
accherasanto[^461-14] akuho[^461-15] katāvīisi sattamo.  // ApTha_53,527.22 //  
Nittiṇṇakaṅkho nimmāno appameyyo anūpamo /  
sabbavākyapathātīto[^461-16] saccaneyyantago jino.[^461-17]  // ApTha_53,527.23 //  
Sattasāravare[^461-18] tasmiṃ pasādo[^461-19] amatāvaho /  
tasmā Buddhe ca dhamme ca saṅghe saddhā[^461-20] mahiddhikā.  // ApTha_53,527.24 //  
Guṇehi evamādīhi tilokasaraṇuttamaṃ /  
vaṇṇento parisāmajjhe akaṃ dhammakathaṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_53,527.25 //  
Tato cuto 'haṃ Tusite anubhotvā mahāsukhaṃ /  
tato cuto manussesu jāto homi sugandhiko.  // ApTha_53,527.26 //  
Nissāso[^461-21] mukhagandho[^461-22] ca dehagandho tath'; eva me /  
sedagandho[^461-23] ca satatam sabbagandho ti seti me.  // ApTha_53,527.27 //  
Mukhagandho[^461-22] sadā mayhaṃ padumuppalacampake[^461-24] /  
atisanto sadā vāti[^461-25] sarīro ca tath'; eva me.  // ApTha_53,527.28 //  
Guṇatthavassapupphan[^461-26] taṃ phalan tu param[^461-27] abbhutaṃ /  
ekaggamanasā sabbe vaṇṇayissaṃ suṇotha[^461-28] me:  // ApTha_53,527.29 //

##### *[PTS Page 462]*

Guṇaṃ Buddhassa vatvāna hitāya janasandhisu[^462-1] /  
sukhito homi sabbattha rasaddhovisamāyuto.[^462-2]  // ApTha_53,527.30 //  
Yasassī sukhito kanto[^462-3] jutimā piyadassano[^462-4] /  
vattā aparibhūto ca niddoso paññavā tathā.  // ApTha_53,527.31 //  
Khīṇ'; ev'; āyu pi[^462-5] nibbānaṃ sulabhaṃ Buddhabhattino[^462-6] /  
tesaṃ hetuṃ pavakkhāmi taṃ suṇotha yathātathaṃ.  // ApTha_53,527.32 //  
Santaṃ yasaṃ bhagavato vidhinā[^462-7] abhivādayaṃ[^462-8] /  
yattha tatth'; upapanno[^462-9] pi yasassī tena bhom'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_53,527.33 //  
Dukkhantakaraṇaṃ Buddhaṃ dhammaṃ santam asaṅkhataṃ /  
vaṇṇayaṃ sukhado āsiṃ[^462-10] sattānaṃ sukhito tato.  // ApTha_53,527.34 //  
Guṇaṃ vadanto Buddhassa Buddhapītisamāyuto /  
sakantim parakantiñ ca janayiṃ tena kantimā.[^462-11]  // ApTha_53,527.35 //  
Janoghe titthikākiṇṇo[^462-12] abhibhuyya kutitthiye /  
guṇaṃ vadanto jotesiṃ[^462-13] nāyakaṃ jutimā tato.  // ApTha_53,527.36 //  
Piyakārijinassāpi[^462-14] sambuddhassa guṇaṃ varaṃ[^462-15] /  
saraṃ divasasaṅko 'haṃ[^462-16] ten'; āsiṃ[^462-17] piyadassano.  // ApTha_53,527.37 //  
Yathāsattivasenāhaṃ sabbavācāhi[^462-18] santhaviṃ /  
sugataṃ tena vāgīso[^462-19] vicittapaṭibhānavā.  // ApTha_53,527.38 //  
Ye bālā vimatiṃ[^462-20] pattā[^462-21] paribhonti mahāmuniṃ /  
niggahiṃ[^462-22] te saddhammena paribhūto na ten'; ahaṃ  // ApTha_53,527.39 //  
Buddhavaṇṇehi sattānaṃ kilese apaniṃ[^462-23] ahaṃ /  
nikkilesamano homi tassa kammassa vāhasā.  // ApTha_53,527.40 //

LIV

[528. Mahākaccāna.] Padumuttaro nāma jino anejo ajitañjayo /  
satasahasse kappānaṃ ito uppajji nāyako.  // ApTha_54,528.1 //  
Vīro kamalapattakkho sasaṅkavimalānano /  
kanakācalasaṅkāso ravidittiharippabho[^463-7]  // ApTha_54,528.2 //  
Sattanettamanohārī[^463-8] varalakkhaṇabhūsito /  
sabbavākyapathātīto manujāmarasakkato.  // ApTha_54,528.3 //  
Sambuddho[^463-9] bodhayaṃ satte vāgīso[^463-10] madhurassaro /  
karuṇāniḍḍhasantāno[^463-11] parisāsu visārado.  // ApTha_54,528.4 //


<!-- PTS Page 464 -->
<a id="page-464"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 464]*

Deseti madhuraṃ dhammaṃ catusaccupasaṅhitaṃ /  
nimugge mohapaṅkamhi samuddharati pāṇino.  // ApTha_54,528.5 //  
Tadā ekacaro hutvā tāpaso Himavālayo /  
nabhasā mānusaṃ lokaṃ gacchanto jinam addasaṃ.  // ApTha_54,528.6 //  
Upecca santikaṃ tassa assosiṃ dhammadesanaṃ /  
vaṇṇayaṃ tassa vīrassa sāvakassa mahāguṇaṃ:  // ApTha_54,528.7 //  
Saṅkhittena mayā vuttaṃ vitthārena pakāsayaṃ /  
parisaṃ mañ ca toseti yathā Kaccāyano ayaṃ[^464-1].  // ApTha_54,528.8 //  
Nāhaṃ evaṃ vidhaṃ kañci aññaṃ passāmi sāvakaṃ /  
tasmā[^464-2] 'tadagge es'; aggo evaṃ dhāretha bhikkhavo.  // ApTha_54,528.9 //  
Tadāhaṃ vimhito hutvā sutvā vākyamanoramaṃ[^464-3] /  
Himavantaṃ gamitvāna āhatvā[^464-4] pupphasañcayaṃ  // ApTha_54,528.10 //  
Pūjetvā lokasaraṇaṃ tan ṭhānaṃ abhipatthayiṃ. /  
tadā mam'; āsayaṃ ñatvā vyāhāsi[^464-5] saraṇañjaho:  // ApTha_54,528.11 //  
Passath'; etaṃ isivaraṃ niddhantakanakattacaṃ /  
uddhaggalomaṃ pīn'; aṃsaṃ[^464-6] acalaṃ añjaliṃ ṭhitaṃ.[^464-7]  // ApTha_54,528.12 //  
Hāsasupuṇṇanayanaṃ Buddhavaṇṇagatāsayaṃ[^464-8] /  
dhammapaṭiggahavaraṃ[^464-9] amatāsittasannibhaṃ.[^464-10]  // ApTha_54,528.13 //  
Kaccānassa guṇaṃ sutvā taṃ ṭhānaṃ patthayaṃ[^464-11] ṭhito /  
anāgatamhi addhāne Gotamassa mahāmune.  // ApTha_54,528.14 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Kaccāno nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_54,528.15 //  
Bahussuto mahāñāṇī adhippāyavidū mune /  
pāpuṇissati taṃ ṭhānaṃ yathāyaṃ vyākato mayā.  // ApTha_54,528.16 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_54,528.17 //  
Duve bhave saṃsarāmi devatte atha mānuse /  
aññagatiṃ[^464-12] na gacchāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_54,528.18 //  
Duve kule pajāyāmi khattiye atha brāhmaṇe /  
nīce kule na jāyāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_54,528.19 //


<!-- PTS Page 465 -->
<a id="page-465"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 465]*

Pacchime ca bhave dāni jāto Ujjeniye pure /  
Pajjotassa Acaṇḍassa[^465-1] purohitadijātino.[^465-2]  // ApTha_54,528.20 //  
Putto Tirīṭivacchassa[^465-3] nipuṇo vedapāragū /  
mātā ca Candapadumā[^465-4] Kaccāno haṃ varattaco.[^465-5]  // ApTha_54,528.21 //  
Vīmaṃsanatthaṃ Buddhassa bhūmipālena pesito /  
disvā mokkhapuradvāraṃ[^465-6] nāyakaṃ guṇasañcayaṃ  // ApTha_54,528.22 //  
Sutvā ca vimalaṃ vākyaṃ gatipaṅkavisosanaṃ /  
pāpuṇiṃ amataṃ santaṃ satehi saha pañcahi.[^465-7]  // ApTha_54,528.23 //  
Adhippāyavidū jāto sugatassa mahāmate /  
ṭhapito etadagge ca susamiddhamanoratho.  // ApTha_54,528.24 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,528.25 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,528.26 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,528.27 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Mahākaccāno thero i. g. a-ti. Mahākaccānattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[529. Vakkali.] Ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji nāyako /  
Anomā nāmo amito nāmena Padumuttaro.  // ApTha_54,529.1 //  
Padumākāravadano padumāmalasucchavī /  
lokenānupalitto va toyena padumaṃ yathā.  // ApTha_54,529.2 //  
Dhīro[^465-8] padumapattakkho kanto va padumaṃ yathā /  
padumuttaragandho 'va[^465-9] tasmā so Padumuttaro.  // ApTha_54,529.3 //  
Lokajeṭṭho ca nimmāno andhānaṃ nayanūpamo /  
santaveso guṇanidhi karuṇāmatisāgaro.[^465-10]  // ApTha_54,529.4 //  
Sa kadāci[^465-11] mahāvīro brahmāmarasuraccito[^465-12] /  
sadevamanujākiṇṇo janamajjhe januttamo[^465-13]  // ApTha_54,529.5 //  
Vadanena sugandhena madhurena rutena ca /  
rañjayaṃ parisaṃ sabbaṃ santhavī sāvakaṃ sakaṃ:  // ApTha_54,529.6 //


<!-- PTS Page 466 -->
<a id="page-466"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 466]*

Saddhādhimutto[^466-1] sumati mama dassanalālaso /  
n'; atthi etādiso añño yathāyaṃ bhikkhu Vakkali.  // ApTha_54,529.7 //  
Tadā 'haṃ Haṃsavatiyā nagare brāhmaṇatrajo /  
hutvā sutvā etaṃ[^466-2] vākyaṃ taṃ ṭhānam abhiropayiṃ[^466-3]  // ApTha_54,529.8 //  
Sasāvakan taṃ[^466-4] vimalaṃ nimantetvā Tathāgataṃ /  
sattāhaṃ bhojayitvāna dussehi chādayiṃ tadā.  // ApTha_54,529.9 //  
Nipacca sirasā tassa anantaguṇasāgare /  
nimuggo pītisampuṇṇo imaṃ[^466-5] vacanam abraviṃ:  // ApTha_54,529.10 //  
Yo so tayā santhavito ito sattamake 'hani /  
bhikkhusaddhāvataṃ aggo tādiso hom'; ahaṃ mune.[^466-6]  // ApTha_54,529.11 //  
Evaṃ vutte mahāvīro anāvaraṇadassano /  
imaṃ vākyam udīresi parisāya mahāmuni:  // ApTha_54,529.12 //  
Passath'; etaṃ māṇavakaṃ pītamaṭṭhanivāsanaṃ[^466-7] /  
hemayaññopacitaṅgaṃ[^466-8] jananettamanoharaṃ.  // ApTha_54,529.13 //  
Eso anāgataddhāne Gotamassa mahesino /  
aggo saddhādhimuttānaṃ sāvako yaṃ bhavissati.  // ApTha_54,529.14 //  
Devabhūto manusso vā sabbasantāpavajjito /  
sabbabhogaparibbūḷho sukhito saṃsarissati.  // ApTha_54,529.15 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_54,529.16 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Vakkali nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_54,529.17 //  
Tena kammavisesena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,529.18 //  
Sabbattha sukhito hutvā saṃsaranto bhavābhave /  
Sāvatthiyaṃ pure jāto kule aññatare ahaṃ  // ApTha_54,529.19 //  
Nonītasukhumālaṃ maṃ jātapallavakomalaṃ /  
mandaṃ uttānasayanaṃ pisācabhayatajjitā  // ApTha_54,529.20 //  
Pādamūle mahesissa sāyeyyuṃ dīnamānasā[^466-9] /  
idaṃ dadāma te[^466-10] nātha saraṇaṃ hohi[^466-11] nāyaka.  // ApTha_54,529.21 //


<!-- PTS Page 467 -->
<a id="page-467"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 467]*

Tadā paṭiggahī[^467-1] so maṃ bhītāna saraṇo[^467-2] muni /  
jālinā saṅkhalaṅkena[^467-3] mudukomalapāṇinā.  // ApTha_54,529.22 //  
Tadā pabhuti tenāhaṃ ārakkheyyena rakkhito /  
sabbūpadhivinimmutto[^467-4] sukhena parivaḍḍhito.[^467-5]  // ApTha_54,529.23 //  
Sugatena vinā bhūto ukkaṇṭhāmi muhuttakaṃ /  
jātiyā sattavasso 'haṃ pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ.  // ApTha_54,529.24 //  
Sabbapārami-sambhūtaṃ nīlakkhinayanaṃ paraṃ[^467-6] /  
rūpaṃ sabbasubhākiṇṇaṃ[^467-7] atitto pihayām'; ahaṃ.[^467-8]  // ApTha_54,529.25 //  
Buddharūparataṃ ñatvā tadā ovadi maṃ jino: /  
alaṃ Vakkali kiṃ rūpe ramase bālanandite.  // ApTha_54,529.26 //  
Yo hi passati saddhammaṃ so maṃ passati paṇḍito /  
apassamāno saddhammaṃ maṃ passam pi na passati.  // ApTha_54,529.27 //  
Anantādīnavo kāyo visarukkhasamūpamo[^467-9] /  
āvāso sabbarogānaṃ puñjo dukkhassa kevalo.  // ApTha_54,529.28 //  
Nibbindiya tato rūpe khandhānaṃ udayabbayaṃ /  
passaṃ sabbakilesānaṃ[^467-10] sukhen'; antam gamissati.  // ApTha_54,529.29 //  
Evaṃ tenānusiṭṭho 'haṃ nāyakena hitesinā /  
Gijjhakūṭaṃ samāruyha jhāyāmi giriniddare.[^467-11]  // ApTha_54,529.30 //  
Ṭhito pabbatapādamhi mam āha[^467-12] sa mahāmuni /  
Vakkalī ti jino vācaṃ taṃ sutvā mudito ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,529.31 //  
Pakkhandiṃ[^467-13] selapabbhāre anekasataporise /  
tadā Buddhānubhāvena sukhen'; eva mahiṃ gato.[^467-14]  // ApTha_54,529.32 //  
Puno pi dhammaṃ desesi khandhānaṃ udayavyayaṃ /  
tam ahaṃ dhammam aññāya arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_54,529.33 //  
Su-mahāparisāmajjhe[^467-15] tadā maṃ[^467-16] maraṇantago[^467-17] /  
aggaṃ saddhādhimuttānaṃ paññāpesi mahāmati.  // ApTha_54,529.34 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_54,529.35 //

[530. Mahākappina.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū /  
udito jaladākāse[^468-2] ravīva saradambare.  // ApTha_54,530.1 //  
Vacanābhāya bodheti veneyyapadumāni so /  
kilesapaṅkaṃ soseti matirasmīhi nāyako.  // ApTha_54,530.2 //  
Titthiyānaṃ[^468-3] yaso hanti khajjotābhā[^468-4] yathā ravi /  
sabbattham sampakāseti[^468-5] ratanaṃ va[^468-6] divākaro.  // ApTha_54,530.3 //  
Guṇānaṃ āyati bhūto ratanānaṃ va sāgaro /  
pajjunno pi[^468-7] va bhūtāni dhammameghena vassati.  // ApTha_54,530.4 //  
Akkhadasso tadā āsiṃ nagare Haṃsasavhaye /  
upecca dhammaṃ assosiṃ jalajuttamanāmino  // ApTha_54,530.5 //  
Ovādakassa bhikkhūnaṃ sāvakassa katāvino[^468-8] /  
guṇaṃ pakāsayantassa vāsayantassa[^468-9] me manaṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.6 //  
Sutvā patīto sumano nimantetvā Tathāgataṃ /  
sasissaṃ bhojayitvāna taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhipatthayiṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.7 //  
Tadā haṃsasamābhāgo haṃsadundubhinīvaco[^468-10] /  
passath'[^468-11] etaṃ mahāmattaṃ vinicchayavisāradaṃ  // ApTha_54,530.8 //  
Mama pādamūle[^468-12] patitaṃ samuggatatanūruhaṃ /  
jimuttavaṇṇaṃ[^468-13] pīn'; aṃsaṃ[^468-14] pasanna-nayanānanaṃ[^468-15]  // ApTha_54,530.9 //  
Parivārena mahatā rājāyuttaṃ[^468-16] mahāyasaṃ /  
eso katāvino ṭhānaṃ pattheti muditāya so.[^468-17]  // ApTha_54,530.10 //


<!-- PTS Page 469 -->
<a id="page-469"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 469]*

Iminā paṇipātena[^469-1] cāgena paṇidhīhi[^469-2] ca /  
kappasatasahassāni n'; upapajjati duggatiṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.11 //  
Devesu devasobhāgyaṃ[^469-3] manussesu mahantataṃ /  
anubhotvāna sesena nibbānaṃ pāpuṇissati.  // ApTha_54,530.12 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_54,530.13 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Kappino nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_54,530.14 //  
Tato 'haṃ sukataṃ kāraṃ katvāna jinasāsane /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tusitaṃ agamās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.15 //  
Devamānusarajjāni sutaso anusāsiya /  
Bārāṇasiyaṃ āsanne jāto Keniyajātiyā.[^469-4]  // ApTha_54,530.16 //  
Sahassaparivārena sapajāpatiko ahaṃ /  
pañcapaccekabuddhānaṃ satāni samupaṭṭhahiṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.17 //  
Temāsaṃ bhojayitvāna pacchā dammi[^469-5] ticīvaraṃ /  
tato cutā mayaṃ sabbe ahumha[^469-6] Tidasūpagā  // ApTha_54,530.18 //  
Puno sabbe manussattaṃ āgamamha[^469-7] tato cutā /  
Kukkuṭamhi pure jāto Himavantassa passato.  // ApTha_54,530.19 //  
Kappino nām'; ahaṃ āsiṃ rājaputto mahāyaso /  
sesāmaccakule jātā mam eva parivārayuṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.20 //  
Mahārajjaṃ sukhappatto sabbakāmasamiddhimā /  
vānijehi samakkhātaṃ Buddhuppādam apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.21 //  
Buddho loke samuppanno asamo ekapuggalo /  
so pakāseti saddhammaṃ amataṃ sukham uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.22 //  
Suyuttā tassa sissā ca sumuttā ca anāsavā /  
sutvān'; esaṃ[^469-8] suvacanaṃ sakkaritvā va[^469-9] vānije  // ApTha_54,530.23 //  
Vihāya[^469-10] rajjaṃ sāmacco nikkhamiṃ Buddhamāmako /  
nadiṃ disvā mahācandaṃ pūritaṃ samatitthikaṃ  // ApTha_54,530.24 //  
Appatiṭṭhaṃ anālambaṃ duttaraṃ sīghavāhiniṃ /  
guṇaṃ saritvā Buddhassa sotthinā samatikkamiṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.25 //  
Bhavasotaṃ sace Buddho tiṇṇo lokantago vidū[^469-11] /  
etena saccavajjena gamanaṃ me samijjhatu.  // ApTha_54,530.26 //


<!-- PTS Page 470 -->
<a id="page-470"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 470]*

Yadi santigamo maggo mokkho ca santikaṃ[^470-1] sukhaṃ /  
etena saccavajjena gamanam me samijjhatu.  // ApTha_54,530.27 //  
Saṅgho ce tiṇṇakantāro puññakkhetto anuttaro /  
etena saccavajjena gamanaṃ me samijjhatu.  // ApTha_54,530.28 //  
Saha kate saccavare maggā-d-apagataṃ jalaṃ /  
tato sukhena uttiṇṇo nadītīre manorame  // ApTha_54,530.29 //  
Nisinnaṃ addasaṃ Buddhaṃ udentaṃ va pabhaṅkaraṃ /  
jalantaṃ hemaselaṃ va dīparukkhaṃ va jotitaṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.30 //  
Sasīva[^470-2] tārā sahitaṃ sāvakehi purakkhataṃ /  
Vāsavaṃ viya vassantaṃ desanājalanandanaṃ.[^470-3]  // ApTha_54,530.31 //  
Vanditvāna sahāmacco ekamantaṃ upāvisiṃ /  
tato no āsayaṃ ñatvā Buddho dhammam adesayi.  // ApTha_54,530.32 //  
Sutvāna dhammaṃ vimalaṃ avocumha mayaṃ jinaṃ /  
pabbājehi mahāvīra nibbiṇṇāmha bhave mayaṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.33 //  
Svākkhāto bhikkhave dhammo dukkhantakaraṇāya vo /  
caratha brahmacariyaṃ icc āha munisattamo.  // ApTha_54,530.34 //  
Saha vācāya sabbe pi bhikkhu-vesadharā[^470-4] mayaṃ /  
ahumhā upasampannā sotāpannā ca sāsane.  // ApTha_54,530.35 //  
Tato Jetavanaṃ gantvā anusāsi vināyako /  
anusiṭṭho jinenāhaṃ arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_54,530.36 //  
Tato bhikkhusahassan taṃ[^470-5] anusāsim ahan tadā /  
*ma*mānusāsanakarā te pi āsuṃ anāsavā.  // ApTha_54,530.37 //  
Jino tasmiṃ guṇe tuṭṭho etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ /  
bhikkhu-ovādakān aggo Kappino ti mahājino.[^470-6]  // ApTha_54,530.38 //  
Satasahasse kataṃ kammaṃ phalaṃ dassesi me idha /  
sumutto saravego ca kilese jhāpayiṃ[^470-7] mama.[^470-8]  // ApTha_54,530.39 //

[531. Dabbamalla.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbalokavidū muni /  
ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji cakkhumā.  // ApTha_54,531.1 //  
Ovādako viññāpako tārako sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
desanākusalo Buddho tāresi[^471-1] janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_54,531.2 //  
Anukampako kāruṇiko hitesi sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
sampatte titthiye[^471-2] sabbe pañcasīle patiṭṭhapi.[^471-3]  // ApTha_54,531.3 //  
Evaṃ nirākulaṃ āsi suññataṃ titthiyehi ca /  
vicittaṃ arahantehi vasībhūtehi tādihi.  // ApTha_54,531.4 //  
Ratanānaṭṭhapaññāsaṃ uggato so mahāmuni /  
kañcanagghiyasaṅkāso dvattiṃsavaralakkhaṇo[^471-4]  // ApTha_54,531.5 //  
Vassasatasahassāni āyaṃ vijjati tāvade /  
tāvatā tiṭṭhamāno so[^471-5] tāresi[^471-6] janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_54,531.6 //  
Tadāhaṃ Haṃsavatiyaṃ seṭṭhiputto mahāyaso /  
upetvā lokapajjotaṃ assosiṃ dhammadesanaṃ.  // ApTha_54,531.7 //  
Senāsanāni bhikkhūnaṃ paññāpentaṃ sa sāvakaṃ[^471-7] /  
kittayantassa vacanaṃ suṇitvā mudito ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,531.8 //  
Adhikāraṃ sasaṅghassa katvā tassa mahesino /  
nipacca sirasā pāde taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhipatthayiṃ.  // ApTha_54,531.9 //  
Tadahaṃ sa mahāvīro mama kammaṃ pakittayaṃ: /  
So yaṃ[^471-8] sasaṅghaṃ bhojesi sattāhaṃ lokanāyakaṃ  // ApTha_54,531.10 //  
So yaṃ kamalapattakkho sīhaṃso kanakattaco[^471-9] /  
maṃ[^471-10] pādamūle patito patthayi[^471-11] ṭhānam uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_54,531.11 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati  // ApTha_54,531.12 //  
Sāvako tassa Buddhassa Dabbo nāmena vissuto /  
senāsanapaññāpako aggo hessat'; ayaṃ[^471-12] tadā.  // ApTha_54,531.13 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch'[^471-13] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,531.14 //  
Satānaṃ tīṇikhattuñ ca devarajjam akārayiṃ /  
satānaṃ pañcakkhattuñ ca cakkavatti ahos'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,531.15 //


<!-- PTS Page 472 -->
<a id="page-472"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 472]*

Padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ[^472-1] /  
sabbattha sukhito āsiṃ tassa kammassa vāhasā.  // ApTha_54,531.16 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe Vipassī nāma nāyako /  
uppajji cārunayano[^472-2] sabbadhammavipassako.  // ApTha_54,531.17 //  
Duṭṭhacitto upavadi sāvakaṃ tassa tādino /  
sabbāsavaparikkhīṇaṃ[^472-3] ‘suddho'; ti ca vijāniya.[^472-4]  // ApTha_54,531.18 //  
Tass'; eva naravīrassa *sāvakānaṃ* mahesinaṃ /  
salākaṃ paggahetvāna khīrodanam[^472-5] adās'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,531.19 //  
Imamhi bhaddake kappe brahmabandhu mahāyaso /  
Kassapo nāma nāmena uppajji vadataṃ varo.  // ApTha_54,531.20 //  
Sāsanaṃ jotayitvā so abhibhuyya kutitthiye /  
veneyye vinayitvā ca[^472-6] nibbuto so sasāvako.  // ApTha_54,531.21 //  
Sasissa-nibbute nāthe attham entamhi[^472-7] sāsane /  
devā kandiṃsu saṃviggā muttakesā rudammukhā.  // ApTha_54,531.22 //  
Nibbāyissati dhammakkho[^472-8] na passissāma subbate /  
na suṇissāma saddhammaṃ aho no appapuññatā.  // ApTha_54,531.23 //  
Tadāyaṃ puthavī[^472-9] sabbā acalā sācalācalā[^472-10] /  
sāgaro ca sasoko va[^472-11] vinadī[^472-12] karuṇaṃ giraṃ.  // ApTha_54,531.24 //  
Catuddisā dundubhiyo[^472-13] nādayiṃsu[^472-14] samānusā[^472-15] /  
samantato asaniyo patiṃsu ca bhayāvahā.  // ApTha_54,531.25 //  
Ukkā patiṃsu nabhasā dhūmaketu ca dissati /  
sabba-thalaja-sattā ca raviṃsu karuṇaṃ[^472-16] migā.  // ApTha_54,531.26 //  
Uppāde dāruṇe disvā sāsanatthañ ca sūcakaṃ[^472-17] /  
saṃviggā bhikkhavo tattha[^472-18] cintayimha mayaṃ tadā  // ApTha_54,531.27 //  
Sāsanena vinā sammā[^472-19] jīvitena alam mayaṃ /  
pavisitvā mahāraññaṃ yuñjāma jinasāsane.  // ApTha_54,531.28 //  
Addasamha tadāraññe ubbiddhaṃ selam uttamaṃ /  
nisseniyā tam[^472-20] āruyha nisseniṃ pātapamhase.[^472-21]  // ApTha_54,531.29 //

Tadā ovadi no thero: Buddhuppādo sudullabho /  
saddhā vo[^473-1] sulabhā laddhā. thokasesañ ca sāsanaṃ.  // ApTha_54,531.30 //  
Nipatanti khaṇātītā[^473-2] anante dukkhasāgare /

ahañ ca Pukkusātī[^473-7] ca Sabhiyo[^473-8] Bāhiyo tathā  // ApTha_54,531.33 //

Ubho puññañ ca pāpañ ca vītivatto 'mhi dān'; ahaṃ[^473-15] /

Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,531.40 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,531.41 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,531.42 //

[532. Kumārakassapa.] Ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji nāyako /  
sabbalokahito vīro Padumuttaranāmako.  // ApTha_54,532.1 //  
Tadā 'haṃ brāhmaṇo hutvā va sato vedapārago /  
divāvihāraṃ vicaraṃ addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ  // ApTha_54,532.2 //


<!-- PTS Page 474 -->
<a id="page-474"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 474]*

Catusaccaṃ pakāsentaṃ bodhayantaṃ sadevakaṃ /  
vicittakathikānaggaṃ[^474-1] vaṇṇayantaṃ mahājane.  // ApTha_54,532.3 //  
Tadā muditacitto 'haṃ nimantetvā Tathāgataṃ /  
nānārattehi vatthehi alaṅkatvāna maṇḍapaṃ.  // ApTha_54,532.4 //  
Nānāratanapajjotaṃ sasaṅghaṃ bhojayiṃ tahiṃ /  
bhojayitvāna sattāhaṃ nānā-'gga-rasa-bhojanaṃ.  // ApTha_54,532.5 //  
Nānācittehi pupphehi pūjayitvā sasāvakaṃ /  
nipacca pādamūlamhi taṃ ṭhānaṃ patthayiṃ ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,532.6 //  
Tadā munivaro āha karuṇ'; eka-ras-āsayo[^474-2] /  
passath'; etaṃ dijavaraṃ padumānanalocanaṃ  // ApTha_54,532.7 //  
Pītipāmujjabahulaṃ[^474-3] samuggatatanūruhaṃ /  
hāsādhikaṃ[^474-4] visālakkhaṃ mama sāsanalālasaṃ  // ApTha_54,532.8 //  
Maṃ pādamūle patitaṃ ekāvattasumānasaṃ /  
esa pattheti taṃ ṭhānaṃ vicittakathikatthadaṃ.[^474-5]  // ApTha_54,532.9 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_54,532.10 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Kumāra Kassapo nāma hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_54,532.11 //  
Vicittapupphadussānaṃ ratanānañ ca vāhasā /  
vicittakathikānaṃ so aggataṃ pāpuṇissati.  // ApTha_54,532.12 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch[^474-6] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,532.13 //  
Paribbhamaṃ bhavākāse raṅgamajjhe yathā naṭo[^474-7] /  
sākhāmigatrajo hutvā migiya kucchim okkhamiṃ.[^474-8]  // ApTha_54,532.14 //  
Tadā mayi kucchigate vijjhavāraṃ[^474-9] upaṭṭhitā /  
sākhena cattā[^474-10] me mātā nigrodham saraṇaṃ gatā.  // ApTha_54,532.15 //  
Tena sā migarājena maraṇā parimocitā /  
pariccajitvā saṃ pāṇaṃ mam evam ovadī tadā:  // ApTha_54,532.16 //  
"Nigrodham eva seveyya na Sākham upasaṃvase /  
Nigrodhasmiṃ mataṃ seyyo yañ ce Sakhasmiṃ jīvitaṃ".  // ApTha_54,532.17 //  
Tenānusi*ṭṭhā* miga-y-ovādena[^474-11] /  
*ahañ ca[^474-12] mātā ca tass'; ovādena*  // ApTha_54,532.18 //


<!-- PTS Page 475 -->
<a id="page-475"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 475]*

Āgamma rammaṃ Tusitādivāsaṃ /  
gato[^475-1] pavāsaṃ sagharaṃ yath'; eva.  // ApTha_54,532.19 //  
Puno Kassapavīrassa attham entamhi[^475-2] sāsane /  
āruyha selasikharaṃ yuñjitvā jinasāsanaṃ.  // ApTha_54,532.20 //  
Idāni 'haṃ Rājagahe[^475-3] jāto seṭṭhikule ahuṃ /  
āpannagabbhā[^475-4] me mātā pabbajiṃ[^475-5] anagāriyaṃ.  // ApTha_54,532.21 //  
Sagabbhan taṃ viditvāna Devadattam upānayuṃ /  
so avoca: ‘vināsetha pāpikaṃ bhikkhuniṃ[^475-6] imaṃ.';  // ApTha_54,532.22 //  
Idāni pi munindena jinena anukampitā /  
sukhinī ajanī[^475-7] mayhaṃ mātā bhikkhunupassaye.  // ApTha_54,532.23 //  
Taṃ viditvā mahīpālo Kosalo maṃ aposayi[^475-8] /  
kumāraparihārena nāmenāhañ[^475-9] ca Kassapo.  // ApTha_54,532.24 //  
Mahā-Kassapam āgamma ahaṃ Komārakassapo /  
vammikasādisaṃ[^475-10] kāyaṃ sutvā Buddhena desitaṃ.  // ApTha_54,532.25 //  
Tato cittaṃ vimucci me anupādāya sabbaso /  
pāyāsiṃ damayitvā 'haṃ[^475-11] etadaggaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_54,532.26 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,532.27 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,532.28 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,532.29 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kumārakassapo thero i. g. a-ti. Kumārakassapattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[533. Bāhiya.] Ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji nāyako /  
mahappabho tilokaggo nāmena Padumuttaro.  // ApTha_54,533.1 //  
Khippābhiññassa bhikkhussa guṇaṃ kittayato mune /  
sutvā udaggacitto 'haṃ kāraṃ katvā mahesino.  // ApTha_54,533.2 //  
Datvā sattāhikaṃ dānaṃ sa-sissassa mune-r-ahaṃ[^475-12] /  
abhivādiya sambuddhaṃ taṃ ṭhānaṃ patthayiṃ tadā.  // ApTha_54,533.3 //  
Tato maṃ vyakarī Buddho: etaṃ passatha brāhmaṇaṃ /  
patitaṃ pādamūle me pīn'; aṃsaṃ[^475-13] paccavekkhanaṃ  // ApTha_54,533.4 //


<!-- PTS Page 476 -->
<a id="page-476"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 476]*

Hemayaññopacitaṅgaṃ avadātaṃ tanuttacaṃ[^476-1] /  
palambabimbatamboṭṭhaṃ[^476-2] sitatiṇhaṃ samaṃ[^476-3] dijaṃ  // ApTha_54,533.5 //  
Guṇatthāmaṃ bahutaraṃ[^476-4] samuggatatanūruhaṃ /  
guṇe kāyatanībhūtaṃ pītisamphullitānanaṃ.  // ApTha_54,533.6 //  
Eso patthayato ṭhānaṃ khippābhiññassa bhikkhuno /  
anāgate mahāvīro Gotamo nāma hessati.  // ApTha_54,533.7 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Bāhiyo nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_54,533.8 //  
Tadā hi tuṭṭho vuṭṭhāya yāvajīvaṃ mahāmuniṃ /  
kāraṃ katvā cuto saggaṃ agaṃ[^476-5] sabhavanaṃ yathā.  // ApTha_54,533.9 //  
Devabhūto manusso vā sukhito tassa ka*mmuno /  
vā*hasā saṃsaritvāna sampattiṃ anubhos'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,533.10 //  
Puno Kassapavīrassa atthaṃ entamhi sāsane /  
āruyha selaṃ sikharaṃ yuñjitvā jinasāsane  // ApTha_54,533.11 //  
Visuddhasīlo sappañño jinasāsanakārako /  
tato cutā pañcajanā devalokaṃ *agamhase.*  // ApTha_54,533.12 //  
Tato 'haṃ Bāhiko jāto Bhārukacche[^476-6] puruttame /  
tato nāvāya pakkanto sāgaraṃ appasiddhiyaṃ.[^476-7]  // ApTha_54,533.13 //  
Tato nāvā abhijjittha gantvāna katipāhakaṃ /  
tadā bhiṃsanake ghore patito makarākare.  // ApTha_54,533.14 //  
Tadā 'haṃ vāyamitvāna *santaritvā* mahodadhiṃ /  
Suppārapaṭṭanam[^476-8] varaṃ sampatto mandavedhito.[^476-9]  // ApTha_54,533.15 //  
Dārucīram nivāsetvā gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ /  
tad'; āha[^476-10] so jano tuṭṭho: "arahā 'yam idhāgato  // ApTha_54,533.16 //  
Imaṃ annena pānena *vatthena sa*yanena[^476-11] ca /  
bhesajjena ca sakkatvā hessāma sukhitā mayaṃ".  // ApTha_54,533.17 //  
Paccayānaṃ tadā lābhī'; tehi sakkatapūjitaṃ /  
arahā 'yan ti[^476-12] saṅkappaṃ uppādesiṃ ayoniso.  // ApTha_54,533.18 //


<!-- PTS Page 477 -->
<a id="page-477"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 477]*

Tato me ci*ttam aññāya co*dayitvā pubbadevatā: /  
‘na tvaṃ upāyamaggaññū[^477-1] kuto hi[^477-2] arahā bhave.';  // ApTha_54,533.19 //  
Codito tāya saṃviggo tadā 'haṃ paripucchi taṃ: /  
ke[^477-3] vā ete kuhiṃ loke arahanto maruttamā?  // ApTha_54,533.20 //  
*Sāvatthiyaṃ Ko*salamandire jino /  
pahūtapañño[^477-4] varabhurimedhaso  // ApTha_54,533.21 //  
Sakyaputto arahā anāsavo /  
deseti dhammaṃ arahattapattiyā.  // ApTha_54,533.22 //  
Tad'; assa sutvā vacanaṃ supīṇito[^477-5] /  
nidhiṃ va la*ddhā[^477-6] kappaṇo va[^477-7] vi*mhito  // ApTha_54,533.23 //  
Udaggacitto arahattam uttamaṃ /  
sudassanaṃ duṭṭhamanantagocaraṃ.[^477-8]  // ApTha_54,533.24 //  
Tadā rato[^477-9] nikkhamitvāna[^477-10] satthuno[^477-11] /  
sadā jinaṃ passāmi vimalānanaṃ  // ApTha_54,533.25 //  
Upecca rammaṃ Vijitavhayaṃ va taṃ[^477-12] /  
dije[^477-13] apucchiṃ: kuhiṃ Lokananda*no?  // ApTha_54,533.26 //  
Tato* avocuṃ naradevavandito /  
puraṃ paviṭṭho asanesanāya[^477-14] so.  // ApTha_54,533.27 //  
Saso va[^477-15] khippaṃ munidassanussuko /  
upecca vandāhi tam aggapuggalam[^477-16]  // ApTha_54,533.28 //  
Tato 'haṃ tuvaṭaṃ gantvā Sāvatthim puram uttamaṃ /  
vicarantan tam addakkhiṃ[^477-17] piṇḍattham apihāgidham[^477-18]  // ApTha_54,533.29 //  
Pattapāṇiṃ[^477-19] alolakkhaṃ bhājayantaṃ idhāmataṃ[^477-20] /  
sirinilayasaṅkāsañ ravidittiharānanaṃ.  // ApTha_54,533.30 //  
Taṃ samecca nipaccāhaṃ imaṃ[^477-21] vacanam abraviṃ[^477-22]: /  
‘kupathe[^477-23] vippanaṭṭhassa saraṇaṃ hohi[^477-24] Gotama.';  // ApTha_54,533.31 //

<a id="page-478"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 478]*

Pāṇasantāraṇatt*hāya[^478-1] piṇḍāya vicarām'; ahaṃ* /  
na te dhammakathākālo icc āha munisattamo.  // ApTha_54,533.32 //  
Tadā punappunaṃ Buddhaṃ āyāciṃ dhammalālaso /  
so me dhammam adesesi gambhīraṃ suññataṃ[^478-2] padaṃ  // ApTha_54,533.33 //  
Tassa dhammaṃ suṇitvānaṃ pāpuṇiṃ āsavakkhayaṃ /  
pari*kkhīṇāyuko santo atho* satthā 'nukampito.[^478-3]  // ApTha_54,533.34 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,533.35 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,533.36 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,533.37 //  
Evaṃ thero viyākāsi Bāhiyo Dārucīriyo /  
saṃkārakuṭe patito bhūtādhiṭṭhāya gāviyā.[^478-4]  // ApTha_54,533.38 //  
*Attano pubbacaritaṃ ki*ttayitvā mahāmati /  
parinibbāyi so vīro Sāvatthiyaṃ puruttame.  // ApTha_54,533.39 //  
Nagarā nikkhamanto taṃ disvāna isisattamo /  
dārucīradharaṃ[^478-5] dhīraṃ bāhikaṃ bāhitāgamaṃ[^478-6]  // ApTha_54,533.40 //  
Bhumiyaṃ *patitaṃ da*ntaṃ[^478-7] indaketuṃ va pātitaṃ /  
gatāyusaṃgataklesañ[^478-8] jinasāsanakārakaṃ.  // ApTha_54,533.41 //  
Tato āmantayī[^478-9] satthā sāvake sāsane rate[^478-10]: /  
gaṇhatha hutvā[^478-11] jhāpetha tanuṃ sabrahmacārino  // ApTha_54,533.42 //  
*Thūpaṃ ka*rotha pūjetha; nibbuto so mahāmati /  
khippābhiññānam es'; aggo sāvako me vaco karo.  // ApTha_54,533.43 //  
Sahassam api ce[^478-12] gāthā anatthapadasaṃhitā[^478-13] /  
ekaṃ gāthāpadaṃ seyyo yaṃ sutvā upasammati.  // ApTha_54,533.44 //  
Yattha āpo ca pathavī ca tejo vāyo na gādhati[^478-14] /  
na tattha sukkā[^478-15] jotanti ādicco na ppakāsati.  // ApTha_54,533.45 //  
Na tattha candimā bhāti tamo tattha na vijjati /  
yadā ca attanā vedī[^478-16] *muni mo*nena brāhmaṇo.  // ApTha_54,533.46 //  
Atha rūpā arūpā ca sukhadukkhā vimuccati[^478-17]  // ApTha_54,533.47 //  
icc evaṃ abhaṇī[^478-18] nātho tilokasaraṇo munī ti.[^478-19] Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Bāhiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Bāhiyattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[534. Mahākoṭṭhika.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbalokavidū muni /  
ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji cakkhumā.  // ApTha_54,534.1 //  
Ovādako viññāpako tārako sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
desanākusalo Buddho tāresi[^479-1] janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_54,534.2 //  
Anukampako kāruṇiko hitesī sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
sampatte titthiye sabbe pañcasīle patiṭṭhapi.[^479-2]  // ApTha_54,534.3 //  
Evaṃ nirākulaṃ āsi suññataṃ titthiyehi ca /  
vicittaṃ arahantehi[^479-3] vasībhūtehi tādihi.[^479-4]  // ApTha_54,534.4 //  
Ratanānaṭṭhapañ*ñāsaṃ ugga*to so mahāmuni /  
kañcanagghiyasaṅkāso battiṅsavaralakkhaṇo.[^479-5]  // ApTha_54,534.5 //  
Vassasatasahassāni āyuṃ vijjati tāvade /  
tāvatā tiṭṭhamānaso tāresi janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_54,534.6 //  
Tadā 'haṃ Haṃsavatiyā[^479-6] brāhmaṇo vedapāragū[^479-7] /  
*upetvā*[^479-8] sattapāraṅgaṃ[^479-9] assosiṃ dhammadesanaṃ.  // ApTha_54,534.7 //  
Tadā so sāvakaṃ vīro pabhinna-mati-gocaraṃ /  
atthe dhamme ca nerutte paṭibhāne ca kovidaṃ  // ApTha_54,534.8 //  
Ṭhapesi etad aggamhi. Taṃ sutvā mudito ahaṃ /  
sasāvakaṃ jinavaraṃ sattāhaṃ bhojayiṃ tadā.  // ApTha_54,534.9 //  
Dusseh'; acchādayitvāna[^479-10] sasissaṃ Buddhasāgaraṃ[^479-11] /  
nipacca pādamūlamhi taṃ ṭhānaṃ patthayiṃ[^479-12] ahaṃ  // ApTha_54,534.10 //  
Tato avoca lokaggo: passath'; etaṃ dijuttamaṃ /  
vinataṃ pādamūle me kamalodarasappabhaṃ.[^479-13]  // ApTha_54,534.11 //  
Buddhaseṭṭhassa bhikkhussa ṭhānaṃ patthayate ayaṃ /  
tāya saddhāya[^479-14] cāgena tena dhammassavena ca  // ApTha_54,534.12 //  
Sabbattha sukhito hutvā saṃsaritvā bhavābhave /  
anāgatamhi addhāne lacchate taṃ manorathaṃ.[^479-15]  // ApTha_54,534.13 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_54,534.14 //


<!-- PTS Page 480 -->
<a id="page-480"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 480]*

Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Koṭṭhito nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_54,534.15 //  
Taṃ sutvā mudito hutvā yāvajīvaṃ tadā jinaṃ /  
mettacitto paricariṃ sato paññāsamāhito.[^480-1]  // ApTha_54,534.16 //  
Tena kammavipākena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch'[^480-2] ahaṃ  // ApTha_54,534.17 //  
Satānaṃ tīṇikkhattuñ ca devarajjam akārayiṃ /  
satānaṃ pañcakkhattuñ ca cakkavatti ahos'; ahaṃ  // ApTha_54,534.18 //  
Padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ /  
sabbattha sukhito āsiṃ tassa kammassa vāhasā.  // ApTha_54,534.19 //  
Duve bhave saṃsarāmi devatte atha mānuse /  
aññaṃ gatiṃ na gacchāmi suciṇṇassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_54,534.20 //  
Duve kule pajāyāmi khattiye atha brāhmaṇe /  
nīce kule na jāyāmi[^480-3] suciṇṇassa idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_54,534.21 //  
Pacchime bhave sampatte brahmabandhu ahos'; ahaṃ /  
Sāvatthiyaṃ vippakule pacchā jāto mahaddhane.[^480-4]  // ApTha_54,534.22 //  
Mātā Candavatī nāma pitā me Assalāyano /  
yadā me pitaraṃ Buddho vinayī[^480-5] sabbabuddhiyā[^480-6]  // ApTha_54,534.23 //  
Tadā pasanno sugate[^480-7] pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ. /  
Moggallāno ācariyo upajjhāyo Sarisambhavo[^480-8]  // ApTha_54,534.24 //  
Kesesu chijjamānesu diṭṭhichinnasamūlikā[^480-9] /  
nivāsento ca kāsāvaṃ arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_54,534.25 //  
Atthadhammaniruttīsu paṭibhāne ca me mati /  
pabhinnā tena lokaggo etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ.  // ApTha_54,534.26 //  
Asandiṭṭhaṃ viyākāsiṃ Upatissena pucchito /  
paṭisambhidāsu tenāhaṃ aggo sambuddhasāsane.  // ApTha_54,534.27 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,534.28 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,534.29 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,534.30 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Mahākoṭṭhiko thero i. g. a-ti. Mahākoṭṭhikattherassa apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[535. Uruvelakassapa.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbalokavidū muni /  
ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji cakkhumā  // ApTha_54,535.1 //  
Ovādako viññāpako tārako sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
desanākusalo Buddho tāresi janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.2 //  
Anukampako kāruṇiko hitesī sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
sampatte titthiye sabbe pañcasīle patiṭṭhapi  // ApTha_54,535.3 //  
Evaṃ nirākulaṃ āsi suññataṃ[^481-1] titthiyehi ca /  
vicittaṃ arahantehi vasībhūtehi tadihi.  // ApTha_54,535.4 //  
Ratanānaṭṭhapaññāsaṃ uggato so mahāmuni /  
kañcanagghiyasaṅkāso battiṃsavaralakkhaṇo[^481-2]  // ApTha_54,535.5 //  
Vassasatasahassāni āyuṃ vijjati tāvade /  
tāvatā tiṭṭhamāno so tāresi janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.6 //  
Tadā 'haṃ Haṃsavatiyā[^481-3] brāhmaṇo sādhusammato /  
upecca lokapajjotaṃ assosiṃ dhammadesanaṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.7 //  
Tadā mahāparisatiṃ[^481-4] mahāpurisasāvakaṃ /  
ṭhapentaṃ etadaggamhi sutvāna mudito ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.8 //  
Mahatā parivārena[^481-5] nimantetvā mahājinaṃ[^481-6] /  
brāhmaṇānaṃ sahassena saha dānaṃ ahaṃ adaṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.9 //  
Mahādānaṃ daditvāna abhivādiya nāyakaṃ /  
ekamantaṃ ṭhito haṭṭho imaṃ[^481-7] vacanam abraviṃ:  // ApTha_54,535.10 //  
Tayi[^481-8] saddhāya me vīra[^481-9] adhikāraguṇena ca /  
parisā mahatī hotu nibbattissa tahiṃ tahiṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.11 //  
Tadā avoca parisaṃ gajagajjita-sussaro[^481-10] /  
karavīkarudo satthā: etaṃ[^481-11] passatha brāhmaṇaṃ  // ApTha_54,535.12 //  
Hemavaṇṇaṃ[^481-12] mahābāhuṃ kamalānanalocanaṃ /  
udaggatanujaṃ haṭṭhaṃ sandhāvantaguṇaṃ mamaṃ[^481-13]  // ApTha_54,535.13 //  
Esa patthayate[^481-14] ṭhānaṃ sīhaghosassa bhikkhuno /  
anāgatamhi addhāne lacchate taṃ manorathaṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.14 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_54,535.15 //

##### *[PTS Page 482]*

Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimito /  
Kassapo nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_54,535.16 //  
Ito dvenavute kappe ahu[^482-1] satthā anuttaro /  
anupamo asadiso Phusso lokagganāyako.  // ApTha_54,535.17 //  
Sa ve[^482-2] sabbatamaṃ hantvā[^482-3] vijaṭetvā[^482-4] mahājaṭaṃ[^482-5] /  
vassate amataṃ vuṭṭhiṃ[^482-6] tappayanto sadevakaṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.18 //  
Tadā hi Bārāṇasiyaṃ rājāmaccā[^482-7] ahumhase /  
bhātaro 'mha tayo sabbe saṃvissatthā[^482-8] va rājino.  // ApTha_54,535.19 //  
Vīraṅgarūpā balino saṅgāme aparājitā /  
tadā kupitapaccanto amhe āha mahīpatī:  // ApTha_54,535.20 //  
Etha gantvā va paccantaṃ sodhetvā[^482-9] avidhī-balaṃ[^482-10] /  
khemaṃ me vijitaṃ katvā puna-r-ethā[^482-11] ti bhāsatha.[^482-12]  // ApTha_54,535.21 //  
Tato mayaṃ avocumha yadi deyyāsi nāyakaṃ /  
upaṭṭhānāya amhākaṃ sodhayissāma te[^482-13] tato.  // ApTha_54,535.22 //  
Tato mayaṃ laddhavarā bhumipālena pesitā /  
nikkhittasatthaṃ[^482-14] paccantaṃ katvā punar upecca[^482-15] taṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.23 //  
Yācitvā[^482-16] satth'; upaṭṭhānaṃ[^482-17] rājānaṃ lokanāyakaṃ /  
munivaraṃ[^482-18] labhitvāna yāvajīvaṃ adimha[^482-19] taṃ  // ApTha_54,535.24 //  
Mahagghāni ca vatthāni paṇītāni rasāni ca /  
senāsanāni rammāni bhesajjāni hitāni ca.  // ApTha_54,535.25 //  
Datvā sasaṅghassa muṇe dhammen'; uppādi-tādino /  
sīlavanto kāruṇikā bhāvanāyuttamānasā.[^482-20]  // ApTha_54,535.26 //  
Sadā[^482-21] paricaritvāna mettacittena nāyakaṃ /  
nibbute tamhi lokagge[^482-22] pūjaṃ katvā yathābalaṃ  // ApTha_54,535.27 //  
Tato cutā Santusitaṃ[^482-23] gatā tattha mahāsukhaṃ /  
anubhutā mayaṃ sabbe Buddhapūjāy'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.28 //

Māyākāro yathā laddho[^483-1] dasseti[^483-2] vikatiṃ[^483-3] bahuṃ /  
tathā bhave bhavanto[^483-4] 'haṃ Videhādhipati ahuṃ.[^483-5]  // ApTha_54,535.29 //  
Guṇ'; Ācelassa[^483-6] vākyena micchādiṭṭhihatāsayo /  
narakaṃ maggam[^483-7] ārūḷho. Rujāya[^483-8] mama dhītuyā  // ApTha_54,535.30 //  
Ovādaṃ nādayitvāna brahmunā Nāraden'; ahaṃ /  
bahuṃ va sāsito santo[^483-9] diṭṭhiṃ hitvāna pāpikaṃ.[^483-10]  // ApTha_54,535.31 //  
Pūrayitvā[^483-11] visesena dasakammapathen'; ahaṃ /  
hitvāna deham agamiṃ saggaṃ sabhavanaṃ yathā.  // ApTha_54,535.32 //  
Pacchime bhavasampatte[^483-12] brahmabandhu ahos'; ahaṃ /  
Bārāṇasiyaṃ pi tāyaṃ jāto vippamahākule.  // ApTha_54,535.33 //  
Maccuvyādhijarābhīto[^483-13] hitvāna ca[^483-14] mahādhanaṃ[^483-15] /  
nibbānapadam esanto[^483-16] Jaṭilesu paribbajiṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.34 //  
Tadā dve bhātato mayhaṃ pabbajiṃsu mayā saha /  
Uruvelāya māpetvā assamaṃ nivasiṃ[^483-17] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,535.35 //  
Kassapo nāma gottena Uruvelā-nivāsitā[^483-18] /  
tato me āsi paññatti[^483-19] Uruvelāsu Kassapo.  // ApTha_54,535.36 //  
Nadīsakāse bhātā me Nadī-kassapasavhayo /  
āsi sakāse[^483-20] nāmena Gayāya[^483-21] Gayakassapo  // ApTha_54,535.37 //  
Dve satāni; Nadīkassa[^483-22] tīṇi majjhassa bhātuno /  
*mama pañcasatā*nūnā sissā sabbe mamānugā.  // ApTha_54,535.38 //  
Tadā upecca me Buddho katvā nānāvidhāni me /  
pāṭihīrāni lokaggo vinesi[^483-23] narasārathi  // ApTha_54,535.39 //  
Satasahassaparivārena ahosiṃ,[^483-24] ‘ehi bhikkhavo'[^483-25] /  
teh'; eva saha sabbehi a*rahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.*  // ApTha_54,535.40 //

Te ca-r-aññe 'va[^484-1] bahavo sissā[^484-2] maṃ parivārayuṃ /  
sāsituñ ca samattho 'haṃ tato[^484-3] maṃ isisattamo  // ApTha_54,535.41 //  
Mahāparisabhāvasmiṃ etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ /  
aho Buddhe[^484-4] kataṃ kāraṃ saphalam me ajāyatha.[^484-5]  // ApTha_54,535.42 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,535.43 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,535.44 //

[536. Rādha.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbalokavidū muni /  
ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji cakkhumā.  // ApTha_54,536.1 //  
Ovādako viññāpako tārako sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
desanākusalo Buddho tāresi janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_54,536.2 //  
Anukampako kāruṇiko hitesi sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
sampatte titthiye sabbe pañcasīle patiṭṭhapi  // ApTha_54,536.3 //  
Evaṃ nirākulaṃ āsi[^484-6] suññataṃ titthiyehi[^484-7] ca /  
vicittaṃ arahantehi vasībhūtehi tādihi.  // ApTha_54,536.4 //  
Ratanānaṭṭhapaññāsaṃ uggato so mahāmuni /  
kañcanagghiyasaṅkāso battiṃsavaralakkhaṇo.  // ApTha_54,536.5 //  
Vassasatasahassāni āyuṃ vijjati tāvade /  
tāvatā tiṭṭhamāno so[^484-8] tāresi janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_54,536.6 //  
Tadā 'haṃ Haṃsavatiyā[^484-9] brāhmaṇo mantapāragū /  
upecca taṃ naravaraṃ assosiṃ dhammadesanaṃ  // ApTha_54,536.7 //  
Paññāpentaṃ mahāvīraṃ parisāsu visāradaṃ /  
paṭibhāneyyakaṃ bhikkhum etadagge vināyakaṃ.  // ApTha_54,536.8 //  
Tadā 'haṃ kāraṃ katvāna sasaṅghe lokanāyake /  
nipacca sirasā pāde taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhipatthayiṃ.  // ApTha_54,536.9 //  
Tato maṃ bhagavā āha siṅginikkhasamappabho[^484-10] /  
sarena rajanīyena kilesamalahāriṇā.[^484-11]  // ApTha_54,536.10 //  
Sukhī bhavassu dīghāyu sijjhataṃ paṇidhī tava[^484-12] /  
sasaṅghe me kataṃ kāram atīva vipulaṃ tayā.  // ApTha_54,536.11 //


<!-- PTS Page 485 -->
<a id="page-485"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 485]*

Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_54,536.12 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Rādho ti nāmadheyyena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_54,536.13 //  
Sake hetuguṇe[^485-1] tuṭṭho Sakyaputto narāsabho /  
paṭibhāneyyakānaggaṃ paññapessati[^485-2] nāyako.  // ApTha_54,536.14 //  
Taṃ sutvā mudito hutvā yāvajīvaṃ tadā jinaṃ /  
mettacitto paricariṃ sato paññāsamāhito.[^485-3]  // ApTha_54,536.15 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ[^485-4] agacch'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,536.16 //  
Satānaṃ tīṇikkhattuñ ca devarajjam akārayiṃ /  
satānaṃ pañcakkhattuñ ca cakkavatti ahos'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,536.17 //  
Padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ /  
sabbattha sukhito āsiṃ tassa kammassa vāhasā.  // ApTha_54,536.18 //  
Pacchime bhavasampatte[^485-5] Giribbajapuruttame /  
jāto vippakule n'; iddhe[^485-6] vikalacchādanāsane.  // ApTha_54,536.19 //  
Kaṭacchubhikkhaṃ pādāsiṃ Sāriputtassa tādino /  
yadā jiṇṇo ca vuddho[^485-7] ca tadārāmam upāgamiṃ.  // ApTha_54,536.20 //  
Pabbājenti na maṃ keci jiṇṇam dubbalathāmakaṃ[^485-8] /  
tena jiṇṇo[^485-9] vivaṇṇaṅgo soko c'; āsiṃ[^485-10] tadā ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,536.21 //  
Disvā mahākāruṇiko mam āha sa mahāmuni: /  
kimatthaṃ putta sokaṭṭo? brūhi te cittajaṃ rujaṃ.  // ApTha_54,536.22 //  
Pabbajjaṃ na labhe vīra svākkhāte tava sāsane /  
tena sokena dīno 'smi; saraṇaṃ hohi nāyaka.[^485-11]  // ApTha_54,536.23 //  
Tadā bhikkhū samānetvā āpucchi munisattamo /  
imassa adhikāraṃ ye sarantā[^485-12] vyāharantu te.  // ApTha_54,536.24 //  
Sariputto tadāvoca: kāram assa sarāmi 'haṃ /  
kaṭacchubhikkhaṃ dāpesi piṇḍāya carato mama.  // ApTha_54,536.25 //  
Sādhu sādhu kataññāsi[^485-13] Sāriputta; imaṃ tuvaṃ /  
pabbājesi dijaṃ vuḍḍhaṃ hessat'; ājāniyo ayaṃ.  // ApTha_54,536.26 //

Tato alatthaṃ pabbajjaṃ kammavācopasampadaṃ /  
naciren'; eva kālena pāpuṇiṃ āsavakkhayaṃ.  // ApTha_54,536.27 //  
Sakkaccaṃ munino vākyaṃ suṇāmi mudito sato /  
paṭibhāneyyakānaggaṃ tato maṃ ṭhapayī jino.  // ApTha_54,536.28 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,536.29 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,536.30 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,536.31 //

[537. Mogharāja.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbalokavidū muni /  
ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji cakkhumā.  // ApTha_54,537.1 //  
Ovādako viññāpako tārako sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
desanākusalo Buddho tāresi janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_54,537.2 //  
Anukampako kāruṇiko hitesī sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
sampatte titthiye sabbe pañcasīle patiṭṭhapi.[^486-1]  // ApTha_54,537.3 //  
Evaṃ nirākulaṃ āsi suññataṃ titthiyehi ca /  
vicittaṃ arahantehi vasībhūtehi tādihi.  // ApTha_54,537.4 //  
Ratanānaṭṭhapaññāsaṃ uggato so mahāmuni /  
kañcanagghiyasaṅkāso battiṃsavaralakkhaṇo.  // ApTha_54,537.5 //  
Vassasatasahassāni āyuṃ vijjati tāvade /  
tāvatā tiṭṭhamāno so tāresi janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApTha_54,537.6 //  
Tadā 'haṃ Haṃsavatiyā[^486-2] kule aññatare ahuṃ /  
parakammāyane yutto n'; atthi me kiñci sandhanaṃ.[^486-3]  // ApTha_54,537.7 //  
Paṭikkamanasālāyaṃ vasanto katabhūmiyaṃ /  
aggiṃ ujjālayiṃ tattha daḷhakaṇhā siyā mahī.[^486-4]  // ApTha_54,537.8 //  
Tadā parisatiṃ[^486-5] nātho catusaccapakāsako /  
sāvakaṃ sampakittesi lūkhacīvaradhārakaṃ.  // ApTha_54,537.9 //  
Tassa tamhi[^486-6] guṇe tuṭṭho paṇipacca[^486-7] Tathāgataṃ /  
lūkhacīvaradhāraggaṃ[^486-8] patthayiṃ ṭhānam uttamaṃ.  // ApTha_54,537.10 //  
Tadā avoca bhagavā sāvake Padumuttaro: /  
passath'; etaṃ purisakaṃ kucelaṃ tanudehakaṃ  // ApTha_54,537.11 //


<!-- PTS Page 487 -->
<a id="page-487"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 487]*

Pītippasannavadanaṃ saddhādhanasamanvitaṃ /  
udaggatanujaṃ[^487-1] haṭṭhaṃ acalaṃ sālapiṇḍitaṃ.[^487-2]  // ApTha_54,537.12 //  
Eso pattheti taṃ ṭhānaṃ saccasenassa[^487-3] bhikkhuno /  
lūkhacīvaradhārissa[^487-4] tassa vaṇṇagatāsayo.[^487-5]  // ApTha_54,537.13 //  
Taṃ sutvā mudito hutvā nipacca sirasā jinaṃ /  
yāvajīvaṃ subhaṃ kammaṃ karitvā jinasāsane.  // ApTha_54,537.14 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsūpago ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,537.15 //  
Paṭikkamanasālāyaṃ bhumiḍāhakakammanā[^487-6] /  
samasahassaṃ niraye aḍayhiṃ vedanaṭṭito.[^487-7]  // ApTha_54,537.16 //  
Tena kammāvasesena pañcajātisatān'; ahaṃ /  
manusso kulajo hutvā tatiyākāraṇ'; aṅkito.[^487-8]  // ApTha_54,537.17 //  
Pañcajātisatān'; eva kuṭṭharogasamappito /  
mahādukkhaṃ anubhaviṃ[^487-9] tassa kammassa vāhasā.  // ApTha_54,537.18 //  
Imamhi bhaddake kappe upaṭṭhitaṃ yasassinaṃ /  
piṇḍapātena tappesiṃ pasannamanaso ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,537.19 //  
Tena kammavisesena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch'[^487-10] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,537.20 //  
Pacchime bhavasampatte ajāyiṃ khattiye kule /  
pituno accayenāhaṃ mahārajjasamappito.  // ApTha_54,537.21 //  
Kuṭṭharogābhibhūto 'haṃ na[^487-11] rattiyaṃ sukhaṃ labhe /  
mogharajjasukhaṃ[^487-12] yasmā mogharāja tato ahaṃ.  // ApTha_54,537.22 //  
Kāyassa dosaṃ disvāna pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ /  
Bāvariyassa dijaggassa[^487-13] sissattaṃ[^487-14] ajjhupāgamiṃ.[^487-15]  // ApTha_54,537.23 //  
Mahatā parivārena upecca naranāyakaṃ /  
apucchiṃ[^487-16] nipuṇaṃ pañhaṃ vāg-īsaṃ vādisūdanaṃ.[^487-17]  // ApTha_54,537.24 //  
"Ayaṃ loko paro loko brahmaloko sadevako /  
diṭṭhi no,[^487-18] nābhijānāmi Gotamassa yasassiṇo?  // ApTha_54,537.25 //

Evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ atthi pañhena āgamaṃ[^488-1] /  
kathaṃ[^488-2] lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ[^488-3] Maccurājā na passati? "  // ApTha_54,537.26 //

attānudiṭṭhiṃ[^488-6] uhacca[^488-7] evaṃ maccutaro[^488-8] siyā.  // ApTha_54,537.27 //  
Evaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ[^488-9] Maccurājā na passāti" /  
iti maṃ abhaṇī Buddho sabbarogatikicchako.  // ApTha_54,537.28 //  
Saha-gāthāvasānena[^488-10] kesamassu-vivajjito /

Puññapāpaparikkhīṇo sabbarogavivajjito /  
sikhī va anupādāno nibbāyissām'; anāsavo.  // ApTha_54,537.33 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,537.34 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,537.35 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_54,537.36 //

Uruvela-Kassapo Rādho Mogharājā ca paṇḍito tīṇi gāthā satān'; ettha bāsaṭṭhiñ c'; eva[^488-13] piṇḍitā. Kaccānavaggo catupaññāso.[^488-14]

[538. Lakuṇṭakabhaddiya.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammesu cakkhumā /  
ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji cakkhumā.[^489-1]  // ApTha_55,538.1 //  
Tadā 'haṃ Haṃsavatiyā[^489-2] seṭṭhiputto mahādhano /  
jaṅghāvihāraṃ vicaraṃ saṅghārāmam agacch'[^489-3] ahaṃ  // ApTha_55,538.2 //  
Tadā so lokapajjoto dhammaṃ desesi[^489-4] nāyako /  
mañjussarānaṃ[^489-5] pavaraṃ sāvakaṃ abhikittayi.[^489-6]  // ApTha_55,538.3 //  
Taṃ sutvā mudito hutvā kāraṃ katvā mahesino /  
vanditvā satthuno pāde taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhipatthayiṃ.  // ApTha_55,538.4 //  
Tadā Buddho viyākāsi[^489-7] saṅghamajjhe vināyako /  
anāgatamhi addhāne lacchase taṃ manorathaṃ.  // ApTha_55,538.5 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_55,538.6 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Bhaddiyo nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_55,538.7 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch[^489-3] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_55,538.8 //  
Dvenavute ito kappe Phusso uppajji nāyako /  
durāsado duppasaho sabbalokuttamo jino.  // ApTha_55,538.9 //  
Caraṇena ca sampanno brahā[^489-8] ujupatāpavā /  
hitesi sabbasattānaṃ bahū mocesi bandhanā.  // ApTha_55,538.10 //  
Nandārāmavare[^489-9] tassa ahosiṃ phussakokilo[^489-10] /  
gandhakuṭisamāsanne[^489-11] ambarukkhe vasām'; ahaṃ.  // ApTha_55,538.11 //  
Tadā piṇḍāya gacchantaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ jinuttamaṃ /  
disvā cittaṃ pasādetvā mañjunā abhikūj'; ahaṃ[^489-12]  // ApTha_55,538.12 //  
Rājuyyānaṃ tadā gantvā supakkaṃ kanakattacaṃ /  
ambapiṇḍaṃ gahetvāna sambuddhass'; opanāmayiṃ.  // ApTha_55,538.13 //  
Tadā me cittam aññāya mahākāruṇiko jino /  
uppaṭṭhākassa hatthato pattaṃ paggaṇhi nāyako.  // ApTha_55,538.14 //


<!-- PTS Page 490 -->
<a id="page-490"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 490]*

Dadāmi haṭṭhacitto 'haṃ ambapiṇḍam mahāmune /  
patte pakkhippa pakkhehi pañjaliṃ katvāna,[^490-1] mañjunā  // ApTha_55,538.15 //  
Sarena rajanīyena[^490-2] savanīyena dhaṃsanā[^490-3] /  
vassanto Buddhapūjatthaṃ[^490-4] niddaṃ gantvā[^490-5] nipajj'; ahaṃ  // ApTha_55,538.16 //  
Tadā muditacittaṃ maṃ Buddhapemagatāsayaṃ /  
sakuṇagghi[^490-6] upagantvā ghātayi duṭṭhamānasā.[^490-7]  // ApTha_55,538.17 //  
Tato cuto 'haṃ Tusite anubhotvā mahāsukhaṃ /  
manussayoniṃ āgacchiṃ[^490-8] tassa kammassa vāhasā.  // ApTha_55,538.18 //  
Imamhi bhaddake kappe brahmabandhu mahāyaso /  
Kassapo nāma gottena uppajji vadataṃ varo.  // ApTha_55,538.19 //  
Sāsanaṃ jotayitvā so abhibhuyya kutitthiye /  
vinayitvā ca veneyye[^490-9] nibbuto so sasāvako.  // ApTha_55,538.20 //  
Nibbute tamhi lokagge pasannā janatā bahū /  
pūjanatthāya Buddhassa thūpaṃ kubbanti satthuno.  // ApTha_55,538.21 //  
Sattayojanikaṃ thūpaṃ sattaratanavibhūsitaṃ /  
kāressāma mahesissa: icc evaṃ mantayanti te.  // ApTha_55,538.22 //  
Kikino Kāsirājassā[^490-10] tadā senāya nāyako /  
hutvā 'haṃ appamāṇassa pamāṇaṃ cetiye vadiṃ.[^490-11]  // ApTha_55,538.23 //  
Tadā te mama vākyena cetiyaṃ yojanuggataṃ /  
akaṃsu naravīrassa nānāratanabhūsitaṃ.  // ApTha_55,538.24 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch'[^490-12] ahaṃ.  // ApTha_55,538.25 //  
Pacchime ca bhave dāni jāto seṭṭhikule ahaṃ /  
Sāvatthiyaṃ puravare iddhe phīte[^490-13] mahādhane.  // ApTha_55,538.26 //  
Purappavese sugataṃ disvā vimhitamānaso /  
pabbajitvāna naciraṃ arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApTha_55,538.27 //  
Cetiyassa pamāṇaṃ yaṃ akariṃ[^490-14] tena kammena[^490-15] /  
lakuṇṭakasarīro 'haṃ jāto paribhavāraho.  // ApTha_55,538.28 //  
Sareṇa madhureṇāhaṃ pūjetvā isisattamaṃ /  
mañjussarānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aggattam anupāpuṇiṃ.[^490-16]  // ApTha_55,538.29 //

sāmaññaphalasampanno viharāmi anāsavo.  // ApTha_55,538.30 //

[539. Kaṅkha-Revata.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammesu[^491-2] cakkhumā /  
ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji nāyako  // ApTha_55,539.1 //  
Sīhahanu brahmagiro haṃsadundrabhinisvano[^491-3] /  
nāgavikkantagamano candasūrādhikappabho  // ApTha_55,539.2 //  
Mahāmati mahāvīro mahājhāyī mahāhito[^491-4] /  
mahākāruṇiko nātho mahātamanisūdano.[^491-5]  // ApTha_55,539.3 //  
Sa kadāci tilokaggo veneyyavinayaṃ[^491-6] bahuṃ /  
dhammaṃ deseti sambuddho sattāsayavidū muni.  // ApTha_55,539.4 //  
Jhāyiṃ jhānarataṃ vīraṃ upasantaṃ anāvilaṃ /  
vaṇṇayanto parisatiṃ[^491-7] toseti janataṃ jino.  // ApTha_55,539.5 //  
Tadā 'haṃ Haṃsavatiyā[^491-8] brāhmaṇo vedapāragū /  
dhammaṃ sutvāna mudito taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhipatthayiṃ.  // ApTha_55,539.6 //  
Tadā jino viyākāsi[^491-9] saṅghamajjhe vināyako /  
mudito hohi[^491-10] tvaṃ brahme, lacchase taṃ manorathaṃ.  // ApTha_55,539.7 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApTha_55,539.8 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Revato nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.  // ApTha_55,539.9 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch[^491-11] ahaṃ  // ApTha_55,539.10 //  
Pacchime ca bhave dāni jāto 'haṃ Koliye pure /  
khattiye kulasampanne iddhe phīte[^491-12] mahaddhane.  // ApTha_55,539.11 //

Yadā Kapilavatthusmiṃ Buddho dhammam adesayi /  
tadā pasanno sugate pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ.  // ApTha_55,539.12 //  
Kaṅkhā me bahuso āsi kappākappe[^492-1] tahiṃ tahiṃ /  
sabbaṃ taṃ vinayī[^492-2] Buddho desetvā dhammam uttamaṃ  // ApTha_55,539.13 //  
Tato 'haṃ tiṇṇasaṃsāro tadā jhānasukhe rato /  
viharāmi, tadā Buddho maṃ disvā etad abravi:  // ApTha_55,539.14 //  
"Yā kāci kaṅkhā idha vā huraṃ vā sakavediyā[^492-3] vā paravediyā[^492-4] vā /  
Jhāyino tā pajahanti sabbā ātāpino brahmacariyaṃ carantā."[^492-5]  // ApTha_55,539.15 //  
Satasahasse kataṃ kammaṃ phalaṃ dassesi me idha /  
sumutto sara*vego va ki*lese jhāpayiṃ[^492-6] mamaṃ.  // ApTha_55,539.16 //  
Tato maṃ jhānanirataṃ[^492-7] disvā lokantagū muni /  
jhāyīnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aggo ti[^492-8] paññāpesi mahāmuni.[^492-9]  // ApTha_55,539.17 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_55,539.18 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_55,539.19 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApTha_55,539.20 //
