vihārā abhinikkhamma {piṇḍapātāya} gacchati.  // ApThi_3,23.3 //  
Ghaṭaṃ gahetvā gacchantī tadā udakahārikā /  
taṃ disvā adadaṃ sūpaṃ[^567-7] pasannā sehi pāṇihi.  // ApThi_3,23.4 //  
Paṭiggahetvā tatth'; eva nisinno paribhuñji so /  
tato netvāna taṃ gehaṃ[^567-8] adāsiṃ[^567-9] tassa bhojanaṃ.[^567-10]  // ApThi_3,23.5 //  
Tato me ayyako[^567-11] tuṭṭho akari[^567-12] suṇisaṃ sakaṃ /  
sassuyā sahagantvāna[^567-13] sambuddhaṃ abhivādayiṃ.  // ApThi_3,23.6 //  
Tadā so dhammakathikaṃ bhikkhuniṃ parikittayaṃ /  
ṭhapesi etadaggamhi; taṃ sutvā muditā ahaṃ.  // ApThi_3,23.7 //

[24. Sakulā.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū /  
ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji nāyako.  // ApThi_3,24.1 //  
Hitāya sabbasattānaṃ sukhāya vadataṃ[^569-11] varo /  
atthāya purisājañño paṭipanno sadevake.  // ApThi_3,24.2 //

##### *[PTS Page 570]*

Yasaggappatto sirimā kittivaṇṇagato[^570-1] jino /  
jino sabbassa lokassa[^570-2] disā sabbā suvissuto.[^570-3]  // ApThi_3,24.3 //  
Uttiṇṇavicikiccho[^570-4] so vītivattakathaṃkatho /  
sampuṇṇamanasaṅkappo patto sambodhim uttamaṃ.  // ApThi_3,24.4 //  
Anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā naruttamo /  
anakkhātañ ca akkhāsi asañjātam[^570-5] ca sañjanī.[^570-6]  // ApThi_3,24.5 //  
Maggaññū ca maggavidū maggakkhāyī narāsabho /  
maggassa kusalo satthā sārathīnaṃ varuttamo.  // ApThi_3,24.6 //  
Mahākāruṇiko satthā dhammaṃ deseti[^570-7] nāyako /  
nimugge mohapaṅkamhi[^570-8] samuddharati pāṇino.  // ApThi_3,24.7 //  
Tadā 'haṃ Haṃsavatiyaṃ jātā khattiyanandanā /  
surūpā sadhanā-ṭhāsiṃ[^570-9] dayitā 'va[^570-10] sirīmatī.  // ApThi_3,24.8 //  
Ānandassa mahārañño dhītā paramasobhanā /  
vemātā[^570-11] bhaginī cāpi Padumuttaranāmino.  // ApThi_3,24.9 //  
Rājakaññāhi sahitā sabbābharaṇabhūsitā /  
upagamma mahāvīraṃ assosiṃ dhammadesanaṃ.  // ApThi_3,24.10 //  
Tadā hi so lokaguru bhikkhuniṃ dibbacakkhukiṃ[^570-12] /  
kittayī[^570-13] parisāmajjhe[^570-14] agge ṭhāne[^570-15] ṭhapesi taṃ.[^570-16]  // ApThi_3,24.11 //  
Suṇitvā taṃ ahaṃ haṭṭhā dānaṃ datvāna satthuno /  
pūjetvāna[^570-17] ca sambuddhaṃ dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ[^570-18] apatthayiṃ.[^570-19]  // ApThi_3,24.12 //  
Tato avoca maṃ satthā: ‘Nande[^570-20] lacchasi[^570-21] patthitaṃ /  
padīpadhammadānānaṃ phalam etaṃ su-n-icchitaṃ.'[^570-22]  // ApThi_3,24.13 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApThi_3,24.14 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādā orasā dhammanimmitā /  
Sakulā[^570-23] nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvikā.  // ApThi_3,24.15 //

Yassa[^572-1] c'; atthāya pabbajitā agārasmā 'nagāriyaṃ /  
so me attho anuppatto sabbasaṃyojanakkhayo.  // ApThi_3,24.31 //

Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApThi_3,24.33 //

Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApThi_3,24.35 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ Sakulā[^572-4] bhikkhunī i. g. a-ti. Sakulā theriyā[^572-5] apadānaṃ samattaṃ.

[25. Nandā (Janapadakalyāṇī).] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū /  
ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji nāyako.  // ApThi_3,25.1 //  
Ovādako viññāpako tārako[^572-6] sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
desanākusalo Buddho tāresi janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApThi_3,25.2 //  
Anukampako kāruṇiko hitesī[^572-7] sabbapāṇinaṃ /  
sampatte titthiye sabbe pañcasīle patiṭṭhapi.[^572-8]  // ApThi_3,25.3 //  
Evaṃ nirākulaṃ āsi[^572-9] suññataṃ[^572-10] titthiyehi ca /  
vicittaṃ arahantehi vasībhūtehi tādihi.  // ApThi_3,25.4 //  
Ratanān'; aṭṭhapaññāsaṃ uggato so[^572-11] mahāmuṇi /  
kañcanagghiyasaṅkāso battiṃsavaralakkhaṇo.  // ApThi_3,25.5 //  
Vassasahasahassāni āyu tiṭṭhati[^572-12] tāvade /  
tāvatā tiṭṭhamāno so tāresi janataṃ bahuṃ.  // ApThi_3,25.6 //  
Tadā'; haṃ Haṃsavatiyaṃ jātā seṭṭhikule ahuṃ[^572-13] /  
nānāratanapajjote mahāsukhasamappitā.  // ApThi_3,25.7 //  
Upetvā taṃ mahāvīraṃ assosiṃ dhammadesanaṃ /  
amataṃ paramassādaṃ paramatthanivedakaṃ.[^572-14]  // ApThi_3,25.8 //  
Tadā nimantayitvāna sasaṅghaṃ tibhavantagaṃ[^572-15] /  
datvā tassa mahādānaṃ pasannā sehi pāṇihi.  // ApThi_3,25.9 //

Jhāyinīnaṃ[^573-1] bhikkhunīnaṃ aggaṭṭhānaṃ apatthayiṃ /

Tadā adantadamako[^573-2] tilokasaraṇo[^573-3] pabhū /  
vyākāsi[^573-4] narasaddūlo[^573-5]: "lacchas'; etaṃ supatthitaṃ.  // ApThi_3,25.11 //

Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApThi_3,25.12 //

Nandā ti nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvikā".  // ApThi_3,25.13 //

Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch'; ahaṃ.  // ApThi_3,25.15 //  
Tato cutā Yāmam agaṃ[^573-6] tato 'haṃ Tusitaṃ agaṃ[^573-7] /

Yattha yatthopapajjāmi[^573-9] tassa kammassa vāhasā /

Tato cutā manussatte rājūnaṃ cakkavattinaṃ /  
maṇḍalīnaṃ 'va[^573-10] rājūnaṃ mahesittam akārayiṃ.  // ApThi_3,25.18 //  
Sampattiṃ anubhotvāna devesu manujesu ca /  
sabbattha sukhitā hutvā 'nekakappesu saṃsariṃ.  // ApThi_3,25.19 //  
Pacchime bhavasampatte suramme Kapilavhaye /

Siriyā[^573-12] rūpiniṃ[^573-13] disvā nanditaṃ āsi taṃ kulaṃ /

Yuvatīnañ ca sabbāsaṃ kalyāṇī ti ca[^573-15] vissutā /

Jarāvasānaṃ[^574-6] yobbaññaṃ rūpaṃ asucisammataṃ /  
rogantam api c'; ārogyaṃ[^574-7] jīvitaṃ maraṇantikaṃ.  // ApThi_3,25.25 //  
Idam pi te subhaṃ rūpaṃ passa kantaṃ[^574-8] manoharaṃ[^574-9] /

Pūjitaṃ[^574-12] lokasāraṃ va[^574-13] nayanānaṃ rasāyanaṃ[^574-14] /

Naciren'; eva kālena jarā samadhihessati[^574-15] /

Sutvāham mātu vacanaṃ pabbajiṃ[^574-18] anagāriyaṃ /

Tam ahaṃ vimhitā disvā avinicchitadehiniṃ[^574-24] /

Tam āham "ehi subhage yen'; attho taṃ vadehi me /

Na pañhakālo[^575-1] subhage ucchaṅge maṃ nivesaya[^575-2] /

Saha tassā nipātena piḷakā udapajjatha[^575-8] /

Sambhinnaṃ[^575-9] vadanaṃ cāpi kuṇapaṃ pūtigandhikaṃ[^575-10] /  
uddhumātaṃ vinīlañ ca sabbañ[^575-11] cāpi sarīrakaṃ.  // ApThi_3,25.38 //  
Sā pavedhitasabbaṅgī nissayanti[^575-12] muhuṃ muhuṃ /  
vedayantī sakaṃ dukkhaṃ karuṇaṃ paridevayi[^575-13]:  // ApThi_3,25.39 //

mahādukkhe nimugg'; amhi saraṇaṃ hohi[^575-15] me sakhī.  // ApThi_3,25.40 //  
Kuhiṃ vadanasobhan te?  kuhiṃ te tuṅganāsikā? /

Kuhiṃ sasiṃ nibhaṃ[^575-18] vattaṃ?  kambugīvā[^575-19] kuhiṃ gatā? /

Makula-khārak'-ākārā[^575-22] kalasā va payodharā /

jātā abhejjabharitā.[^575-27] Aho rūpam asassataṃ.  // ApThi_3,25.44 //

Tassa dhammesu dāyādā orasā dhammanimmitā /

mettacittā paricariṃ[^577-2] paccayehi vināyakaṃ.  // ApThi_3,26.7 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /

Khandhe aniccato disvā dukkhato ca anattato /

Tadā 'gantvā bhikkhuniyo uṇhodakam apucchisu[^577-25] /

dhammam assosi Buddhassa sabbadukkhakkhayāvahaṃ.[^578-9]  // ApThi_3,27.3 //  
Sāvakaṃ dhutavādānaṃ aggaṃ kittesi nāyako /

Nipacca sirasā pāde taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhipatthayi[^578-11] /  
sa hāsayanto parisaṃ[^578-12] tad'; āha narapuṅgavo  // ApThi_3,27.5 //  
Seṭṭhino anukampāya[^578-13] imā gāthā abhāsatha: /  
"lacchase[^578-14] patthitaṃ ṭhānaṃ, nibbuto hohi[^578-15] puttaka.  // ApThi_3,27.6 //


<!-- PTS Page 579 -->

##### *[PTS Page 579]*

Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApThi_3,27.7 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito /  
Kassapo nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako".  // ApThi_3,27.8 //  
Taṃ sutvā mudito hutvā yāvajīvaṃ tadā jinaṃ /  
mettacitto paricari paccayehi vināyakaṃ.  // ApThi_3,27.9 //  
Sāsanaṃ jotayitvā[^579-1] so madditvāna[^579-2] kutitthiye /  
veneyye vinayitvā so[^579-3] ca nibbuto so sasāvako.  // ApThi_3,27.10 //  
Nibbute tamhi lokagge pūjanatthāya satthuno /  
ñātimitte samānetvā saha tehi akārayiṃ[^579-4]  // ApThi_3,27.11 //  
Sattayojanikaṃ thūpaṃ ubbiddhaṃ ratanāmayaṃ /  
jalantaṃ sataraṃsī va sālarājaṃ va phullitaṃ.[^579-5]  // ApThi_3,27.12 //  
Sattasatasahassāni[^579-6] pātiyo tattha[^579-7] kārayiṃ /  
nalaggi[^579-8] viya jotante rataneh'; eva sattahi.  // ApThi_3,27.13 //  
Gandhatelena[^579-9] pūretvā dīpā 'nujjalayiṃ tahiṃ /  
pūjatthāya[^579-10] mahesissa sabbabhūtānukampino.  // ApThi_3,27.14 //  
Sattasatasahassāni[^579-6] puṇṇakumbhān'; akārayiṃ[^579-11] /  
rataneh'; eva puṇṇāni pūjatthāya mahesino.  // ApThi_3,27.15 //  
Majjhe aṭṭh'; aṭṭha kumbhīnaṃ[^579-12] ussitā kañcanagghiyā[^579-13] /  
atirocanti vaṇṇena sārade[^579-14] va divākaro.[^579-15]  // ApThi_3,27.16 //  
Catudvāresu sobhanti toraṇā ratanāmayā /  
ussitā[^579-16] phalakā rammā sobhanti ratanāmayā.  // ApThi_3,27.17 //  
Virocanti parikkhittā avataṃsā[^579-17] sunimmitā /  
ussitāni patākāni ratanāni virocare.  // ApThi_3,27.18 //  
Surattaṃ sukataṃ cittaṃ[^579-18] cetiyaṃ ratanāmayaṃ /  
atirocati vaṇṇena sasañjhā va[^579-19] divākaro.  // ApThi_3,27.19 //

##### *[PTS Page 580]*

Thūpassa medhiyo tisso[^580-1] haritālena pūrayiṃ /  
ekaṃ[^580-2] manosilāy'; ekaṃ añjanena ca ekikaṃ.[^580-3]  // ApThi_3,27.20 //

adāsi dānaṃ saṅghassa yāvajīvaṃ yathābalaṃ.  // ApThi_3,27.21 //  
Sahā 'haṃ[^580-5] seṭṭhinā tena tāni puññāni sabbaso /  
yāvajīvaṃ karitvāna sahā 'va sugatiṃ ahaṃ.[^580-6]  // ApThi_3,27.22 //  
Sampattiyo 'nubhotvāna[^580-7] devatte atha mānuse /  
chāyā viya sarīrena saha ten'; eva saṃsariṃ.  // ApThi_3,27.23 //  
Ekanavute ito kappe Vipassī nāma nāyako /  
uppajji cārunayano[^580-8] sabbadhammavipassako.[^580-9]  // ApThi_3,27.24 //  
Tadā hi[^580-10] Bandhumatiyā[^580-11] brāhmaṇo sādhusammato /  
aḍḍho santo[^580-12] gamenāsi[^580-13] dhanena ca suduggato.[^580-14]  // ApThi_3,27.25 //

[29. Yasovatī-pamukkhāni dasabhikkhunī sahassāni.] Kappe ca satasahasse ca caturo ca asaṅkhiye /

Sumedhañ ca Sumittañ ca samānasukhadukkhataṃ  // ApThi_3,29.2 //

tesaṃ pakittane amha[^591-2] *upaggamma* samāgamaṃ.  // ApThi_3,29.3 //  
Amhaṃ sabbā patī honti anāgatasamāgame[^591-3] /  
sabbā va tuyhaṃ[^591-4] bhariyā manāpā piyavādikā.  // ApThi_3,29.4 //  
Dānasīlam ayaṃ sabbaṃ bhāvanaṃ ca[^591-5] subhāvitaṃ[^591-6] /

Gandhaṃ vilepanaṃ[^591-9] mālaṃ dīpañ ca ratanāmayaṃ /  
yaṃ[^591-10] kiñci patthitaṃ sabbaṃ pariccattaṃ mahāmune[^591-11]  // ApThi_3,29.6 //  
Aññaṃ cāpi kataṃ kammaṃ[^591-12] paribhogañ ca mānusaṃ /  
dīgharattaṃ no[^591-13] sabbaṃ pariccattaṃ mahāmuni.  // ApThi_3,29.7 //  
Anekajātisaṃsāraṃ bahuṃ puññam hi no kataṃ /  
issaram anubhotvāna saṃsaritvā bhavābhave.  // ApThi_3,29.8 //  
Pacchime bhavasampatte[^591-14] Sakyaputta-nivesane /  
nānākulupapannāyo[^591-15] accharā kāmavaṇṇinī.[^591-16]  // ApThi_3,29.9 //  
Lābhaggena *yasa*ppattā[^591-17] pūpitā sabba-sakkatā /  
lābhiyo annapānānaṃ[^591-18] sadā sammānitā[^591-19] mayaṃ.  // ApThi_3,29.10 //  
Agāraṃ pajahitvāna[^591-20] pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ[^591-21] /  
aṭṭhamāse asampatte sabbā[^591-22] patt'; amha[^591-23] nibbutiṃ.  // ApThi_3,29.11 //  
Lābhiyo annapanānaṃ[^591-24] vatthaṃ[^591-25] se*nā*sanāni ca /

Itthaṃ sudaṃ Yasovatī[^592-1] pamukhāni dasabhikkhu*nī* sahassāni bhagavato sammukhā i. g. a-ti. *Āyumāni Yasodharāpamukhānaṃ dasabhikkhunīsahassānaṃ apadānaṃ samattaṃ.*

[30.Yasodharā-pamukhāni aṭṭhārasabhikkhunī sahassāni.] Aṭṭhārasasahassāni bhikkhunī Sakyasambhavā /  
Yasodharī-pamukhāni sambuddhaṃ upasaṅkamuṃ.  // ApThi_3,30.1 //

anāsavaṃ padaṃ santaṃ[^592-4] amataṃ yāma nāyaka.[^592-5]  // ApThi_3,30.3 //  
Khalitañ[^592-6] ce pure atthi sabbāsam pi mahāmuni /

Iddhiñ cāpi nidassetha[^592-8] mama[^592-9] sāsanakārike /  
parisānañ ca sabbāsaṃ kaṅkhaṃ chindatha yāvatā[^592-10]  // ApThi_3,30.5 //  
Yasodharī[^592-11] mahāvīra manāpā piyadassanā /  
sabbā[^592-12] tuyhaṃ mahāvīra agāramhi[^592-13] pajāpatī.[^592-14]  // ApThi_3,30.6 //  
*Thīnaṃ* satasahassānaṃ navutīnañ chaḷ-uttariṃ[^592-15] /  
agāre te mayaṃ vīra pāmokkhā sabba-issarā.  // ApThi_3,30.7 //  
Rūpācāraguṇūpetā yobbanaṭṭhā piyaṃvadā /  
sabbā no apacāyanti devatā viya mānusā.[^592-16]  // ApThi_3,30.8 //  
Aṭṭhārasasahassāni sabbā Sākiyasambhavā /  
Yasovatī[^592-17] sahassāni pāmokkhā issarā tadā.  // ApThi_3,30.9 //

Uddānaṃ: Kuṇḍalā-Gotamī c'; eva Dhammadinnā ca Sākulā Varanandā c'; eva Sonā ca[^596-16] {Kāpilānī} Yasodharā. Dasaṭṭhārasasahassā[^596-17] gāthāyo gaṇitā-v-iha[^596-18] satāni[^596-19] c'; eva cattāri aṭṭhasattatim[^596-20] eva ca. Kuṇḍalakesavaggo[^596-21] tatiyo.

VAGGO IV

[31.Yasavatī-pamukhāni khattiyakaññā bhikkhuniyo aṭṭhārasasahassāni.]

Bhavā sabbe parikkhīṇā bhavasandhivimocitā[^597-1] /  
sabbāsavāmano n'; atthi ārocema mahāmuni.[^597-2]  // ApThi_4,31.1 //  
Purimaṃ kammaṃ kusalaṃ[^597-3] yaṃ kiñci sabbam patthitaṃ[^597-4] /  
paribhogaṃ ayaṃ[^597-5] dinnaṃ tuyh'; atthāya mahāmuni.[^597-2]  // ApThi_4,31.2 //  
Buddhapaccekabuddhānaṃ sāvakānañ ca patthitaṃ /  
paribhogaṃ ayaṃ[^597-5] dinnaṃ tuyhatthāya mahāmuni.[^597-2]  // ApThi_4,31.3 //  
Uccānīcam[^597-6] ayaṃ kammaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ[^597-7] sādhu patthitaṃ /  
uccākulāparikammaṃ[^597-8] kat'; amhehi[^597-9] mahāmune.  // ApThi_4,31.4 //  
Ten'; eva sukkamūlena coditā kammasampadā /  
mānussikam anikkantā[^597-10] jāyiṃsu[^597-11] khattiye kule.  // ApThi_4,31.5 //  
Uppatte 'va kate kamme[^597-12] jātiyā[^597-13] cāpi[^597-14] ekato /  
pacchime ekato jātā khattiyā[^597-15] kulasambhavā.  // ApThi_4,31.6 //  
Rūpavatī bhogavatī lābhasakkārapūjitā /  
antepure mahāvīra devānaṃ viya Nandane.  // ApThi_4,31.7 //  
Nibbinditvā agāramhā pabbajimhā 'nagāriyaṃ /  
katipāhaṃ upādāya sabbā[^597-16] patt'; amha[^597-17] nibbutiṃ.  // ApThi_4,31.8 //  
Cīvaraṃ piṇḍapātañ ca paccayaṃ sayanāsanaṃ /  
upanenti bahuṃ[^597-18] amhe sadā sakkata-pūjitā.  // ApThi_4,31.9 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApThi_4,31.10 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApThi_4,31.11 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApThi_4,31.12 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ Yasavatī pamukhāni khattiyakaññā bhikkhuniyo aṭṭhārasasahassāni bhagavato sammukhā imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti. *Yasavatīpamukhānaṃkhattiyakaññānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ aṭṭhārasasahassānaṃ apadānaṃ samattaṃ.*

[32. Caturāsītiṃ brāhmaṇakaññā bhikkhunī sahassāni.] Cullāsītiṃ[^598-1] sahassāni brahmaññākulasambhavā /  
sukhumālahattha*pā*dā pure tuyhaṃ mahāmuni.[^598-2]  // ApThi_4,32.1 //  
Vessa-sudda-kule jātā devā nāgā ca kinnarā /  
cātuddīpā bahū kaññā pure tuyhaṃ mahāmuni.[^598-2]  // ApThi_4,32.2 //  
Keci pabbajitā atthi saccadassāvino bahū /  
devā ca kinnarā nāgā phusissanti[^598-3] anāgate.  // ApThi_4,32.3 //  
Anubhotvā yasaṃ sabbaṃ patvāna[^598-4] sabbasampadā /  
tvayi[^598-5] pasādaṃ paṭiladdhā[^598-6] bujjhissanti anāgate.  // ApThi_4,32.4 //  
Amhe brāhmaṇadhītā tu brahmaññākulasambhavā[^598-7] /  
pekkhato no mahāvīra pāde vandāma cakkhumā.  // ApThi_4,32.5 //  
Upāgatā bhavā[^598-8] sabbe mūlataṇhā samūhatā /  
samucchinnā anusayā puññasaṅkhāradālitā.  // ApThi_4,32.6 //  
Samādhigocarā sabbā samāpattī *va* sī tathā[^598-9] /  
jhānena dhammaratiyā[^598-10] viharissāma no sadā.[^598-9]  // ApThi_4,32.7 //  
Bhavanetti[^598-11] avijjā ca saṅkhārā pi ca khepitā[^598-12] /  
sududdasaṃ padaṃ gantvā anujānimha[^598-13] nāyaka.  // ApThi_4,32.8 //  
Upakārā mayaṃ tumhe dīgharattaṃ katāvino /  
bahunnaṃ[^598-14] saṃsayaṃ chetvā sabbā gacchatha[^598-15] nibbutiṃ  // ApThi_4,32.9 //  
Vanditvā munino pāde katvā iddhivikubbanaṃ /  
keci dassenti ālokaṃ andhakāraṃ tathāparaṃ.  // ApThi_4,32.10 //  
Dassenti candasuriye sāgarañ ca samacchakaṃ /  
Sineruṃ paribhaṇḍañ ca dassenti pāricchattakaṃ.  // ApThi_4,32.11 //  
Tāvatiṃsañ ca bhavanaṃ Yāmaṃ dassenti iddhiyā /  
Tusitā-Nimmitā-devā Vasavatti-mahissarā.  // ApThi_4,32.12 //  
Brahmāno keci[^598-16] dassenti caṅkamaṃ *ca mahārahaṃ /  
brahmavaṇṇañ ca*māpetvā dhammaṃ desenti suññataṃ.  // ApThi_4,32.13 //  
Nānāvikubbanaṃ katvā iddhiṃ dassetvā satthuno /  
dassayiṃsu balaṃ sabbā pāde vandiṃsu satthuno.  // ApThi_4,32.14 //

Iddhisu ca vasī homa dibbāya sotadhātuyā /

Pubbenivāsaṃ jānāma dibbacakkhuṃ[^599-2] visodhitaṃ /  
sabbāsavā parikkhīṇā n'; atthi dāni punabbhavo.  // ApThi_4,32.16 //  
{Atthadhammaniruttīsu} paṭibhāne tath'; eva ca /  
ñāṇaṃ amhaṃ mahāvīra uppannaṃ tava santike.  // ApThi_4,32.17 //  
Pubbānaṃ[^599-3] lokanāthānaṃ saṅgaman tehi dassitaṃ /  
adhikārā bahū[^599-4] amhe tuyh'; atthāya mahāmuni.[^599-5]  // ApThi_4,32.18 //  
Yaṃ[^599-6] amhaṃ purimaṃ kammaṃ kusalaṃ, sara taṃ muni[^599-7] /  
tuyh'; atthāya mahāvīra puññāni 'pacitāni no[^599-8]  // ApThi_4,32.19 //  
Satasahasse ito kappe Padumuttaro mahāmuni /

Dvārena Haṃsavatiyā[^599-9] Gaṅgā sandati sabbadā /  
Uddā*lana*diyā[^599-10] bhikkhū gamanaṃ na labhanti te.  // ApThi_4,32.21 //  
Divasaṃ dve tayo c'; eva sattā*haṃ* māsikaṃ[^599-11] tato /

Tadā ahu[^599-12] sattasāro jaṭilo[^599-13] nāma raṭṭhiko[^599-14] /

Sataṃsahassehi[^599-16] tadā setuṃ Gaṅgāya[^599-17] kārayiṃ /

Itthiyo purisā[^599-19] c'; eva uccā-nīcakulāni ca /  
tassa setū[^599-20] vihāre ca samabhāgaṃ akaṃsu te.  // ApThi_4,32.25 //  
Amhe aññe ca manujā vippasannena cetasā /

Itthi-pumā[^599-23] kumārā ca bahū c'; eva kumārikā /  
setuno ca vihārassa vālukā ākiriṃsu[^599-24] te.  // ApThi_4,32.27 //

Vīthisammajjanaṃ[^600-1] katvā kadalīpuṇṇakuṭaddhajā /

Setū[^600-5] vihāre kāretvā nimantetvā[^600-6] vināyakaṃ /

Pacchime bhavasampatte[^600-25] ajātā[^600-26] brāhmaṇe kule /

Sabbakālam pi puthaviṃ[^600-27] na passāma n'; alaṅkataṃ /

Agāre[^600-30] vasante amhe sakkāraṃ sabbakālikaṃ /

[33. Uppaladāyikā.] Nagare Aruṇavatiyā Aruṇo[^601-5] nāma khattiyo[^601-6] /  
tassa[^601-7] rañño ahaṃ bhariyā ekaccaṃ[^601-8] vādayām'; ahaṃ[^601-9]  // ApThi_4,33.1 //  
Rahogatā nisīditvā evaṃ cintes'; ahaṃ tadā: /  
kusalaṃ me kataṃ n'; atthi ādāya gamiyam mama.[^601-10]  // ApThi_4,33.2 //  
Mahābhitāpaṃ[^601-11] kaṭukaṃ ghorarūpaṃ sudāruṇaṃ /  
nirayaṃ nūna gacchāmi ettha me n'; atthi saṃsayo.  // ApThi_4,33.3 //  
Evāhaṃ cintayitvāna pahaṃsetvāna[^601-12] mānasaṃ /  
rājānaṃ upagantvā va[^601-13] imaṃ[^601-14] vacanam abraviṃ:  // ApThi_4,33.4 //  
Itthī[^601-15] nāma mayaṃ deva purisānaṃ bharā mayaṃ[^601-16] /  
ekam me samaṇaṃ dehi bhojayissāmi khattiya.[^601-17]  // ApThi_4,33.5 //  
Adāsi me tadā rājā samaṇaṃ bhāvitindriyaṃ /  
tassa pattaṃ[^601-18] gahetvāna paramannena pūrayiṃ.  // ApThi_4,33.6 //

Pūretvā paramaṃ annaṃ sahassaṃ gandhalepanaṃ[^602-1] /  
mahānelena[^602-2] chādetvā[^602-3] adāsiṃ[^602-4] 'tuṭṭhamānasā.  // ApThi_4,33.7 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch'[^602-5] ahaṃ.  // ApThi_4,33.8 //  
Sahassaṃ devarājānaṃ mahesittam[^602-6] akārayiṃ /  
sahassaṃ cakkavattīnaṃ mahesittam[^602-6] akārayiṃ.  // ApThi_4,33.9 //  
Padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto[^602-7] asaṅkhiyaṃ[^602-8] /  
nānāvidhaṃ bahuṃ[^602-9] puññaṃ[^602-10] tassa kammassa phalaṃ[^602-11] tato.  // ApThi_4,33.10 //  
Uppalass'; eva me vaṇṇo abhirūpā sudassanā /  
itthi sabbaṅgasampannā abhijātā jutiṇḍharā.  // ApThi_4,33.11 //  
Pacchime bhavasampatte[^602-12] ajāyiṃ[^602-13] Sākiye kule /  
nārīsahassapāmokkhā[^602-14] Suddhodana-sutass'; ahaṃ.  // ApThi_4,33.12 //  
Nibbinditvā agāre 'haṃ pabbajiṃ[^602-15] anagāriyaṃ /  
sattamīratti[^602-16] appattā[^602-17] catusaccaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.[^602-18]  // ApThi_4,33.13 //  
Cīvaraṃ piṇḍapātañ ca paccayaṃ sayanāsanaṃ /  
parimetuṃ na sakkomi piṇḍapātass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApThi_4,33.14 //  
Yaṃ mayhaṃ purimaṃ kammaṃ kusalaṃ sarase[^602-19] mune[^602-20] /  
tuyh'; atthāya mahāvīra pariccattaṃ bahuṃ mama[^602-21].  // ApThi_4,33.15 //  
Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā /  
duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi piṇḍapātass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApThi_4,33.16 //  
Duve gatī[^602-22] pajānāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ /  
aññaṃ gatiṃ na jānāmi[^602-23] piṇḍapātass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApThi_4,33.17 //  
Ucce kule pajāyāmi tayo sāle[^602-24] mahādhane /  
aññe kule na jānāmi piṇḍapātass'; idaṃ phalaṃ.  // ApThi_4,33.18 //  
Bhavābhave saṃsaritvā sukkamūlena coditā[^602-25] /

[34. Sigālaka-mātā.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū /  
ito satasahassamhi kappe uppajji nāyako.  // ApThi_4,34.1 //

saddhammasavane yuttā Buddhadassanalālasā.[^603-12]  // ApThi_4,34.5 //  
Aggaṃ aṅgavimuttānaṃ assosiṃ[^603-13] bhikkhuniṃ[^603-14] tadā /

##### *[PTS Page 604]*

Sīlañ ca yassa kalyāṇaṃ ariyakantaṃ pasaṃsitaṃ[^604-1] /

Tadā anomo amito vyākarittha vināyako: /

Satasahasse ito kappe Okkākakulasambhavo /  
Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati.  // ApThi_4,34.12 //  
Tassa dhammesu dāyādā orasā dhammanimmitā /  
Siṅgālakassa mātā ti[^604-11] hessati satthu sāvikā.  // ApThi_4,34.13 //  
Taṃ sutvā muditā[^604-12] hutvā yāvajīvaṃ tadā jinaṃ /  
mettacittā paricariṃ paṭipattīhi[^604-13] nāyakaṃ.  // ApThi_4,34.14 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch'[^604-14] ahaṃ.  // ApThi_4,34.15 //  
Pacchime ca bhave dāni Giribbaja-puruttame /  
jātā seṭṭhikule phīte mahāratanasañcaye.  // ApThi_4,34.16 //  
Putto[^604-15] Sigālako[^604-16] nāma mat'; āsīvipathe rato[^604-17] /  
diṭṭhigahanapakkhanno[^604-18] disā pūjanatapparo  // ApThi_4,34.17 //  
Nānādisā namassantaṃ piṇḍāya nagaraṃ[^604-19] vajaṃ /  
taṃ disvā ovadī[^604-20] Buddho magge ṭhatvā vināyako.[^604-21]  // ApThi_4,34.18 //  
Tassa desayito[^604-22] dhammaṃ panādo[^604-23] visaye ahu[^604-24] /

uppanno lokapajjoto tilokasaraṇo jino.  // ApThi_4,39.3 //

vimuttacittaṃ kupitā bhikkhuniṃ abhisāpayiṃ[^613-7]  // ApThi_4,39.4 //

Dāruṇaṃ nirayaṃ gantvā mahādukkhasamappitā /  
tato cutā[^613-10] manussesu uppannā tapassinī.  // ApThi_4,39.6 //  
Dasa jātisahassāni gaṇikattaṃ[^613-11] akārayiṃ /  
taṃ pāpaṃ na vimuccissaṃ[^613-12] bhuttā duṭṭhavisaṃ[^613-13] yathā.  // ApThi_4,39.7 //  
Brahmaceram asevissaṃ[^613-14] Kassape jinasāsane /  
tena kammavipākena ajāyiṃ Tidase pure.  // ApThi_4,39.8 //  
Pacchime bhavasampatte[^613-15] ahosiṃ opapātikā /  
ambasākh'; antare jātā Ambapālī ti[^613-16] ten'; ahaṃ.  // ApThi_4,39.9 //  
Parivutā pāṇakoṭīhi[^613-17] pabbajiṃ jinasāsane /  
pattā 'haṃ[^613-18] acalaṭṭhānaṃ[^613-19] dhītā Buddhassa orasā.  // ApThi_4,39.10 //  
Iddhīsu ca vasī homi sotadhātuvisuddhiyā /  
cetopariyañāṇassa vasī homi mahāmuni.[^613-20]  // ApThi_4,39.11 //  
Pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ[^613-21] /  
sabbāsavā parikkhīṇā n'; atthi dāni punabbhavo.  // ApThi_4,39.12 //  
Atthadhammaniruttīsu paṭibhāne tath'; eva ca /  
ñāṇam me vipulaṃ suddhaṃ Buddhaseṭṭhassa vāhasā  // ApThi_4,39.13 //


<!-- PTS Page 614 -->
<a id="page-614"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 614]*

Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApThi_4,39.14 //  
Sāgataṃ . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApThi_4,39.15 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApThi_4,39.16 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ Ambapālī[^614-1] bhikkhunī i. g. a-ti. *Ambapālī-bhikkhuniyā apadānaṃ samattaṃ.*

[40. Selā.] Imamhi bhaddake kappe brahmabandhu mahāyaso /  
Kassapo nāma nāmena uppajji vadatam[^614-2] varo.  // ApThi_4,40.1 //  
Sāvatthiyaṃ puravare upāsakakule ahaṃ /  
pasutā taṃ[^614-3] jinavaraṃ disvā sutvā ca desanaṃ /  
taṃ vīraṃ saraṇaṃ gantvā sīlāni ca samādayiṃ.  // ApThi_4,40.2 //  
Kadāci so mahāvīro mahājanasamāgame /  
attano abhisambodhiṃ[^614-4] pakāsesi narāsabho /  
ananussutadhammesu[^614-5] pubbe[^614-6] dukkhādikesu ca.  // ApThi_4,40.3 //  
Cakkhuñāṇañ ca paññā ca vijjālokā ca āsi me /  
taṃ sutvā uggahetvā ca paripucchiñ[^614-7] ca bhikkhavo.  // ApThi_4,40.4 //  
Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca /  
jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch'; ahaṃ  // ApThi_4,40.5 //  
Pacchime ca bhave dāni jātā seṭṭhi-mahākule /  
upecca Buddhasaddhammaṃ[^614-8] *sutvā* saccupasaṃhitaṃ  // ApThi_4,40.6 //  
Pabbajitvāciren'; eva saccatthāni[^614-9] vicintayaṃ /  
khepetvā āsave sabbe arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.  // ApThi_4,40.7 //  
Iddhīsu ca vasī homi dibbāya sotadhātuyā /  
cetopariyañāṇassa vasī homi mahāmuṇe  // ApThi_4,40.8 //  
Pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ /  
sabbāsavā parikkhīṇā n'; atthi dāni punabbhavo.  // ApThi_4,40.9 //  
Atthadhammaniruttīsu paṭibhāne tath'; eva ca /  
ñāṇaṃ me vipulaṃ suddhaṃ[^614-10] Buddhaseṭṭhassa vāhasā.  // ApThi_4,40.10 //  
Kilesā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApThi_4,40.11 //


<!-- PTS Page 615 -->
<a id="page-615"></a>

##### *[PTS Page 615]*

Sāgataṃ[^615-1] . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApThi_4,40.12 //  
Paṭisambhidā . . . pe . . . pe . . . pe . . .  // ApThi_4,40.13 //  
Itthaṃ sudaṃ Selā[^615-2] bhikkhunī i. g. a-ti. Seḷā-bhikkhuniyā apadānaṃ samattaṃ. Uddānaṃ: Khattiyā brāhmaṇī c'; eva tathā Uppaladāyikā[^615-3] Sigālamātā[^615-4] Sukkā ca Abhirūpā Aḍḍhakāsikā[^615-5] gaṇikā c'; eva Puṇṇā ca Ambapālī ca[^615-6] bhikkhunī ti. Niṭṭhitaṃ Apadānaṃ.
